en|La fille qui est devenue un Démon de: The girl who became a Blood Demon for love.
en|Il y a de nombreuses années, Carmilla: Many years ago, Carmilla was born in Ansaac House in Aberleen Castle. As the Count's only daughter, she was loved by her entire family since birth. When she grew up, her distinguished family background coupled with her captivating beauty made her one of the most popular noble ladies in Aberleen Castle, and perhaps even in the entire Empire. However, her royal origin was inevitably linked to tragedy and would become a political tool of her father, Count Anssac, consolidating power by betrothing her to another powerful family.
en|Bien que d'innombrables aristocrates: Although countless aristocrats tried to woo Carmilla, none of them pleased her. Her innate pride made her refuse to bow to mediocrity. What she wanted was someone who could connect with her soul. But his father, Earl Ansaac, had already made up his mind. As the threat of the Abyss grew closer, he knew that the new class of military nobles would dominate the country's politics. Thus, he had to establish good relationships with them in order to maintain his family's social status. However, a rather insignificant man in the eyes of the old count foiled this plan. This man was Cecilion, the best opera singer in the Southern Empire. Carmilla has become his most loyal audience since the first day he came to Aberleen Castle. In Carmilla's eyes, he was so elegant and talented, but she could also see the melancholy and mystery in his eyes. For each performance of Cecilion, Carmilla would sit in the right middle of the auditorium, quietly enjoying the performance of her song.
en|Un jour, alors que les rideaux s'appe: One day, as the curtains were calling, Cecilion and Carmilla's eyes met. The flames of passion ignited between them. And like a bolt of lightning splitting the dark night sky, they instantly fell in love.
en|Les jours qui suivirent furent les pl: The days that followed were the happiest of Carmilla's life. At nightfall, Cécile got dressed and came to invite him to the opera, singing songs he had composed for her. And Carmilla watched his performance intently, never taking her eyes off him. At the end of the show, they met backstage, dancing in the moonlight. And early in the morning, Cecilion placed a rose on Carmilla's windowsill, nourished by the morning dew, and quietly left.
en|Au fil du temps, Carmilla remarqua qu: As time passed, Carmilla noticed something unusual about Cecilion. He lived in solitude and never had unnecessary contact with others. His skin was always pale, even when he didn't wear makeup; and it seemed like he was always trying to avoid something. In his eyes, Carmilla could sense his desire for a normal life, and she could vaguely see that Cecilion might have a connection to the legendary blood demon species. Although Cecilion never told him about his origins, she still chose to believe in him, because she felt his love was real. It didn't matter if he was a man or a blood demon, it was just a matter of love between them, and Carmilla believed that she would always belong to Cecilion and spend the rest of her life with him.
en|Bien qu’ils s’aimaient si profondémen: Although they loved each other so deeply, Carmilla's father, the Earl, forbade her from marrying this humble singer. He imprisoned her and forced her to marry Baron Tawil, general of the imperial army, stationed near Aberleen Castle. In order to make Carmilla forget about Cecilion, the count even sent his men to close the opera house. In Cecilion's mind, he knew that the love between the blood demon and humanity would never be true. Even though he loved Carmilla, he ultimately decided to give up. The day he left, he wrote her a letter in which he told her everything, his origins, his story, and left her with a rose on her window sill.
en|Carmilla n'a pas arrêté de se battre,: Carmilla didn't stop fighting, she wasn't ready to succumb to her father's will. But his heart broke when he read his farewell letter. To Carmilla, it didn't matter what species he belonged to. She loved him and without him her life would no longer have meaning.
en|Elle se tenait à la fenêtre, regardan: She stood at the window, looking in the direction Cecilion was going. As dawn broke, she slit her wrist with a sharp dagger. The world fell into endless darkness. And Carmilla buried her love in her own way.
en|Lorsque Carmilla se réveilla, elle se: When Carmilla woke up, she found herself in Cecilion's arms again. His eyes were full of kindness and he looked at her. Then she discovered that his touch was so cold, as if she were lifeless, and that her skin was as pale as Cecilion's. She knew it, her lover did not abandon her, he came back and revived her with his blood. These two lonely souls were finally together again and could live together forever.
en|Après ce jour, les habitants du châte: After that day, the people of Aberleen Castle never saw Cecilion or Carmilla again, only the legendary tales of the night, which passed from mouth to mouth over time. When night came, Carmilla snuggled into Cecilion's arms above the upper tower of Aberleen Castle, as if time had stood still.
en|Elle pourrait être basée sur Carmilla: It may be based on Carmilla, an 1872 Gothic short story written by Sheridan Le Fanu and also one of the first works of vampire fiction.
en|Sa compétence ultime \"Curse of Blood: His ultimate skill "Curse of Blood" is the first skill to bind enemies by spreading damage and crowd control effects.
en|Sa citation : « Celui qui a écrit mes: His quote: “Whoever wrote my lines is an endless bastard. » is the first canon quote that includes profanity.
en|Son skin épique \"Astral Arcana\" est: His epic skin "Astral Arcana" is his only skin that does not have an equivalent with Cecilion.
en|Au début du développement, Carmilla é: Early in development, Carmilla was designed as a mage, similar to Alice, with abilities focused on damage and life loss.
en|Le design final de Carmilla ressemble: Carmilla's final design resembles a noble vampire, but early concept art made her look more like a ghostly spirit.
en|Sa voix \"N'entrez pas doucement dans: His voice "Don't go gentle into that good night" is a reference to the poem of the same title written by a Welsh poet named Dylan Thomas.
en|Carmilla partage son doubleur en japo: Carmilla shares her Japanese voice actor, Takada Sakie, with her fellow Moniyan heroes, Lesley and Silvanna.
en|Il y a de nombreuses années, assister: Many years ago, attending the nightly opera performed by Cecilion was the most popular form of entertainment for the people of Avalor. The theater was always full every time this famous Opera actor performed. Everyone was attracted by her indescribable beauty and talent. However, the applause, love and cheers of human beings did not make Cecilion happy. He was a Blood Demon, and it was difficult for him to open his mind to humans. He had always tried to hide his true identity and blend into human society.
en|D'aussi loin que Cecilion s'en souvie: For as long as Cecilion can remember, her species has lived far from human beings. Lord Lava's oppression of the Blood Demons meant a dark future for them. So, some demons decided to leave the Place of Despair and came to live among humans. They were eager to ask the God of Light for forgiveness, live normally, and integrate into human society. But the fact was that they not only suffered from the hostility of human society, but they were also hunted by the Abyss. When Cecilion became an adult, he was the only one left of his kind.
en|Afin de cacher sa véritable identité,: In order to hide his true identity, Cecilion lived in Avalor as an opera actor and attempted to conceal all abilities and characteristics related to the Blood Demons. He looked magnificent and elegant on stage, surrounded by thousands of enthusiasts. But at night, Cecilion spent his nights alone, night after night.
en|Les journées solitaires ont continué,: The lonely days continued, but that was until Cecilion gave an unforgettable performance. When he walked to the center of the stage to bow, he saw Carmilla. And this beautiful lady was looking at him too. In that moment, the two lonely souls instantly fell in love.
en|Bien que Cecilion se soit toujours mi: Although Cecilion always warned himself against unnecessary contact with human beings, he could not resist his love for Carmilla. So, faced with love, he decided to follow his heart. At each of her performances, Cecilion sang a song for Carmilla and they never stopped looking into each other's eyes. When speaking about her past, Carmilla chose to keep it a secret. Even when Carmilla had doubts about his lifestyle, he still said nothing. However, they swore to be faithful to each other.
en|À mesure que les flammes de l’amour d: As the flames of love grew stronger, unbeknownst to others, they met more frequently. But Carmilla's father, Earl Ansaac, knew everything they were doing. In his eyes, Earl saw Cecilion as nothing more than a humble opera actor. He thought Carmilla should marry a more powerful man. When this couple's love deepened, Earl Ansaac violently interrupted the relationship between the two, imprisoned Carmilla, sealed the Opera House, and exiled Cecilion.
en|Peu de temps après, une rumeur circul: Soon after, a rumor circulated that Count Ansaac was about to marry his only daughter, Carmilla, to Baron Tawil, a general in the Imperial Army. At that moment, Cecilion was so tempted to overthrow the guards and take Carmilla away. However, he knew he couldn't bring her happiness because she would become a fugitive on the run. After much thought, he realized that the love between a blood demon and a human could never be true and he thought it best to give up.
en|La nuit touchait à sa fin et, à l'aub: The night was drawing to a close, and at dawn Carmilla was to marry Baron Tawil. But before the first light of dawn, Cecilion placed a rose and a letter with her name in Carmilla's window and turned away. But what Cecilion didn't know was that his strange lifestyle wasn't important to Carmilla and she didn't care whether he was a blood demon or a human. She loved Cecilion for who he was. After donning the white wedding dress, Carmilla cut her wrist with a sharp dagger, losing her life to her lover, Cecilion.
en|Abandonner Carmilla rendit Cecilion t: Abandoning Carmilla made Cecilion terribly sad and his life seemed to return to what it had been. After two lonely nights, Cecilion went to see Carmilla, from afar.
en|Mais quand Cecilion est arrivé, il a: But when Cecilion arrived, he found Carmilla's cold corpse, motionless in a solemn burial. For a moment, looking at Carmilla's cold skin, Cecilion felt only pain and regret, flowing vaguely into his chest. How could he live without Carmilla? As the new moon rose, Cecilion spread his wings and swept across the city in the cold night, carrying his love with him. He then resurrected Carmilla, using his own blood; but this kind of power comes at a price. And thus, Carmilla was also forever transformed into a blood demon. To protect this eternal love, Cecilion decided that he would never let anyone separate them.
en|Après ce jour, les habitants du châte: After that day, the people of Aberleen Castle never saw Cecilion or Carmilla again. Only the legend of the night, which has passed from mouth to mouth over time. It is said that when night came, Carmilla snuggled into Cecilion's arms above the upper tower of Aberleen Castle, as if time had stood still.
en|Au fil du temps, leur lien s'est renf: Over time, their bond grew stronger and Cecilion realized that being a blood demon made no difference to Carmilla. She loved him for who he was and would always remain her beloved. However, the betrayal of the Blood Demons and the hatred of humans forced Cecilion and Carmilla to choose a path, that of turning their backs on their past. Endless vagrancy and wandering awaited them, but at least they were destined to stay together, wherever they went.
en|Depuis sa jeunesse, Cecilion avait to: Since his youth, Cecilion had always chosen to hide behind the darkness and stay away from the crowd. Leaving all the cheers, chants and popularity behind, the fame of yesteryear seemed unusually meaningless. His identity as a Blood Demon had constantly prevented him from opening his mind to humans. But now, he had decided to share each of his secrets with the one he loved. Running away with Carmilla meant that his identity, which he had tried so hard to hide, was at risk of being revealed. What was left was a life of flight, both from humans and from Abyssal demons. Cecilion, who had already tolerated much throughout his life, could no longer accept any oppression, determined to no longer remain silent in times of crisis. He had begged for forgiveness from the Lord of Light, however, faced with those who were about to kill him and his lover, Cecilion would certainly worship the pool of blood with them.
en|Chaque détail de leur vie incarnait l: Every detail of their lives embodied their love. With love, Cecilion believed he could endure anything and everything. To prevent Carmilla's father, Earl Ansaac, from discovering the truth about their deep love and to avoid interference from the Abyssal Demons, they had to disguise themselves as ordinary humans and integrate into human society. However, accidents happen. Once, due to unavoidable circumstances, their identities were discovered and Cecilion had to kill everyone who knew the truth. It is believed that once Cecilion unleashes his true Blood Demon power, no one, whether Abyssal Demons or humans, could even dream of escaping.
en|Cecilion est le seul héros dont les c: Cecilion is the only hero whose skills scale with magic power and mana.
en|Le skin Starlight \"Stargazer\" et le: Cecilion's Starlight skin "Stargazer" and collector's skin "Crimson Wings" are the only skins that do not have an equivalent in Carmilla.
en|Disciple coquin et mignon du Grand Dr: Naughty and cute disciple of the Great Dragon.
en|Chang'e est la plus jeune disciple du: Chang'e is the Great Dragon's youngest disciple and from a young age, she has demonstrated incredible magical potential, quickly mastering the Great Dragon's greatest spell: the Sacred Satellite. From then on, Chang'e won the eternal love of the Great Dragon. However, Chang'e had an energetic and cheerful personality that gave the Great Dragon quite a few headaches.
en|Chaque fois que le Grand Dragon profi: Every time the Great Dragon enjoyed a peaceful afternoon, he would most likely smell the rotten stench of trouble and soon enough, some of the servants of the Sanctuary would run up to him, only to tell him that Chang'e had once again gotten into some mischief, either by breaking an ancient vase, very dear to the Great Dragon's collection, or running around with his jade rabbit, making a mess of everything in his path.
en|Finalement, il réalisa que ses vieux: Eventually, he realized that his old bones would be trampled in all this ruckus and asked Zilong, his adopted son, to look after Chang'e. The Great Dragon knew that only Zilong's patience could handle Chang'e and also hoped that Zilong's diligent and determined character could help guide Chang'e.
en|Zilong en est venu à aimer le petit c: Zilong came to love the dynamic and intelligent little rascal, Chang'e. They often spent countless hours together, practicing magic and finding divine creatures to play with and Zilong would occasionally play silly games with her, even if it meant a complete waste of time, for Zilong. Chang'e also enjoyed spending time with his older brother, Zilong. To make things productive, Zilong started teaching him the art of Kung Fu and other things like meditation and archery. However, Chang'e's favorite part of the day was the end of practice, when Zilong carried her on his back on the way home.
en|Au cours de la Seconde Guerre des Pla: During the Second War of the Planes, Zilong was ordered to aid the wise rulers of the land, traveling between the Land of Dawn. After she left, Chang'e returned to her naughty and childish ways. At one point, the Great Dragon was unsure if there would ever be another day of peace, until something big happened and the servants rushed to him. Chang'e had swallowed all of his Holy Immortality Pills by accident, thinking they were candy. The Great Dragon was furious, transforming into his dragon form, he frightened Chang'e and immediately chased Chang'e from her sanctuary, ordering her to travel to the Planes, aid Zilong and atone for her mistakes, before she could return to Sanctuary.
en|Même alors, le Grand Dragon se sentit: Even then, the Great Dragon felt compelled to give Chang'e, his precious crescent moon, to protect her. Letting Chang'e go brought peace to the Great Dragon, but not happiness. He hoped she wouldn't consider him too cold and hate him forever. However, Chang'e was excited to venture into the Land of Dawn, which she saw as a place filled with many new things. But above all, she couldn't wait to see her big brother, Zilong, again.
en|Chang'e (嫦娥) est basée sur la déesse: Chang'e (嫦娥) is based on the moon goddess of Chinese mythology, in which she is the subject of several legends. The large crescent moon halo she rides on is proof of this.
en|Dans le zodiaque chinois, le Lapin (兔: In the Chinese zodiac, the Rabbit (兔) is the fourth in the 12-year cycle of animals that appear in the Chinese zodiac linked to the Chinese calendar. These are the Lapin years in the 20th and 21st centuries: 1903, 1915, 1927, 1939, 1951, 1963, 1975, 1987, 1999, 2011, 2023, 2035, 2047, 2059, 2071, 2083 and 2095.
en|Le compagnon lapin de Chang'e s'appel: Chang'e's rabbit companion is named Jade.
en|En raison d'un bug, sa première compé: Due to a bug, his first skill before rework was able to deal damage to turrets.
en|Dans l'une de ses citations, Chang'e: In one of his quotes, Chang'e mentions name = Roger when addressing his fellow rabbits; this is a reference to its wolf form, since wolves are known to prey on many animals, including rabbits. This hostile relationship is one of the most popular relationships in fiction.
en|Son rire qui peut être entendu lors d: His laugh that can be heard during hero selection for Crimson Moon was reused from his old hero selection quote.
en|Un renard insouciant et génétiquement: A carefree, genetically enhanced fox who uses advanced portal technology.

A carefree, genetically enhanced fox who uses advanced portal technology, Chip was once a little fox just trying to survive in the harsh wastes of Agelta. By chance, he was found by Dr. Baker and brought to Laboratory 1718 where he was genetically enhanced with superior intelligence and tasked with testing the laboratory's portal technology. However, he was always lazy by nature and just wanted to enjoy a carefree life. When an inner power struggle took place in the secret laboratory, Chip's life was turned upside down and he was forced to make a difficult decision. To be able to return to his carefree life, he had to work hard one last time... ===Dear Dr. Baker=== The laid-back Chip only wants to enjoy a carefree and peaceful fox life, but the problems keep coming. Once again, Chip's dream of a relaxed existence is disrupted. How can he escape these troubles and embrace a life of leisure?
en|Vous devez être choqué que moi, le Ch: You must be shocked that I, the happy-go-lucky Chip, ever wrote a letter, right?
en|Après tout, normalement, je me conten: After all, normally I just lie in my flying chair and snack on chips all day. But I can't do this anymore, my old friend, because your indecision has interfered with my carefree life, which is why we need to have a long talk.
en|Il était une fois, avant de vous renc: Once upon a time, before I met you, I was just an ordinary little fox, no different from the thousands of other foxes in Agelta. I slept every day in my burrow under the sand and foraged for food when necessary, until one day I came across a bag of half-eaten chips kindly left by a traveler.
en|Mon monde n’a plus jamais été le même: My world was never the same after that. This unique taste and crispy texture was surely the pinnacle of human ingenuity, I thought; their miracle for the world of flea-free peasants.
en|Après cette expérience divine, j’ai a: After this divine experience, I waited day after day along the trade routes, but never had the opportunity to taste this golden delight again. I even stole potatoes from a village and was almost mauled by their mangy dogs, but what are potatoes compared to chips! Alas, the gods did not send a second bag of chips, but a calamity: an earthquake threatening to collapse my burrow. I didn't panic like the rest of my loved ones. I made the softest bed out of hay, put the empty chip bag over my head and was ready for whatever came next.
en|Mais il s'avère que vous passiez par: But it turns out that you happened to be walking past my burrow at that very moment. The sight of my calmness, or perhaps the bag on my head, must have piqued your curiosity, so you took me back to your laboratory. When I woke up, I discovered that I had been modified by your strange science. I had acquired extraordinary intelligence and was soon tasked with testing the laboratory's portal technology.
en|J'étais tellement naïf à l'époque. Le: I was so naive back then. The great Dr. Baker had granted this little fox the opportunity to get his own chips! From that day on, I became a being of higher intelligence, I called myself “Chip,” and I was free to enjoy all my life chips that I could reach from anywhere. Surely the portal I was testing was meant to reach the snack locker while lounging around the house, right? I was grateful, Dr. Baker.
en|Mais si seulement les choses étaient: But if only things were that simple. You later informed me that in addition to eating chips, we smart "scholars" also have to do endless scientific research, record experimental data, assemble robots, and even catch those slimy energy jellyfish in the sea around the island. In other words… work. What a terrible concept! Wasting my life, that’s what it is! I was devastated by this revelation and from that point on all I could do at work was find ways to relax and eat chips. I know you blame yourself, thinking it was an error in your calculations that made me so lazy... but you're wrong. I've always been lazy.
en|Ne vous fâchez pas, j'ai fini mon dis: Don't be angry, I finished my speech. What follows is just an account of a few events.
en|Peu de temps après, le Dr Octavius ​​: Soon after, Dr. Octavius ​​became the new head of the laboratory. He transformed it into a weapons factory and used your technology intended for the benefit of the world to manufacture weapons of war and sell them to Los Pecados. At that moment you couldn't accept what was happening and you ran away. I originally thought you were taking a break from the island, but it turns out you were secretly working on an android, Angela!
en|Une fois qu'Octavius ​​​​l'a découver: Once Octavius ​​discovered it, he made us all work overtime to develop an even better android; to surpass you, he wanted to mass produce weapons equipped with artificial souls. The workload for all of us increased tenfold...we worked from dawn to dusk, without a single break to enjoy even a single chip. This is not a working condition for man or fox. I couldn't take this for another second, so I was forced to do something drastic.
en|J'ai pris l'initiative et me suis por: I took the initiative and volunteered to lead the search and recovery team for you. I used the portals to find your residence and brought you back. I hope you're not too angry. It's not that the chips are more important than you, but I had to bring you back so everyone could finally get a break.
en|Quoi qu'il en soit, vous avez été cap: Anyway, you were captured and brought back to the lab, but Angela escaped. You were so worried about her that you fell into a depression, while I received a hundred bags of original flavored chips as a bonus. But life likes to play cruel tricks on us, as I have learned. That damn Octave gave me a promotion and a raise, but above all gave me even more work and responsibilities!
en|Ce cauchemar finira-t-il un jour ? Je: Will this nightmare ever end? I want to retire with my stash of chips!
en|Alors, tu dois te remettre sur pied,: So you need to get back on your feet, my friend. Think of those who suffer from war, the victims of the weapons manufactured in this laboratory and the poor little fox forced to work overtime! Listen, I'm going to help you regain control of your laboratory. I thought it didn't matter who ran this lab as long as it wasn't me, but now I know it has to be you! Otherwise, people will expect me to work!
en|Quant à ta \"fille\" Angela, ne t'inq: As for your "daughter" Angela, don't worry, I will find her and bring her back but promise you will keep her away from me. She forced me to wear a frilly pink dress the last time we met... Truly one of your most terrifying creations.
en|En conclusion, ressaisissez-vous, Dr: In conclusion, pull yourself together, Dr. Baker! I know your technology will bring joy to all living creatures, and I should be first on that list! I can already see the golden beaches of the Agelta coast. I hid all my chips there, waiting for this day.
en|Une dernière chose. Vous ne pensiez p: One last thing. You didn't think I wrote that letter myself, did you? I hope the ChipBot AI program I developed did a good job conveying my thoughts... or the thoughts the real Chip should have according to my algorithm... Whatever. If you miss me, just contact ChipBot.
en|Bien qu'il réponde seulement qu'il n': Although he only responds that he is not on duty.
en|Chip possède une compétence passive u: Chip has a unique passive skill that allows him to eat chips outside of combat, regenerating his HP to 150. Health regeneration increases by 15% once he takes at least five consecutive bites.
en|Il a le numéro d'étiquette. 5 sur son: It has the tag number. 5 on his ear, implying that other foxes or animals of different species were tested or improved before Chip.
en|La saveur des chips change selon les: The flavor of the chips changes depending on the skin.
en|Un combattant talentueux avec un cœur: A talented fighter with a heart of chivalry.
en|Chou est né dans un bidonville isolé: Chou was born in an isolated slum in the heart of poverty, living the lowest quality of life. Despite the terrible conditions, Chou kept his heart of kindness, while continuing to care for the old and young with passion day after day. During this period there was great unrest and unrest in the Land of Dawn; chaos spread throughout the country and eventually began to affect this small, isolated area.
en|Un jour, Chou a sauvé un moine mystiq: One day, Chou rescued a mystical monk being chased by his captors and brought him back to his slum to take care of him. In return, the monk passed on to Chou the ancient Asian skill of Kung Fu and told him that the world needed a true hero to rise up and end the chaos. Chou then made a vow to begin his journey to the Land of Dawn to become a true hero without looking back. As Chou left, the monk nodded and disappeared into the shadows.
en|Le design de Chou est fortement basé: Chou's design is heavily based on Bruce Lee.
en|Sa capacité ultime, La Voie du Dragon: His ultimate ability, Way of the Dragon, is a direct reference to the 1972 film starring Bruce Lee.
en|Ses citations « L'homme qui peut me b: His quotes “The man who can beat me is not yet born”, “Empty your cup to fill it again”, “Knowing is not enough, we must apply” are the famous Bruce Lee quotes. The last quote is also said by Goethe.
en|Le Jeet Kune Do est un art martial cé: Jeet Kune Do is a famous martial art developed by Bruce Lee.
en|Shunpo (瞬歩) est un mot signifiant éta: Shunpo (瞬歩) is a word meaning quick steps.
en|Sa citation \"Dans le monde du Kungfu: His quote “In the world of Kungfu, speed defines the winner.” is a direct quote from The Beast in the 2004 film Kung Fu Hustle.
en|Le nom « Chou » (周) se trouve couramm: The name "Chou" (周) is commonly found in Chinese and East Asian names and could mean "cycle" or "universe" in Chinese.
en|Son Ultime (La Voie du Dragon) est l': His Ultimate (Way of the Dragon) is one of the few non-tank skills capable of suppressing enemies, making it deadly for isolating carries.
en|Il est l'un des héros possédant le pl: He is one of the heroes with the most skins.
en|Il est le premier héros à recevoir pl: He is the first hero to receive more than one collaboration which is the King of Fighters - Iori Yagami and Saint Seiya - Shiryu.
en|Avant son remodelage, son skin par dé: Before his remodel, his default skin was based on Hong Kong martial artist Bruce Lee.
en|Chou est le quatrième héros à recevoi: Chou is the fourth hero to receive an exclusive M Series champion skin when ECHO Philippines won the M4 World Championship. Other heroes with the M-Series skin include Harith, Lancelot, Estes, Brody, and Joy.
en|Une artiste joyeuse qui répand du pla: A joyful artist who spreads fun and wonder wherever she goes.
en|name=Yoyo Une artiste joyeuse qui rép: name=Yoyo A joyful artist who spreads fun and wonder wherever she goes. Cici, the lead actor of the Whimsical Wonders theater troupe, accompanied by her magical companion Yoyo, began their annual tour. She chose Aberleen Castle, the town where her aunt was once called the Queen of Revelry, as her first destination. But upon arrival, Cici discovered that the town had banned unauthorized performances of any kind, especially folkloric performances, and that her aunt had been exiled when the law was enacted. Intrepid, she decided to bring pleasure and wonder back to the city. Inspired by his spirit, the long-muted artists of Aberleen Castle emerged from the shadows and took part in the most magnificent spectacle the castle has ever seen. === Opening Night === Why did 16-year-old Cici choose Castle Aberleen for her show tour? The place screams “No Entertainment Allowed,” but why? Cici appears to have a complex connection with Aberleen. Hit the link below to dig deeper into Cici's story!
en|Voici la star éblouissante du spectac: Here is the dazzling star of the show! Oh, how hypnotized I am once again! Let us welcome the young girl who frolics in the clouds, on the roofs and in the middle of the meadows. From his hands, Yoyo, his spinning companion, is launched high into the sky, igniting a celestial firework that floods the sky and paints every eye with wonder.
en|\"Maintenant, donnons un tonnerre d'a: "Now let's give a round of applause to say goodbye to Miss Cici of the Fantasy Wonder Troops!"
en|Notre interprète chérie est sur le po: Our beloved performer is about to embark on her annual performance tour, destined to illuminate another city with her dazzling light!

Legend has it that the founder of the troupe, Madame Mimi, who is also Miss Cici's aunt, made her reputation there and left with great grandeur while leaving behind her an influence that will last as long as possible. Aberleen Castle has since been plunged into silence, a testimony to its genius, with no one daring to desecrate its glory with folklore shows.

Furthermore, the lord of your own city has given a bad order, forcing your soldiers to search the empty river banks.

Behind him was a troupe of artists marching in step. Like him, they were old but had clear and melodious voices. Their songs brilliantly broke the silence that had reigned for decades at Aberleen Castle.

en|En chinois, le nom officiel hanzi de: In Chinese, Cici's official hanzi name, "茜茜", which has no meaning and is used to transliterate foreign names, is a homophone of the word "嘻嘻" meaning "laughter" or "laughter", which matches her cheerful nature. His fighting style also has Wushu (Chinese martial arts) influences, reinforcing this connection.
en|Il est possible que son nom soit une: It is possible that her name is a shortened form of "Cecilia". The name is a feminine form of "Caecilius" derived from the Latin word "Caecus" meaning "Blind", but it more likely derives from Saint Cecilia, the patroness of music.
en|Elle devait initialement sortir le 23: It was originally scheduled to release on December 23, but due to a gameplay issue, they decided to move its release date to December 27.
en|Contrairement aux autres combattants: Unlike other fighters who use common weapons, Cici uses a yo-yo, allowing her to attack while moving, improving her kiting abilities and sustained damage.
en|Ses compétences imitent de vraies tec: Her skills mimic real yo-yo techniques like looping, bouncing, and spinning. The way she controls her yo-yo reflects the speed and skill required for real-life Yo-Yo tricks.
en|Contrairement à la plupart des combat: Unlike most fighters who rely on heavy single strikes, Cici focuses on quick strikes.

en|Claude est né à Los Pecados, une vill: Claude was born in Los Pecados, a western town in the Land of Dawn. An infamous city of sins, without ruler or order, lawless and ravaged by crime.
en|Ayant grandi dans un endroit tel qu'o: Growing up as an orphan, Claude quickly learned to fight, lie, gamble, and steal: tricks of the trade he had to rely on to survive. He was particularly talented in the latter area, and no purser he ever met matched him in his keen eye and nimble fingers.
en|Il ne fallut pas longtemps avant qu'i: It wasn't long before he became the leader of a band of wanderers, relying on his "skills" and making a name for himself in Los Pecados. He found one who would offer him and his gang protection: Waldo Kane. Kane had not yet obtained the Los Pecados monopoly he had dreamed of. Wild ambition and conspiracy brewed deep within him. For him, this motley band of homeless vagabonds was the perfect tool to achieve his goals. Behind a mask of kindness, he manipulated these children, with sweet lies and false compassion leading them down a dark path. He molded them to become members of his criminal group, with each wayward child calling him "Father."
en|À l'âge de 18 ans, Claude se voit con: At the age of 18, Claude is given a monumental task: travel to Grandrock Castle, north of Moniyan, and sneak into the Duke of Vance's house. Then he pretended to steal secret accounts, while blaming another gang. Kane promised Claude that people would be waiting for him once he got inside. Once his mission was accomplished, Claude and his team would be rewarded with housing of their own. They would no longer need to live in slums.
en|La vérité, cependant, n’était rien qu: The truth, however, was nothing Claude could have imagined. No one expected him: he was just a simple pawn, and neither he nor his brothers would receive any reward. Like Claude, they were only stepping stones for their “Father” to become king of Los Pecados.
en|Ainsi, lorsqu'il s'est glissé dans le: So when he slipped into the Duke's mansion, he found an unavoidable trap waiting for him. Claude could only accept his fate and was taken into police custody. Following a rushed trial, he was quickly found guilty of all charges and thrown into a cold, dark cell.
en|Enchaîné, Claude brûlait de regret. L: Chained, Claude burned with regret. The only thing in his mind that kept him going was his band of brothers, lost and with nowhere to go.
en|Les jours passaient lentement. Un jou: The days passed slowly. One day, Claude was forced to change cells, his new cell shared with an old man with a beard and snow-white hair. This particular old man was none other than the master thief of legend: Merlin. Merlin, powerful and incredibly resourceful, had a reason to be locked in a cell. One reason that left Claude speechless: he just wanted a quiet place to retire.
en|Le rusé Claude rappelait à Merlin son: The cunning Claude reminded Merlin of his younger self. He therefore decides to pass on his inheritance to her. Yet, in return, Claude would have to acquiesce to one of Merlin's strangest requests. Once released from prison, he must pillage every town in the Land of Dawn, leaving his name behind as his calling card.
en|Au cours des deux années qui suiviren: Over the next two years, Claude inherited every one of Merlin's wonderful techniques of deception, evasion, and combat, among others. His abilities grew until he was ready to steal anything he could imagine. One night, Claude put his perfect prison escape plan into action, stealing his freedom.
en|Pour tenir sa promesse, Claude voyage: To keep his promise, Claude traveled throughout the Land of Dawn over the next few years. The streets were bristling with whispers about the master thief Claude, his charm and his incredible talent. With his carefree smile, Claude was your man if you ever needed something stolen, no matter what. All he asked was that the pay be generous, and that the one from whom it was stolen should be evil.
en|Alors que cela continuait, Claude fut: As this continued, Claude was joined by the perfect partner: the mysterious Dexter. This mischievous little monkey first met Claude in Moniyan, when he stole a lucky gold coin right from under his nose. After a brief chase, their friendship blossomed and Claude took on Dexter as his partner in crime. And this is how their adventures began.
en|Au cours de la cinquième année de son: In the fifth year of his departure from Los Pecados, Claude finally kept the promise he made to Merlin. He had left his traces in every town in the Land of Dawn.
en|Ensuite, il retournerait à Los Pecado: Then he would return to Los Pecados. However, nothing could have prepared Claude for what he saw upon his return after his five years of absence. His brothers of old had not risen through the ranks of the underworld, had not escaped poverty thanks to their manipulative “Father”. No, a completely different fate had befallen them. Instead, he found that not only were there still pitiful street children on every corner of this dilapidated city, people like the Claude of the past; there were even more than before.
en|Claude avait été trompé et cela le me: Claude had been deceived and this sent him into a violent rage. He began to plan his revenge as she swirled within him. Waldo Kane had acquired his monopoly on the city, thus becoming the kingpin of Los Pecados. In order to take revenge, Claude slipped into Eruditio and, with Dexter's help, pretended to be captured, entering prison. He then stole Dr. Rooney's latest invention: a strange holographic mirror.
en|Satisfait de son succès, c'est alors: Satisfied with his success, it was then that Claude noticed a line of text on the device: "I hope this device serves you well. If you have any ideas or suggestions for improving it, contact me immediately!—Rooney."
en|Grâce à ce « cadeau » du Dr Rooney, C: Thanks to this "gift" from Dr. Rooney, Claude and Dexter created songs for Los Pecados. In this chaotic city of nefarious outlaw dealings, he would make the one who deceived him in the past pay the price.

en|Un tireur d'élite plein de droiture e: A sniper full of righteousness and justice.
en|Sur la frontière désolée de Moniyan,: On the desolate border of Moniyan, border with Agelta, there was an ordinary town. The people here lived a peaceful and stable life, far from the hustle and bustle of human society. They worked during the day and in the evening they went to the town tavern to have a few drinks to relax.
en|Une vie aussi ordonnée et stable étai: Such an orderly and stable life was thanks to Clint, the town sheriff. Clint was a famous fast shooter, blessed with unrivaled marksmanship, and was known for his fastest draw speed. The dedicated Clint always considered the safety of the city his duty. He loved his work and his duty and believed in the fairness and justice of the law. He hated evil as his enemy and had protected the city from all kinds of thieves and bandits for many years. This is why he was loved by the people of the city.
en|Lors d'une nuit ordinaire, Clint effe: On an ordinary night, Clint went about his daily patrol with his gun as usual. In the middle of his patrol, he suddenly heard gunshots and disgusting screams coming from the tavern. Clint instinctively knew that a group of uninvited guests had broken into the peaceful town.
en|Clint s'est immédiatement précipité v: Clint immediately rushed to the tavern, where a group of oddly dressed drunks were rampaging wildly. Many locals were beaten to death by them, while the tavern owner was shot dead by the gangster boss. Faced with Clint's warning, the gangsters were not afraid, but openly declared that the city would soon be taken by them and advised Clint not to get involved.
en|Ce que les gangsters ont fait a mis C: What the gangsters did made Clint angry, so he took out his gun and fought a fierce battle with them. Finally, except for one servant who escaped by chance, the rest of the gangsters were either killed by Clint's gun or lost their combat effectiveness and were captured without any resistance.
en|Le lendemain à midi, Clint emmena les: The next day at noon, Clint took the captured villains to the center of the city, preparing to give the criminals a just punishment as all the residents witnessed. The angry people also demanded that these foreigners be severely punished. But at that moment, the leader of the villains suddenly revealed his identity: it was Blandy, the nephew of Waldo Kane, the most powerful boss of Los Pecados. His men had fled to Los Pecados last night to deliver a message that if anything happened to him, his uncle would raze this little town to the ground for good and everyone would be buried with him.
en|Blandy venait de terminer ses paroles: Blandy had just finished his words, the angry crowd suddenly calmed down. They knew Sin City and Waldo Kane, and they knew their way of doing things better. Very quickly, the inhabitants hesitated. They advocated for Blandy's release and hoped that Blandy would "forget" his unpleasant experience in town.
en|Aux yeux de Clint, qui détestait le m: In the eyes of Clint, who hated evil the most, it was nothing more than a compromise to criminals and a trampling on justice. Despite opposition from the locals, he throws Blandy into prison and announces that he will hang him three days later to comfort the tavern owner who was shot by him.
en|Au bout de trois jours à peine, un gr: After just three days, a large number of gangsters had arrived on the outskirts of the city. They brought a lot of weapons, demanding that the locals immediately hand over Blandy to them and offer a large ransom as an apology.
en|La sécurité de la ville était grandem: The security of the city was greatly threatened by these criminals. Clint boldly came out and called on everyone to take up arms to fight the gangs and defend their homeland. But what Clint didn't expect was that the residents and colleagues he had tried to protect in the past had no plans to live and die with him. Instead, they blamed Clint for his stubbornness and inflexibility, which brought disaster to the city. After a hasty vote, the townspeople relieve Clint of his post as sheriff and run him out of town.
en|Les habitants ont ensuite relâché Bla: The locals then released Blandy and handed over a large ransom. But even so, the fierce Blandy still chose betrayal, leading the gangs to occupy the city and preparing to burn it down.
en|À ce moment-là, Clint avait porté ses: By then, Clint had carried his bags and walked away from town. However, as the fire in the small town rose into the sky, Clint couldn't ignore it. Even if the people he had protected with his life and blood betrayed him, the law of justice in his mind could not be erased by this, let alone stand by and watch the gangsters massacre the city. Even if he was alone, Clint would fight crime until the end.
en|Au moment où les gangsters détruisaie: At the time when the gangsters were unscrupulously destroying the city, Clint appeared in the city as if a soldier came from the sky. His invincible marksmanship and incredible drawing speed have become the most terrible nightmare of night criminals. After a fierce battle, Clint was marked and the gangsters also suffered heavy losses, protecting Blandy, who was injured by Clint, to escape.
en|Les habitants survivants ont réalisé: The surviving residents realized their mistakes and asked Clint for forgiveness, hoping that Clint would stay and protect the town.
en|Mais Clint se contenta de sourire et: But Clint just smiled and didn't answer. That night, Clint got on his old donkey, quietly left town and headed to Sin City.
en|Il savait que s’il n’allait pas trouv: He knew that if he didn't go find Kane, Kane would come find him.
en|Clint a été le tout premier héros à ê: Clint was the very first hero to be reworked. He's also the only one whose rework was aimed at nerfing him, as he was meant to be "a sniper good at stinging and consuming enemies from a distance, rather than a hero who charges in and deals damage to crowds like an assassin" (see Patch Notes 1.1.50).

en|Le nom de Clint fait probablement réf: The name Clint likely refers to Clint Eastwood, known for starring in and directing Western-style films and television series.
en|Bien qu'il soit de par sa conception: Although it is by design a double-barreled shotgun, it behaves like a shotgun that fires in a straight line, instead of splaying like a typical shotgun.
en|Avant sa refonte, son nom = Blind Smo: Before its rework, its name=Blind Smoke is the first and only skill in the game that can blind enemies, which would reduce the enemies' name=basic attack success rate. After its overhaul, this mechanic was completely removed from the game.
en|Son nom = Grenade Bombardement est l': Its name = Grenade Bombardment is one of the rare skills in the game that can stack uses.
en|Le skin Valentine de Clint fait spéci: Clint's Valentine skin specifically references American hard rock band Guns N' Roses and Slash.
en|Clint fait partie des héros qui n'ont: Clint is one of the heroes who does not have a base skin. In the Chinese version of the game, he had an exclusive base skin randomly named "Rose Gunslinger" or "Rose Gun Hero".
en|Il est le premier héros à avoir 2 typ: He is the first hero to have 2 types = Starlight: "Rock and Roll" and "Operator CL".
en|Son spécial \"Badminton Champion\" re: His special "Badminton Champion" resembles Alucard's pre-revamped base skin "Lone Hero" from 2016-2018.
en|Il partage le même doubleur japonais: He shares the same Japanese voice actor with Roger, Tsuyuzaki Wataru.

A celestial traveler in the universe.
en|À l'extrême est du Pays de l'Aube, se: In the far east of the Land of Dawn lies the uncharted Land of Giants, home to Cyclops, a one-eyed giant dwarf with a surprisingly small figure. As Cyclops grew he proved to be very different from the other giants, not only was he small in size but he was also unique. As such, unlike the other Giants, he couldn't really rely on brute strength.
en|Cependant, Cyclope était obsédé par l: However, Cyclops was obsessed with the stars and the sky since he was little. He looked at the sky day and night and, as a result, he discovered the truth: the planets were always in orbital motion. And he also realized that these kinds of movements contained incredible magical power. Equipped with an hourglass to charge and control this type of power, he became the famous "Starsoul Magician" of his homeland, granting him the ability to travel between space. The planetary movement would never stop, thus making Cyclops extremely powerful and invincible. Unfortunately, this realization made him feel quite alone.
en|Un jour, lors d'un voyage spatial de: One day, during Cyclops' space travel, he arrived in the Land of Dawn and found, to his surprise, that there were many powerful adversaries waiting for him to be defeated. Cyclops believed that wherever he went and what he saw, he would overcome. With the powerful magical powers of the planetary movement at his side, Cyclops ventured into the Land of Dawn, deciding that he would bring down his name as one of the greatest heroes who ever lived.

en|Cyclope doit son nom aux géants borgn: Cyclops owes his name to the one-eyed giants of Greek mythology.
en|Le terme « nain-géant » est une descr: The term "dwarf-giant" is a size description used in astronomy to describe the size of a star. “Dwarf-Giant” refers to a star that is small compared to a normal star. This term can be used metaphorically to describe Cyclops as a dwarf, indicating that he is short compared to a normal Cyclops.
en|L'objet \"Énergie concentrée\" était: The item "Focused Energy" was once linked to Cyclops lore. In his splash art, you can see Cyclops holding this swirling energy, which is actually a gem causing destruction. After sealing it, the gem is now contained and called "Focused Energy".
en|Il est le seul mage de la MLBB qui ne: He is the only mage in MLBB that does not rely on mana management, as his passive reduces cooldowns instead of using energy.
en|Ses noms de compétences (Stardust Sho: His skill names (Stardust Shock, Planets Attack, Star Power Lockdown) all relate to space and celestial bodies.
en|L'érudit hibou qui peut contrôler le: The owl scholar who can control the weather.
en|On sait que des érudits et des penseu: It is known that scholars and thinkers from all over the world are finally coming together in the city of Antoinerei. This is where the often overlooked Diggie lives. Many don't take five seconds to turn to Diggie because of his small size, until they come across his research in chronoscience. Diggie loves clocks, he thinks these little mechanical toys hide many more secrets yet to be discovered.
en|Grâce à l'utilisation de son « Time N: Through the use of his "Time Nest", Diggie can control the flow of time. He is also able to free his friends from the physical chains of time, taking them with him. Be careful though, because if you make him angry, prepare yourself for the taste of a Hoot Hoot "Time Bomb!"
en|Lui, Akai, Bane, Sun et Chip sont les: He, Akai, Bane, Sun and Chip are the only anthropomorphic heroes in the game.
en|Son design s'inspire des hiboux, symb: Its design is inspired by owls, symbolizing wisdom and intelligence.
en|Diggie détenait le record du plus lon: Diggie held the record for longest gap between hero release and new skin at almost 18 months (November 2017 - May 2019), but this record was later broken by Vale, who has not had a new skin since its release in January 2019 (Cerulean Wind) and was officially announced in January 2021 (Kannagi).

Once a noble prince of the Moniyan Empire, he was kidnapped by Alice, the Blood Demon Queen and transformed into the Prince of the Abyss. Dyrroth, once the Prince of Light of the Moniyan Empire, has become the most defiant son of darkness in the Abyss. Bound by blood, his sister Silvanna never gave up her vigilant search for him, while Alice, his captor, meticulously shaped him into the fiercest and most loyal companion in the Abyss. Although not born of demonic blood, Dyrroth thrived in the depths of the Abyss by embracing its wild nature. In a realm where power is revered above all else, he deliberately precipitated his own corruption to prove his allegiance, reforging his flesh in darkness and severing all ties to the light. ===Blood and Birth=== Blood, everything in sight was bathed in crimson. At the highest point of the Sanguine Lair, a huge droplet of blood hung, suspended in the air like a still-beating heart. Sucking and pumping, drop by drop, until the flowing blood gathered in a pool, flooding everything in sight – this was Alice's pool to feed the Blood Demons.

en|Son corps avait depuis longtemps term: His body had long since completed its transformation, but the holy spear wound in his chest refused to heal... He had been seriously injured and was still alive only because Alice had taken him away from the battlefield. She had left him to recover alone in the Blood Lair, his stronghold in the Abyss where she had fed the Blood Demons – the very place where he had grown up.
en|Il y a des années, Alice l'avait arra: Years ago, Alice had snatched him from the Empire when he was still a baby, and in doing so, she had also presented him with all of the Abyss as his birthright.
en|Le passé dans les souvenirs de Dyrrot: The past in Dyrroth's memories was not the justice his "sister" proclaimed while brandishing her sacred spear; what he remembered was the constant companionship of Alice, the teachings of Thamuz, and all of the Abyss rejoicing at the birth of the "Son of Darkness" – and all that had been destined since then.

Dyrroth went down into the pool.

en|Dans un passé très lointain, lorsque: In the distant past, when the world was just being created, the Ancients built the Heavenly Palace above Sanctum Island in the Sea of ​​Hope.
en|L'île faisait partie d'un volcan sous: The island was part of an underwater volcano. Submerged rocks and atolls were scattered around the island, and the waters nearby were often shrouded in thick sea fog, causing the wreck of many ships that ventured to pass by.
en|Isolée et préservée, l'île était l'en: Isolated and unspoiled, the island was the ideal location for ancient wonders. The Ancients began building temples and workshops using their incredible skills and technologies. When the Heavenly Palace began to operate, the mechanisms of the temple on the island received energy waves from the palace, and thus the island on the ground began to coordinate with the palace above the sky.
en|Avant que la Guerre Sans Fin n’éclate: Before the Endless War broke out, the Ancients attempted to control orders in the Land of Dawn. They sent Kaja and Uranus to arrest the unruly evil gods and imprison them in the Temple of Thunder on Sanctum Island, where a priestess loyal to the Ancients would lead her mecha guard "Phylax" and watch over them.
en|Le Mecha était alimenté par Primal Li: The mecha was powered by Primal Lightning, a unique magic that could control lightning with the power of the Ancients, and could only be performed by those specifically created by the Ancients. Among them are Kaja and Uranus at the top of the Heavenly Palace, as well as the priestess below on Sanctum Island.
en|La prêtresse s'appelait Edith. Elle a: The priestess was named Edith. She accepted the eternal youth and divine power granted by her masters and punished the prisoners with the merciless Primal Lightning. Hearing his name alone could make the most powerful evil gods cower in fear.
en|Cependant, après le déclenchement de: However, after the outbreak of the Endless War, the Ancients no longer used the Twilight Orb to seal darkness and light. Edith, the immortal Primal Warden, fell into a deep sleep as her masters disappeared.
en|Les temps ont changé et des survivant: Times have changed and survivors of the shipwreck have appeared on Sanctum Island. These poor people struggled to survive on this barren island, and many of them trudged across the island just to find scarce resources.
en|Après un tremblement de terre dévasta: After a devastating earthquake, the ruins of a temple have been revealed. It was buried at the bottom of the valley and burned by lightning. While searching for metal debris, an old rag picker discovered the place, but instead found a blonde girl lying in the rubble. She could be struck by lightning at any moment!
en|Le vieil homme a risqué sa vie et a r: The old man risked his life and brought the girl back to the seaside fishing village. Having been injured in the head, the girl only remembered her name: Edith. The childless old man took her in and they lived together in the small village.
en|Le père adoptif d'Edith adorait la fi: Edith's adoptive father adored the girl he had miraculously found and spared no effort to take care of her. Edith could walk around the village when she didn't have to help with the household chores, but the old man had a rule: she couldn't go near the valley, he had a feeling that one day he would lose his daughter there...
en|Quand Edith s'ennuyait, elle regardai: When Edith was bored, she often looked up at the Heavenly Palace above: the villagers said it was the temple of the gods, and sometimes she could see strange bird-like people hovering in the sky with lightning. But every time she saw them, a strong feeling of uneasiness invaded her heart, because the past she had forgotten seemed linked to the sparks of lightning. So she always ran home and buried herself in her father's arms, calming down when the old man patted her hand.
en|Dix ans ont passé et le vieil homme e: Ten years have passed and the old man has become more fragile. The other children all grew up, except Edith who remained as young as when she was first found.
en|Finalement, son père adoptif était tr: Eventually, his adoptive father was too old for physical labor. To survive, he had to break his self-imposed rule: he took Edith with him to collect metal debris from the ruins of the valley.
en|Après avoir fouillé l'extérieur en va: After searching the exterior in vain, the old man had to take the risk and enter the temple with Edith. As they sank deeper, Edith felt her memories resurface once again, and suddenly lightning struck as giant flying blades were fired at her father! Edith rushed forward and instinctively stopped the blades with her power, the blades plunging into the ground and splitting rocks with sparks of lightning.
en|Au milieu du feu et de la poussière,: Amidst the fire and dust, an elemental giant in golden armor appeared in front of Edith: “You have left your post, Edith!
en|C'était... Uranus, le Gardien du Pala: It was... Uranus, the Guardian of the Heavenly Palace! en|Les astrologues, qui observent consta: Astrologers, who constantly observe astrospace, possess the occult abilities to explain and predict everything that happens in the world, including its processes and outcomes. To become an astrologer, candidates must pass rigorous assessments, which will test both their willpower and their astrological abilities. As generations pass, the elders eventually choose Esmeralda, a young girl living in the Western Desert, to be a new successor in the Land of Dawn.
en|Après être devenue le successeur des: After becoming the successor of the astrologers, Esmeralda guards the coffin of Starmoon which is passed down from generation to generation. Hoping to open it and gain the mysterious power of ancient times, Esmeralda sets off for Minos' Labyrinth to discover the secrets of Starmoon's coffin. But unfortunately, as she heads towards the Labyrinth of Minos, the ground suddenly shakes and the desert collapses, followed by a storm of black sand. Suddenly, Starmoon's coffin opens and a flood of mysterious power fills Esmeralda. Under the protection of the mysterious power, Esmeralda suffers no harm and feels old memories returning to her mind. She feels Starmoon's coffin calling to her, reminding her that Khufra, the ruthless tyrant of the Western Desert long ago, has recovered. Following the lead of Starmoon's coffin, Esmeralda changes direction towards the deep desert, where there is an ancient city. After Starmoon's coffin is opened, two streams of power emanating from it begin to concentrate around Esmeralda: Frostmoon, enriched with magic, and Stardust, filled with great power. Impressed by the power of Starmoon's coffin, previously only spoken of in tales, Esmeralda recalls the memories of the first generation of astrologers. When Esmeralda approaches the ancient city, she vaguely senses an unknown love affair between Khufra and astrologers. Seeing the end of their love, Esmeralda feels sad and desolate. But his mission is to seal Khufra and bring peace to the Western Desert.
en|Le nom Esmeralda est d'origine espagn: The name Esmeralda is of Spanish and Portuguese origin, meaning "emerald" (the precious green gemstone). It comes from the Spanish word esmeralda, itself derived from the Greek smaragdos (σμάραγδος), meaning “green gem”.
en|Son nom complète son passif Starmoon: Its name complements its Starmoon Casket passive, representing the combination of stars (Stardust) and the moon (Frostmoon).
en|Le nom et la conception du personnage: Esmeralda's name and character design are somewhat inspired by the character of the same name in the 1996 Disney film The Hunchback of Notre Dame, which itself is an adaptation of the 1831 novel by Victor Hugo.

Since that day, the moon elves have lost the guidance of their king. When the flames of war between humans and orcs burned over this peaceful forest, the young Moonlight Archer, Miya, rose and gathered the rest of the elves to protect their homeland.

Seduced by the Blood Queen, Alice, young elves fell. The moon elf race was once again at stake, which outraged the great elf king! During a night of great thunder and lightning, Estes awoke. He is strict but caring and blessed with the power of sacred moonlight to protect his people and support his allies. With the Moonlight Code in his hands, he swore to repel any enemy who dared violate his homeland.

en|La mage elfique qui commande la foudr: The elven mage who commands lightning with her fingertips to pierce prejudices and light the way forward.
en|Bien qu'ils se soient intégrés à la c: Although they have been integrated into human civilization for many years and their appearance and habits approximate those of humans, many Moniyan still show hostility and distrust towards the Light Elves. It was in a village where such racial tensions reigned that Eudora grew up.
en|En raison de sa proximité avec le Mon: Due to its proximity to the Monastery of Light, most of the inhabitants of this village followed the obsolete teachings of the monastery and were hostile towards the Elves of Light. The prejudices of the older generation also affected the children of the village, and Eudora was bullied and insulted by her peers for her unusual eyes and pointy ears for as long as she could remember, leading her to become a sensitive and withdrawn young elf. She had no friends and her only companion was a humble flower Silver Song.
en|La petite Eudora solitaire restait as: Little lonely Eudora sat next to this flower for hours, sharing with it all her misfortunes and joys.
en|Cependant, sa seule amie fut finaleme: However, her only friend was ultimately destroyed by the cruel children of the village. A group of boys, who often teased Eudora, spotted Eudora talking to her floral friend one day and uprooted her on a cloudy afternoon, then bragged about it to anyone who would listen. When Eudora saw what they had done, she could no longer hold back her emotions. All the years of indignation and insults poured out of her body as pure rage, condensed into the power of lightning, and she nearly leveled the surrounding houses.
en|Ce fut le réveil du pouvoir magique l: This was the awakening of Eudora's latent magical power, but because of this incident, her family had to leave the village and find a new home.
en|Eudora a porté avec elle le fardeau d: Eudora carried the burden of this painful memory with her as she grew up, and this emotional imbalance eventually became a huge obstacle in her struggle to control her magical power. Every time someone tried to insult her because of her appearance, the magical power in Eudora's body would spiral out of control, leaving her family with no choice but to leave to find another home.
en|Leur mode de vie nomade a finalement: Their nomadic lifestyle finally ended when they arrived in northern Moniyan. A tutor at the Magic Academy, named Theresa, discovered Eudora's magical talent and decided to bring her to the school to begin her formal training in the arcane arts. Although she did not want to be separated from her family, Eudora gladly accepted Theresa's invitation and enrolled in the Magic Academy, becoming an apprentice at the Ulturia School.
en|Sous la direction de Theresa, Eudora: Under Theresa's guidance, Eudora absorbed all kinds of magical knowledge and quickly mastered the most powerful magic Theresa had to teach her. Over time, she gradually grew from a young apprentice to one of Ulturia School's most notable magic instructors. She let her hair grow long to try to hide her elven ears. Although she was respected by all who knew her, the scars of her youth remained hidden in her heart.
en|Lorsque Theresa, la mentor d'Eudora,: When Eudora's mentor Theresa, principal of Ulturia School, was about to retire, she announced to the public that Eudora would be taking over. But unexpectedly, this decision sparked intense controversy. Never in the history of the Magic Academy had an Elf headed a magic school and entered the academic committee. Many even thought it was a betrayal of the great prophet.
en|Pendant tout ce temps, Eudora avait c: All this time, Eudora had believed that she would never face prejudice from the Magic Academy, but the doubts that surfaced upon hearing this news sent her heart into turmoil. The shadow of her childhood fell on her. Huge balls of lightning, carrying her heavy memories, crashed to the ground, bringing an abrupt end to the handover ceremony and all the trust Eudora had tried to build over the years.
en|Elle a décidé de renoncer à son rôle: She decided to give up her role as headmistress of Ulturia School and was ready to leave the Magic Academy and look for a new home where she could live without prejudice. But Theresa stopped Eudora in her tracks and gave her a true-seeing mirror that allowed her to see herself.
en|\"Seul ce qui vous tient à cœur peut: “Only what you care about can truly hurt you.”
en|\"Vous vous souciez de votre race, vo: “You care about your race, you care about your appearance…and therefore, you care about what other people say.”
en|Eudora est restée devant le miroir pe: Eudora stood in front of the mirror for a day and a night. These nightmarish childhood experiences and all the doubts surrounding the handover ceremony appeared to him one by one. The light in her eyes shone brightly, the electricity within her surging with no end in sight. Just as she was about to explode, it slowly dissipated, and all that remained when she looked in the mirror again was the calm, pointy-eared Elf she had been running from.
en|Elle se connaissait désormais et avai: She now knew herself and had finally learned to face herself with peace in her heart.
en|Eudora a coupé ses longs cheveux, qu': Eudora cut off her long hair, which she had let grow for many years, and raised her elven ears high and proud. She vowed to return to Ulturia School and tell all those who could not accept her: I know who I am, and you will one day find out who I will become.
en|Eudora est le héros le moins cher du: Eudora is the cheapest hero in the game, costing only 2000, along with Layla and Zilong.
en|Son nom fait référence à l'un des Hya: Its name refers to one of the Hyades from Greek mythology. It is a brotherhood of nymphs who bring the rain.
en|Comme son nom l'indique, sa compétenc: As the name suggests, his skill, Ball Lightning, is based on the real and rare phenomenon, ball lightning, described as luminescent spherical objects that range in diameter from the size of a pea to several meters. Descriptions of ball lightning appear in various stories over the centuries and have captured the attention of scientists.
en|Elle a un type = Limited sur le thème: She has a Vivo-themed Limited type called "Vivo Selfie Goddess", and is one of only two heroes to have a Limited tag along with Miya ("Honor").
en|\"Vivo Selfie Goddess\" peut être mis: “Vivo Selfie Goddess” can be upgraded in Skin Upgrade, while “Honor” cannot be.
en|Les deux héros partagent également le: The two heroes also share the same Japanese language voice actor, Morisaki Miho.

en|Un danseur de lames sur le champ de b: A blade dancer on the battlefield. Fanny is the younger sister of Tigreal, who grew up under the protection of her family and older brother since childhood. But Tigreal took responsibility for a mistake in combat and left home. Despite her family's obstacles, Fanny joined the army, and with her own designed weapons, she successfully completed one task after another, becoming an exceptional fighter capable of taking care of herself. === Lore === Fanny Wertz is the youngest daughter of the Wertz family and the youngest sister of Tigreal. Although the men of the Wertz family served in the military for generations and guarded the Moniyan Empire, the women of the family were never allowed to join the military. From the point of view of the men in the family, their duty was to protect the country and the family from threats, and the women were to stay away from war.
en|Ainsi, depuis qu’elle était enfant, F: So, since she was a child, Fanny had been invited to study painting and design. The elders in the family hoped that she could become a famous artist or designer and help run the family business. But Fanny considered this unworthy of her. For as long as she can remember, Tigreal was Fanny's greatest hero. She also hoped that one day, like her brother, she could fight on the front lines for the Imperial Army and guard the empire.
en|En grandissant, Fanny, active et rebe: Growing up, Fanny, active and rebellious, became a nightmare for her guardian. She was very fed up with these out-of-date lessons. She often ran away for various reasons and had a weakness for dancing with weapons: but Fanny was so intelligent that even if she was tired from her lessons, she managed to understand in a very short time. Tigreal showed extreme affection to her rebellious sister. Every time Tigreal returned to Lumina City for repairs and maintenance with the army, it was Fanny's happiest day, because Tigreal not only told her peculiar anecdotes and exciting stories from battlefields of various places, but also taught her useful combat skills, which made Fanny even more eager for military life.
en|Cependant, Tigreal a fermement refusé: However, Tigreal firmly refused Fanny's desire to join the army as he always did. He didn't want his only sister to be in danger.
en|Par amour pour sa sœur cadette, Tigre: Out of love for his younger sister, Tigreal promised that when Fanny turned 18, he would take her to the Order of Light base to show her what it's like. This expedition therefore had a special meaning for Tigreal and Fanny. However, as Fanny waited day and night for her brother's triumphant return, news arrived from the front lines: although the battle against the border demons had been won, Tigreal, who led the Second Division of the Order of Light, had left its ranks for unknown reasons and disappeared.
en|Alors que l'empire organisait une fêt: As the empire held a national holiday, the Wertz family entered into a crisis. For a time, deserters and cowards replaced heroes and commanders, and these words became synonymous with Tigreal. The Wertz family, once famous throughout Moniyan, has been discredited. On the one hand, she adored her beloved brother, and on the other, damning rumors were flying. Faced with all this, Fanny fell into confusion, but after the confusion, she said to herself in her heart: my brother is not a coward, much less a deserter. In his absence, I must stand up and reinvigorate the glory of the Wertz family.
en|Par la suite, malgré l’opposition far: Subsequently, despite fierce opposition from her mother and other elders, Fanny resolutely chose to join the army. She wanted to use her actions to protect the dignity of her brother and the Wertz family. But it didn't go as well as she had imagined. When Fanny arrived at the barracks, she was greeted with laughter and mockery: the soldiers were full of prejudices against this pampered noble lady, and life in the barracks was much more difficult than she imagined. The heavy training and the lack of material conditions make the task difficult for Fanny, accustomed to a privileged life. For this reason, Fanny got rid of her long hair that she loved, devoted twice as much effort to training, and passed the recruitment test. She was incorporated into the reconnaissance unit of the imperial garrison.
en|Plusieurs années après le début de sa: Several years after the start of her scouting career, Fanny had truly grown and transformed. As an Imperial scout, Fanny often needed to travel between various steep mountains or other difficult terrain. In order to overcome her physical and strength flaws, she inconceivably learned from Tigreal, combining her combat skills with the design knowledge she had previously acquired by designing and constructing for herself a pair of long swords with steel cables. When she pulled the trigger, the steel cables shot out from the handle, latched onto the target, and pulled Fanny towards her. After endless practice, Fanny finally mastered the sword, and with it, she shuttled between the cliffs, gracefully traversing all kinds of difficult and complicated terrain, successfully completing her missions again and again. His performance not only convinced those who were full of contempt and prejudice towards him before, but it also earned him respect and prestige. For her graceful and exquisite figure as she danced in the air, the soldiers kindly called her the “Blade Dancer.”
en|Grâce à ses performances exceptionnel: Thanks to her exceptional performance in the garrison, Fanny finally obtained the necessary qualifications to be selected into the Order of Light. Even more surprising, Tigreal, his older brother who had been away from the Moniyan Empire for many years, also returned to his homeland from the distant Northern Valley. Seeing what her sister had done for the family, Tigreal praised Fanny, believing that she had become a great warrior, and invited her to stay by her side and fight side by side.
en|Voyageurs au Pays de l’Aube, si vous: Travelers in the Land of Dawn, if you see a person flying in the mountains and forests like a free bird, you have surely seen the graceful and swift figure of Fanny.
en|Le nom de Fanny pourrait être dérivé: Fanny's name could be derived from the word "Fanny" (short for Frances or Stefanie), but it could also come from the Germanic word fannen, meaning "to capture" or "to seize", which corresponds to her fast and aggressive style of play.
en|Son nom de famille \"Wertz\" est un n: His surname "Wertz" is a popular Germanic surname, either derived from the Old English personal name Hwit, meaning "the white one", or derived from the Middle High German word "wert" meaning "river island" or "river bank".
en|L'apparence et le style de combat de: Fanny's appearance and fighting style resemble soldiers from the Attack on Titan (進撃の巨人) series. Coincidentally, she also has a collaborative skin, Mikasa, with the series.
en|Fanny est le héros le plus difficile: Fanny is the most difficult hero according to Hero Difficulty Level, being the only hero with a difficulty level of 10 out of 10, the highest of all heroes.
en|Le prochain héros Hirara rejoindra bi: The next hero Hirara will join the list soon.
en|Elle est le premier héros à utiliser: She is the first hero to use energy as a source of skills.
en|Elle est le seul héros sans aucune fo: She is the only hero without any form of crowd control on her kit, not even a slow effect.
en|Son skin \"Skylark\" est inspiré d'un: Her "Skylark" skin is inspired by a type of lark bird known for its high-speed flight and agility, perfectly matching Fanny's fast, aerial fighting style.
en|Claude et Fanny sont parmi les rares: Claude and Fanny are among the few heroes in Mobile Legends to have multiple couple skins, with Fanny's "Lifeguard" and "Heart Afloat" being among her romantic-themed skins.
en|Elle partage son doubleur en japonais: She shares her Japanese voice actor, Ono Saki, with Hanabi.

en|Un nécromancien de Necrokeep détermin: A Necrokeep necromancer determined to find a cure for the Mist.

A Necrokeep necromancer determined to find a cure for the Mist. A gifted doctor who came to Necrokeep to study the mysterious plague. Instead of finding the key to controlling life and death, he met Vexana, the Duchess of the Cursed Earth and the girl who had twice brought sunshine to his dark life. Vowing to find a way to reverse the curse and repay Vexana's kindness, Faramis willingly eroded himself by the Mist and used himself as a specimen for his research. === The Fearless Soul === Faramis comes from a long line of doctors. Using the ancestral staff passed down through the family, his grandfather combined magic and medicine and developed cures for many formerly incurable illnesses. This feat earned the talented physician a title from the Moniyan Empire, and the family had since served the royalty as their personal physicians.
en|Cependant, aucun de ces éléments ne s: However, none of these proved enough to earn the family's respect from his equals. The other nobles viewed them as simple servants with special medical skills, while young Faramis, for this reason, was often bullied and ridiculed by his peers.
en|Lors d'un banquet, les garçons frappè: At a banquet the boys knocked again and poor Faramis was left passed out on the garden floor. When he regained consciousness, he saw a high-born girl half-kneeling beside him, giving him medicine. It was the only time young Faramis received kindness from his peers. The meeting, although brief, was like a ray of sunshine in his gloomy life.
en|Frêle et malade depuis sa naissance,: Frail and sick since birth, Faramis came close to death on numerous occasions and only survived thanks to the meticulous treatment of his parents. After numerous near-death experiences, he vowed to conquer death and take life into his own hands and was reluctant to serve the royalties as his family did.
en|Il trouvait les petits maux des royal: He found the little evils of royalties extremely annoying and wanted nothing to do with these hypocritical nobles. He aspired to tackle complex and incurable diseases to take his skills to heights that no other doctor had ever reached before.
en|Avec cet objectif en tête, Faramis a: With this goal in mind, Faramis left Lumina City and embarked on his journey alone, solving inexplicable illnesses one after another along the way, not under the care of a doctor, but to explore the possibility of going beyond life and death.
en|En apprenant l'incident de Necrokeep,: Upon learning of the Necrokeep incident, Faramis believed he had found the perfect integration of life and death and immediately headed to the city, searching for the key to controlling both.
en|Protégé par son bâton ancestral, Fara: Protected by his ancestral staff, Faramis found himself immune to the Mist that was ravaging the city. He passed through a crowd of desolate inhabitants and came upon Duchess Vexana, ruler of the ruined fortress. She prepared and distributed "Moonlight Brew", a moonlight herb remedy that was said to be the "cure" for the erosion of the Mist.
en|Au début, Faramis pensait que tout ce: At first, Faramis thought it was all a big lie: she was just playing an ignorant and hypocritical role like the other nobles.
en|Jusqu'à ce moment-là, Vexana avait mi: Until that moment, Vexana had put the last "Moonlight Brew" into her hands without hesitation-Faramis was stunned. This was tantamount to abandoning his “hope of living”.
en|L'« hypocrite » voulait vraiment sauv: The “hypocrite” really wanted to save everyone.
en|En regardant la noble dame sous un no: Looking at the noble lady in a new light, Faramis couldn't help but think of his brief encounter with the kind girl in his childhood...
en|La Brume n'avait rien à voir avec les: The Mist was nothing like the incurable illnesses Faramis had encountered before.
