After many failed attempts, he finally achieved breakthrough by infusing magic into herbs. And with every progress he made, he insisted on testing the effects on himself. Except his fragile body could only handle so much abuse. He soon began to experience the consequences of his experiments, eventually passing out in his laboratory.
en|Allongé sur le sol froid, Faramis sen: Lying on the cold ground, Faramis felt his life draining away quickly. He clenched his fists and tried to get up, only to find that he couldn't even open his eyes, his consciousness gradually fading.
en|Faramis n'aurait jamais pensé pouvoir: Faramis never thought he would be able to open his eyes again, and when he did, he saw a young woman bending down, parting her lips to let a bitter liquid fall into her mouth. Confused, Faramis discovered that this image overlapped with his memory of the girl in the garden. Looking at the strange but familiar face, Faramis recognized that she was the same noble girl who had helped him back then.
en|La fille qui avait éclairé son enfanc: The girl who had brightened his childhood had once again come to his aid! During his recovery, Faramis found himself falling in love with the young woman who had saved him from the darkness twice. She was the only person who never abandoned him, except for his parents.
en|Cependant, dès que Faramis s'est réta: However, as soon as Faramis recovered, Vexana urged him to leave the area, saying that it was dangerous for a living person to continue to stay in Necrokeep. The Mist was beginning to master his enchanted staff. If he stayed much longer, he would soon meet a fate like theirs.
en|Faramis ne dit pas un mot ; ses yeux: Faramis doesn't say a word; his eyes were fixed on the moonlit grass and the withered staff in his hands. His reason told him that it was time to leave, but when he stood in front of the castle door and saw the forced smile on Vexana's face, he found himself unable to leave like that. Memories of the childhood encounter and the meticulous care given to Necrokeep flashed through Faramis' mind. He could not abandon the young woman who had twice brought light and warmth into his life. He had made his choice, he would stay in Necrokeep and complete the task at hand.
en|Faramis abandonna la protection de so: Faramis abandoned the protection of his staff, finally plunging into the scourge of the Mist. His skin turned yellowish and pale, and yet he felt no fear. He knew he could defeat this scourge. And to do this, in order to discover the secrets of life and death, he must experience the curse himself.
en|Cette fois, c'était à son tour de sor: This time it was her turn to get Vexana out of the misery she found herself in.
en|Faramis a été initialement publié en: Faramis was originally released as a pure support hero.
en|Faramis a finalement reçu un skin («: Faramis finally received a skin ("Royal Magus") on October 24, 2022, which is the longest time for a hero to receive a second skin, in a period of 3 years, 5 months and 6 days or 1,255 days. Currently, Phoveus has then broken the longest time frame for a hero to receive a skin, over a period of 1511 days or 4 years, 1 month and 19 days, until they get their first Starlight skin.
en|Il est le premier héros à recevoir un: He is the first hero to receive a mythical skin, Clint being the second and Hylos the third.
He is a doctor and necromancer.
en|Il est actuellement le seul support q: He is currently the only support that is not officially in the Roamer roster, but only as a Mid Laner.
en|Ses capacités et son esthétique sont: His abilities and aesthetic are similar to those of necromancers in fantasy lore, such as the characters inspired by the Lich King (Warcraft) and Vlad Dracula.
en|Son ancien doubleur anglais, Cian Hoy: Its former English voice actor, Cian Hoyne, is known for his voice acting of other heroes in the game such as Martis, Hylos and formerly Gusion and Zhask. His current English voice actor as of 2022, Ryan Colt Levy, is a known voice actor in Japanese anime and video games, such as Denji from The Chainsaw Man, Burnt Cheese Cookie from Cookie Run: Kingdom, and Shisuto Naruse from Komi Can't Communicate.
en|Absorbe le fragment d'âme sous forme: Absorbs the soul fragment in the form of health
en|Une fille au bon cœur déterminée à ré: A kind-hearted girl determined to spread greenery across the world.
en|Belerick a découvert le déclin des te: Belerick discovered the decline of Agelta's barren lands during one of his many meanderings long ago.
en|Le désespoir et le chagrin le consumè: Despair and sorrow almost consumed him, when a small blooming flower suddenly appeared before his eyes. “There is still life!” Driven by such tenacious vitality, the treant decided to create on the spot what was later known as the Oasis.
en|Lors de la création de l'Oasis, Beler: When creating the Oasis, Belerick unintentionally poured more power into the little flower, and the overflowing energy condensed into a light seed. The little flower, however, has undergone an even more peculiar transition. He transformed into a life form that had never appeared in the Land of Dawn – Floryn.
en|Depuis le jour de sa naissance, Flory: Since the day she was born, Floryn had never left the Oasis. The latter isolated her from the harsh environment of the desert, allowing her to live a carefree life. For Floryn, this luminous seed was the only mystery of her peaceful life. She spent the days contemplating the secret of the seed and the nights sleeping in the shade of the leaves. Only explorers and caravans occasionally visited this quiet little world.
en|Parmi les caravanes qui fréquentaient: Among the caravans that frequented the Oasis, Floryn met a young man with a bright smile. He told Floryn amusing stories he had seen or heard during his trip each time he came to stay at the Oasis. As their friendship deepened, so did Floryn's trust in the young man. She showed the young man the luminous seed, hoping that it could help her solve the riddle.
en|Au début, le jeune homme a aidé Flory: At first, the young man wholeheartedly helped Floryn search for information about the seed. However, over time, Floryn discovered that the young man always avoided her gaze and changed the subject whenever the seed was brought up. Floryn began to worry about the young man's condition.
en|Une nuit, Floryn s'est réveillée en s: One night, Floryn woke up with a start. She was shocked to find that the seed she had always carried with her was gone!
en|Floryn a cherché partout dans l'Oasis: Floryn searched everywhere in the Oasis but to no avail. Torn with anxiety, Floryn went to the young man for help, only to discover that he had already left the Oasis with his camel.
en|Une pensée que Floryn redoutait de cr: A thought that Floryn dreaded to believe came to mind: could it be him?
en|Floryn suivit les traces du jeune hom: Floryn followed the young man's footsteps out of the Oasis. She wanted to find out the truth.
en|Cependant, ce qui l’attendait était u: However, what awaited her was a silent response to what she had seen and heard along the way. It was Floryn's first time entering the desert, and also the first time she saw the howling sandstorms and the look of despair on the people's faces. Before that, she never understood what kind of suffering people outside the Oasis experienced.
en|Lorsque Floryn a rattrapé le jeune ho: When Floryn caught up with the young man from her village, what appeared were cracked farmlands, dried up wells, starving children...and these desperate children who would stop at nothing to survive.
en|Le jeune homme était affalé dans un c: The young man was slumped in a corner. He had wanted to sell the seeds to feed his family, but he never expected that the seeds would wither as soon as they left Floryn. As a result, those who were willing to bid would not pay a single penny.
en|Le jeune homme rendit la graine fanée: The young man returned the withered seed to Floryn, ready to take responsibility for betraying their friendship.
Floryn, however, doesn't say a word.
en|L'expérience vécue tout au long du pa: The experience along the way had given Floryn insight into the difficult situation the young man found himself in. Compared to the sadness of being betrayed by her friend, another, even stronger and more complicated emotion was bubbling in her heart. Driven by this emotion, Floryn really wanted to do something for the earth, to save people who lived in extreme poverty like the young man.
en|Une vague de pouvoir magique jaillit: A wave of magical power surged from the depths of Floryn's heart. It flowed down her arm and into the seed she held in her hand. feeling the power, the once faded seed shone again, and from the light a hundred times more dazzling than before emerged a cute and living little creature!
en|Cette petite créature sauta dans les: This little creature jumped into the air and eagerly displayed its miraculous powers; he summoned rain with a flick of his tail, and new shoots gradually grew from where the rain fell. The once lifeless village was surrounded by greenery in just a few minutes.
en|Floryn était stupéfaite par la vue de: Floryn was stunned by the sight before her. She had never imagined that the seed could give birth to such a magical creature, just as she had never thought that it would one day leave the Oasis. It was only when Floryn's determination to change the wasteland resonated with Belerick's will within the seed that the latter awakened its true power.
en|Même si la petite créature née de la: Even though the little creature born from the seed was still very young, Floryn saw, with its limited power, endless possibilities to change the desert.
en|\"Tu ressembles à une goutte ronde de: "You look like a round drop of dew. I should just call you Dew!"
en|Dew entourait Floryn avec enthousiasm: Dew surrounded Floryn enthusiastically, as if she appreciated her name too.
en|Les changements dans l'environnement: The changes in the environment brought light back to the villager's eyes. The young man also promised Floryn that he would never stray from the right path again. Bidding the young man farewell, Floryn and Dew moved on to their next stop.
en|Aujourd'hui, grâce aux efforts inlass: Today, thanks to the tireless efforts of Floryn and Dew, the Oasis is growing at considerable speed. And this greenery will eventually spread throughout the desert, dispersing all desolation and despair.
en|Floryn était le 8ème et fait partie d: Floryn was the 8th and is one of the heroes offered free to players upon release. Other heroes offered for free are: Faramis, Belerick, Silvanna, Luo Yi, Benedetta, Mathilda, Phoveus and Edith.
en|Il est fort possible que Floryn soit: It is quite possible that Floryn is based on Flora, the Roman goddess of flowers and spring.
en|Le design et les compétences de Flory: Floryn's design and skills reflect a nurturing and supportive role, which further ties her to themes typically related to a character inspired by flora or nature spirits.
en|Floryn est le premier héros à soigner: Floryn is the first hero to heal his allies anywhere on the map.
en|Elle est la seule à améliorer un autr: She is the only one to upgrade another hero by placing another item on him.
en|Comme Belerick, elle peut aussi créer: Like Belerick, she can also create life; in her case, she created Dew.
en|Le skin « Yatai Waitress » de Floryn: Floryn's "Yatai Waitress" skin is inspired by the Japanese word "Yatai" (屋台), which refers to street food stalls in Japan that sell ramen, takoyaki, and other delicious treats. These stalls are often manned by friendly vendors wearing traditional Japanese aprons and kimonos, just like Floryn in this skin.
en|Floryn a des similitudes avec les « D: Floryn has similarities to Filipino “Diwata” (fairies/guardian spirits) and Southeast Asian folk creatures. Diwatas are mythical nature spirits or deities in Philippine folklore, often compared to fairies, nymphs, or guardian deities of other cultures. They are known for protecting nature, bestowing blessings, and sometimes punishing those who harm the environment.
en|Elle partage son doubleur en langue j: She shares her Japanese language voice actor, Gōto Ayasa, with Kagura, another hero with a Poke specialty and a high level of control effects.
en|Courageux guerrier du pergélisol, l'e: Brave permafrost warrior, Bane's sworn enemy.
en|L'environnement naturel hostile de la: The harsh natural environment of the remote, wintry North Valley has shaped those who live there into a brave and martial people. They revered the strong and were proud of their tall and sturdy appearance. They believed that their sturdy physiques were inherited from their common ancestor, the Golem of Iceland, who once ruled these lands.
en|Mais pour le jeune Franco, cette faço: But for the young Franco, this traditional way of thinking was only oppressive. His tribe had lived on the coast of the Frozen Sea for generations and relied on its large fleet of trading and fishing ships to support themselves. But the passing years have not made young Franco want to become an adult man. They only pointed out the strange way the others looked at him. Although his father was a famous harpooner throughout the coast and his brothers were all tall and strong, Franco was small and unimpressive for a Nord. Some even joked that, given Franco's stature, his ancestor was not the Icelandic Golem, but the dwarves of legend.
en|Pour former de puissants guerriers, l: To train powerful warriors, the Northern Valley tribes located on the coast of the Frozen Sea engaged in intense competitive play from childhood and received systematic combat training once they reached puberty, so that they would be ready to engage in lengthy trading missions or fishing voyages as adults. However, much to Franco's embarrassment, while the other boys had already begun to wield battle axes, spears, and rig sails, he could only wield much smaller weapons. In fact, the battle axes were even taller than him.
en|Bien que de petite taille, Franco ava: Although small in size, Franco had a great ambition: to become the greatest warrior in the Northern Valley, and see his name engraved in the book of heroes, to be adored by future generations. To achieve this ambition, Franco trained tirelessly, day after day, increasing his strength and martial prowess. Yet despite Franco's intense training, he was looked down upon by others due to his small size. Even his father and brothers thought that little Franco was only meant to be a merchant, and never a warrior or sailor capable of facing a cruel environment and fierce enemies.
en|Face aux moqueries et à la discrimina: Faced with constant mockery and discrimination, Franco angrily decided to leave his tribe. He would prove to everyone that, even though he was small, he could still achieve big things. Over the next few years, he hid in the endless mountains of the North Valley, surviving and training alone in this most extreme environment. After long years of fighting against the bitter cold, terrible beasts and omnipresent threats, Franco has developed strength far beyond that of an ordinary man, as well as a firm and indomitable character.
en|Alors que Franco s'entraînait seul da: While Franco trained alone in the mountains, the cruel and power-hungry Captain Bane descended on the frozen sea. Breaking the long-respected rules of the pirates and fishermen of the North Valley, he began to invade and annex the territory of other pirates as well as commoners, ruling them with an iron fist. Those facing Bane's mighty fleet and fearsome firepower had only two options: submit or be annihilated.
en|La cruauté de Bane a suscité une rési: Bane's cruelty was met with fierce resistance from various forces, the fiercest of all coming from Franco's tribe. As a warning to those who would challenge him, Bane sent a massive armada of pirate ships to blockade the surrounding sea and launched constant raids on Franco's tribe, declaring that he would sink all their ships and raze their harbor.
en|Après dix ans passés dans les montagn: After ten years in the mountains, Franco returns to his tribe, full of confidence and strength. Engaging in a fierce battle, he crushed Bane's men with his anchor and his divine strength. It was only after the battle that the members of his oppressed tribe made a surprising discovery: that the hero who had come to save them was none other than the once-mocked little Franco. After learning of Bane's treacherous actions, Franco angrily vowed to annihilate him and all of his henchmen.
en|Franco mena alors ses membres de la t: Franco then led his tribesmen and their ships in resistance against Bane's cruel rule. They outfitted old fishing boats with battering rams and cannons, and attacked Bane's pirate fleets wherever they found them, dealing a heavy blow to Bane's forces. In desperation, Bane assembled a huge fleet to quell Franco's resistance, but the two sides remained in a stalemate after several battles, with Bane unable to gain the advantage. Once, Bane managed to lure Franco into a trap, but only succeeded in injuring him, and Franco managed to escape with his life. Furthermore, more and more residents of the Northern Valley, inspired by Franco's courage and strength, united around him to fight Bane.
en|Voyant la force de Franco croître de: Seeing Franco's strength growing by the day, the cunning Captain Bane hatched a plan: he would sue for peace with Franco, suggesting that they search for the Twilight Orb of legend together, while secretly luring the Moniyan Empire's navy to the frozen sea. This would allow him to kill two birds with one stone: find the Twilight Orb and defeat Franco for good. Wary of Bane's sudden goodwill, Franco pretended to take the bait, ordering his men to search for the Orb of Twilight, while secretly leading a contingent of warriors to take control of a pirate ship among the Black Shark fleet.
en|Bane a déclenché une bataille entre l: Bane instigated a battle between the two marines, preparing to reap the benefits afterwards. However, Franco, hiding within the Black Sharks, ordered his men to open fire behind Bane, hitting the Behemoth directly. In his most exultant moment, Bane and his flagship received a fatal blow from the defiant lord and sank to the bottom of the sea.
en|Une fois Bane noyé, Franco devint le: Once Bane was drowned, Franco became ruler of the entire Northern Valley coast. He led his people in driving out the remnants of Bane's forces, rebuilding the port, and reviving trade, bringing a renaissance to the entire Northern Valley.
en|Par respect pour les glorieuses réali: Out of respect for Franco's glorious achievements, the people of the Northern Valley nicknamed him the Frozen Warrior. But for Franco, everything he had done so far was still not worthy of such praise. Shortly after, Franco learned that Bane not only had not perished, but had gained new power and was gathering his men to make his return.
en|Franco est basé sur un guerrier vikin: Franco is based on a real-life historical Viking warrior.
en|Franco et Lesley ont la même citation: Franco and Lesley have the same quote: “One hit, one kill.”
en|Miya avait la même citation mais a ét: Miya had the same quote but was removed due to her redesign for the NEXT project.
en|La plupart de ses citations sont dire: Most of his quotes are taken directly from the character York from Magic Rush: Heroes, with whom he also shares the same voice acting. This explains why some of them seem completely foreign to him, like: "I love the smell of gunpowder in the morning."
en|Franco est actuellement le seul héros: Franco is currently the only hero whose voice lines come from Magic Rush, while previous heroes with the same case have been replaced.
en|Franco a été temporairement banni du: Franco was temporarily banned from the game on December 29, 2021 after an exploit was discovered in the Serpent's Lair. The ban was lifted on January 19, 2022 for a duration of 21 days and 3 hours, which is the longest recorded ban in MLBB history, prior to Helcurt's ban in 2023.
en|Franco est l'un des trois héros capab: Franco is one of three heroes capable of applying crowd control Suppression, the other being name=Kaja and name=Barats.
en|Un maître évaluateur de trésors à Los: A master treasure appraiser in Los Pecados is accumulating wealth and searching for his lost friend.
en|\"Soyez chéri et versez-moi un verre: “Be darling and pour me a glass of your signature drink,” the drunken bum insulted the bartender. “And I’ll tell you the truth about that bastard Fredrinn!”
en|Les habitants de Los Pecados avaient: The people of Los Pecados had long memorized stories about Fredrinn, but his name was still like a siren's call, drawing all who heard it to its source.
en|\"Deux coups pour notre bon ami\", di: “Two shots for our good friend,” said a young smuggler, throwing a handful of pennies on the counter.
en|\"Ahh, très bon gentleman. Je vais vo: "Ahh, very good gentleman. I'll make it worth your while while I assure you. This one is something you'll never have heard of!" Exclaimed the tramp.
en|Tout le monde dans le bar avait les y: Everyone in the bar had their eyes on the filthy tramp, except for the man who was drinking alone in the hidden corner, a compass clutched tightly in his hand.
en|\"L'histoire commence il y a plus d'u: “The story begins over a dozen years ago,” the tramp began, looking surprisingly sober after taking a sip of his drink. "After receiving his fiefdom, Duke Vance of Castle Grandrock opened the sea trade route to Northern Vale. Merchant ships coming from the north... all laden with rare goods... and all trading exclusively with the Duke. Well, the old weasel was practically bathing in profits!"
en|Le clochard prit une autre gorgée, re: The tramp took another sip, looking around at the greasy faces waiting impatiently for more.
en|\"Mais la richesse et le prestige n'o: “But wealth and prestige brought little pleasure to the Duke,” he continued. "If anything, this new wealth only awakened in him an even greater desire: to climb to the top of the imperial nobility. The Duke began to discipline his children with strict rules, punishing any child who dared to disobey his words."
en|\"Pour une fois, je suis sacrément co: "For once, I'm damn glad I'm not the son of a rich moron!" the smuggler intervened.
en|\"Oui, et tu ne serais pas seul,\" ré: “Yes, and you wouldn’t be alone,” replied the tramp. "One of Vance's boys gave the Duke a never-ending headache. This youngster had no interest in the rules and etiquettes of nobles, and had a desire for freedom and adventure. The Duke didn't want this kid's bad ideas to infect the minds of the other children. So, he arranged for the boy to study at the Monastery of Light."
en|\"Une excuse assez pratique pour se m: “Quite a practical excuse to make fun of the monastery’s archbishop!” the bartender intervened.
en|\"Eh bien, vous auriez raison\", répo: “Well, you would be right,” replied the tramp. "As the Duke was in dire need of stronger political allies. The boy, however... had other plans. Having heard his father's arrangements, the little rascal decided to sneak out of the castle and embark on his own adventure."
en|\"Je pense que le duc n'aurait pas gr: “I don’t think the Duke would have much to fear, though,” the smuggler interjected again. “A spoiled little brat like him, he would soon go back to his daddy!”
en|\"Oui, le duc l'avait compris\", répo: “Yes, the duke understood that,” replied the tramp. “Old Vance was really mad, but he didn’t even bother to look for his boy!
en|\"Le gamin, cependant, s'est révélé b: "The kid, however, turned out to be much tougher than his father expected. He was not an adventurer, mind you; but through his courage, wit, and excellent judgment, the boy managed to overcome every obstacle that came his way. He had a particular penchant for exploring the most dangerous areas yet unexplored by man.
en|\"Et bientôt, son nom s'est répandu d: "And soon, his name spread throughout the Land of Dawn. Yet no one knew about his past life."
en|Le clochard fit une longue pause, com: The tramp paused for a long time, as if waiting for a response. But all he got were blank faces and glassy eyes.
en|\"Oh, vous vous moquez de moi…\" grog: “Oh, you’ve got to be kidding me…” he grumbled with a sigh and a roll of his eyes. "The boy was Fredrinn... Fredrinn Vance!"
en|Sa révélation s’est heurtée à une nou: His revelation was met with a new round of silence. But when his audience caught on, the tavern erupted into an uproar.
en|\"Fredrinn...un noble !? Pourquoi, ce: "Fredrinn...a nobleman!? Why, that punk is a damn crook!" A burly man with a horned helmet, his eyes bulging, they almost popped out of their sockets.
en|\"Personne ne connaît mieux que moi c: “No one knows this money scammer better than me!” the man exclaimed. "No matter what you prepare in advance, the leech will always demand a higher price. Well, a gang leader himself barged into his store to personally deliver his payment, a loaded gun pointed right between Fredrinn's eyebrows. The bastard didn't even flinch...and instead demanded more money!"
The young smuggler raised his hand. "But is it true what they say about him? 'A no-questions, no-disclosure policy' about his valuation of hunted treasures?"
en|\"Oui,\" répondit l'homme costaud. \": “Yes,” the burly man replied. "No matter who you are, this scoundrel sticks to his guns. It is not possible to compel him, not even by force. What are you going to do, attack his treasure shop? Then prepare to be beaten - according to the customs of Los Pecados. And if you are lucky enough to wake up, all damaged items must be paid for in double, not a single penny less - "
en|\"Allez, nous sommes tous au courant: “Come on, we all know about this!” cried the tramp, his voice dripping with sarcasm. "But what about Fredrinn's secret!? That crystal lodged in his chest—"
en|La foule est tombée étrangement silen: The crowd fell eerily silent, only to erupt into wild cheers moments later. Even the bartender poured the tramp another shot to get him to talk. "The crystal is said to come from the ruins of a lost civilization. It seals an ancient power coveted even by the King of the Abyss. Fredrinn went to great lengths to get his hands on this crystal, even killing his own partner in the process..."
en|L'homme assis dans le coin s'approcha: The man sitting in the corner approached, interrupting the wanderer's words.
en|Sa silhouette musclée dominait tout l: His muscular figure towered over everyone in the tavern. His eyes burned with disdain as he looked at the lesser men around him. Embedded in his scarred chest, right where his heart was, a strange crystal pulsed with a ghostly glow.
en|\"F-F-Fredrinn...\" bégaya le clochar: "F-F-Fredrinn..." the tramp and the burly man stuttered in awe.
en|La boîte de vin en fer blanc dans la: The tin wine box in Fredrinn's hand creaked as his fist clenched.
en|\"Une merveilleuse histoire, mon ami,: "A wonderful story, my friend," Fredrinn said calmly. “However, if I hear someone say that I killed my partner again… I will come to their door and give them a thorough assessment.”
en|Fredrinn sortit du bar après ces mots: Fredrinn walked out of the bar after those words, his blood and his memory coursing through him.
en|L'évaluateur de trésors astucieux et: The astute and revered treasure appraiser of Los Pecados was once a passionate and adventurous boy who wanted to escape his noble status. There was always a friend at his side who was ready to do anything with him… Fray.
en|Lors de leur dernière aventure ensemb: During their last adventure together, the two came across an ancient altar. A giant crystal hovered at its center, radiating an ominous glow.
en|Fray a prévenu son partenaire, mais l: Fray warned his partner, but the young and reckless Fredrinn could not escape the lure. He approached the altar and placed his hand on the crystal, thus disturbing the balance of an ancient protection.
en|Une silhouette fantomatique vêtue d’u: A ghostly figure dressed in a black cloak emerged from the center of the altar.
en|\"…Vous deux serez l'offrande finale\: “…You two will be the final offering”
en|Ce furent les derniers mots que Fray: These were the last words Fray and Fredrinn heard before the altar began to collapse under the weight of ancient magic, trapping them in the middle of the chaos.
en|\"Fredrinn… cette fois, c'est à mon t: “Fredrinn…this time it’s my turn to save you…”
en|Fray, qui s'était toujours caché derr: Fray, who had always been hiding behind Fredrinn, picked up a shard of crystal and pressed it against Fredrinn's chest, giving him the only chance of survival. The crystal's power integrated with Fredrinn's and protected him from collapse. But when he looked up, he found Fray and the ruins gone without a trace. The only thing left was Fray's magic compass.
en|Fredrinn a trouvé une nouvelle quête: Fredrinn found a new quest the moment he opened the compass. The blue pointer recorded Fray's life trace. It spun wildly and vibrated like tiny heartbeats.
en|Pour rechercher des indices qui pourr: To search for clues that could help locate Fray, Fredrinn remained in Los Pecados as a treasure appraiser. He has accumulated his funds to build a vast intelligence network gathering all knowledge related to the ruins.
en|Debout devant un mur d'indices, Fredr: Standing in front of a wall of clues, Fredrinn looked at the magic compass in his hand.
en|\"Tant que le pointeur tourne, je n'a: "As long as the pointer is ticking, I will not give up."
en|\"Fredrinn\" ressemble à Frederick, u: "Fredrinn" sounds like Frederick, a Germanic name meaning "peaceful ruler" (frid = peace, ric = ruler).
en|La sortie d'un nouveau héros, Joy, a: The release of a new hero, Joy, took 98 days to succeed Fredrinn, making it the longest interval between hero releases.
en|À l'origine, il était censé avoir une: He was originally supposed to have a baseball bat instead of a sword. Early drafts suggested that Fredrinn would wield two short swords instead of a single large blade. The developers opted for a heavy sword to emphasize its raw strength and precision.
en|Il adore les aventures et réside actu: He loves adventures and currently resides in Los Pecados.
en|Premier tank avec une mécanique « bas: First tank with a “combo-based” mechanic. Unlike most tanks, Fredrinn relies on the chaining of several skills to activate his ultimate, Appraiser's Wrath.
en|Son design et sa personnalité ressemb: His design and personality resemble rogue adventurers or mercenaries, similar to characters like Indiana Jones, Flynn Rider (Tangled), or Gambit (X-Men).
en|L'un des rares héros de la MLBB avec: One of the few MLBB heroes with a delayed ultimate activation. His ultimate requires skill combos first, which differentiates him from tanks who can instantly use their ultimates.
en|Certains premiers croquis de concept: Some early concept sketches made him look more like a pirate captain than a noble adventurer.
en|\"Qu'est-ce que la Valkyrie ?\" Alors: “What is the Valkyrie?” As smoke began to rise from the hallowed halls of Sessrumnir, this question – which had haunted Freya's thoughts for so long – surfaced once more in her troubled heart.
en|\"...The Valkyrie is a legacy.\" Quan: "...The Valkyrie is a legacy." When Freya was just a child, her sister Skuld, newly chosen to become the next Valkyrie, took her small hand in his, and together they grasped the ancient sword and shield. Little Freya could not yet understand the fierce light that burned in her sister's eyes, but she felt, for the first time, the deep weight of the sword and shield pressed against her palms.
en|Fate, however, is a cruel and fickle: Fate, however, is a cruel and fickle thing. Years later, Skuld perished during a perilous mission, and with his death came the disappearance of the Heart of Aurora, that sacred relic preserved in Sessrumnir for countless centuries, the very embodiment of the strength and heritage of Northern Vale. The people mourned Skuld's sacrifice, but whispers began to creep through the blizzards like poison: some dared to call Skuld a failure, an incompetent Valkyrie who had betrayed the North Valley itself. Freya spoke no words in her sister's defense. Instead, she simply tightened her grip on her sword and shield, as if shaking her sister's hand again.
en|Elle s'avança dans le blizzard hurlan: She stepped out into the howling, endless blizzard, her heart determined to recover the lost Aurora Heart. She would never allow her sister's hands - hands worn from protecting others - to be stained with the mark of betrayal, nor would she allow the sacred title of "Valkyrie" to disappear into the vast and merciless blizzard.
en|Épée à la main, Freya avançait à trav: Sword in hand, Freya marched across the endless expanses of Northern Vale, gathering the myriad answers to a single, haunting question: "What is the Valkyrie?"
en|Les gens ordinaires murmuraient que l: Ordinary people whispered that the Valkyrie was salvation incarnate. She had raised her blade amid the bloody feuds of the Garland tribe, saving Hilda and her parents from certain doom.
en|Les guerriers marqués par la bataille: Battle-scarred warriors proclaimed the Valkyrie to be glory manifested. Hadn't she braved the dangerous Frozen Sea, forging an alliance with Franco to protect innocent fishermen from Bane's incessant attacks?
en|Pourtant, d'innombrables autres perso: Yet countless others in the North Valley have declared that the Valkyrie is faith itself, for within the hallowed halls of Sessrumnir burns a forge powered by the sacred Heart of Aurora.
en|Ici, pour la première fois, Freya a d: Here, for the first time, Freya discovered the true genesis of the Valkyries' legacy: eons ago, when the world was young, the Frost Giants erected a mighty forge deep in the snowy wilderness to challenge the two gods themselves, blessing the North Valley with eternal spring. But the wrath of the gods was swift and merciless: the glaciers descended like divine judgment, shattering the forge and leaving the northern lands shattered and bloodied. It was only when Sigrun, the first Valkyrie - a half-giant of legendary prowess - wielded a fragment of the Twilight Orb called the Aurora Heart to reignite the dying embers of the forge, that Northern Vale caught its breath. Sigrun entrusted this sacred power to the bravest of warriors, charging them with guarding both the homeland and the Aurora Heart. Future generations would know them by one revered name: Valkyries.
en|À travers le vent hurlant et la neige: Through the howling wind and swirling snow, Freya stared at Sessrumnir in the distance. It remained cold and silent, like the heart of Northern Vale, frozen and still.
en|Même si sa poursuite incessante n'ava: Although her relentless pursuit had yet to reveal the whereabouts of the Aurora Heart, Freya was getting closer and closer to the terrible truth behind her sister's sacrifice.
en|Les glaciers, nés de la volonté divin: The glaciers, born of the divine will of the God of Light, had attracted countless followers who transformed them into fortresses, extending the dominion of their divinity across the realm, even inadvertently fostering the birth of the divine maiden Aurora. After the end of the Endless War, these followers of light disappeared like ghosts, only to resurface years later with nefarious intent. They set cunning traps that cost Skuld his life, and in the chaos that followed, the Aurora Heart disappeared into legend. Yet the dark ambitions of the cultists remained undiminished: they sought to drain the very essence of the forge and destroy it completely, eliminating all obstacles to the inevitable return of the God of Light.
en|Une fumée épaisse et étouffante s'éch: Thick, choking smoke was escaping from the sacred halls of Sessrumnir!
en|Lorsque Freya atteignit le champ de b: When Freya reached the battlefield, Sessrumnir was in total ruin. The followers of the light greedily siphoned the power of the forge with reckless abandon. The warriors of the North Valley fought desperately against overwhelming odds, while the aurora-colored flames in the forge flickered weaker and weaker. Deep tremors shook the very foundations of the country: everything teetered on the brink of collapse...
en|Repérant l'arrivée de Freya en renfor: Spotting Freya's arrival as reinforcement, the followers of light prepared to flee like cowards. Every fiber of Freya screamed to pursue them, to seek revenge on her fallen sister, but the power of the forge was draining, requiring its presence to safeguard the very survival of Northern Vale.
en|Comment choisir entre vengeance et de: How to choose between revenge and duty? Freya's gaze fell on those dying flames of dawn—
en|La forge exigeait de la nourriture ;: Blacksmithing required food; only a new energy could reignite his sacred fire.
en|— Avec une détermination brûlante dan: — With determination burning in her heart and defiance coursing through her veins, Freya rushed toward the dying light of the forge.
en|Dans la danse tourbillonnante des aur: In the swirling dance of dawn and flame, the ethereal form of her sister Skuld materialized once more, her spectral hand tenderly clutching Freya's.
en|Freya comprit enfin la lumière radieu: Freya finally understood the radiant light that had always burned in her sister's eyes.
en|Pendant mille ans, lorsque les deux d: For a thousand years, when the two gods cast their glacial curse to freeze the North Valley in an eternal winter, the people kept the forge burning and built the mighty walls of Sessrumnir around it. Generation after generation of Valkyries had fought in these hallowed halls, bled and died here. They faced death without fear, knowing that the roaring flames of the forge would transform their essence into weapons of unimaginable power, to pass on to the next Valkyrie.
en|Maintenant, Freya a elle aussi accept: Now Freya too has accepted this eternal duty and thrown herself into the flames.
en|Son sacrifice lui a valu la reconnais: Her sacrifice earned her the recognition of the collective will of all the Valkyries who had come before her, whose spirits still resided in the forge, but in truth, she had long since earned the blessing of Northern Vale. Not through the Aurora Heart, but as Sigrun, the very first Valkyrie: with the aurora as her guide and the tundra as her witness, Freya carved her glory from wind and ice and transformed her body into an invincible weapon.
en|L'épée et le bouclier de Freya, ferme: Freya's sword and shield, held tightly in her grip, were reforged like a halberd amidst the roaring flames, while golden wings spread majestically behind her. After passing the final test, she returned to Sessrumnir as the glorious Valkyrie. With her sword raised high, she pursued the fleeing followers of light: it was her revenge, her duty and her answer.
en|\"Je suis une fille de Northern Vale: “I am a daughter of Northern Vale and I will defend this land to the death!”
en|Freya est basé sur la déesse Freyja,: Freya is based on the goddess Freyja, a goddess from Norse mythology. It is associated with love, beauty, fertility, sex, war, death and magic.
en|L'apparence de Freya dans la traditio: Freya's appearance in lore is based on a Valkyrie. Valkyries are female figures who guide the souls of the dead to the Valhalla hall of the god Odin.
en|Freya de première génération est un h: First generation Freya is a paid hero. Additionally, Freya is one of two heroes (including Odette) who cannot be purchased with Battle Points. However, Odette was purchased by Battle Points back in the day when it was released in 2017. Until now, Freya was only purchasable with diamonds. The reason for this is still unknown.
en|La doubleuse anglaise Freya a égaleme: English voice actor Freya also voiced some of Battlefield's rapid-fire chatter.
en|Amener les guerriers tombés au combat: Bringing the fallen warriors to Valhalla
en|Gatotkaca la \"Mighty Legend\" était: Gatotkaca the "Mighty Legend" was the son of Bima and Arimbi of the Arcapada universe. Since his childhood, he has been a champion of the Gods and fights the evil enemies of his homeland.
en|Gatotkaca a perdu une fois au combat: Gatotkaca once lost in battle and was beaten near death, but he rose again as a mighty warrior of the Pandava clan and gained supernatural power after training within Candradimuka, the Cauldron of Heaven. With his Antakusuma armor and Braiamusti-Braiadenta gauntlets, he can fly through the skies like lightning and hunt down his sworn enemies, the wrathful Asuras.
en|Gatotkaca, le chevalier de Pringgadan: Gatotkaca, the Knight of Pringgadani, is a symbol of bravery and devotion. Based on the comic series “Garudayana” created by Is Yuniarto and inspired by traditional Indonesian shadow puppets.
en|Gatotkaca est basé sur Bharatyuddha,: Gatotkaca is based on Bharatyuddha, a Javanese adaptation of the Sanskrit epic Mahabharata. According to the creator of the Garudayanas, Is Yuniarto, its design is inspired by wayang, a traditional Javanese shadow theater. Wayang is used to retell epics including Bharatayuddha.
en|Son skin le plus récent, \"Tide Prese: His most recent skin, "Tide Preserver", was released on January 8, 2024, making him the hero who received the skin for the longest period, 1745 days, between it and "Spark", released on March 30, 2019.
en|Ses lignes vocales \"Om Telolet Om\": His vocal lines "Om Telolet Om" are a social media meme that depicts the excitement of young Indonesians when a bus driver honks rhythmically as they pass by.
en|Gatotkaca partage son doubleur en jap: Gatotkaca shares his Japanese voice actor, Abe Daiki, with his rival Martis, and with Helcurt, who shares his recommendation on the roaming route.
en|Un amalgame magique de créatures mign: A magical amalgamation of cute and mischievous creatures that dwell deep within the Shadow Swamp.
en|Au cours d'une immense guerre menée d: During a massive war in the Barren Lands, the Second Regiment of the Moniyan Empire was almost completely wiped out. Among the sea of ​​corpses scattered all around, a Moniyan soldier had managed to survive; but he lost all his comrades and had to return alone to his native country.
en|Des nuages ​​sombres enveloppent les: Dark clouds shroud the Barren Lands year after year. Without the sun, moon, and stars to guide his path, this lone survivor became lost and lost in the Shadow Swamp.
en|La terre et l'eau trouvées dans les f: The land and water found in the forests of Shadow Marsh are corrupted by the Abyss, leaving the place damp and putrid. The man's extreme hunger and fatigue, along with the endless forest around him, plunged him into darkness and despair.
en|Alors qu'il était sur le point de s'é: As he was about to pass out, a strangest sensation made him regain consciousness: a sticky sensation spread down his back, then he lost all control of his limbs which ran wildly on their own.
en|Il décrirait ce moment dans ses mémoi: He would describe this moment in his memoir as feeling like he was just a wooden puppet, like those played by the Moniyan children. He was manipulated by an invisible force, rushing nimbly through the forest at incredible speed.
en|L'homme était sur le point de perdre: The man was about to lose consciousness when the body he no longer controlled stopped. Coming to his senses, he looked with wide eyes at what was before him...
en|Là, il vit les ruines d'un grand temp: There he saw the ruins of a great temple surrounded by vines, weathered by wind and frost but still grand and imposing. These ancient temple ruins stood out like a sore thumb in the surroundings of Shadow Swamp.
en|La sensation étrange qui lui parcoura: The strange feeling running down his spine faded when he stopped, but that's when he saw something small jumping into the nearby bushes, seemingly hidden.
en|Est-ce que cette chose pourrait être: Could this thing be behind all this? The soldier was determined to get to the bottom of this and moved in the direction the figure was taking. A loud rustling sound emanated from the vegetation, and it seemed as if some sort of violent struggle was taking place inside.
en|Et alors que le soldat s'avançait fur: And as the soldier advanced furtively, reaching out to push aside a branch, there appeared before him a small creature the size of a charcoal briquette; he prepared to catch it and study it more closely, but before he could act, countless others had appeared from everywhere. They piled up neatly, and in just over ten seconds, the creature no bigger than a lump of coal had transformed into a mighty beast. This struck fear into the heart of poor soldier Moniyan who fainted on the spot. But when he awoke once again, he found himself no longer in the swamp, but on the border of the Drylands and the Empire.
en|De retour dans l'empire, il a régalé: Back in the empire, he regaled everyone with this tale. The citizens of Moniyan had great respect for this veteran, but considered his story to be mere hallucinations of a man consumed by fatigue after having narrowly escaped death.
en|Après tout, même les érudits les plus: After all, even the most erudite scholars of Moniyan had never heard of such a creature. There was little the soldier could do except write his experiences down on paper, as the evidence that would be discovered later might prove his sanity.
en|Comme par hasard, il n'eut pas à atte: As luck would have it, he didn't have to wait that long. This dream came true while he was still alive and healthy.
en|Lorsque le texte elfique \"Azrya\" pa: When the Elvish text "Azrya" reached the Magic Academy, a student of the Moniyan Empire read records within a faction called Gloo - records directly consistent with the experiences of that Moniyan soldier he had read about before.
en|L'étudiant curieux chercha la doyenne: The curious student sought out the dean of Ulturia School, Eudora, who, after reading through the soldier's writings, confirmed that they did indeed describe an encounter with Gloo.
en|Après l'avoir entendu d'Eudora, l'hum: After hearing it from Eudora, humanity became aware of the existence of the Gloo, special beings with special ways of life. Thanks to a mysterious secretion, once just one of them had attached itself to a living being, they could then begin to completely envelop it.
en|De plus, leur revêtement extérieur se: Additionally, their gel-like outer covering acted as a conscious organ that allowed unique neural networks to function between individual “Goos,” forming the larger “Gloo” sensation. Among these beings, some would occupy higher roles within the network, commanding all others when they combined into a single form. By merging into different numbers[,], they were able to control their size and shape at will.
en|Les Goos se sont révélés être des êtr: The Goos were shown to be intelligent and pure beings, proud of their shared "group wisdom" which was mainly used to play pranks on neighboring Elves. When she heard about Private Moniyan's bizarre adventure, she realized what had happened: a group of Goos must have wandered too far away, and so they clung to him as a larger organism to hitchhike home.
en|Depuis sa naissance, les Goos ne s'ét: Since his birth, the Goos had never ventured outside of Azrya, instead guarding the forests and the mysterious old temple. They had never initiated any sort of battle, at most taking the form of a terrifying beast to frighten away any outsiders who accidentally entered their territory. Even the Elves who lived nearby knew little about their species.
en|Peut-être que la plus grande intellig: Perhaps Goo's greatest intelligence could be seen in the fact that they resided in the depths of the forests, living in peaceful harmony with the rest of the world.
en|Réfugiés dans l'ancien temple, Goos s: Taking refuge in the ancient temple, Goos strove to maintain his rationality and faith, to avoid becoming like the nearby Dark Elves who had fallen into his clutches. But a deep, dark corruption spread within them and their forest as the Abyss wielded its power.
en|Eudora n’ignorait en aucun cas la sit: Eudora was by no means unaware of Goo's predicament. At the end of Soldier Moniyan's writings, she left a few sentences.
en|\"Les Abysses sont une catastrophe. I: "The Abyss is a catastrophe. It divides factions and breeds pure hatred. But maybe, just maybe, it is a chance for us: a chance for all the souls of these lands to come together once more, to become one."
en|Lorsque les destins de tous les peupl: When the destinies of all people are linked, where will sweet Gloo go next?
en|Le nom Gloo est un jeu de mots du mot: The name Gloo is a pun on the word "Glue", referring to his Grab, Grab for sticking to an enemy hero.
en|Gloo est le deuxième héros qui peut s: Gloo is the second hero who can attach to another hero and use her skills while attaching, the first being Angela.
en|Gloo est le premier héros à s'attache: Gloo is the first hero to attach to an enemy hero, while Angela attaches to an ally hero.
en|Le fruit préféré de Gloo est la pomme: Gloo's favorite fruit is the apple.
en|Gloo est le deuxième héros à avoir un: Gloo is the second hero to have a base skin with skill effects, the other here is Guinevere.
en|Doyen de l'École Icare de l'Académie: Dean of the Icarus School of the Magic Academy.
en|Gord a toujours été la preuve vivante: Gord has always been the living proof of excellence within the magic academy. He was born with the gift of manipulating mystical powers, which allowed him to master several sophisticated spells at a young age. But it's clearly a double-edged sword as Gord has become more and more arrogant over time. One day, he came across a banned book at the academy that recorded the method of forging pure mystical existence from the human body using mystical powers.
en|Le jeune sorcier s'enfonça dans le li: The young wizard buried himself in the book and threw himself into his study without respecting outside opinions. It worked successfully at first, pure mystical energy began to flow through Gord's veins, allowing him to cast even more powerful spells. Unfortunately, Gord was unable to control this power and was overwhelmed by the mystical energy. Gord then tried to seek a solution from ancient magical sources. With the combination of the two different energies, Gord's body was almost devastated. With the help of Elward, the chief wizard, the turbulence in his body could finally be controlled. The incident had a huge impact on Gord, leaving his body half red and half blue. Although he was saved, Gord would never again be able to control the magic contained in pure mystical energy.
en|Elward a encouragé Gord jusqu'à ce qu: Elward encouraged Gord until he finally got back on his feet. Elward then invited Gord to continue his career as a wizard and invited him to teach at the academy. After careful consideration, Gord accepted the offer. He wanted to find a student who would continue his studies without making the same mistakes. From that day on, Gord began a new life as the strictest teacher in the magic academy.
en|Il a une petite ressemblance avec Sil: He bears a slight resemblance to Silver Surfer, both riding on a floating surfboard-like contraption.
en|Gord est l'un des héros qui ne marche: Gord is one of the heroes who doesn't walk, but rides on his floating board.
en|Avant sa refonte, il exécute son ulti: Before his recast, he performs his ultimate using his floating board. Now he performs it only with his hands.
en|Gord est l'un des héros qui peut infl: Gord is one of the heroes who can deal more than one type of damage with his skills (Magic Damage and True Damage).
en|Gord est l'un des héros qui peuvent e: Gord is one of the heroes who can zoom out in the game, when he uses name=Mystic Gush. The other heroes are name=Pharsa, name=Kimmy, name=Lesley, and name=Gatotkaca, all with their ultimates, as well as name=Yi Sun-Shin's name=Blood Floods while charging.
en|Gord était le mentor de name=Valir pe: Gord was name=Valir's mentor during his time at the Magic Academy and is currently seeking to put an end to his student after Valir's arcane flame was unleashed on the academy.
en|Un mystérieux chasseur de démons qui: A mysterious demon hunter who operates outside the conventions of the Church of Light. Always seen with a violin case in hand, he hunts down demons with his two soul-devouring weapons.
en|Un barde, un célèbre chasseur de démo: A bard, a famous demon hunter Granger, a demon hunter who is somewhere between human and demon, always preferred to stay alone. But if anyone could enter his world, they would realize how terrifying it is: the incessant screams and shrill screams constantly deafen his ears and his heart. When he draws his demon-eating weapons and unleashes a hail of bullets, the demons' agonizing screams become a requiem playing deep within his soul. Only the intertwining of their death cries and the sound of gunshots can drown out the noise that torments him every day. Every shot Granger fires is not only her performance against the Abyss, but also an expression of her lament. === Bullet Sonata === An unnamed city on the border of the Moniyan Empire is Granger's destination for this trip
en|Il marchait tranquillement, l'écharpe: He walked leisurely, the bright red scarf around his neck exuding a strange aura. His skin was as pale as parchment, with a high collar covering half of his face, revealing only a pair of dark eyes.
en|Granger se dirigea vers la périphérie: Granger headed towards the outskirts of the city, fully aware of what awaited him. Even though their deep growls were hard to hear, the ringing in his ears that he despised was growing louder and louder.
en|Soudain, une mélodie familière attira: Suddenly, a familiar melody caught Granger's attention. A child sits in the street and plays a tune on a flute. It is the “Hymn to the Light”, a song he often heard when he was young.
en|L'enfance de Granger a été pour le mo: Granger's childhood was tragic, to say the least.
en|Une nuit, sa ville fut attaquée par d: One night, his city was attacked by demons. With nowhere to escape, Granger's parents hid him in a small space under the floorboards. As the demons burst in and dragged his parents away, their screams and demonic growls left an indelible shadow on his young heart. This memory turned into a constant ringing in her ears, torturing Granger night after night. The pain caused him to withdraw from others and he became more and more reclusive. Until the day when a beautiful and sweet melody calmed the ringing, like a warm hand on his heart, granting him a moment of peace that he had almost forgotten.
en|Pour la première fois, il sortit de s: For the first time, he stepped out of his chaotic world and looked up to see a priest playing the violin.
en|\"Quel est le nom de cette pièce ?\": “What is the name of this room?”
en|Le prêtre sortit un stylo et du papie: The priest took a pen and paper from his pocket and wrote the words "Hymn to the Light."
en|Il s’est avéré que le prêtre était au: It turned out that the priest was once the choir leader of the Monastery of Light. It was his job to soothe people's suffering hearts with his voice. But years ago, when Alice infiltrated Lumina City and threw the city into chaos, the priest was struck by a demon and lost the ability to speak. But instead of falling into despair, he picked up the violin and continued to help others through music.
en|Peut-être que le son du violon était: Perhaps the sound of the violin was too inviting. Granger left his world and followed the priest to the monastery. He even tried to learn the violin but could only produce discordant noises.
en|\"On dirait que je n'ai aucun talent,: "It seems like I have no talent," Granger lamented dejectedly. The priest smiled and showed him that true melody does not come from talent, but from kindness and perseverance in the heart, and in this aspect he thought Granger had a lot of it.
en|Granger, qui n'a pas réussi à faire b: Granger, who failed to make much progress in music, showed exceptional talent in hunting demons. The leaders of the Church personally invited him to join the ranks of their demon hunters, even offering him a specialized weapon: a pair of demon-eating pistols capable of absorbing demonic energy and converting it into special bullets for killing demons. The few friends he had, including Alucard, invited him to hunt demons together, but Granger refused. Even though the priest's music had healed his chaotic world, the night of his parents' deaths still remained in his heart like a permanent wound, bleeding at the slightest touch.
en|Le prêtre respecta la décision de Gra: The priest respected Granger's decision. He believed that even the deepest wounds could heal one day and that this introverted and gentle child would eventually accept the past and move towards a better future.
But that day would never come.
en|Dyrroth, le prince des Abysses, mena: Dyrroth, the Prince of the Abyss, led his Abyssal legions through the Moonlight Forest to attack the Moniyan Empire. In response, the Church of Light recruited demon hunters to prepare for the impending war. Seeing Granger disturbed by this, the priest let him take leave of the monastery to decide his future. Whether or not he chooses to remain a demon hunter, the monastery will always be his home.
en|Mais quand Granger revint au monastèr: But when Granger returned to the monastery, he saw only burning ruins and the priest lying in a pool of blood – the demons had already struck.
en|Quel que soit son choix, il n’avait p: Whatever he chose, it no longer made sense.
en|La main du prêtre tenait toujours l'a: The priest's hand still held the violin bow. Granger could almost imagine the priest calmly performing his final requiem as the demons attacked. The ringing invades his world again. But this time, there would be no Hymn to the Light to appease him. There would be no one to smile and comfort his pain, no one to play him a lullaby to help him sleep. How could he silence this piercing noise... this creeping madness... this deafening rage in his chest?
en|Sentant la présence d'une âme vivante: Sensing the presence of a living soul, the demons stationed nearby moved closer. Granger took out her weapons and began a frenzied 'performance'. As the screams of the demons grew louder, the sound of the bullets also grew louder. The two cacophonies intertwined in a grand requiem, drowning out the ringing in Granger's ears. He suddenly realized that for him, it was the only way to ease the pain. Blood for blood, until all evil is dead and gone.
en|Après cela, Granger est officiellemen: After that, Granger officially became a demon hunter. He named one of his pistols "Dirge", modified the other into a cannon and installed it in the priest's violin case, which he named "Requiem". He wrapped bandages around his hands to prevent bloodshed from staining the hands that once hoped to learn the violin. From then on, every hunt became a requiem for those he lost.
en|Les souvenirs qui avaient refait surf: The memories that had resurfaced were shattered again.
en|L'attention de Granger revint au prés: Granger's attention returned to the present. Since he set foot in this small town, the ringing in his ears hasn't stopped, but he knew that everything would calm down soon.
en|Il s'accroupit et plaça doucement que: He crouched down and gently placed a few coins in front of the child.
en|Alors que « l’Ave Maria » atteignait: As the “Ave Maria” reached its finale, the Demon Hunter’s Death Sonata was about to begin.
en|Alors que \"Granger\" signifiait à l': While "Granger" originally meant "farm steward", it also sounds like "Ranger", which fits his lone wolf and marksman personality. His name could be inspired by The Gunslinger (Stephen King's Dark Tower series), which features a similar gun-wielding anti-hero.
en|Granger a été le premier tireur d'éli: Granger was the first sniper that required no mana or energy.
en|Cependant, ses capacités coûtent déso: However, his abilities now cost energy after his rework, with the exception of skill 2.
en|Granger est le premier tireur d'élite: Granger is the first sniper without a basic attack crit.
en|Son nom de fichier de jeu interne est: Its internal game file name is Mike.
en|Il a des racines françaises et italie: He has French and Italian roots.
en|Son nom d'arme est Dirge et son nom d: His weapon name is Dirge and his barrel name is Requiem.
en|Son Ultimate (Death Sonata) doit son: His Ultimate (Death Sonata) is named after a piece of classical music, corresponding to his experience as a violinist.
en|Son design est fortement inspiré des: Its design is heavily inspired by Western gunslingers, mixed with anime and gothic elements.
en|Il porte un étui à violon et l'appell: He carries a violin case and calls it a guitar case but it's loaded with cannons. One of his deleted vocal lines "Don't you dare touch my guitar case". But it's actually a violin case.
He speaks French in his voices.
en|En fait, il joue de la musique avec s: He actually plays music with his gun on his violin case during the encore.
en|Le skin Doomsday Terminator de Grange: Granger's Doomsday Terminator skin is heavily inspired by The Terminator film series. Its cybernetic design, glowing red eye, and robotic enhancements resemble the T-800 (played by Arnold Schwarzenegger).
en|Silvanna, Fanny, Harith, Tigreal (co-: Silvanna, Fanny, Harith, Tigreal (co-members of Lightborn)
en|L'homme de pierre s'est réveillé du s: The stone man woke up from sleep.
en|Au fond des montagnes du Pays de l’Au: Deep in the mountains of the Land of Dawn lies an ancient fortress. Although its owner is unknown, rumor has it that it may be a descendant of the legendary race that once roamed the Dawnlands. It said that this race is older than the earth itself and that having a special affinity with nature, they were capable of forming deep bonds and relationships with various beings of nature, particularly the Stone Titans.
en|Ces aimables géants possèdent une pea: These friendly giants possess rocky skin almost impervious to any physical force, but due to their benevolent nature, they primarily use their physical prowess to sleep safely. These stone giants love to sleep so much that they sometimes hibernate for up to six months. However, once they wake up, it is difficult for them to go back to sleep. One day, when Grock woke up, he found himself alone with the long-lost keepers of the fortress. He then saddled the fortress on his back to find the owners, traveling throughout the Land of Dawn to find news of their fate, so that he could one day return their home to them.
en|Le design de Grock est fortement infl: Grock's design is heavily influenced by golems, which are stone or earth-based protectors in mythology and fantasy.
en|Grock est le premier héros du jeu à i: Grock is the first hero in the game to summon a physical wall.
en|Fille aristocratique au tempérament é: Aristocratic girl with a strange temperament, loved by her older brother Lancelot.
en|La famille baroque est l'une des rare: The Baroque family is one of the few nobles in the Land of Dawn. Their most prestigious skill, swordsmanship, the family's strong suit, discourages countless opponents from even thinking about attacking. In addition, beauty and wisdom are also the most perfect genetic signs of the Baroque family, just like Violette's eternal beauty and love.
en|Aussi célèbre que soit l'escrime de l: As famous as the Baroque family's fencing is, young Guinevere doesn't like it at all. Just like other girls, she naturally loves beautiful things. From her youth, she was sent to the Magic Academy. Relying on her own sensitive spiritual perception and anti-gravity magic, when Guinevere was 10 years old, she successfully combined mental perception with super energy and invented multiple magical effects - super magical power. Such a breakthrough made Guinevere more passionate about magic and she often experimented with her new magic on her brother Lancelot. No matter how Lancelot hides, he will be found by his sister. Therefore, Lancelot is often caught in an unknown thrill. As a child, his sister always gave him headaches. Regardless, Lancelot still loves Guinevere. He always shows a smile to his beloved sister. But every time Lancelot thought of his little sister's magical experience, he wore a bitter smile.
en|Récemment, quelque chose tourmente Gu: Recently, something has been tormenting Guinevere, making her uncomfortable. It is said that the Paxley nobles, who have very high magical status, proposed marriage to the Baroque family. Guinevere is undoubtedly the most suitable choice and Guinevere's father seems very amenable to this marriage. But Guinevere, reluctant, suddenly has an idea: she hopes to find her brother Lancelot...
en|À l'origine, dans les contes d'Arthur: Originally in the Arthurian tales, the character Guinevere is supposed to be the wife of King Arthur and is said to have had an illicit affair with one of his knights, Lancelot. However, in the game, they are siblings.
en|\"Fleur de Bleau\" de Guenièvre signi: Guinièvre's "Fleur de Bleau" means "Blue Flower" in French.
en|Même si la couleur de ses cheveux \"F: Even though her "Fleur de Bleau" hair color is brown on the splash art, the hair color on the model is actually blonde.
en|Guenièvre est sorti officiellement le: Guinevere was officially released on February 21, 2019 on the official server and is the 80th hero.
en|Guenièvre a l'une des durées de chaîn: Guinevere has one of the longest CC chain durations in the game at around 3.5 seconds to 4 seconds.
en|Alors qu'elle était encore sur le ser: While still on the advanced server, 2-3 days before Guinevere's initial release, she could ignore turret damage reduction and deal massive damage to turrets with Space Migration and Purple Requiem. But this controlled bug was fixed shortly after.
en|Guenièvre utilise deux types différen: Guinevere uses two different types of unique magic called Super Magic and Anti-Gravity Magic.
en|Selon l'un des artistes VFX qui ont t: According to one of the VFX artists who worked on the effects of Guinevere's KOF skill, her space migration (KOF) originally had a trace when she dashed; it was scrapped because it would destroy the style of the King of Fighters franchise and didn't really fit Athena's character.
en|Le nom Guenièvre a ses racines en gal: The name Guinevere has its roots in Welsh and is derived from the elements “gwen” and “ever”. "Gwen" means "fair", "white" or "blessed" in Welsh. It is often associated with purity, beauty and goodness. “Ever” comes from the Welsh word “hwyfar”, meaning “smooth” or “soft”.
en|Compte tenu de ses caractéristiques r: Given her regal and noble characteristics, combined with the historical context of King Arthur's reign, Guinevere's nationality would most likely align with that of the British, representing the royal aristocracy and legendary nature of Arthurian tales.
en|La maison baroque est la plus ancienn: The Baroque house is the oldest ducal family having existed since the beginning of the Moniyan empire.
en|Fils rebelle de la Maison Paxley Bien: Rebellious Son of House Paxley Although born into the most powerful magical family on the continent, Gusion has no interest in magic. He is keen to draw inspiration from the sacred light to develop new combat skills. Eventually, Gusion left the family. ===Patriarchs and big brother... Do you really know me?===
en|La maison Paxley régnait sur le châte: House Paxley ruled Aberleen Castle, south of Moniyan. Generations of the house had guarded these areas for the Moniyan Empire, defending against invasion from the Abyss.
en|Il y a environ mille ans, la maison P: About a thousand years ago, House Paxley was granted the dukedom during the reign of the legendary mage Valentina.
en|De nombreuses histoires horribles ont: Many horrible stories were told across the Moniyan Empire of House Paxley's use of forbidden magic, and so people avoided any Paxley they encountered.
en|Mais Gusion Paxley était une exceptio: But Gusion Paxley was an exception.
en|Il était naturellement doué avec les: He was naturally skilled with blades and daggers, and before he could speak, he had been able to accurately strike his nanny in the forehead with a toy dagger in revenge for disciplining her. And when he began to read and write, the ink-dipped quill always flew toward the back of his personal tutor's head as if it had eyes.
en|Ses comportements indisciplinés ont c: His unruly behaviors continued until his older brother Aamon took control of the duchy – young Gusion was showing off his dagger skills at the party when he accidentally missed his target, the dagger instead leaving a deep cut on Aamon's face.
en|Aamon n'a pas blâmé son jeune frère i: Aamon did not blame his careless younger brother, but word quickly spread throughout the Moniyan Empire that the fourth child of House Paxley was a blade-wielder - for the Paxley family who were famous for their magical skills, only lower-class citizens who did not know magic would fight with daggers and swords.
en|Les anciens Paxley qui contrôlaient r: The Paxley elders who actually controlled the family soon ordered Gusion to stop playing with daggers and concentrate on practicing magic. And Gusion actually inherited the family's magical talent. He had a strong affinity for the element of light and quickly awakened his potential while learning magic. But he hated memorizing tedious spells and writing complicated scrolls. When the other students were researching magic indoors all day, Gusion powered himself with sunlight so he could run faster than a leopard, or used candlelight to move knives and cut an entire table's dishes into pieces.
en|Gusion était le seul étudiant de la c: Gusion was the only upperclassman who spoke with the servants at their family academy, and he was a naughty but friendly child, so the servants always covered up his incessant violation of the rules; even when he was kept in solitary confinement, the guards pretended not to see the desserts that the servants slipped under the door...
en|Finalement, ces aînés exaspérés ont d: Eventually, these exasperated elders asked young Aamon to discipline his desperate brother. Gusion hoped his brother would be on his side, but Aamon instead began lecturing him as the head of the family.
en|Gusion était déçu et ignorait complèt: Gusion was disappointed and completely ignored his brother's lessons, while feeling deeply sorry for the big brother who was close to him – Aamon in front of him was clearly one of the elders, only the youngest...
en|Et pendant leur dîner ensemble, Aamon: And during their dinner together, Aamon persuaded Gusion to follow family traditions and accept training in magic, as Valentina, the first duchess of their family, was a great mage herself. Aamon also told Gusion that he could become an assassin like him, transforming magic into sharp blades.
en|Gusion se sentit fortement réticent e: Gusion felt strongly reluctant and instead asked, "Can't a Paxley become an assassin who fights with blades?"
en|Aamon n’avait pas d’autre choix que d: Aamon had no choice but to say, “As a noble, sometimes you will have to hide what you truly love…”
en|Gusion regarda son frère et ne parla: Gusion looked at his brother and did not speak further.
en|Quelques années plus tard, lors de sa: A few years later, during his coming-of-age ceremony, a family fighting competition, the 18-year-old Gusion appeared in the arena in a unique style: he used bizarre and fanciful movements to dodge projectiles fired by the other young mages, while his swift and mysterious dagger precisely struck his opponents before they could even cast their spells. The elders of House Paxley were stunned: Gusion was an unconventional blade wielder, but he did indeed use magical powers to control the dagger...
en|Les autres jeunes mages perdus contre: The other young mages lost to Gusion began to accuse him of "cheating", but he instead provoked them further, claiming that those who felt unfair could challenge him together, as he was capable of defeating ten cocky Paxley mages!
en|Les concurrents provoqués se sont pré: The provoked competitors rushed towards him, when Gusion suddenly used a move no one had seen before: he swung his arm and sent daggers flying towards the fan-shaped area ahead, hitting any enemies that charged him. Then he jumped onto the spectator stand, before throwing a dagger at the statue of House Paxley ancestor Valentina and hitting her in the forehead to provoke the others!
en|\"C'est ce que vous voulez – c'est ex: “It’s what you want – it’s just like the motto of House Paxley: fear over love.”
en|Après que Gusion ait crié ces mots de: After Gusion shouted these angry words, the exasperated elders began chanting spells, attempting to punish the rebel of House Paxley with magic. Aamon, who had remained silent, then stood out and announced loudly: Gusion was going to be kicked out of the family for seriously breaking their rules!
en|Maintenant qu'Aamon avait expulsé son: Now that Aamon had expelled his brother, the elders who were ready to kill Gusion had to stop their dark magic spells, watching Gusion walk out of the arena without sparing them a glance.
en|Quel serait son avenir ? Gusion n'y a: What would its future be? Gusion had never thought about it. He felt a heavy weight lifted from his shoulders, confident that with his abilities, he would one day make a name for himself in the Land of Dawn.
en|Aamon pensa en regardant Gusion s'élo: Aamon thought as he watched Gusion walk away: “What I can do is give you your freedom back…”
en|Dans la version initiale de Gusion, i: In the initial version of Gusion, he was originally known as Gossen. His name was later changed to Gusion in later updates.
en|En démonologie, Gusion est le onzième: In demonology, Gusion is the eleventh of the 72 demons of Goetia. He is a powerful Grand Duke of Hell and rules over forty legions of demons.
en|Les noms de Gusion et de son frère Aa: The names of Gusion and his brother Aamon are derived from the writings of The Lesser Key of Solomon.
en|Gusion a été le premier héros à infli: Gusion was the first hero to deal physical and magical damage with his skills. (Physical: passive skill; Magic: all active skills) His rework allowed his passive to deal magic damage.
en|Gusion est le premier héros dont les: Gusion is the first hero whose active skills include second phases.
en|En 2018, Gusion a utilisé le mot « co: In 2018, Gusion used the word "bullshit" in the now-deleted cinematic trailer (only removed on the official MLBB YouTube page, but the official Facebook page is still up as of June 6, 2023), marking the first time profanity has appeared in official Mobile Legends media, which would thankfully be par for the course for a game rated T by the ESRB for the Americas.
en|Les Anciens qui connaissent la prophé: The Elders who know the prophecy wanted to kill Gusion to prevent the God from being reborn. This is because Gusion is cursed by the god of trickery "Kalon".
en|Chef de la Secte Écarlate, dans l'Omb: Leader of the Scarlet Sect, in the Scarlet Shadow of the Riverlands of Cadia.

Leader of the Scarlet Sect, in the Scarlet Shadow in the Riverlands of Cadia. As the owner of the Higanbana, one of the Seven Great Armaments of the Scarlet Shadow Clan, Hanabi is the pride of the Scarlet Sect. To perpetuate her father's will, she has sought power since childhood. Because of her single-minded focus, she closed herself off from all feelings and emotions. Despite this, she was never truly accepted by Higanbana. One day, while pursuing an enemy spy and losing ground, she accidentally entered Higanbana's world and lingered between illusion and reality. Eventually, she understood that power without emotion was volatile and fleeting. She came to terms with herself and embraced her feelings and desires by becoming one with Higanbana. === The shore ===
en|\"Le Higanbana fleurit sur le rivage,: "The Higanbana blooms on the shore, as if consumed by flames. Unable to let go of their obsessions, lost souls plunge into the abyss. They no longer remember their past lives and the future is a mystery. They are drawn to this place, which condemns them to hell." —Higanbana, Seven Armaments of the Scarlet Shadow
en|Sombre et glacial, mais tranquille. E: Dark and icy, but peaceful. She floated above the water as if suspended in mid-air. A thick, impenetrable mist swirled all around her. In the darkness, the only light was a group of Higanbana in the distance. They were a bright, piercing purple, red as hellfire, like fire burning on a distant shore she would never reach.
en|C'était un cauchemar récurrent que Ha: It was a recurring nightmare that Hanabi had been experiencing since she was 7 years old. This was the year when, due to her inherent talent for cultivation, she unintentionally activated the Scarlet's ancient weaponry, "Higanbana". All she remembered was being swallowed up by the weapon and falling into a vast, nightmarish abyss. When she woke up, her eyes were filled with tears, but despite this, the crowd that had gathered before her were cheering and congratulating her for becoming the one deemed worthy of being Scarlet's successor.
en|Même à son jeune âge, Hanabi réalisa: Even at her young age, Hanabi realized what this meant: within the Scarlet Shadow, there was the Scarlet Sect, which favored the use of weapons, and the Shadow Sect, with a predilection for Ninjutsu. For generations, each fought to dominate the other. And if the Scarlet Leader wins, the Scarlet Sect wins. All young Hanabi could do was place her trust in the sect and its plan. So she took on this solemn duty and did her best to hold her head high. Day after day she trained, rivulets of sweat running down her body from sunrise to sunset. In competition, Hanabi was undefeated. Over time, she grew accustomed to victory and the dark river that bloomed in her dreams. She knew that when she reached this shore, she would harness the power of Higanbana and then truly become the leader of the Scarlet Sect.
en|Tout cela s'est terminé avec l'appari: This all ended with the appearance of Hayabusa.
en|De tous les individus remarquables de: Of all the notable individuals in the Shadow Sect, Hayabusa was the most distinguished. Like an apparition, he appeared during competitions, quickly defeated his opponents and left without uttering a single word. It was like he wasn't even interested in competitions. Hanabi often stalked Hayabusa and challenged him to a fight. As they clashed, they both fled across mountain streams and over thatched roofs, their blades clashing and clanging more times than could be counted. However, in the end, Hanabi would still be defeated and the Black River would begin to swell, with water reaching its banks. With each defeat, Hanabi, filled with resignation, asked Hayabusa how he managed to surpass her, and each time he only shrugged his shoulders and said:
en|L'arrogance sans entrave et la frivol: The unfettered arrogance and utter frivolity of his response made Hanabi blinded with rage. She couldn't lose, just like the Scarlet Sect. She threw herself even further into her training; she would do whatever it took to reach that distant shore.
en|Hanzo, l'un des ninjas les plus puiss: Hanzo, one of Scarlet Shadow's most powerful ninjas, fled with Ame no Habakiri, making himself an enemy of both Scarlet and Shadow.
