Together, the two sects sent their best warriors to hunt Hanzo. This was Hanabi's first time fighting with Hayabusa on the same side, and she wasn't going to miss this opportunity to redeem herself. She would find Hanzo alone, without any help from Hayabusa. However, after locating Hanzo, he proved more pernicious than Hanabi anticipated. Unable to withstand a frontal attack from the Ame no Habakiri, Hanabi struggled to continue escaping. She could feel herself slipping, and as the blade passed through her throat, she remembered the dark river.
en|Elle ne pouvait pas perdre, tout comm: She couldn't lose, just like the Scarlet Sect. She had to win.
en|En jurant son allégeance éternelle à: Pledging her eternal allegiance to Higanbana, Hanabi offered her own body.
en|Au moment de sa mort, un immense pouv: At the moment of his death, an immense power swept away Hanabi like a raging tsunami, and in that moment, she understood that Hanzo had pledged allegiance to Ame no Habakiri in exchange for this power. I didn't have time to think any further. Hanabi rushed towards Hanzo. Amidst a flurry of cuts, cuts, and stabs, Hanabi's vision began to blur, but she could make out her opponent stumbling backwards. She had won! However, the waters began to surge and she found herself submerged once again in that familiar dark river.
en|Loin de s'apaiser, la rivière faisait: Far from calming down, the river raged with greater ferocity as monstrous waves crashed one after another, dragging Hanabi to the bottom of the riverbed. Such was the fate of countless souls who had been locked within this weapon. Every ounce of their pain and resentment turned into an insurmountable power that enslaved all who entered, keeping them trapped inside forever. It was the land of the dead, a land from which there was no escape.
en|Les vagues déferlantes résonnaient da: The crashing waves echoed in his ears, the sound almost like a chorus. She fought with all her strength, but Hanabi was unable to escape. This burning flower that was once so far away was now so close, but it still remained out of his reach. Little by little, she sank deeper...
en|Le son de la voix d'Hayabusa transper: The sound of Hayabusa's voice pierced the void, bringing Hanabi back from the abyss. Ignoring the souls of the dead pressed against her throat, she raised her head.
en|Le clair de lune se reflétait sur la: The moonlight reflected off the surface of the river. It was magnificent.
en|Ce qui était autrefois de pures ténèb: What was once pure darkness was now exposed to light. The dead retreated and the raging waters calmed until all was calm again. The first Scarlet Chieftain was the first owner of the armaments. In his incessant quest for power, he was not there for his wife in her final moments. The world was his, but he had lost everything. Therefore, he went crazy. In his mania, he locked all his power and all his sorrow into Higanbana.
en|Hanabi put enfin voir que le rivage n: Hanabi could finally see that the shore was no longer far away. It was before his eyes. She had won. In the distance, she looked at the flowers that grew at the end of the river. Hidden among them, she could see the faint figure of the first scarlet chief and his wife, standing side by side in the moonlight. The Scarlet Shadow had sacrificed everything for victory. Now, at that moment, it was clear that their sacrifices had not been in vain.
en|Alors que Hanabi reprenait progressiv: As Hanabi gradually came to his senses, Hayabusa took her away, while Hanzo managed to escape. They were in no condition to pursue them, but it was just a simple setback, nothing more.
en|Higanbana reposait doucement dans la: Higanbana rested gently in Hanabi's hand. She had unlocked its secrets and become its owner. Freed from her obsessions and inner demons, Hanabi was able to truly see Hayabusa, her former adversary, clearly for the first time. She finally understood what he had been telling her all along: there are things in this world more precious than winning.
en|Même si elle ne savait pas exactement: Although she didn't know exactly how to proceed, she also knew that she no longer needed advice from others. Whichever direction she took, all paths led to her shore.
en|Elle leva la tête et leva les yeux ve: She raised her head and looked up at the night sky. The moon was beautiful this evening. »
en|Le nom Hanabi (花火) est d'origine japo: The name Hanabi (花火) is of Japanese origin and means "fireworks" (花 = "flower", 火 = "fire"). It symbolizes beauty, fleeting moments and explosive power.
en|Ses shurikens énergétiques en forme d: Her petal-shaped energy shurikens resemble fireworks as they bounce between enemies. His ultimate, Forbidden Jutsu: Higanbana, explodes like fireworks, stunning several enemies.
en|Le nom de l'arme de Hanabi et d'Ultim: The name of Hanabi and Ultimate's weapon, Higanbana, refers to the Japanese common name of the plant Lycoris radiata, known in English as the red spider lily or equinox flower.
en|Hanabi et nom = citation d'entrée de: Hanabi and name = entry quote from Hayabusa, Sanjou (in the English and Japanese audios), as well as Hanzo (in the Japanese audio, pre-recast), is a Japanese term that roughly translates to "I have arrived" or "I am here". In the context of ninjas, "Sanjou" is often used as a declaration of arrival or as a means of announcing one's presence. It is a way for the ninja to assert his presence and let others know that he is ready to take action.
en|Le skin « Fiery Moth » de Hanabi est: Hanabi's "Fiery Moth" skin is inspired by Japanese folklore. Moths are sometimes thought to carry the spirits of the dead, which fits Hanabi's Higanbana (flower of death) theme.
en|La peau Rakshesha de Hanabi est inspi: Hanabi's Rakshesha skin is inspired by the Rakshasa (राक्षस), which are demonic entities in Hindu and Buddhist mythology.
en|Elle s'inspire quelque peu de Coco de: She is somewhat inspired by Coco from Magic Rush: Heroes.
en|Le design de Hanabi est inspiré de la: Hanabi's design is inspired by the kunoichi (female ninja) from Japanese folklore. His rival, Hayabusa, has samurai-like discipline, while Hanabi embodies the archetypal rogue ninja who pursues forbidden techniques.
en|Elle partage son doubleur en japonais: She shares her Japanese voice actor, Ono Saki, with Fanny.
en|Ninja génial de la Shadow Sect qui es: Awesome Shadow Sect ninja who is at a crossroads.
en|Ninja de génie de la Secte des Ombres: Shadow Sect genius ninja at a crossroads A Shadow Sect genius ninja in the Scarlet Shadow. In order to pursue great power, he absorbed the "Hanekage" into his body and used the enemy's flesh and blood to nourish the "Hanekage". After gaining power, he took the strongest supreme ninjutsu and Ame no Habakiri into the Scarlet Shadow, and went further and further on the path of killing. ===Nindo's End=== "Protecting the secrets of the Sacred Tools is your duty; value it more than your life."
en|Alors que Hanzo se réveillait au mili: As Hanzo awoke in the middle of the night from the pain inflicted by the Ame no Habakiri, he remembered this teaching that had led him down this path of no return. Before turning his back on Scarlet Shadow, Hanzo was the sharpest blade in the Shadow Sect.
en|Adopté par la Secte de l'Ombre dès so: Adopted by the Shadow Sect at a young age, Hanzo was lucky to escape the fate of a wandering beggar. He learned the ways of Nindo, to “uphold justice and endure hardship,” and lived his new life according to his teachings. For the Scarlet Shadow, his beloved home, he was ready to do anything.
en|Féroce et tenace comme le loup, Hanzo: Fierce and tenacious like a wolf, Hanzo has always embarked on the most perilous missions. Even when he returned with serious injuries, he made his full report before seeking treatment. Failure was something even Hanzo's greatest rivals wouldn't dare think about. They knew Hanzo would stop at nothing to achieve his goals.
en|Au cours d'une décennie, Hanzo a accu: Over the course of a decade, Hanzo accumulated so much merit that his peers considered him, a commoner by birth, second only to Kurēn, the next heir of the clan. Hanzo recognized Kurēn's unparalleled wisdom. If Kurēn swore to defend Nindo after taking power, then Hanzo would become his sharpest blade.
en|Jusqu'à présent, Hanzo n'avait jamais: Until now, Hanzo had never thought his past was wrong, but it was his near-obsessive persistence that brought him to this point.
en|Il y a quelque temps, Hanzo, alors qu: Some time ago, Hanzo, while immersed in the Nindo scriptures, suddenly realized that his peers, other orphans adopted by the clan, had been regularly disappearing without any explanation. Very perplexed, Hanzo began to investigate alone. During his research, he came across several elders, which resulted in him being stripped of all rank in the clan. The merits he acquired at the risk of his life were erased overnight. Hanzo cared little for fame, but he knew something sinister was being concealed. Eventually, he discovered that the ancients had sent ninjas on a mission to the Forbidden Grounds to steal a cursed tool that was supposedly sealed within: the demon blade Ame no Habakiri.
en|D’innombrables vies ont été sacrifiée: Countless lives were sacrificed to the demonic blade. Hanzo couldn't bear to think how many members of the Scarlet Shadow who simply sought to uphold justice ended up with this fate.
en|Un manque de concentration momentané: A momentary lapse in concentration led to Hanzo being discovered by another ninja in the Forbidden Grounds: it was Kurēn.
en|Dans la chambre sombre et en pierre,: In the dark, stone chamber, Kurēn revealed the truth about the Scarlet Shadow: the two factions of the clan vied for control of the Seven Sacred Tools, each attempting to tip the balance of power in their favor. The elders of the Shadow Sect sacrificed their own to the Ame no Habakiri in order to awaken its true power.
en|Kurēn avait secrètement gagné en infl: Kurēn had secretly gained influence to abolish this vile practice once he became the leader of the clan, and seeing Hanzo, he was eager for a ninja from Nindo to help him change the future of the clan.
en|\"Ceux qui ont été sacrifiés à Ame no: “Those who were sacrificed to Ame no Habakiri...what about their future?”
en|Kurēn n'avait pas de réponse à sa que: Kurēn had no answer to his question, which made Hanzo angry. He had seen too many hypocrites pretending to act for the common good, and in that moment he realized that the Scarlet Shadow was no different. His Nindo did not tolerate bad deeds, so the Scarlet Shadow should not exist. If they craved Ame no Habakiri's power so much, he would show them his true might.
en|Alors que Hanzo attrapait la lame dém: As Hanzo grabbed the demon blade from the pedestal, he thought, "Come, either devour me, or let me devour everything!"
en|Au moment où il a saisi l’Ame no Haba: The moment he grabbed the Ame no Habakiri, its unbridled demonic power invaded his body. In a trance, he saw a whirlwind swallowing ships, or was it a leviathan devouring entire islands? Quickly he realized what he was really seeing:
en|C'était un vortex d'âmes ; les ninjas: It was a vortex of souls; the ninjas who had been sacrificed, and countless others before them. Their wills had long since been erased, leaving only insatiable hunger and restless darkness within the blade; a madness that was neither human nor demonic.
en|Le pouvoir démoniaque a envahi l'être: Demonic power invaded Hanzo's very being, but his pride refused to be consumed. Feeding on his rage and obsession, he eventually tamed the Ame no Habakiri.
en|\"Président naïf, vous serez témoin d: “Naive President, you will witness my reign from this blade.”
en|Et sur ce, Hanzo a balancé la lame su: And with that, Hanzo swung the blade at his former comrade Kurēn. "Gaining influence"... is just a cowardly compromise of the weak. Without the courage to take the first step, change would never happen.
en|Après avoir dévoré Kurēn, Hanzo a qui: After devouring Kurēn, Hanzo left the forbidden grounds. He knew that his path as a Shadow Sect ninja was broken forever. But what about it? This Akuma will eliminate the Scarlet Shadow's rot once and for all.
en|Le nom Hanzo a été porté par le trist: The name Hanzo was borne by the infamous ninja Hanzō Hattori, nicknamed Oni no Hanzō (Demon Hanzō).
en|Le nom est dérivé de la lettre 半 (han: The name is derived from the letter 半 (han) meaning "half" and 蔵 (zō/zou) meaning "to hide".
en|Son titre, Akuma Ninja, est dérivé du: Its title, Akuma Ninja, is derived from the word "Akuma" (悪魔), which translates to devil, demon or evil spirit in English. It is formed from the combination of two Japanese characters: "aku" (悪), which means "bad" or "evil", and "ma" (魔), which means "spirit", "magic" or "ghost". This perfectly shows his power-hungry character as an evil ninja.
en|Selon la mythologie japonaise, Ame no: According to Japanese mythology, Ame no Habakiri is one of the 4 Totsuka swords. Ame no Habakiri was used by Susanoo to kill Yamata no Orochi.
en|Le mot japonais écrit sur son dos est: The Japanese word written on its back is Fū which translates to “seal”.
en|Certains aspects de l'armure et du ma: Certain aspects of Hanzo's armor and mask resemble the Tengu, mythical creatures who were feared and respected as powerful ninja-like beings.
en|Hanzo possède l'une des jungles les p: Hanzo has one of the fastest jungles as his first skill (Ninjutsu: Demon Feast) instantly eats jungle monsters, gaining buffs faster than most heroes.
en|Maison d'Akakage, Ombre Écarlate, Riv: House of Akakage, Scarlet Shadow, Shores of Cadia
en|Transformez son âme en Hanekage et ac: Transform his soul into Hanekage and gain a new set of skills
en|Garçon léonin venu d'Azrya dans l'emp: Leonine boy from Azrya in the Moniyan Empire.
en|Les légendes disent qu'une ancienne r: Legends say that an ancient race of elves reside in the enchanted forest of the Land of Dawn. Stories often describe this feline breed as small, agile, playful, independent, and very intelligent. However, few people know of the long-standing alliance between the Leonine Elves and the Moon Elves.
en|Dès son plus jeune âge, Harith a surp: From a young age, Harith surpassed his peers in talent and wisdom. He quickly became the most powerful mage among the Leonins, perhaps as strong as the other mages in the Land of Dawn. However, the Leonins never leave the Enchanted Forest, living a peaceful and safe life alone. The Leonines became so complacent with their happy existence that they no longer indulged in the magical arts, a hallmark of their people. Harith became very unhappy with this trend and confidently left the Enchanted Forest to see the outside world at the young age of 15. Harith was driven by his passion for the magical arts, aspiring to become the leader of his people in matters of magic.
en|Harith arriva dans l'empire Moniyan,: Harith arrived in the Moniyan Empire, where he joined the armies to fight the orcish invaders. Proving himself in battle, Harith gained the recognition of Tigreal, who came to appreciate Harith's beautiful spirit and strong abilities. People say that Harith has been given the rank of lieutenant and will soon be appointed as the Imperial Magic Master of the Moniyan Empire. That said, Harith has Imperial permission to use magic to control space and time to unlock the secrets of the dawn to seal away evil and protect justice.
en|Plein d'enthousiasme et de ferveur, H: Full of enthusiasm and fervor, Harith also knew that once named Master of Magic, he would become the target of public criticism. True to his dream of becoming the leader of his people in matters of magic, Harith moved forward alone and without fear. As time passed, Harith found his life consumed by his mission and the empire. Harith slowly became lonely and reclusive. Even when he met his comrade Léonine, Nana, he was unable to maintain a normal conversation. Although Nana showed signs of affection towards him, he could not express his feelings, believing that the best way to protect her from criticism was for him to be alone. After all, whenever the empire needed magical aid, the Master of Magic was there to ward off the dangers of evil.
en|Le \"Key Insight\" passif de Harith é: Harith's passive "Key Insight" was capable of increasing his resilience.
en|Bien qu'Harith soit un mage, son rôle: Although Harith is a mage, his primary role is often played in the Gold Lane rather than the Mid Lane.
en|Harith est le premier héros à recevoi: Harith is the first hero to receive an exclusive M Series champion skin when EVOS Legends won the M1 World Championship. Other heroes with the M-Series skin include Lancelot, Estes, Chou, Brody, and Joy.
en|Harith a également un skin de collabo: Harith also has a Hunter × Hunter collaboration skin with Killua, whose English voice in the 2011 anime, Cristina Vee, is shared with the game's announcer and with older versions of Kagura and Lolita.
en|Alice, Dyrroth, Thamuz, Balmond, nom: Alice, Dyrroth, Thamuz, Balmond, name = Helcurt (enemies)
en|Le jeune mage dont les pouvoirs éveil: The young mage whose awakened powers were once put in danger and who now arrives at the Magic Academy to study.

The young mage whose awakened powers were once put in danger and who now arrives at the Magic Academy to study the heir to Castle Grandrock, Harley was of average talent and was not regarded with any importance by the Duke of Vance, his father. However, he was always very close to his sister Lesley. To attract his father's attention, he practiced conjuring to make it appear as if he had magical abilities. However, this had the unexpected result of getting him kidnapped. Lesley rushed to his aid, and in the midst of his crisis, his powerful magical powers awoke. The two men then fought their way out. Eventually, Leslie sent Harley to live and study at the Magic Academy. === Magic Awakens === As the only son of Duke Vance, Harley lost his mother shortly after his birth; and in this political battle, Lesley's father, the leader of the Duke's guards, also gave his life to protect the Duke.
en|Afin de remercier sa gentillesse, le: In order to repay her kindness, Duke Vance adopted Lesley as his own daughter and trained her to become the best sniper in the Moniyan Empire.
en|Harley, en revanche, en tant que seul: Harley, on the other hand, as the only heir of the Vance family for whom people had high hopes, possessed neither the talent for magic nor combat. Duke Vance was extremely disappointed in him. He rarely paid attention to Harley. Instead, he turned to marrying allies to consolidate his power and cultivate new heirs, a series of actions that amounted to abandoning Harley altogether.
en|Mais l'innocent Harley ne comprenait: But the innocent Harley did not understand the complex methods of adults, and he took full advantage of a carefree childhood.
en|La personnalité de Harley était un pe: Harley's personality was a bit eccentric. He preferred to do things that interested him alone rather than play with others, but Lesley was an exception. Harley saw that almost everyone was avoiding Lesley and she seemed worried all day. Harley always stayed by Lesley's side, doing her best to make her happy.
en|En étant ensemble jour après jour, la: By being together day after day, the relationship between the two deepened. Harley also noticed that although Lesley had a serious personality and rarely smiled, she was actually a very gentle person, especially towards him. She has always been extremely tolerant and forgiving.
en|Mais malgré cela, Harley avait toujou: But despite this, Harley still desperately needed her father's love. He always asked Lesley how he could make his father like him, but Lesley never had the heart to tell him that the cold-blooded Duke Vance had long since cast him aside.
en|Un jour, la petite Harley, excitée, t: One day, excited little Harley found Lesley and said, "Lesley! I can do magic!"
en|Lesley était très surprise. Si cela é: Lesley was very surprised. If this were true, then Duke Vance might change his mind. She told Harley, "Really? Show me now!"
en|Harley redressa fièrement son nœud pa: Harley proudly straightened his bow tie and stood in front of Lesley. He took out a hat, gently tapped the hat with a "magic wand", and dozens of little birds came out. Harley then reached into the hat with her hand and, unbelievably, pulled out a cute little white bunny. Then he put down the hat, walked over to Lesley, and took out a dazzling red rose from behind her ear. Lesley smiled, accepted Harley's rose and said, "That's amazing!"
en|Malgré tout cela, Lesley, aux yeux pe: Despite all this, the sharp-eyed Lesley had realized that these were just tricks Harley was doing. It wasn't real magic.
en|\" Qu'en penses-tu ? Si mon père déco: "What do you think? If my father found out that I can do magic, would he start to like me?" Harley asked Lesley excitedly. He was very satisfied with his performance.
en|\"Certainement, mais ta magie n'est p: "Certainly, but your magic isn't fully developed yet. You should practice more." Lesley couldn't bear to hurt Harley and didn't want him to be scolded by Duke Vance, so that was all she could say.
en|Harley a également estimé que ce que: Harley also felt that what Lesley said made sense, and he returned happily holding the rabbit.
en|Après cela, Harley entraînait souvent: After that, Harley would often drag others to watch her "magical" performances together. Everyone saw that his magic was just tricks, but they didn't say anything. They were just pleasing little Harley to make him happy.
en|Mais la nouvelle que la petite Harley: But the news that little Harley could do “magic” was spread by malicious people. One rainy and windy night, Duke Vance's political opponents sent someone to take Harley away.
en|Les astuces de la petite Harley n'éta: Little Harley's tricks were of no use in a real fight. He cried, wanting to escape, but was gagged with a piece of cotton cloth. He was blindfolded, had his hands and feet tied, and was locked in a dark dungeon.
en|Les ravisseurs de Harley ont fait de: Harley's captors made Harley a hostage and wanted to negotiate terms with Duke Vance. What they didn't expect was that Duke Vance would immediately refuse them. To him, Harley was just a pawn who could be sacrificed at any time. But Lesley wasn't ready to give up on Harley. For the first time, she violated the Duke's orders and broke into the dungeon where Harley was being held alone.
en|Dans l'obscurité, Harley entendit le: In the darkness, Harley heard the sound of a sniper rifle and Lesley's cry: "Don't worry! Harley! I'll save you no matter what!"
en|Harley a eu du mal à baisser son band: Harley struggled to lower her blindfold and saw Lesley standing firmly in front of the cell door, accurately shooting any enemies that tried to approach. But even so, the enemies still managed to hurt Lesley one after another. Harley deeply regretted pretending to know magic and causing all this trouble. He was even more afraid of being the one who could cause the death of the only parent he cared about.
en|À ce moment, une flèche sombre frappa: At that moment, a dark arrow struck out of nowhere, blinding Lesley's left eye. Seeing this, Harley cried and wanted to come to Lesley's side, but her bound hands and feet made him helpless.
en|Dans l'obscurité, Harley sentit une f: In the darkness, Harley felt a force surge from her body. At this moment, a violent fire burned the ropes on his body. Harley got up and ran towards Lesley. With a simple wave of his hand, he managed to reduce all approaching enemies to ashes. Contrary to expectations, Harley truly had a gift for magic. This ability awakened at a time of crisis and the power was enormous.
en|Finalement, les deux frères et sœurs: Eventually, the two siblings worked together to break out of the encirclement.
en|Lesley a emmené Harley tout au nord j: Lesley took Harley all the way north to the northern port of Castle Grandrock and boarded a large ship for the Magic Academy.
en|« Lesley, on ne rentre pas à la maiso: “Lesley, aren’t we going home?” Harley was surprised by Lesley's action.
en|\"Est-ce que tu aimes cette maison?\": “Do you like this house?” Lesley did not answer his question.
en|Harley baissa la tête, réfléchit long: Harley lowered her head, thought for a long time, and said, "I love my sister more."
en|Lesley sourit et frotta la tête d'Har: Lesley smiled and rubbed Harley's head, "Then we won't go home. The Magic Academy is a sacred place for all magicians in the world. You will live a very happy life there."
en|Harley, arrivée à la Magic Academy, s: Harley, arriving at the Magic Academy, woke up and found that Lesley was missing, and only a note was left behind:
en|Vivez bien et attendez que je vienne: Live well and wait for me to come and get you.
en|Lesley retourna au Château Grandrock: Lesley returned to Grandrock Castle and reported the entire incident to Duke Vance. She tried to bear the blame as best she could, but to her surprise, Duke Vance did not punish her.
en|Il a dit à Lesley de se retirer, puis: He told Lesley to step down, then he hired more assistants.
en|\"Le plan a changé. Notre prochain pl: "The plan has changed. Our next plan will revolve around Harley..."
en|Le nom Harley est d'origine anglaise: The name Harley is of Old English origin and means "hare's meadow" or "rocky glade". He is commonly associated with being playful and mischievous, which fits with his trickster magician theme.
en|Son nom pourrait être inspiré par Arl: His name may be inspired by Harlequin, a classic jester and trickster character from European theater and Western comics.
en|Son chapeau, sa cape et ses cartes re: His hat, cape and cards resemble famous stage magicians like Harry Houdini.
en|La peau de Harley \"Naughty Joker\" r: Harley “Naughty Joker” skin resembles the medieval court jesters who entertained kings with tricks and performances. She also recalls the Joker from the Batman series.
en|Le skin « Royal Magister » de Harley: Harley's "Royal Magister" skin is heavily inspired by European royal court magicians, noble wizards, and fantasy aristocrats. Harley's fancy coat, tie, and gold ornaments resemble the European aristocracy of the Baroque and Rococo periods.
en|Son esthétique et ses capacités resse: His aesthetic and abilities resemble other playing card-based characters in games and media, such as Twisted Fate from League of Legends or the trickster theme from Joker.
en|La Harley d’avant la refonte avait un: The pre-redesign Harley had an adult voice, which was the same voice as the pre-2020 Alucard. Although her Dream Caster skin still had adult voice lines.
en|Il partage son doubleur en japonais,: He shares his Japanese voice actor, Matsumoto Sachi, with Diggie and Rafaela.
en|*Membre de la Maison Vance *Héritier: *Member of House Vance *Heir to Château Grandrock
en|Infliger des dégâts magiques avec sa: Dealing magic damage with your wand
en|Invocation d'un anneau de feu magique: Summon a magical ring of fire
en|Le jeune chef de la Shadow Sect qui b: The young leader of the Shadow Sect who wields his blade during moonless nights, traveling the path of nindo without fear.
en|Chef de la secte de l'Ombre de l'Ombr: Leader of the Shadow Sect of the Scarlet Shadow, in the Riverlands of Cadia. As the second heir of the Crimson Shadow Sect, Hayabusa had always looked up to his brother, a figure he viewed as the moon itself. To preserve the delicate balance of power between the Shadow and Scarlet Sects, Hayabusa willingly took his brother's place to be a political pawn and hostage, to be raised within the rival Scarlet Sect. Every day spent in the Scarlet Sect, Hayabusa lived by his brother's principles. He mastered his unique Shadow Shuriken technique and forged an unbreakable bond with Hanabi, a kunoichi of the Scarlet Sect. But when Hanzo's betrayal and his brother's disappearance shattered their hopes for peace, Hayabusa realized that the moonlight that had always guided him was gone. Yet he held his blade tightly, determined to advance through the shadows, following his brother's nindo. ===Shadow and Moon=== When the clouds obscure the moon,
en|Où les ombres trouveront-elles leur p: Where will the shadows find their place?
en|En tant que descendants de la Shadow: As descendants of the Shadow Sect, Hayabusa and his brother underwent rigorous training from childhood. Even as a young boy, Hayabusa knew that his brother's skills far exceeded his own. But what really seemed beyond his reach was his brother's vision of nindo, ninja-style: integrating ninja tools with ninjutsu to end hostility between ninja clans.
en|Aux yeux d'Hayabusa, son frère brilla: In Hayabusa's eyes, his brother shone as bright as the moon, illuminating not only himself but the entire Scarlet Shadow. Hayabusa only wished to be his shadow.
en|Cependant, son frère n'était pas le s: However, his brother wasn't the only genius in the Shadow Sect: there was another one named Hanzo. Soon, the Scarlet Sect, the other half of Scarlet Shadow, sent a warning to the Shadow Sect: the balance of power in Scarlet Shadow must not be questioned. Hayabusa learned that the two sects would use their own bloodlines as pawns to control each other, and that he or his brother would have to become that pawn.
en|Sur le toit, Hayabusa trouva son frèr: On the roof, Hayabusa found his brother. Although no words were spoken, the moonlight filled their hearts.
en|Pour Hayabusa, le monde pourrait surv: For Hayabusa, the world could survive without shadows, but without moonlight, night would reign forever...
en|Assis à côté de son frère, Hayabusa ô: Sitting next to his brother, Hayabusa took off his mask. A childish smile broke out on his stern face.
en|Au cours de ses premières années à la: During his early years in the Scarlet Sect, Hayabusa, as a pawn, was met with contempt. He found companionship only in his own shadow. During training, he constantly worked to integrate ninja tools into his ninjutsu, creating his unique Shadow Shuriken technique. Little by little, more and more people came to challenge him. Hayabusa calmly accepted each challenge and left silently after each victory. For him, winning or losing was less important than fulfilling his brother's will: ending the hostility between the two sects.
en|Jusqu'au jour où il rencontra une fil: Until the day he met a girl whose beliefs rivaled his own: Hanabi. As the successor to "Scarlet", Hanabi has always held her head high. She considered her victories as victories for the Scarlet Sect, and her fierce competitive spirit drove her to challenge Hayabusa again and again.
en|Vallées cachées, forêts de bambous, t: Hidden valleys, bamboo forests, rooftops... Every corner of the Scarlet Shadow bore witness to their battles. Every time Hayabusa won, Hanabi would ask, "Why did I lose...", but he would only shrug in return.
en|Hayabusa avait depuis longtemps admis: Hayabusa had long admitted that he possessed no extraordinary talents. Pursuing his brother's nindo, he trained alone, until he finally understood that the relationship between ninja tools and ninjutsu was like that of scarlet and shadow, two sides of the same coin. They were inseparable. The Scarlet Sect and the Shadow Sect surely knew this too, but they chose to remain determined to defeat each other.
en|Mais les illusions finiront par se br: But the illusions will eventually be shattered.
en|Le génie ninja Hanzo a fait irruption: Ninja genius Hanzo broke into the Forbidden Lands, stole the sealed weapon Ame no Habakiri and fled. Hayabusa's brother, who accompanied him, disappeared without a trace. Overnight, Hanzo became the Scarlet Shadow's greatest threat, and peace teetered on the blade's edge.
en|Pour capturer Hanzo et récupérer l'ar: To capture Hanzo and retrieve the cursed weapon, both sects did their best, and Hayabusa and Hanabi were among them.
en|Avant de partir, Hayabusa a reçu un o: Before leaving, Hayabusa received a secret order from his father: "Recover the Soul no Habakiri for the Shadow Sect and kill Hanzo and anyone who gets in your way." Strangely, the order made no mention of his brother. Filled with doubt, Hayabusa followed Hanzo's trail: he had to find him.
en|Au cours de sa poursuite, Hayabusa dé: During his pursuit, Hayabusa discovered Hanabi lying on the ground, surrounded by ninjas from both sects writhing in agony. As Hayabusa tried to wake Hanabi, a malevolent aura hit him. He gripped his blade tightly. Then, he saw a familiar but strange figure: it was his brother, radiating murderous intent.
en|Il vit du sang tacher les mains de so: He saw blood staining his brother's hands... He saw that the light had disappeared from his eyes...
en|Quelle que soit la manière dont Hayab: No matter how Hayabusa called, he was only met with increasingly violent attacks, each aimed at killing.
en|Jamais Hayabusa n'aurait imaginé que: Hayabusa never imagined that the moon could turn so blood red.
en|L'obscurité engloutit le cœur d'Hayab: Darkness engulfed Hayabusa's heart. He lowered his blade as his brother rushed towards him.
en|\"Hayabusa, n'ose pas perdre contre q: "Hayabusa, don't you dare lose to anyone other than me!"
en|La voix de Hanabi résonnait dans sa m: Hanabi's voice echoed in his memory, like a flame igniting in his heart.
en|Au plus profond de lui, Hayabusa voya: Deep inside, Hayabusa saw the moonlight, and beneath it, Hanabi.
en|Les yeux de Hanabi brûlaient alors qu: Hanabi's eyes burned as she looked at Hayabusa while gently twirling her Higanbana, "I'm going to surpass you."
en|À cet instant, Hayabusa reprit consci: At this moment, Hayabusa regained consciousness. With one hand, he formed a seal, activating Quad Shadow to send four shadows that restrained his opponent with lightning speed. He grabbed his blade and struck without a moment's hesitation.
en|Hayabusa regarda l'aura meurtrière se: Hayabusa watched as the murderous aura gradually dissipated along with the image of his brother, revealing Ame no Habakiri's true form, glaring at him in rage and laughing maniacally.
en|Le rusé Ame no Habakiri avait essayé: The cunning Ame no Habakiri had tried to use illusions to exploit the weakness of the human heart, only to be met with such resilience. Freeing himself from the illusion, Hayabusa was no longer bound by darkness. Even though he knew Ame no Habakiri was powerful, behind him stood Hanabi, Kagura, and his brother's unknown fate. He had no choice but to get up.
en|Même sans le guidage de la lune, une: Even without the guidance of the moon, a shadow must carve its own path.
en|\"Où que j'aille, je le fais sans cra: “Wherever I go, I do so without fear.”
en|« Hayabusa » (隼) signifie littéraleme: “Hayabusa” (隼) literally means “peregrine falcon,” a bird known for its incredible speed and deadly precision.
en|Dans son premier modèle de héros, le: In his first hero model, Hayabusa's headgear is inspired by Kabuto helmets, worn by samurai and elite ninja warriors.
en|Son ultime \"Shadow Kill\" ressemble: His ultimate "Shadow Kill" resembles the "Shunshin" (Body Flicker) technique, a legendary ninja ability that allows a warrior to move so fast that they appear to attack from multiple directions at once.
en|Son Ultimate, \"Ougi: Shadow Kill\",: His Ultimate, "Ougi: Shadow Kill", also resembles classic ninja assassination techniques. In Japanese ninja stories, a "finishing blow" (奥義 / Ougi) is a secret assassination technique passed down from generation to generation.
en|Hayabusa est probablement inspiré de: Hayabusa is probably inspired by Ryu Hayabusa from the Ninja Gaiden and Dead or Alive series.
en|Les premiers concepts artistiques d'H: Hayabusa's early concept art featured simpler, more traditional ninja attire, closer to common Japanese historical depictions of ninjas.
en|La compétence Quad Shadow de Hayabusa: Hayabusa's Quad Shadow skill is similar to Zed's skill from League of Legends "Living Shadow", which involves placing a clone that he can teleport to and attack from different angles.
en|Son doubleur anglais actuel en 2021,: His current English voice actor in 2021, Gaku Space, is known for his voice as Genji from Overwatch, both of whom have rivals of the same name.

en|Le cauchemar de l'Abysse prêt à trahi: The nightmare from the Abyss ready to betray anyone to survive. Helcurt was born into the Styx clan of the Abyss and bore the scars of his clan's betrayal of the Lord of the Abyss. However, by a twist of fate, he was appointed to the Tribunal responsible for executing traitors to the Lord. To survive, Helcurt was willing to do anything, including hunting his own parents. However, during the great uprising against the Lord of the Abyss, it was Helcurt who killed him. He was born a traitor and never knew the honor of loyalty, but even as a traitor he had the right to live.
en|=== Né dans les ténèbres === Né dans: === Born in Darkness === Born in darkness, Helcurt was blessed with a genius for stalking and ambushes. He lived in the shadows, only looking for his prey. Enslaved by the Abyss, he waited for the split second when his prey would weaken. Now Helcurt emerges from the darkness, his blade ready. The time of hiding is over and the hunt will begin. Official MLBB Social Media They were traitors from birth.
en|Dans les profondeurs les plus sombres: In the darkest depths of the Abyss, the Styx Clan once bared its fangs against the Lord of the Abyss.
en|Le clan Styx était le chasseur le plu: Clan Styx were the deadliest hunters who roamed the shadows, born to spread darkness. They could stalk their enemies for days in complete silence before finally slitting their throats and disappearing into the night. Their talents made them the most feared assassins in the Abyss. But their bestial nature was even more terrifying, because when survival is at stake, it's impossible to predict what a beast would do.
en|Face à la rébellion du Clan Styx, mêm: Facing the rebellion of the Styx Clan, even the mighty Lord of the Abyss felt fear. But he could not allow such transgressions against the name of darkness.
en|Contre la simple puissance du Seigneu: Against the sheer might of the Lord of the Abyss, the Styx Clan was defeated. They were branded traitors and suffered a most cruel punishment: they received the blood of the Lord of the Abyss, to be chained forever to his will. This not only physically prevented them from raising their claws against the Lord of the Abyss, but was also the greatest form of humiliation. The beasts of the Abyss were thus tamed like dogs.
en|Helcurt était le descendant de ce cla: Helcurt was the descendant of this clan of traitors. He was born in the middle of the Great War and saw his loved ones used as cannon fodder. Their broken bodies filled the battlefields, and eventually, it would be his turn.
en|La seule pensée qui traversait l'espr: The only thought running through Helcurt's mind was surviving. He ran and fought with all his might across the battlefield and emerged victorious from the merciless meat grinder. After the battle, he was summoned by the Lord of the Abyss. Seeing Helcurt's small, wild stature, the Lord mockingly declared Helcurt to be the "most faithful dog" of his clan, and placed him at the Tribunal to judge and execute traitors.
en|« Espèce de misérable. fais ce que je: “You miserable thing. do what I want and you will have your share of leftovers.
en|Helcurt obéit. Le premier traître jug: Helcurt obeyed. The first traitor tried was a member of his clan. A veil of darkness shrouded his path that night. and amid the fearful expressions of those close to him, Helcurt slit the traitors' throats with a flash of his blade, thus accomplishing his mission. Blood flowed silently as he dropped the lifeless body. He carried out the execution without hesitation, but in that moment he felt an eternity of anguish.
en|Il est né avec la stigmatisation d'un: He was born with the stigma of a traitor, and now he must live up to that name and cast out his own. He became the Tribunal Blade, slaughtering his brothers who had betrayed the Lord of the Abyss, even if they were only trying to survive. No one knew what Helcurt was thinking during these hunts. All he knew was that he had to live. Even though he was born in darkness, walked in darkness, and would stay there forever, he was still alive.
en|Dans les marécages sombres où il pouv: In the dark swamps where he could alone, Helcurt marked each passing year by tying a knot on a rope. This was his proof that he was alive. To live was his humblest and proudest desire, even if he did it like a dog in the shadows......
en|Helcurt avait survécu jusqu'à la fin: Helcurt had survived until the end of the war, but with the absence of the gods. madness spreads across the Abyss. The source of all this was the Lord of the Abyss, who had gone astray without his dark god. For thousands of years he controlled the Abyss using his corrupted blood, and now his madness was infecting them in the same way. This was the curse of the 310CX-i. Having no choice, the demons of the Abyss, led by Thamuz. turned against the Lord of the Abyss, they rushed towards the palace of the Lord of the Abyss. and Helcurt. at the head of the Tribunal, constituted the last line of defense, like an imposing wall.
en|Au milieu du chaos, Helcurt serra fer: Amidst the chaos, Helcurt held his tightly.
en|La sensation grossière de l'objet lui: The gross feel of the object reminded him that he was still alive.
en|Bien que né dans les ténèbres, né tra: Although born in darkness, born a traitor, he had the right to live.
en|Helcurt se retourna et se retrouva fa: Helcurt turned around and found himself face to face with the imposing Lord of the Abyss before emitting a bestial roar. With all his strength, he purged the cursed blood and made it flow from his body. The sheer force caused his bones to burst from his skin like blades. In an instant, he was at the peak of the Lord of the Abyss, slashing with his blades, breaking free from the shackles of the Blood Curse in the most appropriate way.
en|\"Quand tu as décidé de mon sort, tu: "When you decided my fate, you should have remembered that I was born a traitor..."
en|Il avait dévoilé ses armes contre le: He had revealed his weapons against the Lord of the Abyss. Just like his ancestors a thousand years ago.
en|Il a toujours été un traître. === Au: He has always been a traitor. === Help! I almost got killed in the Abyss! ===
en|Helcurt fait partie des héros qui ne: Helcurt is one of the heroes who does not walk, but crawls.
en|Si vous regardez attentivement le por: If you look closely at Helcurt's portrait, you will notice his white, cat-like pupils.
en|Il s'inspire fortement d'Alma de Magi: It is heavily inspired by Alma from Magic Rush, another game developed by Moonton.
en|Il a été banni en raison d'un bug imp: He was banned due to a significant bug for 41 days and 21 hours from May 16, 2023 at 01:00:00 to June 26, 2023 at 22:00:00, which is the longest official ban in MLBB history.
en|Nom de Helcurt = Dark Night Falls pou: Helcurt's name = Dark Night Falls could previously be heard by enemies. This has since been removed.

en|Helcurt partage également son doubleu: Helcurt also shares his Japanese voice actor, Abe Daiki, with Gatotkaca, who shares his recommendation on the Roaming route, and Martis, who shares his recommendation on the Jungle route.
Heir to the power of the megalith.
en|Nichée entre les toundras de la Vallé: Nestled between the tundras of the North Valley and the Moniyan Plain lies a unique land with a massive, ancient stone formation that has earned it the name Megalith Wasteland. The Megalith Desert must be crossed if one wants to reach Northern Vale. It was also Hilda’s homeland.
en|Dans la vallée du Nord, aux ressource: In the resource-scarce North Valley, tribal conflict was as constant as year-round ice and snow. The strongest tribes would gain the right to own the largest and easiest hunting grounds. This was even more true for the Garland tribe of the Megalith Wasteland. The perilous geography and barren soil of the Jad Wasteland made it incredibly inhospitable to human habitation. Yet, thanks to the protection of the Power of the Megaliths, this tribe tenaciously survived for many years.
en|L'ancien mégalithe se trouvait ici de: The ancient megalith stood here for many centuries. Its creators hoped to use its magical powers to confine the Golems of Iceland to the north of the continent, thus preventing them from coming south. As time passed and the Golems disappeared, the magic of the megalith also lost its original purpose. All that remained were ancient ruins, brimming with the power of the megalith passed down through the centuries.
en|La légende raconte que seul celui qui: Legend has it that only he who leads the purest lineage of the Garland clan can lift the stone disc plate, located in the center of the megalith, and inherit its power. So, when each successor as head of the tribe was 20 years old, they went to the Megalith and received its incredible power, becoming the Power of the Megalith. They would then be ready to lead their tribe against foreign incursions.
en|Depuis qu'elle était enfant, Hilda fa: Since she was a child, Hilda had been the subject of great expectations, since her mother, the former Megalith Power, had been killed in battle while defending the tribe ten years ago. Having lost the protection of the Megalith, the tribe had fallen into deep crisis, enduring constant pillaging and harassment. Therefore, the tribesmen pinned all their hopes on Hilda, praying that she would become strong and take on the important task of protecting the tribe.
en|Hilda ne les a pas déçus. Dès son plu: Hilda did not disappoint them. From a young age, she demonstrated exceptional talent for combat and strength far beyond her years. Over time, she became the tribe's most powerful warrior.
en|Finalement, Hilda devait avoir 20 ans: Eventually, Hilda was to turn 20, and the languid Garland tribe held a grand ceremony for the event. They prayed day and night for the power of the megalith to be reborn and hoped that it would restore the tribe to its former glory.
en|Pourtant, alors que beaucoup regardai: Yet while many watched with bated breath, Hilda was unable to lift the stone disk even with all her strength. There was stunned silence until a tribe elder stepped forward to tell the truth: Hilda was not the biological daughter of the previous Megalith Power, but was adopted after being found as an abandoned baby in the wild.
en|Les membres de la tribu, si pleins d’: The tribesmen, so full of hope and anticipation before, now fell into despair. The faith that had sustained them over the years collapsed in an instant. Their immense, simmering disappointment quickly led to rage and prejudice, and they began to shove and curse Hilda, declaring that she was worthless. Hearing this, Hilda found it difficult to remain stable.
en|Aussi déçue que les autres, Hilda se: As disappointed as the others, Hilda suddenly remembered her adoptive mother's last words to her: "The power of the megalith is not simply inherited. One must truly understand its inner meaning. The power of the megalith of each generation has had its own unique meaning. To me, the power of the megalith is a heart, as resilient and indomitable as a giant rock."
en|Hilda, remplie de frustration, quitta: Hilda, filled with frustration, left the Megalith Desert, which had been her home for many years, and began a long period of wandering life. During these years, she became a wandering mercenary and traveled throughout the Moniyan Empire and most of the Land of Dawn.
en|Les paroles de sa mère ne l'ont jamai: Her mother's words never left her during these times. However, she never backed down, no matter what danger she faced. The constant trials and tribulations she endured greatly strengthened her, making her a warrior as fearsome as stone.
en|Et même si elle avait laissé derrière: And even though she had left the Megalith Desert behind, Hilda knew that this was where her heart belonged. Years later, Hilda saved a slave girl from torture and recognized her as a member of the Garland tribe. From her, Hilda learned of the current state of the tribe: after Hilda left, the Garland tribe chose a new megalith power, who was truly from the line of leaders. However, this new power of the megalith was not leadership material. His foolish and childish ways caused the Garland tribe to decline even further, until it was completely subjugated by another tribe and all its inhabitants reduced to slavery.
en|Malgré le traitement que sa tribu lui: Despite her tribe's treatment of her, Hilda returned to the Megalith Desert without hesitation, freeing her people from brutal enemies, fighting them with her bare fists, and leading them to rebuild their home. It was only then that the tribesmen finally understood that true leadership has nothing to do with a person's ancestry. Coming to their senses, they accepted Hilda as their leader and hoped that she would stay with them and continue to pass on the glorious power of the megalith.
en|Cette fois, cependant, Hilda refusa l: This time, however, Hilda refused their invitation, deciding to return to a foreign country. His mother's words weighed constantly on his mind: the power of each generation's megaliths had its own meaning. She had received an indomitable heart from her mother, but she still had not found her own meaning. But one day, she thought, she would.
en|Hilda est un nom d'origine germanique: Hilda is a name of Germanic/Nordic origin, meaning "battle" or "warrior". It comes from the Old Norse word Hildr, meaning battle, war or combat.
en|Hilda est aussi une valkyrie comme Fr: Hilda is also a valkyrie like Freya.
en|Contrairement à la plupart des héros: Unlike most female heroes who are mages, assassins, or supports, Hilda was one of the first to be designed as a brawler in her own right.
en|Hilda est également la seule combatta: Hilda is also the only fighter with a "Bush Healing" passive. Hilda can heal herself simply by hiding in bushes, allowing her to reset fights without remembering.
en|Une geisha ninja de Scarlet Shadow, a: A geisha ninja from Scarlet Shadow, armed with two fans and adorned with crimson maple and meisen. In his twisted mind, death is the ultimate salvation.
en|Je ne suis qu'un danseur sous le Meis: I'm just a dancer under the Meisen. Life is as fleeting as the morning dew and death, serene as the autumn leaves. I only wish to burn the purple leaves, sculpt your incomparable beauty into eternity.
en|Hirara ne connaissait que trop bien c: Hirara knew this “sky” only too well. In the illusion created by the Great Armament "Ukifune", there were no stars, only a river, the "Meisen", hanging upside down in the sky. She walked barefoot across the scorched earth, the searing pain sending tremors of ecstasy through her body – the same feeling as when crimson stained her gaze as she gazed upon the Higanbana.
en|Dans le paysage infernal des fans, la: In the hellscape of fans, the world's most magnificent Noh play was performed endlessly. “Come on, it’s the first part tonight.” Hirara opened her fans and evil spirits descended on her. Captivated by Hirara's dance, they sought to tear her apart and claim this eternal beauty. Hirara, smiling amidst her swirls, gently shredded them before absorbing their essence. On this scorched ground, cruelty was the height of elegance.
en|La folie de cette scène a toujours ra: The madness of this scene always reminded Hirara of her teacher, once the most famous geisha in the Flower District. Her teacher lived in terror of growing old, until one night she set fire to the tea room. “Never forget that erosion is the vilest curse of this world,” the professor said as he held young Hirara in his arms. “Only by becoming ashes can fleeting beauty be saved.” As the silk turned to ashes in the fire, Hirara did not scream; instead, she eagerly inhaled the charred smell – she seemed to understand the lesson of this destruction.
en|Soudain, une silhouette cramoisie tra: Suddenly, a crimson figure walked across the sea of ​​fire. It was Hanabi, covered in soot. Although they had never met, she grabbed Hirara's wrist without hesitation. The heat from his hand was hotter than any flame in this infernal inferno.
en|Par la suite, Hirara a été amenée à l: Afterwards, Hirara was brought to the Scarlet Sect where she volunteered to become Hanabi's personal guard. When Hirara asked her about that night again, Hanabi replied that she was just saving her. To repay this grace, Hirara wanted to save Hanabi in the deepest sense of the word. Protecting her from the blades wasn't enough; it must save it from “erosion”, from the inevitability of decadence.
en|Une nuit au clair de lune, une obsess: One moonlit night, an inexplicable obsession drove Hirara to push open the forbidden door and reach the fans of "Ukifune", the infernal weaponry forged from "Kaerazu" and "Meisen-e". If she could control them, she could save Hanabi, she thought.
en|La puissance la parcourut au moment o: Power coursed through her the moment she touched them. Hirara got his wish, but his physical body fell into an illusion: a hell under the Meisen, born of the Great Armaments. Here, in the midst of endless slaughter, she found herself in ecstasy. The connection between the Great Armaments gave her, the mistress of “Ukifune”, the privilege of freely spying on the “Higanbana” which flourish above the Meisen.
en|Au début, son regard n’était qu’effra: At first, his look was only frightened. As the heir of the Scarlet Sect, Hanabi was as dazzling as the sun. But as time passed, she saw Hanabi stumble through the rain and snow for the "honor" of the Scarlet Sect, pursuing the ghost called "victory" while being knocked down again and again, only to get back up again... The cruelty of this fleeting world was like a dull blade, eating away at her. It was “erosion,” the vile curse his teacher spoke of. It had entangled Hanabi after all.
en|Comment cela pourrait-il être permis: How could this be allowed? Higanbana should never be allowed to wither. Hirara was devastated. She must return to the world of the living. And to do so, she used “Kaerazu” and “Meisen-e” to slaughter countless evil spirits and assimilate their power. It was during this carnage that the twisted words of his teacher became his illusion: beauty will erode; only death can stop it.
en|Lorsque Hanzo a trahi la Secte de l'O: When Hanzo betrayed the Shadow Sect, Hanabi was seriously injured during their confrontation. Desperately seeking the power to protect her clan, she submitted to the weapon in her hand: the Higanbana. As her consciousness sank into this pitch-black river, Hanabi thought it was the dead that were dragging her down. No. It was, in truth, Hirara's “softest” embrace.
en|\"Laisse-moi te sauver de ce monde gr: "Let me save you from this crude and fleeting world," Hirara called softly from the depths of the Meisen. But Hanabi didn't hear him. A ray of moonlight suddenly woke her and she broke the illusion of weaponry to return to the world of the living.
en|En regardant les Meisen retourner au: Watching the Meisen return to dead silence, a smile appeared on Hirara's face. This was the Hanabi she adored: the girl whose soul was fiercer than fire, who would do anything to protect others. Since her embrace could not hold one of such determination, she would sail against the tide, break the chains of the fleeting world, and carry Hanabi to a place free from erosion: "hell."
en|Hirara se donna entièrement à l'armem: Hirara gave himself entirely to the weaponry, letting his soul sink into his hell. She was no longer herself, but a spirit roaming the world of the living, a calamity existing solely to "save" Hanabi.
en|Finalement, le sceau de l’armement se: Finally, the weapon seal broke. Hirara stepped over the corpses of her Scarlet Sect parents and stood in front of Hanabi, as she had wished. The childhood companion who was thought to be dead had returned. The shock and sorrow in Hanabi's eyes finally solidified into cold, murderous intent. For the sake of the Scarlet Sect, Hanabi launched her Higanbana without hesitation.
en|Ah, c'était tout ce dont Hirara avait: Ah, it was everything Hirara had dreamed of. She spread her fans, adorned herself with crimson maple and Meisen, and rushed toward a reunion she dared not disappoint.
en|\"S'il te plaît, embrasse-moi !\" Hir: “Please kiss me!” Hirara opened her arms to the cold glow. Since her gentle appeal had been rejected, she would fill that void with the shock of flesh and blood. This pain that pierced my body was the embrace that you refused me in the depths of Meisen.
en|\"S'il vous plaît, sauvez-moi !\" Fac: “Please save me!” Facing the impending blade, Hirara's tears trembled with emotion. I understand now: just as I sought to seal your beauty with death, you also could not bear to see me erode. This fatal blow is your deepest and most merciful protection.
en|\"S'il te plaît, tue-moi !\" Hirara h: “Please kill me!” Hirara screamed in happiness, offering her frantically beating heart to the edge of the blade. Her fans hugged each other and walked towards Hanabi... Now that I have received your kindness, please... accept my devotion, Hanabi-sama!
en|Dans la langue japonaise, les kanji s: In the Japanese language, kanji are characters from Chinese writing and the meaning of a name changes depending on the kanji characters chosen. Names with many kanji variations are generally more common in Japan, while names with only a few variations are considered more unique and rare. Here are some of the popular kanji variations for the name "Hirara" (which is one "nanori"), each with a different meaning.
en|Hirara (舞) signifie « danser » ou « d: Hirara (舞) means "to dance" or "to dance". It can refer to rhythmic movement to music, often as part of a group performance. It also conveys the idea of ​​graceful, fluid movement, like leaves or petals dancing in the wind.
en|Hirara (華) signifie « fleur », « fleu: Hirara (華) means "flower", "blooming" or "splendid". It symbolizes beauty, flourishing growth, elegance and magnificence.
en|Hirara (姫) ​​signifie « princesse »,: Hirara (姫) ​​means "princess", "lady" or "beautiful". It symbolizes nobility, grace, elegance and feminine beauty.
en|Hirara (妃) signifie « épouse », « rei: Hirara (妃) means "wife", "queen" or "empress". A consort is the wife of a monarch, a queen is a female ruler or the wife of a king, and an empress is a female emperor or the wife of an emperor.
en|Hirara est le premier héros à ne poss: Hirara is the first hero to only have two skills.
en|Elle est également le troisième héros: She is also the third hero after Julian and Suyou without Ultimate.
en|Pour cette raison, il est impossible: For this reason, it is impossible for Valentina to copy Hirara's Ult.
en|Elle était au début censée être le hé: She was initially supposed to be the most difficult hero alongside Fanny, but after her ultimate was removed, her difficulty was reduced to that of the other Cadia Riverlands heroes, Yi Sun-shin, Ling, Yu Zhong, and Suyou.
en|Au milieu des montagnes brumeuses des: Amid the misty mountains of the northern reaches of the Land of Dawn, reside the ancient and mysterious race of Centaurs, half-man, half-horse creatures. The Centaurs guard a fountain which is located at the highest peak of the mountain. This fountain is said to give the gift of immortality and infinite wisdom. Dark forces have relentlessly attempted to gain the power found in the waters of this fountain, but only to be thwarted time and time again by the centaurs.
en|Cependant, au fil du temps, les centa: However, over time, the centaurs grew tired and attrition quickly set in. It was only after the arrival of Hylos, where he unleashed his mastery over nature's wrath, that he was able to crush and punish all the fountain's invaders. He had become a legendary figure in the annals of the Land of Dawn.
en|C'est un centaure, basé sur la créatu: He is a centaur, based on the creature from Greek mythology. The Minotaur is the other.
en|Il s'inspire de Malachie de Magic Rus: It is inspired by Malachi from Magic Rush by Moonton.
en|Aux côtés de Masha et X.Borg, Hylos e: Alongside Masha and X.Borg, Hylos is the only hero capable of reducing his own HP with a skill.
en|La Frappe Naturelle de Belerick conso: Belerick's Natural Strike consumed some of his HP, but this was removed during his second recast.
en|L'Anneau du Châtiment d'Hylos est la: Hylos' Ring of Punishment is the first of the only toggle skills in the game.
en|Une elfe aux cheveux roux qui vit et: A red-haired elf who lives and fights alongside her companion Leo.
en|Les chasseurs ont finalement découver: Hunters finally discovered the fatal weakness of these creatures. As elusive as they were, smilodons were always drawn to the cries of an infant because it sounded so similar to the cries of their own young. Hunters were quick to exploit this weakness. They kidnapped the infants of other races to use as bait and ambushed unsuspecting smilodons. Irithel had once been one of those babies. Born under a menacing red moon, the forsaken elf entered the world with strange crimson markings on her skin and was feared from her first breath. Those around her considered her existence a bad omen and rejected her without hesitation. Greed and wickedness had almost swallowed her up. Yet, in the end, she managed to survive.
en|Le smilodon qui suivit ses cris se tr: The smilodon that followed her cries happened to be the Primary Matriarch who had recently lost her young. This little one had fallen into the hands of hunters not long before. The sight of such a crude trap sent the matriarch into a frenzy, baring her fangs. But the smell of milk on the matriarch attracted the hungry child to the smilodon. Little Irithel crawled towards her, staggering. At this moment, the smilodon's rage weakened. Looking at the little elf, maternal instinct began to take over. But the hunters had already lost patience. They approached from all sides, determined to take the bones of the smilodon for themselves. They understood the power of a smilodon, but knew nothing of the ferocity of a mother. Keeping little Irithel at her side, the matriarch rushed forward and roared at every hunter who dared to approach. The hunters were completely disoriented by his attacks and, when failure seemed imminent, they fled the forest in panic.
en|Irithel a eu une mère ce jour-là. Ce: Irithel had a mother that day. She was not a graceful elf. The matriarch gave her everything a mother could: milk to feed her, shelter under the wild canopy, the skills to hunt and survive... and a dear companion, her only surviving cub. Irithel returned this love in kind. As the matriarch had hoped, Irithel grew up alongside the cub and learned to chase away intruders from the forest. Bow in hand and barely able to stand, she climbed on the little one's back and sent arrows into every corner of the forest. Over time, Irithel came to understand the truth about her own origins. Having endured such cruelty herself, she could not calm her distrust of outsiders, especially humans.
en|Cela n’a commencé à changer qu’après: This only began to change after meeting Nana, a kind-hearted Leonine girl. Irithel didn't understand his words, but she could feel the warmth of Nana's smile. Even though Irithel could only respond with grunts, little Leonine happily took both of his hands in hers. Only heat could melt the ice to such a depth, and little by little, Nana's perseverance began to change it. Proudly calling herself Irithel's "little teacher", she set about teaching her the language of humans. Unable to refuse such kindness, Irithel followed Nana's patient advice and, for the first time, managed to clumsily reconstruct her first word: "F-nothing." Together they named Irithel's companion Leo, and they walked the forest paths laughing and singing. But this simple happiness ended too soon with Nana's departure.
en|Irithel a dû apprendre et grandir par: Irithel had to learn and grow on her own. Before Irithel knew it, her mother had aged. Increasingly, the matriarch looked at her daughter with quiet expectation in her eyes. When her fangs could no longer protect what she loved, she led Irithel to one last place. They arrived deep in the forest, where countless white bones lay silently. This was the graveyard of the smilodons, the place these hunters had been searching for for a long time. Before Irithel knew what was happening, her mother gently lay down on the bed of bones. Like any mother, she wanted to leave a gift for her child when Irithel reached the age of majority. But the matriarch had no treasure to pass on. The only gift she could leave her child was... her own bones. Under Irithel's gaze, the matriarch slowly closed her eyes. The proud head that had never bowed in her life rested on her daughter's knees, and in that final calm, Irithel understood the secret of the smilodons: when they died, their spirit bones released their immense magic into the forest, nourishing the earth and continuing the endless cycle of life.
en|La respiration de la matriarche s'est: The matriarch's breathing gradually weakened and Irithel's vision blurred from tears. When those tears finally fell, a glow crossed her mother's translucent, weathered bones, as if urging her not to stop there. Irithel therefore set off in search of the Tree of Life in the Moonlight Forest. With the gentle blessing of Estes and Miya, she forged her weapon from one of her strong silver branches and her mother's bones, shaping them into the crossbow she now carried. It was proof that his mother would always be with them. From that day on, any hunter who dared to set foot in the forest would learn to fear the roar of Leo and the fierce elf on his back with the magic crossbow. Together, they would chase away all intruders from the forest.
en|Irithel regarda les chasseurs s'enfui: Irithel watched the hunters flee in panic as she gently placed her hand on her crossbow. Leo leaned against her, the feeling warm and familiar. Under his fingers, his crossbow gave off the same warmth, as if the years had never passed and his mother was still there at their side.
en|Le nom Irithel est d'origine turque e: The name Irithel is of Turkish origin and means "Goddess of hunting and prayer. Strong bow and bow".
en|Quand Irithel a été publiée pour la p: When Irithel was first released on the Advanced Server, she was named Mona and had the hero title "Descendant of the Forest".
en|Elle est le premier héros à monter en: She is the first hero to ride permanently with a mount, the second being Barats.
en|Elle a qualifié Leo de « tigre » dans: She called Leo a "tiger" in one of her quotes, but he is biologically a smilodon.
en|Elle est le premier héros capable d'e: She is the first hero capable of performing basic attacks while moving with a joystick. Kimmy and Leomord (while riding Barbiel in his Phantom Steed) are the other heroes to do so.
en|Elle est le seul héros à distance dot: She is the only ranged hero with an explosive basic attack, where the damage from her basic attack while using the Heavy Crossbow can hit multiple enemies in a small area at once.
en|Lorsque son skin \"Night Arrow\" a ét: When his "Night Arrow" skin was released, Leo's appearance closely resembled Toothless from How to Train Your Dragon; it was later edited to look more feline, presumably to avoid copyright issues.
en|Elle est le quatrième héros à avoir d: She is the fourth hero to have two StarLight skins ("Nightarrow" and "Checkered Knight").
en|Leader de Bad Soul et inventrice auto: Leader of Bad Soul and self-proclaimed inventor, she wields a homemade weapon powered by a stolen Starlium reactor.

Leader of Bad Soul and self-proclaimed inventor, she wields a homemade weapon powered by a Starlium reactor. Born into a tribe of sand hunters, Ixia was shaped by the harsh desert environment to become a cunning leader from a young age. While most Sand Hunters only care about plundering, Ixia has always had a penchant for inventing gadgets and believed that science should not be a tool reserved only for scholars in Eruditio. Ixia has always lived by its own rules, like the ever-changing sands of Agelta's barren lands. ===Sandstorm at SnakeboneTavern === "It's a heist, hands where I can see!" "These beautiful books, I will take them from your hands. She is the leader of Bad Soul who "takes" the books of others only to invent them. She has been shaped into a cunning leader by the harsh desert environment. While believing that science should not be a tool for only a few, she is determined to make her way! How will she continue to invent her gadgets and live by her own rules like the ever-changing sands of the barren lands from Agelta? Hit the link below and discover the story of Bad.
en|C'est un bâton, les mains là où je pe: It's a stick, hands where I can see! Put away your gold, it's no use to me. But these beautiful books, I will take them from your hands. Now go this way, before you get lost in these sands. —Ixia, boss of Bad Soul (7 years)
en|L’endroit tout entier semblait sur le: The whole place looked like it was about to collapse. Gravel seeped through the cracks in the windows, hitting the cups like bullets. But at that moment, the traveler would rather brave the sandstorm outside than spend another second at Snakebone Tavern. The traveler had come from the Moniyan Empire, intending to take advantage of the Festival of Lights to study at Eruditio. He couldn't believe his luck in finding a place to spend the night this far out in the desert. Until a group of sand hunters sat down at the table next to him and started complaining about their latest job. He wrapped himself tightly in his cloak and pretended to enjoy the gritty soup in front of him, trying not to look like their next victim.
en|\"C'est assez d'alcool... Je ne suis: "That's enough alcohol... I'm not in the mood. You know, I don't regret shooting that kid, but now it's coming to me suddenly, like a sandworm crawling through my head. The last time we had a sandstorm this bad was when Ixia was born. It was sixteen years ago, on a night so dark you couldn't even see your own gun in your hands. Her mother, then the boss of Bad Soul, had gotten lost in the desert and was about to give birth But as things happened, a shooting star flew over Eruditio and lit the way to Ixia's birth.
en|Ixia a toujours été une enfant intell: Ixia has always been a smart child. She learned how to load a gun before she could even walk straight. Sigh... It's a shame she got into such bad habits. She was only seven years old when she flew for the first time. And what was his loot? A stack of books! Can you believe this? What kind of sand hunter steals books? And from then on, she would always target caravans heading to Eruditio, just to return with bags of dusty books. She said she wanted to be an inventor... What a naive little fool! She kept inventing all this useless crap... A grill made with a guitar, a swimming contraption in the desert... Damn, my boy almost drowned in that quicksand! And... Huh?! Who is making this noise? »
en|Le voyageur fit semblant de s'étouffe: The traveler pretended to choke on his soup to hide his sudden burst of laughter. An outlaw who loved to read? He had never heard of such a thing. Filled with curiosity about this person from Ixia, the traveler silently moved his stool closer to the noisy table.
en|\"De toute façon, cela n'avait rien à: "It had nothing to do with her inventions anyway. I took this shot to uphold the customs of this country. I couldn't believe it when her mother passed the leadership of Bad Soul to Ixia. She was smaller than my rifle, but she dared to sit so high above her predecessors. I often encountered her on our hunts. She was fearless and a natural marksman, and as the eldest, I planned to watch over her, but she despised us for taking unarmed civilians! She even went out of her way to return everything we stole! A crook with a conscience... That girl really doesn't know what's best for her until she comes face to face with the barrel of a gun.
en|Le voyageur a été repris, car il s'in: The traveler was recaptured because he had a keen interest in medical devices. Maybe he could exchange knowledge with this Ixia...
en|COGNER! Un couteau est tombé et a fai: KNOCK! A knife fell and nearly split the table as the leader of the group cleared his throat angrily.
en|\"Idiots ! Vous méritez d'avoir souff: "Idiots! You deserve to have suffered under her thumb all these years. Who cares about her inventions, or even the dishonor among thieves? Ixia's greatest mistake was incurring Eruditio's wrath. Think about it! When did the winds of this desert turn against us? Eruditio's Rangers spent years trying to hold us back, but courage and gunfire got us through the worst. But since then that they found out that Ixia was inventing things, they They thought we were out to take what was theirs! They came to our land, installed pumps and generators, then lured our men into taking their so-called "stable jobs". exhibition. What a laugh she was stopped by a guard before she could even enter. They broke her craft and made her the laughing stock of these lands.
en|BOUM ! La porte de la taverne s'ouvri: BOOM! The tavern door opened suddenly, and the onslaught of wind and sand almost knocked the traveler off his stool.
en|Le voyageur ajusta ses lunettes juste: The traveler adjusted his glasses just in time to see the figure pull out a pair of strange gadgets.
en|\"Mais je vais donner quelque chose à: “But I’ll give your widows something to tell!”
en|Et c'est à ce moment-là que les balle: And that's when the bullets started flying. Making an exquisite arc around the traveler, Ixia's shots were aimed at the three Sand Hunters behind him. The traveler dove under the table and kept his mouth shut. He watched in terror as a pair of spiked boots approached and stopped right in front of his table.
en|\"Des balles qui peuvent arcer, inspi: "Bullets that can arc, inspired by the sandworms of this desert. What do you think, stranger?"
en|Avec beaucoup d'intérêt, Ixia se penc: With great interest, Ixia half-bent down and lifted the cloak that tightly enveloped the traveler, as if to admire a new invention.
en|\"Hmm... L'odeur du cirage et du cuir: "Hmm... The smell of shoe polish and leather. It hasn't gone away even after coming all this way, has it Mr. Moniyan shoemaker?"
en|Alors qu'Ixia révélait vivement son i: As Ixia vividly revealed her identity, the traveler's face blushed a bright red. The template was in place. How could a simple shoemaker hope to become an academic? Eruditio would definitely have made fun of him the same way they made fun of Ixia. He should just go home and leave this terrible journey behind him.
en|Mais sous l’impulsion du moment, le v: But on the spur of the moment, the traveler found the courage to ask a question.
en|\"D-D-Pensez-vous que je peux devenir: “D-D-Do you think I can become an academic at Eruditio?”
en|\"Bon sang si je sais,\" Ixia haussa: "Hell if I know," Ixia shrugged as she grabbed the traveler's bag. "But in this wilderness, no one can tell you which way is right or wrong. It is said that sand hunters cannot be inventors, and inventors cannot be outlaws." Ixia smirked and took out a few books from the bag for herself. “But who are they to define us?”
en|Le voyageur fut repris par ses parole: The traveler was taken back by his words and lost himself for a moment in his thoughts. Collecting her loot, Ixia was halfway to the door when she turned around one last time.
en|\"Vous devez tracer votre propre chem: “You must carve your own path, just like the ever-changing sands.”
en|Ixia pourrait porter le nom de la fle: Ixia could be named after the Ixia flower, known for its bright colors and resilience. This could symbolize his elegance and deadly accuracy, just like his sniper skills in the game.
en|Elle est le premier et actuellement l: She is the first and currently only hero (as of 1.7.94 patch notes) whose abilities scale with Lifesteal. Ixia is also the only hero whose basic attacks don't trigger lifesteal.
en|Ixia peut recharger une arme avant de: Ixia can reload a weapon before she can walk.
en|Ixia est l’un des héros tireurs d’éli: Ixia is one of MLBB's high-tech sniper heroes, equipped with a dual-energy weapon that fires precise plasma shots. His design and abilities exude a sci-fi and cybernetic atmosphere, making him one of the most modern heroes in the game. Unlike traditional snipers who use guns, bows or arrows, his design has a futuristic look.
en|Contrairement à la plupart des tireur: Unlike most snipers who focus on single target damage, Ixia specializes in AOE (area of ​​effect) damage, making her a great teamfight carry. Her attacks can hit multiple enemies at once, making her powerful against grouped opponents.
