en|Robot intelligent utilisé pour protég: Intelligent robot used to protect little Ailee.
en|Des organisations clandestines ont ex: Clandestine organizations have existed throughout the many eras of the Land of Dawn's history. No one knows the true purpose of these organizations, but one thing is certain: whenever a crisis arises, mysterious figures emerge from the shadows to restore order to the world.
en|Le professeur Henry et son épouse tra: Professor Henry and his wife worked for the Dawn Council, known for its research into cutting-edge technologies, providing an endless and varied stream of high-tech products to government agencies and mysterious, anonymous clients. But when they finally finished developing the "SMART-01", everything changed, as their new creation was more intelligent and powerful than any android the world had seen before. It was designed such that once a genetically compatible host controlled it, it could act according to the controller's consciousness. The leaders of the Dawn Council saw the potential of this technology for warfare and ordered the Henrys to transfer the technology to selected government agencies for a mass production program. The Henrys refused.
en|Après avoir ordonné à leur Prototype: After ordering their Prototype One to destroy all data from the experiment, the Henrys mysteriously disappeared. To this day, little Ailee has no knowledge of these events. All she knows and cares about is that this special robot has always been there to protect and accompany her, and that he calls her "Honey" like her father once did, while she affectionately calls him "Jawhead" in return. The only clue left by her parents was a pocket watch that she carries with her wherever she goes. Finally, Ailee decides to travel with her robot friend to find the whereabouts of her parents...
en|Jawhead est le seul héros qui porte u: Jawhead is the only hero who carries a companion (Ailee) who doesn't help in battle.
en|Des révisions du nom d'Ailee ont été: Revisions to Ailee's name were made from Alice and Ellie.
en|Presque tous les skins de Jawhead ont: Almost all Jawhead skins have two eyes/lenses that are different from the default one.
en|Victory Loader est le premier skin à: Victory Loader is the first skin to use Ailee's face in the avatar icon instead of using Jawhead's face.
en|Un super cyborg qui peut se transform: A super cyborg who can transform into a car and lead his teammates into battle.
en|Johnson était une légende du monde de: Johnson was a legend in the world of Varis, a place where speed is everything. Here, the sport of auto racing was monopolized by the rich and elite until Johnson became the first commoner to break that mold. But just when he shocked the world by winning his first official race, he disappeared without a trace.
en|La seule personne qui avait une idée: The only person who had any idea where Johnson was was an old man who claimed to have gotten into his car. According to him, Johnson was driving so fast that he was tearing the fabric of space and going beyond the stars. However, everyone who heard the story simply dismissed the old man as senile.
en|Ce vieil homme menait une vie ordinai: This old man led an ordinary life and spent most of his life in the city's slums. He worked in construction in his youth and helped build many of the city's extravagant landmarks, including the famous Varis Speedway. He earned a meager salary for his work, but loved gazing at the lights of downtown and getting lost in their promises of a better life. The years passed and he grew older. He could no longer work as before, but his debts continued to accumulate. The debt collectors' visits became increasingly frequent and violent, and one night they came looking for blood.
en|Le vieil homme courait avec tout ce q: The old man was running with everything he had, but he felt like he was sinking into the mud. Surely this city he helped build would give him a way out, right? Little did he know that his salute was heading towards him at 180 miles an hour...
en|Le vieil homme fut soudainement tiré: The old man was suddenly pulled into the passenger seat by a firm grip as his pursuers disappeared in the rearview mirror. Everything happened so quickly that the old man only saw a flash of light and believed that he was finally going to meet his maker.
en|Lorsqu’il reprit ses esprits, il réal: When he came to his senses, he realized that the driver was only a child. A young boy who took up almost the entire driver's seat.
en|C'était la première fois que le vieil: It was the first time the old man had ridden in Johnson's car. He had spent his whole life in Varis, but he had never seen the city like this; at least not at this speed. Johnson drove like he was possessed, speeding through every corner of the city. They were moving so fast that the outside world seemed to move in slow motion.
en|\"Mon père m'a toujours dit d'être ra: “My dad always told me to be fast!”
en|Le vieil homme ne savait pas quel gen: The old man did not know what kind of father this boy had, but the boy spoke about him with a sparkle in his eyes and kept these words dear to his heart. For the first time, the old man began to understand why the people of Varis kept saying that speed was a passion and that the pinnacle of speed was the limits of the universe. After experiencing such extreme speed, he gained a deeper understanding of the city.
en|Les gens allaient et venaient toujour: People were always coming and going in a hurry, and all this was illustrated by the words of Johnson's father: "Be quick!" »
en|Le vieil homme n'a pas revu le garçon: The old man did not see the boy again for many years after that fateful ride. He returned to the construction site even though he was too old and sick for the job. He looked up just as a pipe fell from the upper floors. He closed his eyes and believed that he would finally be free of his debts.
en|Soudain, il y eut un autre éclair de: Suddenly there was another flash of light, and a silhouette, or rather the silhouette of a car, appeared at full speed and grabbed the old man. For a moment, he couldn't understand what he was seeing...
en|C'était Johnson ! Il est devenu... mo: It was Johnson! He has become... half machine, half car? A roaring engine was now Johnson's new heart, and a carbon frame was his body. On both sides of him were exhaust pipes that looked like bottle rockets. In this world where speed is everything, the old man couldn't think of a body more suitable for Johnson.
en|Mais c’est la tragédie qui a conduit: But it was tragedy that led to this moment. Johnson and his father were in a terrible car accident and only Johnson survived the accident. He had no money to pay for expensive prosthetics, so he allowed doctors to perform an experimental procedure to fuse him with his car.
en|Le vieil homme fronça les sourcils. C: The old man frowned. This child had managed to escape death. And not once, but twice! Despite his age, he saw in Johnson the true meaning of speed. It was strange, but real.
en|Alors que le vieil homme disait au re: As the old man said goodbye to Johnson for the second time, he had the feeling that they would one day meet at the ends of the universe.
en|La vie du vieil homme s'est ensuite d: The old man's life then passed uneventfully, until the day he saw Johnson on a jumbotron, crossing the finish line at Varis Speedway. This kid had performed a miracle! He was the first commoner to win an official race. He became a pioneer and a beacon of hope for the lower class; the catalyst that will change this world forever.
en|L'excitation monta dans les veines du: Excitement rose in the old man's veins and he began to dream of becoming like Johnson; having passion pumped through a roaring engine in his soul.
en|Johnson ne s'est pas présenté sur le: Johnson did not appear on the podium after his victory. As he crossed the finish line, something triggered in his mechanical body and a blinding light appeared in front of him, like a door to another world. And just like that, Johnson, who had just become a legend in his world, disappeared into the light.
en|\"Johnson était mon apprenti, vous sa: "Johnson was my apprentice, you know. Now he's among the stars. There! It's him!"
en|Le vieil homme a réalisé son souhait: The old man got his wish and became like Johnson, and now lives his life at breakneck speed. In his free time, the old man would tell stories about his time with Johnson. He still believes that if you can move fast enough, you can leave this mundane world and soar into the cosmos, just like Johnson did.
en|Johnson, à cette époque, venait d'arr: Johnson, at that time, had just arrived in a strange new world. For him, it simply meant new faces to meet, new places to explore, and new speed limits to exceed.
"Hey, you with the ponytails. Want to race?"
en|Le rugissement de son moteur résonna: The roar of its engine echoed throughout Eruditio.
en|Johnson est l'un des héros les plus u: Johnson is one of the most unique heroes not only in Mobile Legends but among the universes of the MOBA game genre.
en|L'ancienne version de Johnson était l: The older version of Johnson was one of the characters in Mobile Battleground - Blitz.
en|Le « Jeepney Racer » de Johnson est u: Johnson's "Jeepney Racer" is a tribute to the Philippines. This special Elite skin transforms Johnson into a colorful Filipino jeepney, honoring the country's iconic public transportation.
en|Nom de Johnson = L'Electro Airbag et: Johnson's Name = Electro Airbag and Impact Wrench are the only skills in the game that scale with Physical Defense.
en|L'ultime de Johnson s'associe très bi: Johnson's ultimate pairs very well with heroes with high-damage AoE abilities; her most popular pairing being nom=Odette thanks to her nom=Swan Song (Ultimate). This is referenced on his mastery code.
en|Johnson dans sa citation \"Autobots ?: Johnson in his quote "Autobots? That sounds familiar.", and during his transformation into a car using his ultimate ability, there are references to the Autobots from the Transformers franchise which later became a collaboration skin in the game.

en|L'\"Enfant du Miracle\" revenu chez l: The “Miracle Child” returned to the Leonins after years of wandering.

The “Miracle Child” returned to the Leonins after years of wandering. Agile and cunning, known as Lumina City's most infamous "little thief", Joy had longed to have her stomach filled and her heart warmed. In a fortunate turn of events, Joy returned to the land of the Leonines, her wandering heart healed by the simple, unconditional love of her loved ones. She was no longer afraid of losing love again and swore to protect those around her, to transform into a golden lightning resonating with the house... === Me, Joy === Who am I?
en|Au moment où la foudre frappa sa poit: The moment the lightning struck her chest, the Leonine girl couldn't help but think about this question.
en|Elle cherchait une réponse depuis tou: She had been looking for an answer all this time.
en|\"Tu es le lapin d'amour préféré de g: “You are Grandma’s favorite love bunny.” This was the response she received from her adoptive grandmother. For as long as she could remember, they had lived in the slums of Lumina City. Even though grandmother was poor, she always found a way to feed the girl and put her to sleep. Meanwhile, the magic necklace on the girl's chest was still beating lightly to the rhythm of the lullaby. According to her grandmother, she was already wearing the necklace when she was discovered. One, two, three, four! It was like the beats of love.
en|Un jour, grand-mère ne s'est plus jam: One day, grandmother never woke up again... The girl stood by the frozen body for days, but could not find a way to wake her grandmother. The beating of the necklace on the girl's chest became slower and lighter.
en|C'était comme si son cœur était ferme: It was as if her heart was being gripped tightly by a pair of large hands, and she would never be able to hear the lullaby again. It was on that day that the young girl learned about death, the impermanence of love. No matter how hard he tried, it would always disappear eventually. For no reason!
en|Tout en essuyant ses larmes, elle réf: As she wiped away her tears, she thought about where she would find warm bread.
en|La jeune fille commença à errer. Même: The girl began to wander. Although life had always been sad, it had also taught him many things. She learned to sneak into stores to steal food, evade city guards, and even fight off stray cats for food. His leonine magic was strong enough to protect the girl, turning the bitterness of her life into a sweet cake.
en|À cette époque, la réponse qu'elle en: At that time, the answer she heard most often was "a thief who brings shame to the Leonin clan."
en|Elle se souvint de ces paroles d'Hari: She remembered these words from Harith, a henchman of the Imperial army. He was upset that the girl would tarnish the clan's reputation for honesty and kindness. Despite all attempts at reprimands and punishments, the girl never changed. Harith's anger grew greater and greater, until one day he discovered that the girl had never returned to the Leonin clan... never knew who she was.
en|Lumina City était suffisamment grande: Lumina City was large enough that wanderers often lost sight of each other. Young Leonine didn't know she had any choice but to wander. After several battles, Harith finally managed to bring the girl back to her homeland, Bright Marsh.
en|Situé dans les forêts centrales d'Azr: Located in the central forests of Azrya, the Glittering Swamp has been home to generations of Leonins. Years of wandering had put the young girl on her guard. Always vigilant, she was like a stray cat forcefully adopted. All she wanted was to escape from her new home.
en|Le patriarche des Léonins donna à la: The patriarch of the Leonins gave the young girl his third answer: “a miracle child, the one who will fulfill the prophecy of the Leonin clan”.
en|Il y a des années, par une nuit d'ora: Years ago, on a stormy night, a girl was born in the swamp, holding the "Leonine Crystal". In the clan's ancient prophecies, she was known as the "miracle child" who would save their people. But when the little girl was only three years old, she accidentally fell into a river...
en|Le patriarche a emmené la jeune fille: The patriarch took the girl to the Leonine temple, where the Leonine crystal was enshrined... The shape was the same as that of the necklace on the girl's chest. They began to resonate.
en|C'était comme si la chanson de grand-: It was like Grandma's song was being sung again.
en|Mais même la prophétie n'a pas pu cha: But even the prophecy could not change the girl's habits. She continued to play tricks on those around her and lie to get her hands on delicious food. She even organized a barbecue party in the Leonin temple! Even the other kids who didn't like the girl had no way to deal with her. Whenever the kind and simple Leonin villagers showed concern or kindness towards her, they always reminded the girl of that moment when she felt her heart beating slowly... Of the tingling sensation that she never wanted to feel again.
en|\"Je n'ai pas besoin de me soucier de: “I don’t need to worry about who I am here…I hope things can stay this way forever.”
en|Mais le tonnerre au milieu de la nuit: But thunder in the middle of the night shattered the girl's dreams.
en|Cet orage abyssal semblait vouloir to: This abysmal storm seemed to want to erase everything. The girl was terrified... She was the "miracle child", the one who had been given so much drink and food for free... They were definitely going to ask her to save them!
en|Mais la demande du patriarche était q: But the patriarch's request was that she flee to a safe place. The Leonins had no intention of sacrificing a child in the name of prophecy. They didn't care about her because they wanted something... but rather because they felt sorry for an orphan. The Leonins released the young girl, as if she were a child who had left home.
en|Levant les yeux, la jeune fille vit q: Looking up, the girl saw that the temple was about to collapse under the pressure of the storm. The shivering Leonins had surrounded the temple, doing their best to keep it propped up by magic. Closing their eyes and praying, they thought of their families for peace of mind.
en|Le collier sur sa poitrine recommença: The collar on his chest began to beat again, slowly and lightly. Was she going to lose her new home the same way she lost her grandmother?
en|Alors qu’un autre éclair brillant sor: As another bright bolt of lightning came from the sky, the temple began to collapse. Suddenly... this girl managed to resist the lightning! Running back and forth through the storm, she absorbed the lightning into her body, preventing it from further damaging the temple. She continued to run and roll at high speed, until a bolt of lightning struck her in the chest.
en|C'est à ce moment-là qu'elle trouva s: That's when she found her answer.
en|Le cristal Léonin dans la tempe vibra: The Leonine crystal in the temple vibrated with the necklace. One, two, three, four!
en|Les Léonins et le Cristal surgirent d: The Leonins and the Crystal emerged with magical energy oozing from the girl, as if it were a blessing from the house. The light spread to his ears and legs...illuminating his entire body.
en|\"J'ai volé de la nourriture et fait: "I stole food and did a lot of bad things..."
en|La jeune fille a continué à courir, d: The girl continued to run, getting faster and faster, to the point where nothing could stop her.
en|\"Mais en ce moment, je suis un enfan: “But right now, I am a child loved by everyone... The miracle child of the Leonins!”
en|Elle n'avait plus peur de perdre l'am: She was no longer afraid of losing love...Instead, she would use her life to protect those she loved. The light on the girl's body became brighter and brighter. Like golden lightning, it shot towards the dark clouds overhead.
en|Le nom « Joy » représente sa nature l: The name “Joy” represents her playful and energetic nature. Her vocal lines are happy and enthusiastic, showing her young and cheerful personality.
en|Elle est la 4ème Léonine à être intro: She is the 4th Leonine to be introduced into the game along with Nana, Harith and Aulus.
en|Elle a des oreilles de chat, une pers: She has cat ears, a playful personality, and makes cute purrs and meows in some of her vocal lines. Even her Ultimate, "Ha, Electrifying Beats!", makes her jump like a hyperactive kitten.
en|Joy est le premier héros à accompagne: Joy is the first hero to accompany the rhythm through his skills, like a rhythm game.
en|Joy est officiellement sorti le 18 no: Joy was officially released on November 18, 2022, since Fredrinn released on August 12, 2022, making it the longest gap between hero releases at 98 days.
en|Joy est le sixième héros à recevoir u: Joy is the sixth hero to receive an exclusive M Series champion skin after Fnatic ONIC PH won the M6 ​​World Championship. Other heroes with the M-Series skin include Harith, Lancelot, Estes, Chou, and Brody.
en|Un Corbeau assassin de l'Église de la: A Raven assassin from the Church of Light, a young boy searching for his home…
en|Un assassin Corbeau de l'Église de Lu: A Raven assassin from the Church of Light, a young boy searching for his home... A member of the secret force of the Church of Light on the path to self-awakening. Julian was the son of Terizla, the leader of the Free Blacksmiths' Guild. The guild was exterminated by the Church of Light on charges of heresy when Julian was very young. The poor child was then adopted by the Archbishop, trained and molded into an elite member of the Ravens, a secret force that only listened to the Archbishop's orders. Later, during his mission to “purify” Xavier, he glimpsed the secret buried in time… ===Awakening: Nirvana===
en|Il y a dix ans, une nuit d'hiver, une: Ten years ago, one winter night, a snowstorm raged on the citadel of the Free Blacksmiths Guild.
en|La Guilde des Forgerons Libres de Ter: The Freesmiths' Guild of Terizla was accused of pledging allegiance to the Abyss and destroyed by the Church of Light. The only survivor was the ruler's six-year-old son, who wandered the streets for days until the Church found the starving boy. The archbishop saw in him a special talent, bestowed upon him the name of an ancient saint – Julian, and sent him to the special academy of the Church of Light – Raven's Nest.
en|Située au sommet d'une falaise, l'éco: Situated on top of a cliff, the school housed orphans with special talents. The Archbishop told them that children abandoned by their families were not worthy of love, but that he would give them love and rebirth, which must be repaid with gratitude and loyalty: they must become Ravens, a secret special force that answers directly to the Archbishop and cleanses the world of all heretics and evils for the Lord of Light.
en|Julian s'est forcé à oublier son pass: Julian forced himself to forget his past, but despite all his efforts, he could not erase the nightmare from his mind: his mother left him behind and begged for mercy for herself, without even sparing him a glance...
en|Julian se souvenait également d'un ge: Julian also remembered a strange gesture accompanying the nightmare: he always raised the corners of his mouth with his hands and forced himself to smile unconsciously. But other than that, he didn't remember anything else. He didn't know who taught him how to do that or what happened back then.
en|Les enfants du Raven's Nest s'appelai: The children of Raven's Nest were called Nestlings. They performed arduous tasks and studied books and combat skills during the day, then stayed in their separate caves to rest and rest at night.
en|La vie des Nestlings est solitaire. M: The life of Nestlings is lonely. But Julian started a family with the other guests of his cave: a rodent who loves breadcrumbs, a chirping sparrow and a goat he took care of. Every windy night, they listened to Julian talk about his loneliness and his doubts. For him, it was his family who didn't speak.
en|Avec leur entreprise, Julian a travai: With their company, Julian worked diligently at the Academy and was one of the most excellent students when it came to work, study, and combat. He was congratulated by the Archbishop but did not notice another Nestling's jealousy towards him.
en|Une nuit, Julian se retira dans sa ch: One night, Julian retired to his room and found three stiff animal carcasses on the stone bed.
en|Derrière lui venaient les ricanements: Behind him came the evil sneers of the other Nestling, "Rodents represent infidelity, sparrows ignorance and the weakness of goats... Julian, you are not worthy of the love or revival of the Church!"
en|Sa vision se brouilla dans un soudain: His vision blurred in a sudden rush of blood, as he clenched his fists, his mind blank.
en|Après une bagarre sanglante, Julien f: After a bloody fight, Julien was taken away by members of the Church, and the archbishop who was there to review their work also arrived – the consequences would be serious. Nestling, seriously injured, lay unconscious on the ground. Julian almost lost his balance against the wall, as if his heart had fallen into freezing water.
en|Il ferma les yeux, attendant la punit: He closed his eyes, waiting for the archbishop's punishment.
en|\"Jalousie... Un Nestling si sale et: "Jealousy... Such a dirty and weak Nestling. Excommunicate this failure!"
en|La punition était plus terrifiante qu: The punishment was more terrifying than the execution! But how would the archbishop punish Julien? Much to Julian's surprise, the archbishop patted him on the shoulder.
en|\"Julian, tu as bien fait. Et tu as n: "Julian, you did well. And you cleaned those things in that corner, didn't you?"
en|Julian était à court de mots. Il rega: Julian was at a loss for words. He looked at the carcasses in the corner: they were dirty, cold and insignificant. The other Nestling's words still rang in his ears: Julian, you are not worthy of the Church's love or revival!
en|\"N'est-ce pas !?\" La voix de l'arch: “Isn’t that right!?” The archbishop's voice was that of a pair of hands clasped around his neck, while Julian trembled slightly. After what seemed like a century, he turned up the corners of his mouth and forced a stiff smile onto his cheeks.
en|Un éclat de lumière matinale brillait: A sliver of morning light shone from the east, half of Julian's face exposed to the sun while the other half was hidden in the darkness. He nodded slightly.
en|\"...Oui. Je les ai tués, pour ma ren: "...Yes. I killed them, for my rebirth."
en|L'archevêque a caressé la tête de Jul: The archbishop stroked Julian's head, slowly chanting the scripture: "Your fear and your dread will be on every beast and every bird." Your verdict will be accepted by every soul that walks the earth. And every path on which the Light shines, by your hand they will be traced.
en|Une lumière étrange brillait dans les: A strange light shone in Julian's dark pupils. He raised his hand to summon his weapon, proving himself to the archbishop.
en|Julian savait qu'il deviendrait le Co: Julian knew he would become the strongest Raven of all.
en|Les années passèrent, et à l'âge de 1: The years passed, and at the age of 15, these Nestlings faced their last trials before becoming Ravens: some infiltrated the enemy base, others explored the Abyss, others eliminated the heretics... After the perilous challenges, even the most elite Nestlings would be exhausted. But once they passed the tests, they would return to the Church of Light. The luminous arrow would be in front of them, as their faces lit up with hope – just one step before rebirth!
en|Mais ce n’était que le début de l’épr: But this was only the beginning of the most difficult test.
en|Au tournant devant l'église, quelqu'u: At the turn in front of the church, someone called a nest by its birth name. If they could not stop themselves from turning back, they would be excommunicated and considered heretics. This step was to test if a Nestling was loyal enough to forget the person they once were.
en|Julien a réussi le test. Toutes ces a: Julien passed the test. All these years, he lived in fear of being abandoned by the Church and even heard in dreams the words of the Archbishop: A Raven must forget himself! But... he wasn't a pure Raven. A voice in the back of his head had always resisted the archbishop's voice. He had no idea what that voice was and was confused about the two conflicting voices.
en|Tard dans la nuit, Julian fit à nouve: Late that night, Julian made that gesture again: turning up the corners of his mouth into a forced smile.
en|Pourquoi devrait-il sourire ? Julian: Why should he smile? Julian didn't know that, but it didn't matter because he was the strongest Raven.
en|Lorsque Xavier a fait sauter la porte: When Xavier blew up the city gate and fled with Yin and Melissa, the archbishop sent Julien on a mission: poor Xavier's mind had been poisoned by heretics and he had to be given mercy. Julian chased them for seven days in the mountains and finally caught up with Xavier and the other two who had exhausted their strength.
en|Une bataille était inévitable, et il: A battle was inevitable, and there was no clear winner between the strongest Raven and the greatest Arbiter of Light. But by accident, Julian's Raven hood fell off, and at the sight of his red hair, Xavier stood stunned for a moment as if he had recognized something. Then he took Julian's next blow.
en|Xavier ne pouvait plus se battre mais: Xavier could no longer fight but still protected Yin and Melissa. He laughed: "It was you who came to purify me. Very good. After all, your mother..."
en|L'arme de Julian n'est pas tombée. Se: Julian's gun didn't fall. His eyes were wide, "You know my past!?"
en|Xavier hésita un instant avant de dir: Xavier hesitated for a moment before telling the truth: on that snowy night, young Julian was hidden in a corner by his mother. She held Julian's face and forced a smile as she said, "Stay here. Everything will be fine. When you don't know what to do... Smile..."
en|Effrayé, Julian s'accrocha à sa mère: Frightened, Julian clung to his mother before she cruelly pushed him away and ran away to attract enemies... After Julian's mother was killed by the Ravens, Xavier keenly noticed Julian hiding behind some crates.
en|Julian ne savait pas ce qui se passai: Julian didn't know what was happening or what reaction he should have. At that very moment, he remembered the way his mother raised the corners of her mouth.
en|Le sourire tira fort sur la corde sen: The smile tugged on Xavier's heartstrings, and so he left with the Ravens.
en|Le visage de la mère de Julian, qu'il: The face of Julian's mother, whom he had forgotten for ten years, suddenly became clear, as did all the walls of the Artisans' Union, the fires inside the furnaces, and the wooden toys that his father had given him... Julian's hands were shaking violently. A Raven who found himself could no longer wield his sword without hesitation. His mother loved him deeply and even risked her life to prove it. He was never abandoned by his family.
en|A ce moment, Alice se présenta à l'en: At this moment, Alice appeared at the entrance of the cave with demons. Xavier and the other two were out of breath after days of battle. It was at this desperate moment that Julian stood between them and Alice. He gave Xavier and the others time to cross the rope bridge over the cliffs, before cutting the bridge and confronting Alice alone.
en|Cela ne les protégeait pas dans le li: This did not protect them in Julian's book. Eliminating heretics was one of the Ravens' missions, but it wasn't just a mission for Julian. He would only be able to find Xavier and learn more about his past if he won this fight.
en|Malgré les puissants démons devant lu: Despite the powerful demons before him, Julian still saw his mother's smile in his mind, and for the first time, her smile wasn't forced.
en|Il s'est finalement retrouvé et a aus: He finally found himself and learned to smile too.
en|Le prénom « Julian » est un prénom ma: The first name “Julian” is a common male first name in Europe and Latin America. It is based on the Roman name "Julianus", derived from "Julius".
en|Julian est le premier héros à posséde: Julian is the first hero to have a level 5 Ultimate skill, the second being Suyou.
en|Parmi les membres de Forsaken Light,: Among the members of Forsaken Light, Julian is the only one without a promotional comic.
Among the members of Forsaken Light, Julian is the only one who doesn't have a cinematic trailer, only an animated trailer.
en|Julian a un trouble de la parole et c: Julian has a speech impediment and some of his vocal lines are paused. It's because of his childhood trauma.
en|Il a les HP de base les plus élevés (: He has the highest base HP (2878) at level 1 among fighter roles, which exceeds Silvanna's HP of 2828.
en|Il possède remarquablement le deuxièm: He remarkably has the second highest HP in the entire game, behind Hylos who has an HP of 2909 at level 1.
en|Bien que cela n’ait pas été officiell: Although it has not been officially confirmed, Julian is considered one of the first heroes created due to an upcoming anime collaboration skin. Other heroes involved are members of Forsaken Light – Yin, Melissa and Xavier – for the Jujutsu Kaisen collaboration, as well as Suyou, Lukas and Kalea for the Naruto Team 7 collaboration event.
en|L'un des rares héros à figurer dans p: One of the few heroes to be featured in multiple MLBB collaborations. Julian is often called the "King of Collaboration" in the Mobile Legends: Bang Bang community as he has appeared in several collaboration events and crossover skins.
en|Julian était le 10ème héros offert gr: Julian was the 10th hero given to players for free upon release. The other free heroes are Faramis, Belerick, Silvanna, Luo Yi, Benedetta, Mathilda, Phoveus, Floryn and Edith.
en|Lors de sa sortie initiale, Julian a: During his initial release, Julian was introduced as a fighter/mage. At the time of patch 1.9.64, the developers changed his role to Assassin/Fighter after finding that his playstyle was too similar to that of an Assassin and made him more precise.
en|Xavier, Yin, Melissa (co-membres de F: Xavier, Yin, Melissa (co-members of Forsaken Light)
en|La reine des mers du Sud, Kadita, éta: The Queen of the South Seas, Kadita, was once the princess of a small island nation. Admired by all, Kadita was considered by all to be authentic, intelligent and caring. However, fate often finds a way to hit people with conflicts. Kadita was no different. As the king's heir apparent, a member of the royal family became jealous of Kadita and conspired to ruin her. An unknown mage wielding the power of dark magic viciously attacked the princess. Kadita was subjected to a powerful spell that stole all her beauty, giving her a strange skin disease.
en|Les habitants du royaume ont essayé t: The people of the kingdom tried everything they could to help their beloved princess, but no one could break the spell. Over time, people's love for Kadita faded, causing her to lose power and confidence. Driven by immense despair, Kadita threw herself into the stormy seas of the South. However, Kadita was saved by the ocean demons. Using the Sea Trident, the ocean demons were able to break Kadita's powerful spell, but due to her skin disease, her skin was never able to return to its original tone. That day, Kadita becomes the legendary Queen of the South Seas.
en|Assumant de nouveaux pouvoirs, Kadita: Assuming new powers, Kadita became expert in controlling ocean waters and the weather. Sailors around the world came to fear the South Seas because they were bound to face Kadita's wrath. No one dared to conquer the South Seas anymore. The survivors renounce their experiences in front of Kadita. In some ways she had the appearance of a strange mermaid, while others said she was more beautiful than the princess they knew before. As stories of Kadita began to spread, legends say that she possessed seven legendary spears, each with their own unique abilities, used to punish any invaders intending to rape the South Seas.
en|Kadita s'inspire du folklore indonési: Kadita is inspired by Indonesian folklore, notably the legend of Nyi Roro Kidul, the Queen of the South Seas. In myth, Nyi Roro Kidul is said to rule the Indian Ocean and have the power to control the waters and command sea creatures.
en|Kadita est l'un des rares héros de Mo: Kadita is one of the few heroes in Mobile Legends whose powers are purely water-based, and this is reflected in both her abilities and her appearance.
en|Les couvre-chefs et accessoires de Ka: Kadita's headwear and accessories have designs inspired by the sea goddess, resembling coral crowns and sea creature motifs, emphasizing her divine and supernatural status. She has shell designs on her attire, which further connects her to the beauty and mystery of the ocean.
en|Dans le patch 1.4.94, Kadita a subi d: In patch 1.4.94, Kadita underwent role adjustments, moving from Mage to Mage/Assassin.
en|Sa « thalassophobie » passive est bas: His passive “thalassophobia” is based on a real phobia, that is to say an intense fear of deep bodies of water.
en|Reine des mers du Sud, princesse d'un: Queen of the South Seas, princess of a certain island (formerly)
en|Jeune esprit né des désirs profonds e: A young spirit born from the deep desires stored in the Seimei umbrella, she finally emerged from her dream, like a radiant bloom, in defiance of the dark night.
en|Bien que l'Ombre Écarlate lui ait don: Although the Scarlet Shadow gave her a name and Hayabusa taught her peace, the young Kagura remained unsure of her true path. When she opened her umbrella in contemplation, she saw not gentle rain but visions of calamity, eons of regret, and a past seen through her umbrella. Kagura finally understood: although born of persistent attachments, her path led to freedom. She would carry both the regrets and hopes of those who had died to experience the beauty of the mortal realm that they had never been able to enjoy, and embrace the future that had been stolen from them but graciously granted to her. ===Spring stirs as dreams fade===
en|L'histoire des origines de Kagura éta: Kagura's origin story was sketchy at best. The old man who had brought her to the Scarlet Shadow was well beyond his years, and whenever he was asked, he simply repeated the same memory: on a rainy spring day over ten years ago, he found an abandoned baby under an umbrella and named it Kagura. Nothing more could be gained from it. The Shadow Sect sensed a mysterious power within her and, after much deliberation, decided to raise the child. Yet Kagura was destined to stay away from them – the power within her rejected their ninjutsu, and she could not understand why these warriors lived and died by their nindo. Only the umbrella, whose origins were equally mysterious, kept him company, in joy and in sadness.
en|Au fil du temps, Kagura a appris à tr: Over time, Kagura learned to find her own peace within the Scarlet Shadow. She observed the manners of the ninjas and took care of those exhausted from training. A young member of the Shadow Sect named Hayabusa told her that they fought tirelessly for honor, and although Kagura nodded in response, she could not understand the meaning of those words.
en|Les jours de printemps, lorsque les f: On spring days, when the cherry blossoms fell like rain, Kagura would sit in the trees, watching the people rushing by below. Everyone had a destination and their steps were hurried but determined. But not knowing where she came from, she never knew where her destination was. She could only brush the fallen petals and fall asleep.
en|Kagura avait toujours senti un autre: Kagura had always sensed another world beneath her umbrella, but despite countless attempts, she could never unravel its mysteries. Until one late spring day, when she fell asleep as usual among the flowers of a tree. As the spring breeze curled around her fingers and soft petals rested in her hair, her umbrella suddenly seemed different.
It was a dream like no other. Kagura could only watch as things unfolded around her; before his eyes was a young spiritualist who exuded a familiar feeling. He called for his sister, with both sadness and joy so real that it was as if she were there. However, Kagura couldn't answer him. His gaze passed through her and landed on a figure in the distance.
en|Kagura regarda le jeune homme travail: Kagura watched the young man work on his spiritual tools and soon learned his name: Seimei, the legendary spiritual artisan. The young man expressed his sorrows while working hard at his profession: when the imbalance of Yin and Yang caused widespread calamity in the riverlands of Cadia, Seimei went in search of the Great Dragon to quell the unrest. But when he returned with the Great Dragon, he was greeted by the lifeless body of his sister. But he refused to accept this cruel fate. He would do anything to see his sister again, so he created a special spirit tool made of spirit insects: the Seimei Umbrella.
en|Lorsque Seimei a ouvert le parapluie,: When Seimei opened the umbrella, he could see his sister, smiling and calling to him. But how could a simple illusion born from his desire, a puppet constructed from his memory, be enough?
en|Une larme de sang tomba sur Kagura al: A tear of blood fell on Kagura as darkness consumed Seimei's once bright eyes. A fragment of the Twilight Orb had unconsciously resonated with his obsession, driving him to madness. Kagura could only watch helplessly as the balance of Yin and Yang collapsed, and countless souls erupted from the Lanterns of Infinite Lights, causing catastrophe once again. The Great Dragon had no choice but to overpower Seimei. In the end, Seimei spat out his last breath of blood as his eyes glowed with defiance. Kagura's vision blurred from tears before fading into darkness.
en|Lorsqu'elle rouvrit les yeux, Kagura: When she opened her eyes, Kagura found herself near the Lantern of Infinite Lights. As the souls continued to rage, Seimei's apprentice, Akazawa, exhausted himself creating small spirit lanterns to contain them all, but their unrest could not be calmed.
en|La légende dit que c'est le parapluie: Legend has it that it was the Seimei Umbrella that appeared in the sky at that critical moment, but now it was Kagura instead. She finally understood: it wasn't a dream, but the memories of the umbrella, and she was the spirit of the Seimei umbrella.
en|Les âmes se rassemblaient autour d'el: Souls gathered around her, whispering. As she listened, these victims of the calamities explained to her why they lingered in the mortal realm. It was not because of worldly desires or bloody revenge, but because of regrets and unfulfilled wishes. They simply wanted to see more of the beauty of the Riverlands of Cadia, witness the spring flowers bloom. They hoped that the umbrella that had accepted all their regrets would see these spectacles for them.
en|Et ainsi, à travers l’accumulation de: And so, through the accumulation of these lingering thoughts, the umbrella spirit took the form of a young girl, carrying the regrets of all those who still had attachments, born amidst the spring rain of falling cherry blossoms.
en|Le rêve s'est terminé ici. La familia: The dream ended here. Familiarity returned as the flailing of Scarlet Shadow's limbs and falling cherry blossoms filled his vision. But the lingering warmth in her palm and the tears on her face told Kagura that this wasn't just a dream. She looked at the umbrella in her hands, turning it gently. Even though the voices no longer resonated, the spring breeze chose this moment to brush past her, the petals gently wiping away the tears, as if to deliver their unspoken message:
en|Ceux qui sont nés du désir n’ont pas: Those born of desire need not be bound by the past; It is only through the young girl's blossoming growth that these lingering regrets can find their answer. Dwelling on past sorrows would only lead to finding yourself trapped in despair like Seimei. These past regrets can never truly be repaired, but now that you know where you came from, use those eyes to witness the beauty in this world that they couldn't.
en|Alors que le rêve s'effaçait et que l: As the dream faded and spring returned, Kagura understood where his path would take him. She would see, hear and feel all the beauty this world had to offer. She would blossom with her own brilliance – only then could she truly honor their kindness.
en|Sous l'arbre, des voix criaient son n: Under the tree, voices were calling out his name. Kagura looked down to see Hayabusa and Hanabi ready to catch her.
en|Le royaume des mortels était riche de: The mortal realm was rich in splendor, and there was always someone waiting for her to return. Perhaps that was what made life so precious: these simple moments of happiness.
en|Kagura est le premier héros à utilise: Kagura is the first hero to use the concept of yin and yang.
en|Dans le contexte du nom de Kagura, il: In the context of Kagura's name, it represents "divine music" or "sacred dance". This suits her character, as she wields the Seimei Umbrella, a magical artifact linked to spiritual power and rituals.
en|Importance culturelle : Kagura (神楽) f: Cultural Significance: Kagura (神楽) refers to traditional Shinto ritual dances performed to honor the gods and invoke blessings. These dances are highly symbolic and were meant to invite spiritual energy. This concept reflects Kagura's role as guardian of the Seimei Shrine, where her actions and abilities also invoke spiritual forces.
en|Le design visuel de Kagura s'inspire: Kagura's visual design takes inspiration from traditional Japanese clothing, with her kimono-style dress and elegant, mystical aura fitting the theme of a guardian priestess. Its design incorporates traditional elements while emphasizing its magical nature.
en|Kagura est le seul héros de Mobile Le: Kagura is the only hero in Mobile Legends whose primary weapon is an umbrella, specifically the Seimei Umbrella.
en|Elle est l'un des héros à parler japo: She is one of the heroes who speaks Japanese along with the Scarlet Shadow heroes.
en|Sa voix : kagura.revamp.move14.ogg es: His voice: kagura.revamp.move14.ogg is indeed a trick to master Kagura. When the umbrella returns to him, it stuns enemies by triggering the reversal of Yin and Yang, as if Yin and Yang reunited.
en|Ses capacités sans le parapluie (yang: His abilities without the umbrella (yang) in hand are primarily offensive, while his abilities with the umbrella in hand (yin) are defensive (purify, rush, push back).
en|Elle partage son doubleur en langue j: She shares her Japanese language voice actor, Gōto Ayasa, with Floryn, another hero with a Poke specialty and a high level of control effects.
en|Chef de Nazar qui garde le Palais Cél: Chief of Nazar who guards the Heavenly Palace.
en|Le Palais Céleste, demeure des dieux,: The Heavenly Palace, home of the gods, was once a bustling city patrolled by countless Nazar guardians. Any demon that dared to approach the city would be overwhelmed by its unrivaled flying speed and bound by its fearsome lightning whips that would rob its victims of all magical abilities. No demon could escape when pursued by these divine warriors, and thus perpetual peace was maintained in the Heavenly Palace.
en|En tant que chef, Kaja était capable: As a leader, Kaja was able to refine the power of lighting into pure energy to control as he wished, dealing catastrophic damage to any enemies that faced him, and was responsible for directly protecting the city's ruler. Countless centuries ago, after the city's ruler created the Nazar Guardians and left, the city gradually fell into a state of ruin. When Uranus was activated, the ruler of the Heavenly Palace gave new orders to the Nazar: drive the evil demons out of the city and rebuild the Heavenly Palace in anticipation of the master's return.
en|Kaja a une relation particulièrement: Kaja has a particularly close relationship with Uranus, being depicted as being extremely loyal to him in his bending code, paralleling their interactions in Edith's storyline.
en|name=La peau de base d'Argus, qui a é: name=The base skin of Argus, which has been confirmed as canon from his past as an angel of the Monastery of Light, sports a shoulder that strongly resembles Kaja's face. It is possible that the two knew each other at some point, or at least existed at the same time.
en|Il est le deuxième héros capable d'em: He is the second hero capable of preventing enemies from leaving a specific area, the other being Silvanna.
en|Il était le deuxième héros à posséder: He was the second hero to possess a suppression effect, along with Franco and Barats.
en|Cependant, il a été supprimé après sa: However, it was removed after its redesign and replaced with a sober effect.
en|Enroule, supprime et traîne la cible: Wraps, removes and drags the target
en|Avec sa queue de serpent, cette fière: With her serpent's tail, this proud descendant of the Great Serpent swims gracefully in the Sea of ​​Vonetis, aspiring to one day carry the full power of her heritage.
en|Dans la mer de Vonetis, une île appel: In the Sea of ​​Vonetis, an island called Solari Isle was facing the storm of the century. As the waves rose higher and higher, dull thunder rumbled through the gray clouds.
en|Les villageois de l'île étaient paniq: The villagers on the island were panicked: the typhoon had arrived without warning and no fishing boats had yet returned from the sea. They prayed to an ancient idol, hoping that the maiden with the blood of the Great Serpent would hear them and bring their loved ones back safely.
en|Les enfants, serrant dans leurs bras: The children, hugging their toys made with the image of the Great Serpent, began to sing a song.
