The enemy, very mobile and intimate with the terrain, had the upper hand. Despite this being Kimmy's first real combat mission, she remained remarkably calm. She quickly identified the enemy's movement patterns, followed them to a small outpost, and launched a successful first strike on her own.
en|Avant que le frisson de la victoire n: Before the thrill of victory faded, the extent of the enemy's operations was revealed: they had kidnapped soldiers
en|chercheurs pour les forcer à créer de: researchers to force them to create new weapons. Worse, they had already used stolen weapons to ambush frontline troops, causing heavy casualties. With no time to call for reinforcements, Kimmy disguised herself in enemy clothing and infiltrated their fortress, quickly locating the holding cells.
en|Derrière les barreaux de fer se trouv: Behind the iron bars were more than a dozen imprisoned allies. Kimmy acted decisively, opening the prison doors with her rifle. The sound alerted his comrades waiting to launch their attack outside. Thanks to their coordinated assault from within and without, chaos erupted within the enemy fortress, leading to their rapid defeat.
en|Alors que Kimmy évacuait les prisonni: As Kimmy evacuated the prisoners, an older officer, slowed by his injuries, caught his attention. Those familiar shoulders, that short cut of gray hair – that was his father. Kimmy, usually fearless, felt her confidence waver. She had never told her strict father about enlisting. As their eyes met, Kimmy prepared herself for the worst. However, after a moment's pause, he simply gave her a formal military salute, pretending not to recognize his masked daughter. His voice was no longer as deep as he remembered, and his injured stature seemed smaller than he remembered. He advised the “new recruit” to do something in the army. Kimmy shouldered her gun and nodded solemnly while trying to keep her voice from shaking.
en|De nouvelles missions attendues à l’h: New missions expected on the horizon. Kimmy looked up at the sky, knowing that her wings now held her father's.
en|attentes. Elle était destinée à attei: expectations. She was destined to reach even greater heights.
en|Kimmy est un nom féminin issu d'un di: Kimmy is a feminine name derived from a diminutive form of Kimberly, which began as an English place name combining "Cyneburg" (royal fortress) and "leah" (glade). As a standalone name, Kimmy has a cheerful, friendly quality that retains the warmth of a nickname while functioning as a full name. Kimmy conveys approachability and youthful charm, making it appealing to parents looking for a name that is sweet without being too formal.
en|Kimmy est le premier héros et actuell: Kimmy is the first hero and currently the only hero to be a Marksman/Mage type.
en|Elle est le troisième héros du jeu à: She is the third hero in the game who can convert one stat (attack speed) into another stat (magic power).
en|Lorsqu'elle passe Hero Voice en japon: When she plays Hero Voice in Japanese, instead of saying "Fighting 'Kimmy!" ”, she says “Fighting Jimmy!”
en|Alors qu'il était encore en développe: While still in development, Kimmy's first name and hero title was Mary the Ink Queen.
en|Le nom peut faire référence à Marie q: The name may refer to Marie who is an Inkling/Squid from Nintendo's Splatoon.
en|Kimmy est l'un des héros à avoir reçu: Kimmy is one of the heroes to receive an overhaul even before its release on the original server.
en|Son attaque de base se propageait et: Its basic attack spread and pierced enemies similar to shotgun pellets.
en|Elle avait 2 sources de compétences :: She had 2 skill sources: one for her first skill and one for her second skill.
en|Sa deuxième compétence était une autr: His second skill was another basic attack enhancement skill similar to his first skill, but was later transformed into a blink skill that consumes no energy.
en|Avant sa refonte dans les notes de mi: Before her overhaul in the 1.6.10 patch notes, Kimmy had mixed damage alongside Esmeralda, but she was later replaced with a magic damage specialty, making Esmeralda the only hero specializing in mixed damage.
en|La mélodie qu'elle prononce lorsqu'el: The melody she speaks when chosen with the Dragon Tamer skin is a parody of Hush Little Baby Don't Say A Word by The King's Singers 1987.
en|Elle est le troisième héros capable d: She is the third hero capable of performing basic attacks while moving with a joystick. Irithel and Leomord (while riding Barbiel in his Phantom Steed) are the other heroes to do so.
en|Lolita, Layla, Bruno, Johnson, Diggie: Lolita, Layla, Bruno, Johnson, Diggie, Ixia, Dr. Rooney (companions/friends)
en|Fils prodigue et épéiste de génie de: Prodigal son and genius swordsman of House Baroque.
en|Au [sud-ouest] de l'empire Moniyan [s: To the [southwest] of the Moniyan Empire [is] Castle Gorge which had fallen into decline due to the depletion of its famous gold mines.
en|En tant que plus ancien noble de l'Em: As the oldest noble in the Empire, House Baroque ruled over Castle Gorge. The Baroque Duke's eldest son, Lancelot, was a handsome young man with [unparalleled] swordsmanship. He received a good education in all areas, but also inherited his father's snobbery and haughtiness.
en|La maison baroque était en déclin dep: The Baroque house had been in decline for years and the Duke relied on loans to maintain a [façade]. To revive his family, the duke had a brilliant plan: choose a daughter-in-law with a nice dowry and make his fortune thanks to Lancelot's marriage. At least that's what he thought...
en|Lancelot était fasciné par les charma: Lancelot was fascinated by charming knights and their heroic tales since childhood and believed that he was the most brilliant and charismatic knight of modern times. So, for him, it would tarnish his honor if he earned money from his own marriage. Thus, Lancelot left home after a ridiculous duel with his father leading to a serious falling out.
en|Même s'il avait perdu le soutien fina: Although he had lost his father's financial support, Lancelot earned his living through his excellent swordsmanship by competing in competitions across the land. He never lost a battle in the arena and uttered his family motto "The thorns remain if the petals fall" while signing his initials on his opponent's body with his sword.
en|Libéré du contrôle de son père, Lance: Freed from his father's control, Lancelot began to play with women and stories of his romantic adventures spread throughout the empire. People jokingly called it the Blade of Roses. But Duke Baroque clearly didn't think of it as a delightful story and was told that he had struck Lancelot's name from their family records in a fit of anger...
en|Lancelot a joué et voyagé jusqu'au la: Lancelot played and traveled to Lake Azure, and after drinking his fill in a tavern, he held a harp, played and sang a song in its praise, secretly rejoicing in the cheers of the crowd. Then he suddenly saw a few drunks surrounding a young girl in a velvet coat. Immediately, he took out his sword to help the harassed girl out of the situation, but he was accidentally injured due to his intoxicated mind.
en|Après avoir chassé les hooligans ivre: After chasing away the drunken hooligans, Lancelot stumbled out of the tavern, knowing his wound could be fatal, and he refused to collapse in a tavern so gracefully.
en|Couvert de sang, il s'est traîné vers: Covered in blood, he dragged himself towards a tree and fell to the ground. Before he lost consciousness, he saw a pair of glowing swan wings. Perhaps they were the angels who came to welcome his soul to paradise?
en|Lancelot se réveilla et découvrit qu': Lancelot awoke to find that he was lying on a bed with bandages wrapped around his chest, an elegant young girl smiling wearily at himself. The swan wings he saw before he passed out were actually the swan crown on the girl's head. Lancelot thought he had never seen such a beautiful and innocent face, but he could barely speak before falling back into a deep sleep...
en|La jeune fille traita Lancelot avec b: The girl treated Lancelot with great care and continued to use magic to help him heal. After a few days of struggle, his life was finally no longer in danger. It was then that Lancelot learned that he lived in the swan castle of House Alvin and that the girl who saved him was Princess Odette of the noble family.
en|Il était interdit de laisser des étra: It was forbidden to let outsiders into Swan Castle, so Odette brought Lancelot in and hid him in a room at the top of the castle tower. As Lancelot gradually recovered from his injury, Odette delivered food to him every day with a young servant.
en|Au début, Lancelot pensait avec vanit: At first, Lancelot conceitedly thought that Odette had saved him because she had been seduced by his charisma. But later he found out that she was the girl he was helping at the tavern.
en|Au cours des premiers jours qu'ils pa: During the first days they spent together, Lancelot did not change his old habit of telling half-truths about his mastery of the sword and the great adventures he had experienced across the land. He hid his Baroque identity and called himself "Lancelot, the Romantic Knight of Castle Gorge". Odette believed in every poem he sang while playing the harp, whether it was about his hometown, Castle Gorge, or the Heavenly Palace he had never been to, the bandits and thieves he had defeated, or the dark deities he had only heard about on his travels. This young princess who had been locked inside the Swan Castle since she was a child was full of curiosity about the outside world.
en|Plutôt que d'être comme d'habitude, L: Rather than his usual self, Lancelot began to feel guilty for lying. When he could no longer boast of his conquests in front of Odette, he realized that he had fallen madly in love with the pure princess. He regretted the promiscuity he led before but had difficulty revealing his feelings to Odette. So every time she came to visit him, Lancelot would hold the harp and sing passionate love songs. At first, Odette did not understand his intentions, then no longer knew how to react. Later, she remained silent, her cheeks blushing...
en|Au cours des quelques jours précédant: In the few days before Lancelot was fully healed, Odette, for some reason, never showed up once. Unable to see the object of his desire, Lancelot couldn't even stop his fingers from trembling while playing the harp...
en|Lancelot, agité, dut interroger la se: Lancelot, agitated, had to question the servant who came to deliver him food what had happened to Odette. The girl replied with a cheerful smile: "Someone proposed to our princess. She was busy with that..."
en|Les mots le frappèrent comme le tonne: The words hit him like thunder. At that very moment, Lancelot, completely shocked, broke a string of the harp.
en|Après avoir réfléchi à la situation,: After thinking about the situation, he asked the maid to send a letter to Odette:
en|Chère princesse, pardonnez-moi de par: Dear princess, forgive me for leaving without goodbye. I decided to travel to all the mythical countries like in the songs I sang. I promise you that the day I return to Swan Castle, I will appear before you as a true knight. I hope that with Lake Azure and the sunlight as my witness, I will finally be able to tell you what I have been whispering to myself...
en|Au moment où Odette déposait la lettr: By the time Odette dropped off the letter and rushed to look out the window, Lancelot had quietly left on a grand journey across the country.
en|Alors que des guerres brutales se dér: As brutal wars raged across the Land of Dawn, the Blade of Roses was about to compose a song of praise that was truly her own...
en|Le style de combat de Lancelot est fo: Lancelot's fighting style is heavily inspired by fencing. He wields a rapier, the primary weapon of fencing, known for its speed and precision.
en|Avec son amante Odette, Gatotkaca, Ka: Along with his lover Odette, Gatotkaca, Kadita and Leomord, they are the only heroes based on literature.
en|Il est basé sur le personnage du même: It is based on the character of the same name in Arthurian legend; Described as King Arthur's greatest companion. Another hero based on Arthurian legend is Leomord.
en|Dans la légende, l'amante de son pers: In legend, her character's lover is supposed to be Guinevere, but this was changed in-game as she was revealed as his younger sister.
en|La lettre \"L\" qu'il dessine dans so: The letter "L" he draws in his old entrance animation is inspired by Zorro's signature "Z".
en|Il semble montrer beaucoup d’amour po: He seems to show a lot of love for his swords. This is evident from his quotes “my sword”, “Become one with the sword! »
en|Lancelot est le deuxième héros à rece: Lancelot is the second hero to receive an exclusive M Series champion skin when Bren Esports won the M2 World Championship. Other heroes with the M-Series skin include Harith, Estes, Chou, Brody, and Joy.
en|La maison baroque est la plus ancienn: The Baroque house is the oldest ducal family existing since the beginning of the Moniyan Empire.
en|Héros qui défend les îles Vonetis con: Hero who defends the Vonetis Islands against outsiders
en|Du haut du sommet, Lapu-Lapu contempl: From the top of the summit, Lapu-Lapu contemplated the flames of the Moniyan camp, at the foot of the mountain. He never thought he would once again find himself on a battlefield, the kind of place he hated the most. But he knew that to protect what was most important, he could no longer run away.
en|Dès le milieu de l'ère des conflits,: From the middle of the Age of Strife, the Dorik people came to the Vonetis Islands, southeast of the mainland, where they prospered.
en|Tout comme les vagues turbulentes con: Just as turbulent waves are the normal state of the sea, this solitary archipelago was by no means peaceful. The protection of the sea and the isolated way of life made the Dorik forget the vows made by the different tribes hundreds of years before to join forces and resist the powerful Moniyan navy and there was constant conflict between the tribes large and small.
en|Lapu-Lapu était le guerrier le plus c: Lapu-Lapu was the most famous warrior of the Vonetis Islands. It was employed by various tribes for a long period, passing between islands. The endless fighting brought him weariness, dignity, honor and money... On the battlefield, human lives were worthless. So[,] what was the value of all this? After fighting countless wars, he returned to his hometown with his body and mind scarred.
en|Lapu-Lapu menait une vie tranquille d: Lapu-Lapu led a quiet life in his hometown as an ordinary hunter, working at sunrise and resting at sunset. But the peaceful life he hoped for did not last. Some warlords who had defected from the Moniyan Empire set their sights on this free land. Well-trained troops landed on the Vonetis Islands like a tidal wave. The scattered Dorik peoples were powerless to resist, and large areas of land fell to the enemy.
en|Diverses tribus envoyèrent des invita: Various tribes sent invitations to Lapu-Lapu, hoping that he might join their camp. He was no longer willing to work for the interests of the tribal leaders, but under no circumstances could he become a contemptible capitulator. He therefore rejected the beliefs of the rulers and the Moniyan and simply wanted to remain a simple hunter, away from any worldly conflict.
en|Lapu-Lapu et les Moniyan ont conclu u: Lapu-Lapu and the Moniyan entered into a non-aggression agreement. However, in the eyes of the greedy Moniyans, neutrality did not exist and everything in the Vonetis Islands belonged to them. Soon, the Moniyans broke the agreement and ransacked Lapu-Lapu's tribe in his absence.
en|Cette perte humiliante n'a fait que p: This humiliating loss left him with nothing but mourning for his wife and children and a devastated home. Lapu-Lapu was furious. He wanted nothing more than to protect everything around him. If the Moniyan wanted to pay for his compromises with perfidy, he would show them his inviolable dignity in the form of their own blood.
en|Lapu-Lapu a rassemblé les jeunes de l: Lapu-Lapu gathered the tribe's youth into a unit and began his resistance campaign. He knew the hometown under his feet better than anyone and knew how to attack, fight and retreat in the mountains and forests. The unit continued to attack Moniyan bases and supply lines, coming and going without a trace, leaving the Moniyan in constant confusion and panic.
en|Lorsqu'un chef de guerre Moniyan déco: When a Moniyan warlord discovered that all this was the work of Lapu-Lapu, the despicable invaders began to deliberately plunder the villages with which Lapu-Lapu had allied himself. They strengthened their defenses and hid supplies to force Lapu-Lapu to appear. The villages that once cordially welcomed Lapu-Lapu had become completely unrecognizable under the iron boot of the Moniyan.
en|Lapu-Lapu, au cœur brisé, comprit que: Lapu-Lapu, heartbroken, understood that guerrilla warfare would not be enough to achieve final victory. The Dorik were destined to confront the powerful Moniyan Empire head-on; an arguably impossible task for him and his unit.
en|La voix anglaise de Lapu-Lapu inclut: Lapu-Lapu's English voice includes the Tagalog line ("Umalis kayo sa aming lupain"), implying that he is bilingual and that the language of the Dorican people being Tagalog is canon.
en|Le skin « Vulcain » doit son nom au d: The “Vulcan” skin owes its name to the god of the same name associated with fire in Roman mythology.
en|Le « Champion Impérial » est basé sur: The “Imperial Champion” is based on the military personal equipment of ancient Rome.
en|Le skin « Adlaw's Chosen » est probab: The "Adlaw's Chosen" skin is likely inspired by the word "adlaw" in Cebuano and other Visayan languages, meaning "sun". The sun symbolizes power, heroism and strength, all of which represent Lapu-Lapu, the first Filipino hero who resisted Spanish colonization. “The skin resembles the ancient aesthetic of Visayan warriors, connecting it to pre-colonial Filipino culture.
en|L'épine dorsale des Eruditio Rangers,: The backbone of the Eruditio Rangers, also known as the Shining Star.
en|\"Layla Grant, un membre éminent des: "Layla Grant, a prominent member of the Eruditio Rangers, bravely protected the heart of Eruditio technology, the Starlium Reactor, during a violent attack on Eruditio just a day earlier. While her actions protected civilization, they also proved that the city's youth possessed resilience and perseverance and that love and belonging in this home they shared was the life force that flowed through the veins of the Eruditios. Thus, the honorary title of “Bright Star” was given to her.”
en|Cette année, le titre de Shining Star: This year, the title of Shining Star was not awarded to a scholar, but to a member of the Eruditio Rangers. and it was none other than the “daughter of Eruditio”. She grew up on the streets of Eruditio, and every scholar of the Spire of Knowledge had experienced her mischievous nature at one time or another. Somehow, the problems she caused would miraculously help scholars achieve a breakthrough in their research. Other times, Layla would suddenly try to close a deal on behalf of the traders with her funny accent when they had difficulty conversing with the foreign visitors. Every porter on the docks also benefited from his help in one way or another. Like an ever-assisted guardian, she watches over the city like a bright star.
en|Pendant ce temps, le seul parent de s: Meanwhile, Layla's only blood relative; the old but still strong as a bull, former captain of the Eruditio Rangers, Thomas, had never shown signs of joy. Sitting in a backlit room, his figure resembled the distant shadow of high mountains. Fondling an old-fashioned pistol, he looked both imposing and desolate.
en|Tenant dans ses bras un bébé qui pleu: Holding a crying baby in her arms, Thomas's beloved daughter disappeared behind the "Infinite Gateway" which turned into stardust in the sky, leaving him with only this precious little thing. As if she knew what was happening, her screams echoed endlessly through the night sky. Hastily, he ran home with the child in his arms as the morning star in the east gradually rose. He didn't want the light of day to harm him because the protection of night was fading quickly. He had lost a daughter at the dawn of humanity, and the one in his arms was all he had left.
en|Il emmaillotait le bébé dans le mante: He wrapped the baby in the cloak of darkness to hide him, naming him after the night: Layla.
en|Au fil du temps, elle a grandi et a é: Over time, she grew and was a real pleasure to Thomas's barren life. She loved both heaven and earth, and her little life was always full of joyful energy. As a result, Thomas' face, once marked by pain, began to smile again. He collected the equipment from his youth while he was still a young Ranger, and together with Layla, he jumped off the ground and flew over the horizon of Eruditio, becoming the biggest headache for the young Rangers of Eruditio. What were these poor guys supposed to do, chase down and arrest the old man whose face is printed on the Ranger rulebook? She was everything to Thomas: dawn, noon and dusk. But deep down, she still wanted to know her parents.
en|\"C'est une tragédie qu'ils aient dû: "It's a tragedy that they had to die in the meteor crash. Hey, why don't we check out Grandpa's newly developed weapon for you? It has three times the firepower of the previous one!"
en|\"Lorsque les queues de cheval de Lay: "When Layla's ponytails reached her shoulders, she stopped asking him about his parents because she could no longer stand to see the sadness and evasiveness in her grandfather's eyes. She soon realized that the grandfather who never left her side always left the house before dawn one day a year. So Layla quietly followed him and discovered the answer to her question. He had gone to a cemetery to pay his respects to a woman named Lillian, a name that Layla had seen in an old newspaper and which appeared in an official obituary of the Spire of Knowledge She was a great scholar who died for the advancement of the Eruditio Layla realized that this was her mother and that knowledge made her proud beyond measure, but she was also saddened by the thought that they could never be together. photo but just one line: I will hold your hand in the middle of the starry sky.
en|Layla a compris que son grand-père vo: Layla understood that her grandfather wanted to erase all traces of her parents from her life so that she would never have to grieve. Even though Layla understood, she still wanted to leave a little door in her heart for the woman named Lillian, so that if she ever missed Lillian, she could always visit her in her dreams. As for the tombstone of the mysterious man, since she had no idea who he was, she hoped that one day he would walk through that little door with his mother and finally reveal his true identity.
en|Dans son cœur. Layla a juré qu'elle s: In his heart. Layla swore that she would remember her mother no matter what and protect Eruditio, the city her mother had given her life for. In her grandfather's eyes, Layla was following a very different path from her mother. She didn't like studying and failed every exam she took, but she was strong, and no scoundrel ever left without learning a lesson. However. this was great news for her grandfather, because that way she would never end up a scholar, sacrificing herself for the future of humanity. And above all, she would never experience the same fate as... Lillian.
en|Ainsi, lorsque Thomas apprit que Layl: So when Thomas learned that Layla had almost died protecting Eruditio, he entered the room he had sealed for 15 years and sat there for a long time. Lillian's entire life flashed through her mind. She was incredibly passionate, intelligent, and brave, and she was also protective of Eruditio in her own way. She was the brightest star in the sky, and they were exactly the same.
en|La voix timide de la jeune fille réso: The girl's shy voice echoed in the doorway and a belt could be seen hanging around her body. It seemed that the treatment at the Spire of Knowledge had perfectly restored his body. However, Layla was full of guilt because she knew how much her grandfather would do for her, even for a small scratch. So, this time, since she had been seriously injured while protecting Eruditio, she expected her grandfather to get really angry...
en|Mais il la serrait fort contre lui, t: But he held her tightly to him, his whole body trembling violently.
en|\"Ta mère serait si fière de toi.\": “Your mother would be so proud of you.”
en|Thomas tendit à Layla l'arme qu'il av: Thomas handed Layla the gun he had locked in the closet – a prototype gun left by Lillian. For 15 years, he couldn't bear to see any trace of Lillian, but he forgot that the girl in front of him was the deepest trace Lillian left on him.
en|\"Si vous voulez protéger Eruditio, a: "If you want to protect Eruditio, then you will have to do so with the strongest firepower. This is a weapon...that your mother and father made. So hold it tight and protect yourself with it!"
en|Avec le pistolet maléfique entre les: With the evil gun in Layla's hands, no evil stands a chance before her. As if the stars are always guiding her, every time Layla holds her gun, she feels like Lillian is right next to her. Even this nameless man is there for her.
en|Layla (ليلى) est un nom arabe signifi: Layla (ليلى) is an Arabic name meaning "night" or "dark beauty". This matches his midnight blue energy based attacks, which resemble cosmic or nocturnal elements.
en|Layla est le premier héros à apparaît: Layla is the first hero to appear in official MLBB cinematics. Layla is one of the main protagonists in MLBB lore and appears in several animated trailers and official comics.
en|Le premier design original de Layla é: Layla's first original design was based on the main character from the Black Rock Shooter franchise.
en|Elle a la plus longue portée d'attaqu: She has the longest attack range in the game (perhaps tied only with Zhask, considering the attack range of her Nightmaric Spawn), unlocking her at level 12 she is able to attack enemy turrets outside of their own attack range, making her one of the best heroes for destroying enemy turrets.
en|De 2016 à 2020, elle est le premier h: From 2016 to 2020, she is the first hero that new players can get for free after completing the tutorial, but she was replaced by Eudora.
en|Le son de son projectile correspond à: The sound of her projectile matches her evil gun (Layla); the further away the target is, the higher the intensity of the sound effect.
en|Elle est le quatrième héros à avoir d: She is the fourth hero to have two Starlight skins ("Bunny Babe" and "Twilight Waltz"), after Moskov ("Snake Eye Commander" and "Violet Spear"), Saber ("Force Warrior" and "Iron Hound"), and Clint ("Rock and Roll" and "Operator CL").
en|De plus, les noms de ses skins peints: Additionally, the names of his painted skins, "Midnight Waltz" and "Sunset Waltz", did not match their respective appearances upon release. This was fixed in an unknown update.
en|Le skin « Blue Specter » de Layla est: Layla's "Blue Specter" skin is considered the rarest and unobtainable skin in the game. It was Layla's first exclusive skin and was only available during early MLBB events in 2017.
en|Le skin \"S.A.B.E.R. Breacher\" de La: Layla's "S.A.B.E.R. Breacher" skin is her default skin for Battleground Blitz.
en|Layla était l'un des héros réorganisé: Layla was one of the revamped heroes in the first batch of Project NEXT in September 2020, along with Miya, Eudora, Zilong, Alucard, and Saber. The goal was to balance the power gap between older and newer heroes, as the latter had better mechanics and animations.
en|Diggie, Dr Rooney, Johnson, Bruno, Lo: Diggie, Dr. Rooney, Johnson, Bruno, Lolita, Beatrix, Kimmy (companions)
en|Un chevalier juré qui a juré de garde: A sworn knight who swore to guard Necrokeep until his last breath.

A sworn knight who swore to guard Necrokeep until his last breath. Once a sworn knight of Ridgeburg, Leomord was forced to break the oath he took with his own sword in an unfortunate turn of events. Since then, he carried the curse of the Mist and guarded the lands abandoned even by death. The light had faded, and yet his guard had only just begun... === The Oath === Perched on the rocks of the Lantis Mountains, the colossal spiers of Ridgeburg overlooked the blackened plains of the Abyss. The rot had spread almost to the outskirts of the city, but no further. For thousands of years, fortified towers stood guard at the gates of the Abyss, keeping the Moniyan Empire safe from its scourge.
en|Léomord est né dans cette forteresse: Léomord was born in this border fortress. Coming from a long line of royal guards under the Southern lords, he was hired as the personal squire of Atticus, the son of the Duke of Ridgeburg, shortly after his birth.
en|Ensemble, les deux garçons se sont en: Together, the two boys trained under the best champions of Ridgeburg's army and listened to gray-bearded professors talk about history and politics. Atticus excelled in every lesson, showing remarkable maturity beyond his years, while Leomord struggled to keep up with his young master's pace. Reluctant to be left behind, he continued to train in secret, working alone day and night to perfect his skills.
en|Étant légèrement plus âgé, Atticus ai: Being slightly older, Atticus often helped young Léomord during his training. Leomord, in turn, considered Atticus not only his future lord, but also his older brother.
en|À l'âge de sept ans, les deux garçons: At the age of seven, both boys helped give birth to their horses, as was the custom among the people of Ridgeburg. Léomord named his pony Barbiel, with whom he became an ally and close friend. Although Léomord never expressed his feelings openly, Barbiel always seemed to know what was on his mind. And whenever Léomord felt depressed, Barbiel rubbed his head to offer him some relief.
en|Au cours des années suivantes, les de: Over the next few years, both boys became formidable fighters on the training ground, and that's when fate struck.
en|Après le décès prématuré du vieux duc: After the old duke's untimely death, Atticus was forced to assume his father's role as the new Duke of Ridgeburg, with Leomord at his side as captain of his royal guard. The boys had never tasted real combat, but seeing the gravity of the situation, they quickly set out to rid the border outposts of demonic intruders. For years, the two men fought endlessly, until they finally cleansed all traces of the Abyss from the Periphery.
en|Une fois que la ville eut retrouvé un: Once the city had found some respite from the assault, Atticus decided it was time to begin building ties with other noble houses in the Empire. He sought an alliance with the royal house of Gaius, proposing to Princess Vexana. Lord Gaius welcomed the offer and quickly arranged for the princess to travel to Ridgeburg and meet her fiancé.
en|Et pourtant, le destin avait autre ch: And yet, destiny had something else in mind for the young duke. Shortly before Vexana's expected arrival, he received a letter from one of the border towns. An unusually vicious race of demons had begun to appear along the border, and oddly enough, they carried traces of the same putrid magic that had once tormented his father. Some of the city's inhabitants had also disappeared, and the outpost requested the Duke's help in ridding the city of this threat.
en|Atticus rassembla immédiatement ses h: Atticus immediately gathered his men. He had no doubt that this quest could finally unravel the mystery of his father's death. Léomord, on the other hand, only felt a terrible presentiment.
en|Avant le départ, Atticus conduisit Lé: Before leaving, Atticus led Léomord to the top of the city walls. He drew his sword and motioned for Leomord to kneel on one knee. Knowing exactly what was going to happen, the young soldier took a deep breath and solemnly knelt before Atticus as he was told.
en|\"Duc Atticus, je jure par la présent: "Duke Atticus, I do hereby swear, in the name of my father and his house, that I will always lend my sword in your service, that I will give you advice when you ask for it, and that I will lay down my life if your safety requires it. I swear it this day, until the day of my death."
en|Atticus plaça le contondant de son ép: Atticus placed the blunt of his sword on Leomord's shoulder and declared him a sworn knight of Ridgeburg. The young soldier had difficulty containing himself. For over twenty years, they trained and fought together. And that day, Atticus had deemed him worthy of his trust.
en|Alors que le duc lui remit l'épée du: As the Duke handed him the Sword of Oath, Leomord knew that this was his destiny: to ride alongside his lord in this battle that could very well be his last. Except that Atticus had a different task for him: Leomord was to stay and keep guard at Ridgeburg.
en|Le chevalier ne pouvait pas croire ce: The knight couldn't believe what he had just heard, but Atticus's eyes were serious and stern. Princess Vexana would soon arrive; she would need all the help and protection she could get. And the Duke could count on no one else to carry this delicate burden than his closest friend, Leomord.
en|Et ainsi, aux premières lueurs du jou: And so, at first light, the young knight watched Atticus and his party disappear into the horizon. He clutched the sword of the Duke's Oath, pondering the new task at hand, which he felt was far greater than any battle he had ever fought.
en|Pendant deux ans, Léomord et la princ: For two years, Léomord and Princess Vexana waited. The quest took much longer than expected, and at one point Atticus even stopped sending letters back.
en|Et puis un jour, tout à coup, un mess: And then one day, suddenly, a messenger arrived to announce the Duke's return. Leomord let out a long sigh, as his mind finally felt at ease. Except that instead of the joy he expected to see in Atticus' eyes, he saw only… emptiness.
en|La campagne a dû être brutale et ardu: The campaign must have been brutal and arduous, he could only assume. Leomord chose not to push further and quickly set about joining the townsfolk in preparing for the long-delayed wedding of Duke Atticus and Princess Vexana.
en|Les habitants de Ridgeburg ont accuei: The people of Ridgeburg welcomed the evening with festivity and joy. The time had finally come for Atticus to give the alliance to Vexana. However, as the Duke opened the box, what came out was a pair of magical wings, as a deep, squeaky voice shook the stone walls of the fortress:
en|Embrassez le monde de la mort ! » Att: Embrace the world of death! » Atticus and his men transformed into demons at that very moment, their eyes burning with malice. They reeked of foul magic – rotten and vile – the putrid scourge of the Abyss. The city's once devoted guardians have become destroyers and the bane of their existence; sacred marriage turned into a massacre.
en|Léomord s'agrippa à l'Épée du Serment: Leomord clutched the Sword of the Oath, his mind blank as blood-curdling screams pierced his ears and pierced his skull. He couldn't understand what was happening in front of him, and more importantly, why Atticus would wield his blade against the people he had loved as his own, against the girl he had sworn to protect until he died.
en|Le duc déchaîné se jeta sur la prince: The furious duke threw himself at Princess Vexana.
en|La voix de Vexana résonna dans toute: Vexana's voice echoed throughout the room. Atticus froze, his legs shaking as his labored breathing scraped his lungs.
en|\"Tue-moi… Léo— K-tue-moi… je t'en su: “Kill me… Leo— K-kill me… I’m begging you—”
en|Léomord ne pouvait que le regarder av: Léomord could only look at him in horror. All he could think about was the wish he made two years ago.
en|« Je jure par la présente… au nom de: “I hereby swear…in the name of my father and his house, that I…will lay down my life if your safety requires it.
en|La sécurité du duc pèse-t-elle plus l: Does the Duke's security weigh more heavily than the security of the city? » the young knight wondered silently, just before gritting his teeth and driving his blade into Atticus' chest.
en|Les yeux du duc s'éclaircirent, comme: The duke's eyes brightened, as if freed from a curse. Gripping Léomord's vest, the words that came out of his mouth were hoarse and confused. "Brother...my brother...I am...free—"
en|Et alors qu'il rendait son dernier so: And as he breathed his last, he turned his gaze to Vexana and whispered. “The Mist… If there is no other choice—”
en|En regardant le corps d'Atticus se ré: Watching Atticus' body slowly burn to ashes, Leomord wanted nothing more than to follow his lord into death, but he could not die yet. He had a more important mission on his shoulders: Ridgeburg, besieged on both sides, needed his sword. Ridgeburg would fight to the end, even at the cost of freeing the Mist.
en|Cent ans s'étaient écoulés, et pourta: A hundred years had passed, and yet time in Ridgeburg seemed to stand still. Shrouded in a thick, dark fog, the city was known to be cursed, shunned by both light and darkness. Necrokeep, as they called it.
en|On pouvait parfois voir Léomord debou: Leomord could sometimes be seen standing on one of its towers, looking into the distance towards the horizon. His skin was sickly pale, neither alive nor dead. His eyes were tired from a hundred years of half-death, but they still shone with a glimmer of hope. He knew in his heart that he and Vexana would eventually find a way to reverse the curse of the Mist.
en|Depuis ce jour, il y a cent ans, sa v: Since that day, a hundred years ago, his life no longer belonged to himself, but to Ridgeburg. As long as there was still a soul in the city, he would keep it until his last breath. »
en|Le nom de Leomord est inspiré de « Lé: Leomord's name is inspired by "Léon" (lion) and "Mord" (death/murder). This could symbolize his bravery (like a lion) and tragic fate (like an undead knight).
en|Son nom fait peut-être référence à Si: His name may be a reference to Sir Mordred from Arthurian legend – Mordred was a knight who betrayed King Arthur, although Leomord's story is more about loyalty and tragedy.
en|Dans la tradition, l'épée du serment: In lore, the Sword of Oath was originally used by Duke Atticus.
en|Il est le seul héros du jeu qui peut: He is the only hero in the game who can summon a mount during battle, thus modifying his skills.
en|Le skin \"Diavel V4 Rider\" de Leomor: Leomord's "Diavel V4 Rider" skin had a bug where he was immune to the move effect, but it was later fixed.
en|Leomord présente de grandes similitud: Leomord bears strong similarities to Silent Salt Cookie from Cookie Run: Kingdom; both are tragic, brooding knight characters who had a steed as a companion, Barbiel and Nox Black Salt, which they can ride as part of their in-game skills. In the story, both have ties to the currently deceased characters and former rulers of their kingdoms, Duke Atticus of Ridgeburg and the former Faerie Cookie of the fairy kingdom, and allies with the female characters voiced by Erica Mendez, Vexana and White Lily Cookie.
en|Leomord a les HP de base les plus éle: Leomord has the highest base HP at level 1 (2908).
en|Il est le deuxième héros capable d'ef: He is the second hero capable of performing basic attacks while moving with a joystick (this can only be done by riding Barbiel on his Phantom Steed). Kimmy and Irithel are the other heroes to do so.
en|Ancêtres anonymes de la garde royale: Anonymous ancestors of the royal guard
en|Fille adoptive de la maison Vance, un: Adopted daughter of House Vance, an underground sniper.
en|Lesley a grandi dans la maison Vance,: Lesley grew up in the Vance household, where her father presided over the security of the noble family. In an unexpected attack by a rival family, Lesley's father was killed. As the attackers approached the Vance house, Lesley took her father's long black rifle and fulfilled her late father's mission. Tears streamed down Lesley's cheeks as she fired shot after shot, amazingly, each one taking out an assassin. The final tear came as the final shot felled the last of the rival family's men.
en|Lesley a été adoptée par la famille V: Lesley was adopted by the Vance family, with the patriarch of the noble house even putting their sole heir, Harley, under his guardianship. Harley was a natural troublemaker, who used her magical talents to unintentionally cause trouble at the Vance household. Only Lesley could keep Harley in check. Harley's streak of trouble was the last bit of heat in Lesley's consciousness.
en|Après avoir appris comment Harley s'é: After learning how Harley had traveled to the dangerous Land of Dawn after defeating the Dark Magic Boss, Lesley followed him, with her trusty heirloom rifle. After meeting Harley during a long, arduous journey, she discovered that the once immature young boy [had] changed through the many life experiences he had experienced. She decided it would be best if her adopted little brother trained alone, while she silently protected him from the shadows. From that day on, all monsters inflicted by Harley's magic would also be struck by a black bullet, which would impeccably pierce their hearts. Tales of the magical youth being followed by a mysterious black sniper quickly spread across the Land of Dawn like wildfire.
en|Le nom Lesley a des origines écossais: The name Lesley has Scottish origins and means "holly garden" or "holly fortress". It comes from the Scottish surname Leslie, derived from a place name in Scotland. Its name could symbolize its precision, stealth and resilience, much like a strong fortress or a sniper hiding in the shadows.
en|Contrairement aux autres tireurs d'él: Unlike other snipers, Lesley doesn't rely on attack speed, she focuses on high damage from critical hits.
en|Lesley est l'un des rares tireurs d'é: Lesley is one of the few snipers in the game that uses energy instead of mana.
en|Son passif, Lethal Shot, lui permet d: His passive, Lethal Shot, allows him to deal 100% critical damage after gaining extra energy, making him a sniper-type hero rather than a typical ADC (Attack Damage Carry).
en|La maison royale de Lesley et Harley: The Royal House of Lesley and Harley "Vance" means "Marsh, Mud, and Fen" in Old English which is used as a male first and last name primarily in American usage.
en|Citation de Lesley ; \"Ennemi à porté: Quote from Lesley; “Enemy in range, and so are you.” is a reference to Murphy's Law of Combat.
en|Lesley est le premier et, jusqu'à pré: Lesley is the first and, so far, only Marksman/Assassin hero in the game, while Yi Sun-shin, who shares the same Japanese voice actor as her in-story crush Gusion, is an Assassin/Marksman.
en|Lesley partage également son doubleur: Lesley also shares her Japanese voice actor, Takada Sakie, with fellow heroes Moniyan, Carmilla and Silvanna.
en|Dans ses premières créations, elle av: In her early designs, she had shorter hair and a more military-style outfit. The developers then gave her a long coat and a more assassin-like appearance, making her more elegant and deadly.
en|Un pinson gracieux et libre et le com: A graceful and free finch and the oriental fighter who inherited the power of the vermilion bird.

A graceful and free finch and the oriental fighter who inherited the power of the vermilion bird. Ling once belonged to the Finch Sect, a mysterious and feared order of assassins from the Riverlands of Cadia. During a mission, he almost lost his life but was saved by the Vermilion Bird; it was an encounter that would fuel his desire for freedom. In an effort to leave the Finch Sect, he undertook one final mission to infiltrate the Dragon Altar.
en|Ce n'est que lorsqu'il s'est allié à: It was only when he joined forces with Yu Zhong, the reincarnation of the Black Dragon, to break the seal of the Dragon Altar, that the spirit of the Vermilion Bird saved his life again. Only then did he see the truth and understand the meaning of freedom. In this world, the Vermilion Bird had disappeared, leaving only Ling, a young man with wings to soar freely among the clouds like the Cyan Finch.
en|=== Je suis le pinson cyan === \"À pa: === I am the Cyan Finch === "From now on, you are the Vermilion Bird. When the bird's cry echoes through the dragon altar, you will fly away."
en|Ling n'était pas comme les autres mem: Ling was not like the other members of the Finch sect: different in talent and circumstances. And he was treated differently by the elder.
en|La Finch Sect, un ordre d'assassins d: The Finch Sect, an order of assassins from the Riverlands of Cadia, takes in orphans, training and honing them to become renowned assassins. The disciples of Finch Sect are numerous, each with their own reasons to fight. Some are blindly loyal to the Finch Sect, some never had a choice, and others are driven by the quest for power... Whatever the reason, once you become a Finch of the sect, your life is your own. Not a single finch has ever left the nest.
en|Ling est devenu le prodige de la sect: Ling became the prodigy of the Finch sect at a young age. His skills had quickly surpassed those of his peers and he was known for never failing a mission. The other members often whispered, “This man is not like us. Maybe one day he will leave the Finch Sect and spread his wings.
en|\"Mais... et alors ?\" Un jeune Finch: “But… so what?” A young Finch interjected hesitantly.
en|Il a été accueilli par le silence. C': He was met with silence. That was a good question. If they left the Sect, where could they go?
en|À ce moment-là, Ling rengaina son épé: At that moment, Ling sheathed his sword and leapt away. As the wind brushed against his face, he suddenly remembered something from the past.
en|Lorsque Ling était en mission dans sa: When Ling was on a mission in his youth, he met a bird dealer. The merchant raised beautiful birds for others to enjoy. But these birds were caged from birth and never experienced the freedom that was their natural right. Even if the cage door was open, they wouldn't know where to go. At this time, a young man nearby suddenly said: “Something that is born with wings belongs to heaven. What a pity.
en|Plus tard, Ling se lia d'amitié avec: Later, Ling befriended this young man, who turned out to be a disciple of the Tianyin Swordmaster Sect named Zilong.
en|La prochaine fois qu'il rencontra Zil: The next time he met Zilong, Ling had changed his identity.
en|Ce jour-là, l'ancien de la secte Finc: That day, Sect Elder Finch summoned Ling and, behind heavy curtains, spoke only four words: “The time has come. The next day, Ling was sent on an impossible mission: to assassinate the guardian of the Dragon Altar, Baxia. Ling's sword was resolute, but Baxia was too formidable. Ling was no match for the veteran who had survived the Battle of the Twin Dragons, but he couldn't go back. On the verge of death, Ling suddenly heard birds chirping and saw a flicker of flames; a firebird appeared in front of him. His appearance even caused Baxia to take on his true form, the Mystic Turtle.
en|Cela a fonctionné. Tant que Baxia cro: It worked. As long as Baxia believed he was the Vermilion Bird, he would not kill Ling.
en|Il revit l'oiseau de feu. Dans l’obsc: He saw the firebird again. In the darkness, they looked at each other in silence. According to the elder, from Baxia and from the scriptures of the Finch sect, he knew that it was the vermilion bird. Since his childhood, whenever Ling was about to die, the bird would appear before him and protect him from disaster. Ling didn't know where it came from, because he never spoke. He only knew this dark, familiar space and this flickering flame.
en|Quand il s'est réveillé, Baxia l'a em: When he woke up, Baxia took him to see Zilong, the successor of the Cloud Dragon. Together they returned to the Dragon Altar and became brothers.
en|La vie à l'Autel du Dragon avec Baxia: Life at the Dragon Altar with Baxia and Zilong was peaceful, with most of the time spent practicing martial arts. Baxia was rarely seen, so Ling spent most of her time with Zilong. Zilong practiced his spear daily tirelessly, but whenever they practiced, Zilong rarely won. After a match, Ling couldn't help but ask Zilong why he was practicing his spear. Zilong had no answer. And in that moment, tumultuous waves surged through Ling's heart – did Zilong really have no reason...or did he never need one, because he simply followed his heart.
en|Ce sentiment... était-ce de l'envie ?: This feeling... was it envy? Resentment? Self-pity? Ling's expression remained calm as he changed the subject effortlessly.
en|La réponse n'avait plus d'importance,: The answer no longer mattered, as this game was coming to an end. That night, Ling was ordered by Sect Elder Finch to locate a forbidden seal in the back mountains of the Dragon Altar.
en|Après quelques recherches, Ling l'ava: After some searching, Ling had found it. The moment Ling touched the seal, he heard a clear and long cry; a bird of fire suddenly illuminated the darkness. When he awoke from the apparent hallucination, he saw that Baxia had caught him in the act. Without exchanging words, they began a fierce battle until Zilong arrived and put an end to their confrontation with his spear.
en|C'était la première fois que Ling éta: This was the first time Ling had witnessed the power of the Cloud Dragon; the divine power of the Four Immortals.
en|Les Quatre Immortels protègent les Ri: The Four Immortals have protected the Riverlands of Cadia since the time of the Endless War. Since then, the four have been silent and their power has been passed down among the disciples of the Great Dragon. Once a mortal becomes an Eastern Fighter, they naturally take on the responsibility of protecting the Riverlands of Cadia. Baxia repeated these principles daily during morning classes, unaware that Ling had already read and memorized them in the Finch Sect archives.
en|Ling savait ce que recherchait l'aîné: Ling knew what the elder was looking for, just like he knew what Baxia was looking for, but Ling felt they were both wrong.
en|Si un oiseau en cage ne pouvait même: If a caged bird couldn't even save itself, how could it save others?
en|Ling est retourné à la secte Finch. L: Ling returned to the Finch Sect. The elder did not ask if Ling had succeeded in his mission, nor was he surprised by Ling's return. The assassins of the Finch Sect all eventually return to their nest. But Ling returned with something lingering in his heart. A few years later, Yu Zhong and Luo Yi approached the Finch Sect to form an alliance with the Elder and attack the Dragon Altar. Ling volunteered to join us.
en|Zilong était devenu plus fort. Il ava: Zilong had become stronger. He had learned to fully control the power of the Cloud Dragon and Ling was defeated.
en|Pour la première fois, Ling ressentit: For the first time, Ling felt despair. He drew his sword again and launched attack after attack...
en|Zilong a soudainement demandé : « Man: Zilong suddenly asked: "Are you wielding your sword for your mission?"
en|\"Je brandis ma lance pour moi. Pour: "I brandish my spear for myself. For whom do you draw your blade?"
en|Ling se retrouva de nouveau dans cet: Ling found himself in this dark place again, facing the firebird from afar.
en|Lorsque le sceau de l'Autel du Dragon: When the seal of the Dragon Altar was weakened, the successors of the Cloud Dragon and the Agile Tiger had already been found, but the Vermilion Bird was seriously injured in its struggle to escape. Only part of his mind managed to escape and was resting in the forest near Shanshui City. After encountering a young Ling on the verge of death, the Vermilion Bird decided to pass on his incomplete power to him to save his life, thus sealing his own fate.
en|\"Ce n'est pas moi qui suis en cage.\: “I’m not the one in the cage.” The Vermilion Bird spoke for the first time. "With a caged heart, everywhere is a prison. With a free heart, nothing can lock you up."
en|Ce n’était pas une mission ou une sor: It wasn’t a mission or some sort of exchange. The last wish of the remaining spirit of the Vermilion Bird was that Ling could soar freely between heaven and earth, as a bird should. The seemingly heavy burden of the mission could also be handed down to the weight of a feather. Saving yourself from death and protecting the Riverlands of Cadia had the same meaning. The power granted to him by the Vermilion Bird was neither a weapon of death nor a symbol of salvation, but...
en|Ling entendit le bruit de quelque cho: Ling heard the sound of something cracking. The bird flapped its wings one last time and the darkness began to crack. A light fell on Ling, igniting the blue flames within him which burst forth like a pair of wings.
en|C'était la danse finale du Vermilion: It was the final dance of the Vermilion Bird...and the first flight of the Cyan Finch.
en|=== Histoire secrète de l'autel des d: === Secret History of the Dragon Altar ===
en|Avec d'autres membres des Oriental Fi: Along with other members of the Oriental Fighters, he is based on the Four Symbols, the Vermilion Bird of the South.
en|L'oiseau vermillon du Sud est décrit: The Southern Vermilion Bird is described as a red bird that resembles a pheasant with plumage of five colors and is perpetually covered in flames. However, her Fiery Dance skin mainly represents the accurate description of Vermillion Bird.
en|Ling est désactivé dans Brawl, car le: Ling is disabled in Brawl, as the game mode does not have a wall for Ling to climb onto.
en|L'esprit de l'oiseau vermillon: The Spirit of the Vermilion Bird
en|Membre des Eruditio Rangers et protec: Member of the Eruditio Rangers and protector of the Leviathan Workshop.

Member of the Eruditio Rangers and protector of the Leviathan Workshop. Lolita was a sweet and tenacious half-elf girl. After being rescued from the war and brought to Eruditio, she became a craftsman in the workshop. But she had an unusual ambition: to join the Eruditio Rangers and fight like those who rescued her. However, every battle proved overwhelming for her, because even though she was a good fighter, she couldn't bear to hurt anyone. During an attack on the workshop, Lolita protected Noumenon's energy core with her body and was seriously injured. It was through this incident that his courage was recognized by the Eruditio Rangers, and they decided to welcome him. Eventually, she understood that it doesn't matter if one has destructive powers, because protecting also requires courage, and gentleness itself is also strength. === How steel is forged ===
en|Êtes-vous curieux de savoir comment l: Are you curious about how steel is made?
en|\"Tout d'abord, vous aurez besoin de: "First of all, you will need raw materials and the best iron ores in the business district..."
en|Après avoir lu une seule ligne, Lolit: After reading just one line, Lolita threw it away.
en|« N'existe-t-il pas un moyen de fabri: “Isn’t there a way to make steel without using iron ore?”
en|Juste pour que vous ne vous mépreniez: Just so you don't get me wrong, Lolita wasn't trying to be unreasonable. In fact, she generally comes across as gentle and understanding. Of course, she wasn't trying to invent a new way to make steel, but rather a way to "strengthen" herself. She was always looking for ways to make herself as powerful, fearsome and indestructible as steel...
en|Parce qu'elle serait alors capable de: Because then she would be able to protect everyone.
en|Lolita était une demi-elfe : à l'exce: Lolita was a half-elf: except for her pointy ears, she was literally no different from an ordinary human. She was born in a village that was later destroyed by war and that devastating night. she was the only survivor. When she finally regained consciousness, the City of Scholars – Eruditio welcomed her with warmth, passion and freedom that protected her like a beast of steel for the rest of her life.
en|Plus tard, l'Atelier Léviathan l'a ac: Later, the Leviathan Workshop welcomed her. This is the applied technology center of Eruditio, where the dreams of all scholars have come true. If the Arrow of Knowledge was the brains of the city. so the workshop was the heart. providing the blood of technology to the entire city. Even though the sophisticated concepts and small jobs of the craftsmen had little to do with Lolita, she occupied herself as much as she could every day, and even when the tasks were boring and insignificant, she always gave her best.
en|De temps en temps, elle regardait ave: From time to time, she looked with fascination at Noumenon's flaming red energy core, the precious Starlium reactor, which was also the workshop's power source. This wasn't just any ordinary workshop furnace, as it also served as Eruditio's power generator. And as long as it remained burning, Eruditio would never stop moving forward.
en|Lolita vivait dans l'atelier et la ch: Lolita lived in the workshop and the heat of the fire had always accompanied her in her sleep. Every time she remembered the night the war broke out, the souls of the dead always let out a painful wail that haunted her. And every time it happened. a tall, inscrutable figure of steel would always stand before her, leading her to the warmth of Eruditio.
en|Même si Lolita ne se souvenait pas de: Although Lolita didn't remember his face, she clearly remembered that he had an unknown mark on his back that looked like a tree. So, Lolita concluded that it must be a tree that grew in the desert and that this tree served as hope for a future oasis.
en|Mais quand elle apprit que c'était le: But when she learned that it was the symbol of the Eruditio Rangers. Lolita decided to join them and protect the city like they did.
en|Elle a donc dû s'entraîner, et il lui: So she had to train, and it took her exactly 49 tries to finally accept the cruel reality that she wasn't good at fighting. Her gentleness proved a disadvantage on the battlefield, she was not able to maneuver freely and repel merciless and destructive attacks, and even the shield magic of her elven blood did not make her a more intimidating opponent.
en|Elle regarda ses petits bras minces q: She looked at her thin little arms that couldn't even lift the slightly larger hammer, it was her – a 'piece of low-grade ore that probably didn't contain any iron'. She sighed deeply, disappointed in herself for having no talents.
en|Elle pensait que comme elle n'avait p: She thought that since she didn't have the talent, she would make up for it with time, but destiny never waits for anyone.
en|Tard dans la nuit, Lolita a été révei: Late at night, Lolita was awakened by an explosion and saw the workshop catching fire. An unidentified enemy had launched a surprise attack. Heavy gunfire erupted everywhere, even though all defense mechanisms were activated. they failed to repel the enemy invasion. The Guardian Artisans covered Lolita and retreated to the core, the last line of defense. If the Noumenon Energy Core is damaged. the consequences would be unthinkable.
en|Soudain, Lolita vit son passé défiler: Suddenly, Lolita saw her past flash before her eyes. It was as if she was back in the war-lit village of her childhood. The same moans of pain, the same helpless eyes and the same weakness that needed protection. Grief. guilt. cowardice, anger... a mix of emotions arose, but his body froze.
en|Effectivement, un « minerai à faible: Indeed, a “low-grade ore” like this will never become “steel”...
en|Elle devint déterminée et regarda le: She became determined and looked at the still blazing core.
en|« N'y a-t-il vraiment aucun moyen de: “Is there really no way to make steel without iron ores?
en|\"C'est vrai. L'élément fer peut être: "That's right. The element iron can be found everywhere in nature, but is only revealed in extreme heat... Can you stand it?"
en|Sans un mot. son corps a commencé à b: Without a word. his body started to move. Everything around her remained still: the sound of gunshots, explosions and screams faded, and there was only one target in her eyes: Noumenon's energy core. No matter the cost, she will protect this land...
en|Soudain, une lumière aveuglante jaill: Suddenly, a blinding light burst into the sky. and they were the flames of life.
en|Après un temps indéterminé, Lolita eu: After an indeterminate time, Lolita had difficulty opening her eyes, and there stood before her this tree, the tall silhouette.
en|\"Vous avez touché le noyau à mains n: “You touched the core with your bare hands and it’s a miracle you’re still alive.” » said the man with admiration.
en|\"L'énergie déferlante du noyau a pén: "The surging core energy penetrated your body and miraculously activated the shield magic in your blood that protected the workshop..."
en|\"Vous nous avez sauvés et vous mérit: "You saved us and you deserve to be recognized for your courage. As captain, I now welcome you to the Eruditio Rangers."
en|\"Mais je suis faible et je ne sais p: "But I am weak and I don't know how to fight..."
"Fighting isn't the only way...because protecting is just as important and we need you." After saying this, he turned around and walked out the door.
en|Il a souri et a dit : « Eruditio est: He smiled and said, “Eruditio is a place where miracles happen. »
en|Grâce à la technologie d'Eruditio, Lo: Thanks to Eruditio's technology, Lolita received a mechanical glove with great powers. The workshop even made him a hammer from a fragment of Noumenon's energy core, a symbol of the workshop's will and affirmation of his courage. Since the core had been integrated with elven magic during the invasion, she could now use it effortlessly.
en|Avec le courage d'utiliser son corps: With the courage to use her body as a shield, Lolita became a member of the Eruditio Rangers. Even though she was the youngest, she took good care of everyone, and whenever danger arose, she always rushed to the front.
en|Alors, êtes-vous toujours curieux de: So, are you still curious about how steel is made? It's not important anymore. Because his courage and gentleness became stronger than steel, protecting the city forever. === Outlaw ===
en|Lolita est un nom anglophone définiss: Lolita is an English name defining a young girl.
en|Elle est la première femme Tank intro: She is the first female Tank introduced in the game.
en|Son emote est toujours basée sur un a: His emote is still based on an old model. His old entrance animation is reused for his Special Op skin.
en|Les phrases de Lolita \"Je te protége: Lolita's phrases "I will protect you", "Don't worry my friend, I am your shield" are a direct reference to Rienhardt from Overwatch.
en|Le Bouclier de réflexion du Gardien d: Lolita's Guardian's Reflection Shield (second skill) was the first MLBB ability to completely block ranged attacks, including basic attacks and certain skills.
en|Avant la refonte, son bouclier vient: Before the rework, his shield comes from the hammer, but now his shield comes from his gauntlets.
en|Son ancienne comédienne de doublage,: His former voice actress, Cristina Vee, also voices name=Kagura (formerly) and the game's announcer (see also the voice actors page here). She is also known for voicing Marinette (English) [see in Miraculous Ladybug Wiki or Wikipedia page] (Miraculous Ladybug), Killua Zoldyck (キルア゠ゾルディック - Kirua Zorudikku) - dubbed in English (Hunter X Hunter [see in Hunterpedia or Wikipedia page]) and Riven (League of Legends (LoL) [see in League of Wiki Legends or Wikipedia page]).
en|Dans le patch 1.4.94, les rôles princ: In patch 1.4.94, Lolita's primary and secondary roles were changed to Support/Tank.
