en|Une bête sacrée légendaire qui peut p: A legendary sacred beast that can take the form of a turbulent young man.

A legendary sacred beast that can take the form of a rambunctious young man, Lukas, is recently reanimated inside the Imperial Sanctuary. Blessed with a special bloodline that allows him to take human form, he once befriended Emperor Gaius and fought alongside him to create the glorious Moniyan Empire. After a thousand-year sleep, he was awakened by Silvanna and swore to announce a new era for the Empire at her side. Beneath his brash and boisterous appearance lies a pure and serious heart. For Lukas, fighting is not only his duty but the instinctive expression of his spirit. He firmly believes that he will create something as bright as the rising sun to illuminate every corner of the Moniyan Empire and rewrite the legend of the Beast of Light. ===The rising sun===
en|Au cœur du sanctuaire impérial se tro: At the heart of the Imperial Shrine is a statue that has stood for a thousand years, symbolizing the past glories of the Moniyan Empire. But it has long been neglected and almost unrecognizable today.
en|Sous la statue se trouve une tablette: Beneath the statue is a stone tablet recounting the history of the empire. As a historian sweeps away the dust, an age-old legend is revealed:
en|\"Après la guerre sans fin, une ancie: "After the Endless War, an ancient beast with a unique bloodline yearned to prove himself against the world. At the same time, a fiery young man vowed to establish a glorious nation where all war-torn people could live."
en|La bête et le jeune homme étaient des: The beast and the young man were destined to meet, and that is what they did, in a titanic confrontation that lasted three days and three nights. In the end, although no winner could be decided, their unwavering spirit melted the divide.
en|L'homme posa sa lance et tendit la ma: The man put down his spear and stretched out his hand towards the beast. It was his hope to fight alongside the beast and leave their mark on the world together. The beast would never have imagined that a human would be brazen enough to offer friendship, but as the young man held out his hand, the beast felt a strange sensation as its three tails began to wag.
en|Et ainsi, les deux se sont lancés dan: And so, the two set out on their long journey, crossing the blood-curdling frozen sea, the sand-swept barren lands of Agelta, and the peaceful moonlit forest...struggling for unification amidst the chaos. They faced countless adversaries and obstacles, but their trials of combat had forged an unbreakable bond between them. Together they were invincible. Eventually, the young man and the beast founded the Moniyan Empire. This new nation has become the new sun in the Land of Dawn; a beacon of eternal glory that attracted war-weary people from all corners of the world. The young man was now revered as Emperor Gaius, and his most faithful companion became a sacred beast. He would be known as Lukas, the Beast of Light, in the hearts of all Moniyans.
en|Lors de la première cérémonie d'adoub: During the empire's first knighting ceremony, Gaius infused the light of his lineage into Lukas's horns, causing them to glow a brilliant gold. From then on, wherever Lukas went, the radiance of the sun followed him.
en|Mais après le décès de Gaius, l'empir: But after the death of Gaius, the empire fell into disarray, the faith of the citizens wavered and the Beast of Light lost his mind...
en|\"Quoi ?! Que veux-tu dire par « perd: "What?! What do you mean 'lost your mind'?!"
en|Un jeune homme apparut soudain à côté: A young man suddenly appeared next to the historian, casually waving his emblematic weapons: two tonfa hammers. “Why was the Beast of Light here in his human form,” the historian wondered. As the subject of this story, Lukas had a vested interest in the tablet's inscription.
en|\"Pour raconter la glorieuse histoire: "To tell the glorious story of the Beast of Light, we need a personal touch..."
en|Lukas a pris la plume des mains de l': Lukas took the pen from the historian, only to realize that he had never learned to write.
en|\"... À la réflexion, c'est votre tra: "...On second thought, it's your job. Just write down what I say!"
en|Lukas s'assit nonchalamment sur la ta: Lukas sat casually on the stone tablet while the historian diligently recorded his words:
en|\"Même les mortels les plus puissants: "Even the most powerful mortals cannot escape the inevitable. After Gaius passed away, the Beast of Light fell into deep grief for a very long time... but he never forgot his promise. He locked himself and Gaius's sacred spear in the Imperial Sanctuary, hoping that one day, a descendant of Gaius would awaken him to fight again for the glory of the empire. So Lukas waited and waited, and just like that, a thousand years had passed...
en|Puis un jour, une jeune princesse fit: Then one day, a young princess burst into the Sanctuary. As a member of Gaius' bloodline, Silvanna was capable of drawing the sacred spear. But what was truly surprising was that, without fear or hesitation, she invited the intimidating Beast of Light to join her in repelling the invading legions of the Abyss. But Lukas could never recognize a human so easily!
en|Une autre bataille titanesque s’ensui: Another titanic battle ensued, just like a thousand years ago. Silvanna faced the beast's powerful attacks and did not take a single step back. She carried the glory of Lumina City on her shoulders and swore to protect it and all the citizens in her care.
en|La Bête de Lumière regarda dans les y: The Beast of Light looked into Silvanna's blue eyes, full of hope and determination, and remembered young Gaius. At that moment, the flame within him that had been cooling for a thousand years was ignited again. He stopped his attack and chose to stand alongside the princess! And so, they returned to Lumina City together. As a sacred beast of a new era, Lukas was striving to make up for everything he had missed. In order to raise funds for people who had lost everything due to the war, he organized a network in the streets and took on all challengers; to dispel the ghosts of the empire's past, he bravely braved a haunted house; To protect bullied children, he personally led an uprising in their imaginary war. Oh, and did I mention he won the eating competition 3 years in a row? Truly his greatest pride.
en|Même si les citoyens de Lumina City t: Even if the citizens of Lumina City found these feats too childish and unsuitable for the prestige of a Sacred Beast, Lukas didn't care! He did things his way and gave his all, whether it was playing with the children or defending the empire alongside Silvanna. Its roar would echo across the sky of Lumina City like a thousand years ago—
en|Ensemble, nous créerons quelque chose: Together we will create something glorious! »
en|La plume de l'historien de la cour s': The court historian's pen eventually broke as he could barely follow the story. He let out a long sigh, only to be interrupted by a tug on his collar.
en|\"Hé, dans la partie sur Silvanna, aj: "Hey, in the part about Silvanna, add some adjectives like beautiful and inspiring. I don't want to be grounded again..."
en|\"Oh... et trouve-moi quelque chose p: “Oh...and find me something to clean this thing with.”
en|La statue, qui était là depuis mille: The statue, which had been there for a thousand years, was finally able to reveal its original appearance...
en|Devant l’emblème du soleil et de l’ép: In front of the sun and sword emblem was a beast with golden horns, head held high, guarding Lumina City with utmost vigilance.
en|Le nom Lukas est d'origine grecque et: The name Lukas is of Greek and Latin origin, derived from the Greek name Loukas (Λουκᾶς), meaning "from Lucania", a region in southern Italy. It is also associated with the Latin name Lucas, meaning "light" or "light-bearer."
en|Les motifs et la forme de la bête de: The designs and shape of Lukas' beast are likely influenced by the Pixiu (貔貅, píxiū), a beast in Chinese folklore described as "having wings, the head of a dragon, and the body of a lion".
en|Bien que cela n’ait pas été officiell: Although it hasn't been officially confirmed, Lukas is said to be one of the heroes created through an upcoming anime collaboration skin. Other heroes involved are members of Forsaken Light – Yin, Melissa, Xavier and Julian – for the Jujutsu Kaisen collaboration, as well as Suyou and Kalea for the Naruto Team 7 collaboration event.
en|Transformez-vous en bête sacrée: Transform yourself into a sacred beast
en|Une créature miraculeuse née dans Twi: A miraculous creature born in Twilight Orb.
en|Créatures miraculeuses nées dans Twil: Miraculous Creatures Born in Twilight Orb Lunox was born with magical powers, and her dream world reflects and changes the real world. With this power, she uses her dream world to temporarily maintain the energetic balance between order and chaos. But as the power of order and the power of chaos rushed into his dreams, Lunox fell into a long sleep and transformed into one of the "Twilight Orbs". === Bio === As the final battle began, the Orb of Twilight devoured the Mage's energies and opened, from which emerged a girl surrounded by the power of Chaos and Order. His eyes are as deep as the ancient lake.
en|L’atmosphère mystérieuse qu’elle a cr: The mysterious atmosphere it created then plunged all the heroes into the land of dreams... The powers of Chaos and Order have been fighting against each other since ancient times, and this struggle has plunged the world into despair. Lunox, the mysterious young girl, is the one who survived despair. Thanks to her unique talent, she can project her dream into reality and change it.
en|Un jour, un son lui murmura et lui di: One day, a sound whispered to him and told him to balance the two powers with his dreamland ability. But the price to pay would be hunger more than ever. For the world she loves, she accepted this fate, channeled both powers into dreamland, and became one of the Twilight Orbs, at the cost of falling into an endless sleep. But the sound also told Lunox that one day she would awaken to pursue her destiny: to find more Twilight Orbs forgotten by history === Twilight Origins ===
en|Le nom de Lunox est un portemanteau d: The name Lunox is a portmanteau of two Latin words lumos and nox, respectively “light” and “dark” in English.
en|Lunox est actuellement l'être le plus: Lunox is currently the most powerful being (aside from the One God) in the MLBB universe.
en|Lunox est le seul héros de l'univers: Lunox is the only hero in the MLBB universe to ever encounter the One God and witness the true form of the Astral Realm.
en|Lunox Skill 3 (Cosmic Fission) inflig: Lunox Skill 3 (Cosmic Fission) officially dealt damage in a fan-shaped area.
en|Lorsque le passif de Lunox impliquait: When Lunox's passive still involved CDR, she was the only hero in the game capable of reaching up to 100% magic penetration. Even currently, she is still the hero with the real potential who can exceed over 70% magic penetration with enough penetration emblems and equipment and Vemp spells.
en|Son ancien titre de héros s'appelle \: His ancient hero title is called "The Enlightened One", in reference to the name of Buddha.
en|Elle est la principale protagoniste d: She is the main protagonist of the Determination event with Belerick.
en|Le concept Lumière et Ténèbres de Lun: Lunox's Light and Dark concept was reused for Luo Yi.
en|Son skin complémentaire \"Bloody Mary: Her companion skin "Bloody Mary" refers to Mary I of England, so called due to the execution of numerous Protestants during her 6-year reign. It is also the name of a popular drink.
en|Les pouvoirs lumineux de Lunox vienne: Lunox's light powers come from his mother and his dark powers come from his father.
en|Lunox est le don unique de Dieu au mo: Lunox is God's unique gift to the world (Land of Dawn).
en|Lunox est le deuxième niveau le plus: Lunox is the second hardest level to use (the first being Fanny) and the first hardest Mage hero.
en|Cherchant à faire revivre un passé an: Seeking to revive an ancient past, she is the only one to master the secrets of Yin and Yang.

Seeking to revive an ancient past, she is the only one to master the secrets of Yin and Yang. Luo Yi was the only person in all of the Riverlands of Cadia who truly understood the concept of Yin and Yang.
en|Harmoniser le Yin et le Yang n'était: Harmonizing Yin and Yang was not only his talent but also his worldview. She became the successor to the Great Witch of Zhu'an when she was just a child after accidentally following a spirit to the Cliff of Infinite Lights. There, she witnessed a vision of a utopia in the ancient past, when the Ancients lived among the pure energies of Yin and Yang. It was then that she discovered her true identity as a descendant of the ancient Cajuns.
en|Désormais fidèle stratège de Yu Zhong: Now Yu Zhong's loyal strategist, Luo Yi took his ambitions and meticulously implemented them. However, hidden beneath her veil is her own worldview.
en|===Yin et Yang=== Qu'est-ce que le Yi: ===Yin and Yang=== What is Yin and what is Yang?
en|La première fois que Luo Yi a posé ce: The first time Luo Yi asked the Great Witch this question, she sighed deeply and gently patted Luo Yi's head.
en|\"Les terres fluviales de Cadia sont: "The river lands of Cadia are born from Yin and Yang. And Zhu'an is the place where Yin energy is most concentrated, so it has become our eternal duty to safeguard this city."
en|Le jeune Luo Yi était perplexe : « Co: Young Luo Yi was puzzled: “How can we watch over Yin without knowing Yang?
en|La main de la Grande Sorcière s’arrêt: The Great Witch's hand stopped abruptly, clenched it tightly, and released it shakily. "It seems...you are different from others after all..."
en|D'aussi loin qu'elle se souvienne, el: For as long as she can remember, she was the sole successor to the Great Witch of Zhu'an.
en|Orpheline née avec une vision, elle n: An orphan born with a vision, she had no friends. She was accompanied only by a sea of ​​books and endless training from her master. Even though she was a young genius, her mysterious past always made people tired of her presence.
en|Cependant, rien de tout cela n'avait: However, none of this mattered to Luo Yi as she was only interested in one thing.
en|Qu’est-ce que le Yin et qu’est-ce que: What is Yin and what is Yang?
en|Les habitants des terres riveraines d: The people of the waterlands of Cadia know that Yin and Yang are part of the endless cycle of life. However, Luo Yi knew the true answer and it had always haunted Luo Yi... until one day she wandered towards the Cliff of Infinite Lights.
en|Luo Yi a été témoin d'une rivière d'â: Luo Yi witnessed a river of souls, a harmonious blend of white and black, emerging from the cave and circling around it.
en|Les âmes commencèrent à prendre de la: The souls began to pick up speed as they merged into a bright, dazzling light. At the same time, a cacophony of voices rang in Luo Yi's ears: “The Ancients enlightened Yin and Yang to create life and shape the Riverlands of Cadia.
en|Alors que la lumière diminuait, une s: As the light faded, a scene appeared before Luo Yi's eyes.
en|Des gens vêtus de vêtements simples é: People dressed in simple clothes sat around a man and a woman who exuded a celestial aura. Luo Yi instantly remembered the paintings of the Ancients she had seen in the ancient manuscripts, especially the couple Fu Yang and Su Yin, two of the Four Immortals and the ancestors of the Riverlands of Cadia.
en|Luo Yi sentit le pouvoir du Yin et du: Luo Yi felt the power of Yin and Yang surging within her, pushing her towards the group of people.
en|\"Qu'est-ce qui t'a pris si longtemps: "What took you so long? Did you have fun?" » One of the women asked, noticing Luo Yi and motioning for him to come sit next to her. The others had no noticeable reaction, as if he belonged here. All their attention was on Fu Yang and Su Yin in the center.
en|Fu Yang écarta les doigts et un symbo: Fu Yang spread his fingers and a golden Yang symbol floated above his palm; Next to him, Su Yin slowly beckoned with her index finger as a dark purple Yin symbol merged onto her fingertips.
en|Les deux joignirent lentement les mai: The two slowly joined hands as the Yang and Yin symbols seemed naturally drawn to each other. The two symbols soon began to spin around each other like a vortex.
en|Le vortex noir et blanc a libéré une: The black and white vortex released a huge amount of energy, once again flooding Luo Yi's vision with blinding light.
en|\"On craignait que l'arrivée soudaine: "It was feared that the sudden arrival of the Twin Gods would cause a great cataclysm in the world." Voices rose again as the broken pieces of the past gradually fell into place in front of Luo Yi. "Fu Yang and Su Yin led the Four Immortals and all the people of the land to the Heavenly Palace to fight the Twin Gods of Light and Darkness..."
en|La grande bataille a secoué le monde: The great battle shook the world and continued for endless days and nights. Ultimately, it was only through their self-sacrifice that Fu Yang and Su Yin managed to deal a significant blow to the twin gods. Upon their death, the Four Immortals swore to protect the Riverlands of Cadia forever, reincarnating as Eastern Fighters to watch over each generation. However, this did not end the conflicts. Even with the arrival of the dragons, the threat of the Twin Gods remained.
en|\"Dans la bataille décisive contre le: "In the decisive battle against the Twin Gods, the Black Dragon and the White Dragon created a massive explosion which created the Yin Yang Eye which still exists to this day..."
en|L'explosion persista dans les yeux de: The explosion lingered in Luo Yi's eyes as she felt heartbreaking pain. This land was once a true utopia where Yin and Yang existed in perfect harmony. After everything that had happened, the Cadia Riverlands was nothing more than a poor imitation.
en|Elle avait recherché la vérité sur le: She had sought the truth about Yin and Yang and inadvertently witnessed its dissolution with her own eyes. Additionally, she was a direct descendant of the Ancients.
en|Luo Yi a laissé les dernières traces: Luo Yi left the last traces of herself with her tears in Zhu'an. With the blood of the Ancients flowing through her body, she was able to quickly master the secrets of harmonizing Yin and Yang simply from her observations in her vision. She bid farewell to the Great Witch, left Zhu'an, and traveled alone through the Riverlands of Cadia for the sake of her new purpose.
en|Mais ce n’est qu’après avoir rencontr: But it was only after meeting Yu Zhong, the reincarnation of the Black Dragon, that his vision of restoring Yin and Yang came to fruition.
en|Debout devant le digne Baxia et les a: Standing in front of the dignified Baxia and the other current oriental fighters, Luo Yi remained calm and collected.
en|\"Dans les temps anciens, la dualité: "In ancient times, the duality of Yin and Yang gave birth to the Four Immortals and all living beings. Today, I will show you the true Yin and Yang."
en|Elle souleva lentement le hossu dans: She slowly lifted the hossu in her hand and a swirl of black and white energy surfaced around her.
en|Premier coup : donner naissance au ro: First move: giving birth to the fiery kingdom of Yang. Second move: giving birth to the frozen realm of Yin. Third move: gather the power of Yin and Yang.
en|Baxia, Zilong et Ling se sont soudain: Baxia, Zilong and Ling suddenly found themselves trapped in a circle of enchantment. They could only watch as the Black Dragon's power burst out from its thousand-year seal before enveloping Luo Yi and Yu Zhong and disappearing.
en|Maintenant que Yu Zhong avait acquis: Now that Yu Zhong had acquired the full power of the Black Dragon, he was one step closer to his ambitions of conquering the Riverlands of Cadia.
en|À cette fin, Luo Yi a proclamé : « Si: To this end, Luo Yi proclaimed: “If this is your will, then it is my duty to carry it out. »
en|Et elle a dit la vérité sans paroles: And she spoke the truth without empty words, and yet...
en|L’équilibre du Yin et du Yang n’avait: The balance of Yin and Yang had not yet been achieved in the Riverlands of Cadia. And just as Yu Zhong needed Luo Yi to harmonize Yin and Yang, Luo Yi needed Yu Zhong's power to unify the Riverlands of Cadia.
en|Mais les propres ambitions de Luo Yi: But Luo Yi's own ambitions extended beyond all that: to the utopia created by Fu Yang and Su Yin. A world far beyond what the Twin Dragons can recreate; a world far beyond what the Four Immortals can protect. Thus, with her own hands, she will restore Yin and Yang to their original form and usher this world into true and eternal peace. ===Eastern fighters gather===
en|===L'éveil du dragon noir féroce Yu Z: ===Awakening of the Fierce Black Dragon Yu Zhong===
en|===Secrets du nouveau héros - Luo Yi=: ===Secrets of the new hero - Luo Yi===
en|Luo (罗 / 羅) peut signifier « filet »,: Luo (罗/羅) can mean "net", "gather" or "silk", symbolizing connection, destiny or entrapment. Yi (依) means "rely on", "harmony" or "grace", signifying balance and stability. One who unites and balances, this fits with her yin-yang theme, where she manipulates opposing forces to maintain harmony.
en|Luo Yi est basé sur un véritable pers: Luo Yi is based on a real historical male figure from the Tang Dynasty.
en|Son titre Géomancien, quelqu'un qui p: His title Geomancer, someone who practices geomancy which translates to Earth Divination.
en|Ses capacités s'inspirent de la philo: His abilities are inspired by the Taoist philosophy Yin-Yang, which represents balance in the universe.
en|Dans la version initiale sur le serve: In the initial version on the advanced server, her name was Yi and she has four skills instead of three.
en|Elle est le premier héros capable de: She is the first hero capable of teleporting her teammates. Luo Yi's Ultimate (Diversion) allows him to teleport his teammates to a different location, making it one of the most revolutionary mobility skills in MLBB.
en|Luo Yi a été le premier héros sorti d: Luo Yi was the first hero released in the "Oriental Fighters" revamp that introduced oriental-themed lore to MLBB.
en|Elle est le troisième héros à utilise: She is the third hero to use the concept of Yin and Yang along with Kagura and Lunox.
en|Baxia, Ling, Wanwan, Zilong Oriental: Baxia, Ling, Wanwan, Zilong Oriental Fighters (enemies)
en|Crée un sceau entre le Yin et le Yang: Creates a seal between Yin and Yang
en|Une petite sorcière drôle et pleine d: A funny and witty little witch.
en|Il y a des centaines d'années, lorsqu: Hundreds of years ago, when Magic reigned in the Land of Dawn, the Dark Mages were important precursors to the creation of the Magic Academy. However, there had always been a big gap between them and White Magic. They had completely different opinions on magical ideas.
en|Le cœur de toutes ces disputes était: The heart of all these disputes was that Dark Magic possessed a mysterious power known as Alien Space Summoning. This magic could create a portal to unknown worlds, bringing alien monsters to the Land of Dawn. It was destructive and unpredictable, and also a great threat to the human world. The White Mages had always opposed Summoning experiments. However, the dark mages turned a deaf ear. Eventually, this dangerous magic went awry during a summoning, causing a disturbance at the Magic Academy. The incident ended with the death of a high-ranking white magician.
en|Cela a déclenché un fort ressentiment: This sparked strong resentment from the white magicians and after the Senate's decision, the black magicians took full responsibility. They were permanently banished to the west of the Land. This decision also led to the end of black magic. The esoteric Alien Space Summoning was also permanently banned and the Magic Academy was under the control of White Magic.
en|Même après la fin de cet incident, qu: Even after this incident, which people called the Rift War, ended, a crisis remained, hidden deep within the Land of Dawn. The remaining Void Monsters appeared everywhere and they continued to look for food to live on, especially Magical Powers and this time, they got closer to the Magic Academy.
en|À cette époque, il y avait une jeune: At that time, there was a young girl named Lylia, who was one of the most gifted and best students at the Magic Academy, and who also happened to be the naughtiest girl. She also believed in dark magic and was the sole successor of Alien Space Summoning. She always used her powerful but dark magic to prove that she was right. She bought horrors rather than surprises for everyone, most of the time. Naturally, she was misunderstood by others, mainly because of her unusual characteristics and also, since she was a dark wizard and the Magic Academy's favorite magical genius, the idol of the apprentices. This also explains why Lylia was hated and isolated by all her friends, why she was exiled with other dark magicians and also why everyone called Lylia the "Little Witch". Overnight, she lost everything and became lonely.
en|Récemment, cependant, il y avait eu d: Recently, however, there had been signs of Void Monsters in the Magic Academy. Magicians and teachers did their best to catch or at least stop these strange creatures. Lylia had managed to capture one of the most special creatures among these creatures. She not only felt his power, but also discovered how cute he was. The Void Monsters were fond of Dark Magic. After all, it was through the invocation of powerful dark magic that they were created.
en|Lylia a donné à son nouvel animal de: Lylia gave her new pet a name: Gloom. She considered him her friend, probably the only friend Lylia ever had, and wanted to introduce him to everyone at the Magic Academy. But no one believed that Lylia could have tamed such a menacing creature single-handedly. They began to question and even taunt Lylia. Gloom sensed that his master was being provoked and began attacking the Academy's magicians. Some magicians were shocked to see Gloom's power, which was actually far greater than that of most Void monsters. They thought it was one of Lylia's plans, to destroy the Magic Academy. They decided to capture Lylia by force and also eliminate Gloom.
en|Peu importe ce que faisait Lylia, ell: No matter what Lylia did, she couldn't stop these magicians from attacking Gloom. Other magicians gathered to fight Lylia, as she tried to protect Gloom, which made Gloom very angry. With the help of Lylia's dark magic, he summoned a portal to the outside world and summoned many other Void monsters to fight alongside him. Everything spiraled out of control when the Void Monsters began destroying the Magic Academy. A fierce battle ensued and many of these magicians were seriously injured. As a mentor and teacher, Eudora summoned her lightning powers and tried her best to resist these Void monsters, but nothing happened. She and the other magic teachers at the academy were surprised to see how these monsters had become so vicious.
en|Lylia, cependant, appréciait l'ambian: Lylia, however, was enjoying the ambiance, as she felt she was having an exciting and fun time, commanding the void monsters and directing everything as if she were in charge. It was at that moment that Eudora realized that this was the powerful, ancient alien space summoning magic and that there was much more crisis to face. She warned the other teachers of this invasion and, with the remaining magicians, tried to repel the monsters. However, the monsters regrouped, as a huge wave of new monsters appeared from the rift and launched an attack on Eudora. Even though Lylia wanted everyone to suffer for distrusting and mistreating her, she realized that what she was doing was absolutely wrong. As the monsters charged to devour Eudora and the rest of the Magic Academy, Lylia hastily dove in front of Eudora and used her dark power to seal these monsters into Gloom. Lylia managed to save Eudora's life. Since then, Eudora has discovered that despite Lylia's indifference, she is much more courageous and powerful in magic. She also knew that Lylia's understanding of dark magic was superior to that of others, and realized that good and evil were determined by those who wielded the magic, not the nature of the magic itself.
en|Le nom Lylia est une variante de Lili: The name Lylia is a variation of Lilia or Lilia, derived from the Latin word lilium, meaning "lily", a flower symbolizing purity, beauty and renewal. In Arabic, it is related to Layla, which means "night" or "dark beauty". In Hebrew, it can be associated with Lilah, meaning “night” or “sweet beauty.”
en|Son animal de compagnie Gloom apparti: His pet Gloom belongs to the Snores species, a type of void monster that likes to devour magic.
en|Gloom ressemble à Tharz de Magic Ches: Gloom resembles Tharz from Magic Chess.
en|Dans sa tradition, Lylia fait toujour: In her tradition, Lylia is still part of the Magic Academy and is one of the best students there; but according to her code of mastery, she was expelled from the Academy along with her family.
en|Elle s'inspire probablement d'une cha: She is probably inspired by an American pop singer, Melanie Martinez.
en|Elle avait une couleur de cheveux fen: She had a split hair color, which is one of Melanie Martinez's signature hairstyles.
en|L'une de ses voix mentionnait \"Cry B: One of his voices mentioned "Cry Baby", which is an album and a character from Melanie Martinez's storyline.
en|Sa peau par défaut ressemble à la ten: Her default skin resembles Melanie's dollhouse outfit.
en|Ses chaussures noires (Ultime) sont l: His black shoes (Ultimate) are one of the most unique skills in MLBB, allowing him to "go back in time".
en|Originaire de la Maison Paxley, c'est: Hailing from House Paxley, he is an elegant, mysterious and bizarre artist whose divided soul has merged with his camera.
en|Marcel Paxley, le talent élégant mais: Marcel Paxley, the elegant but mysterious talent of Castle Aberleen.
en|Lui-même est une double exposition ma: Itself is a masterfully composed double exhibition: the first exhibition captured the refined character of the Paxley household: Marcel, the boy; the second exhibition captured a torn soul, fragmented by black magic: Clemar, his camera. Since then, they have looked at the world through two viewfinders.
en|L’un conserve un vernis d’élégance im: One retains a veneer of impeccable elegance; the other carefully documents reality. Together, they believe that pain is the best chemical for development, while imperfection defines true depth of field. Yet a finished work always presents itself as its own individual “self”.
en|\"Dans tout le cercle artistique de M: "In the entire Moniyan art circle, if you ask which name is the most searched for today, the answer is undoubtedly: Marcel! This art world darling has talent and a mysterious past! Our journalists dug deep and finally found the face behind the lens!"
en|Sur le comptoir du café, une caméra d: On the cafe counter, a dark magic camera quivered wildly, its lens focused on the newspaper below – the front page of Lumina City Entertainment Weekly.
en|En effet, la vérité se cache derrière: Indeed, the truth is hidden behind the lens.
en|\"Le plus grand photographe de ce siè: "The greatest photographer of this century, from the illustrious house of Paxley, possesses superb talent and enviable favor..."
en|Marcel est né dans les couloirs sombr: Marcel was born in the dark corridors of the House Paxley estate. He inherited his father's powerful dark magic, as well as his infamy: after a series of infighting within the family, his father committed suicide to escape judgment, and Marcel was labeled "the son of a traitor". The latter had tainted Marcel's childhood, as his peers used violence to "discipline" him, to turn him into a skilled person named Paxley, but Marcel always smiled kindly and stood up straight. He believed he was worthy of the name, not because of the pain he endured, but because of the deep love that guided him through it: his mother.
en|La mère de Marcel était issue d'une b: Marcel's mother came from a distant branch of the Paxley family, chained to House Paxley by marriage, but with a soul yearning for freedom. His mother loved embroidery and photography, and on one of her birthdays she gave Marcel a camera, teaching him how to frame and freeze moments, then take those photos and turn them into memories on film.
en|Mère était tout pour Marcel, mais ell: Mother was everything to Marcel, but she didn't reciprocate. After receiving a “discipline” that almost killed him, Marcel returned home covered in wounds, only to find the silhouette of his mother walking away. After his father's suicide, Marcel's mother had endured all sorts of exclusions and pressures, ultimately securing a chance to escape House Paxley. However, the family forced her to leave behind her magically gifted son... In the end, she was the only one to escape.
en|Les départs à la Maison Paxley sont t: Departures from the Paxley House are always silent. With eyes blurred with tears, Marcel watched her leave, and she never looked back.
en|\"...Et son objectif de capture d'âme: "...And his goal of soul capture comes from his gift of dark magic. Naturally, Marcel became Duke Aamon's right-hand man. It's undoubtedly a perfect 'hand and glove' story!"
en|Après le départ de la mère de Marcel,: After Marcel's mother left, the "discipline" intensified, but he no longer wanted to resist, letting himself be tormented and mocked like pouring rain. That is, until a moment near death, when consciousness was fading, Marcel glanced at the camera on the wall.
en|Sa mère ne l'avait pas pris. Il l'ava: His mother didn't take it. He had watched him – watched his struggle, his madness, his pain beneath the surface –
en|Marcel se sentit se détacher et entre: Marcel felt himself break away and step into his lens, watching coldly as the little boy named Marcel Paxley stood up elegantly with a bloodied face. This objective perspective was clear and indifferent; all pain had been sealed away by the lens. When his consciousness returned to his body, his hand was already holding the camera next to him! The camera screamed and dark magic poured out, freezing everything around him.
en|Les pouvoirs de Marcel s'étaient plei: Marcel's powers had fully awakened. Simultaneously, a soul named "Clemar" was born inside the camera.
en|Contrairement à l'élégant Marcel, Cle: Unlike the elegant Marcel, Clemar was direct and volatile, but the two became inseparable. Relying on dark magic, Marcel became an aide to his distant cousin, Aamon, paving the way to becoming leader of Paxley. Those who had harassed him in the past no longer dared to look this terrifying “enforcer” in the eyes, fearing his camera.
en|Hélas, mieux vaut être craint qu’être: Alas, it is better to be feared than to be loved. This is the Paxley method.
en|\"...Le grand art naît souvent d'un a: "...Great art is often born from deep love. After the death of his mother, Marcel channeled his grief into creation. There you have it, a true flowering of talent! It's as if his camera had a spirit..."
en|Dans les années qui suivirent, Marcel: In the years that followed, Marcel never felt like he had lost anything. Indeed, he felt neither pain nor anger. His emotions had long been locked away in his camera, Clemar.
en|Autrement dit, jusqu'à ce que la nouv: That is, until the news of his mother's death came.
en|Il avait appris la vérité : après avo: He had learned the truth: after leaving the Paxley household, his mother remarried, opened a tailoring shop and gave birth to a daughter named Melissa, before dying of illness seven years ago.
en|C'était une vieille nouvelle des anné: It was old news from years past, but fate and hatred hid it from him. Clemar roared in Marcel's ear: "She had a new life! A new child! What am I?! Why all my suffering?!"
en|Marcel se croyait impassible, mais la: Marcel thought he was impassive, but the dark magic within him was becoming even more uncontrollable. Clemar was no longer content to reside in the camera, frequently attempting to take over Marcel's body. Marcel began to suffer from memory loss and fainting spells. He would wake up unpredictably on street corners near Aberleen Castle, surrounded by crowds frozen in time. Even Aamon was left helpless, until Marcel, after studying every clue, returned the loan and directed it at himself!
en|Au moment où le déclencheur a cliqué,: The moment the shutter clicked, Marcel entered the camera. The interior was chaotic and desolate, with rolls of floating film sweeping like tidal waves, inflicting endless pain. As he walked past all his memories, a scarred figure stood alone at the end of the corridor...
en|Cela avait été un moyen d'évasion, ma: It had been a means of escape, but also of self-protection. Years ago, Marcel split his soul, naming the new entity "Clemar". Two sides of the same soul were isolated inside and outside the camera, experiencing their own pain and sorrow. Marcel got rid of the pain time and time again, storing it in the Clemar camera.
en|La douleur n'a pas disparu ; il était: The pain has not gone away; he was simply carried by another, in solitude.
en|Finalement, la caméra a capté la trag: Eventually, the camera caught the tragic news, causing chaos inside Aberleen Castle.
en|Il y a des années, pas à pas, sa mère: Years ago, step by step, his mother passed out and never looked back. Now Marcel looked at Clemar and advanced step by step towards him.
en|Il a tendu la main et a embrassé le m: He reached out and embraced the self that was “frozen” in the past.
en|...Ses souvenirs prirent fin et Marce: ...His memories ended and Marcel gently pushed the newspaper away.
en|Après leur épisode devant la caméra,: After their episode in front of the camera, Marcel and Clemar reconnected. Today, Clemar is no longer just Marcel's camera, but his witness, his companion and his peer. He is her other half.
en|\"Ils ne comprennent pas du tout notr: “They don’t understand our art at all!”
en|Marcel tapota Clemar : \"Ça n'a pas d: Marcel patted Clemar: "It doesn't matter. We know what we are...and what art is."
en|Le volet figea l'instant : des lumièr: The shutter froze the moment: warm lights shone on the dark stone streets of Aberleen Castle. This world has many flaws, but it is precisely because of them that it seems incredibly real.
en|Sa mère a choisi la liberté, même si: His mother chose freedom, even if it meant leaving him. He understood his limits and learned to accept his half-sister, Melissa. They had lives of their own, and how could the photographer who understood art best ruminate on the incompleteness of life?
en|Maintenant, il se tient aux côtés de: Now he stands beside Clemar, looking through the viewfinder, ready to move forward into their future.
en|Marcel est un prénom masculin d'origi: Marcel is a male first name of French and Latin origin, derived from the Roman first name Marcellus. It usually means "young warrior", "warrior", or "dedicated to Mars" (the Roman god of war).
en|Le prénom Clemar est une anagramme de: The first name Clemar is an anagram of “Marcel”.
en|Le père de Marcel n'est pas de la fam: Marcel's father is not from the Paxley family; her father was a foreign dark mage from Aberleen Castle chosen by House Paxley for a political marriage. Since Marcel's mother is the Paxley and holds noble status, Marcel inherits her family name.
en|Dans les premières fuites, Marcel por: In early leaks, Marcel was codenamed “Lingshi.”
en|Le Frozen Moment CC est l'un des CC q: The Frozen Moment CC is one of the CCs that can inflict heroes even with CC immunity.
en|Marcel est le deuxième héros capable: Marcel is the second hero capable of inflicting CC on allied heroes and units, the first being Jawhead's Ejector.
Marcel is the second hero who can stop turret damage for a short time, using his ultimate. Aurora can freeze turrets using her 2nd skill and her ultimate with her Pride of Ice.
en|Il est le premier héros dont les dégâ: He is the first hero whose damage increases with magic defense.
en|Il est également le premier héros don: He is also the first hero whose damage scales with both physical and magical defense.
en|Marcel est le seul héros qui ne gagne: Marcel is the only hero who does not gain HP from items.
en|Diggie et Marcel sont les seuls héros: Diggie and Marcel are the only pure support heroes whose primary skills do not include healing.
en|Le clan Shura a prospéré dans l'isole: The Shura clan thrived in isolation for countless generations in the Arcapada universe. Their men, renowned for being the bravest fighters in the world, and their women, renowned for being the greatest beauties in the world. At the heart of the Shura clan's beliefs is the legend of the Three Thousand Worlds. Legends speak of three thousand secret worlds which, upon entering, one must face different levels of psychic and physical trials and advance from world to world after victory. Members of the Shura clan had discovered a way to access these worlds, and only those who had conquered more than three hundred worlds could be granted the title of Asura, elevating them to the rank of demigod in the eyes of their people. However, throughout the countless eons of Shura history, none managed to conquer the legendary world of three thousand, until Martis appeared.
en|Avec une ambition et une déterminatio: With an ambition and determination capable of shaking the heavens, Martis trained every day of his life to become stronger, advancing tirelessly through the secret worlds, each personal breakthrough against the legions of demons providing him with a unique sense of personal satisfaction. No one knew how many years passed before Martis reached the final and hardest secret world. However, his desire for glory pushed him to move forward. After numerous defeats, he fell into despair, but despite this, he refused to give up. He transformed his thirst for victory into his twin blades of righteous fury, now known as the Teeth of Asura, and for countless days and nights he fought against the demons of the end world with strength and determination never before seen on the mortal plane. He eventually became the first Asura to defeat all three thousand secret worlds and has since been considered the "Asura King", ruling over tens of millions of Asura aspirants.

In Roman mythology, Mars was the god of war, combat and violence, often associated with aggression and conflict. The name Martis retains this connection to the strength, power and combat prowess of a warrior.
en|La citation de Martis \"3000 mondes e: Martis' quote "3000 worlds and not a single worthy enemy" was a bluff, he was actually defeated several times and was even plunged into despair.
en|Le terme « 3000 Mondes » est une réfé: The term "3000 Worlds" is a hyperbolic reference to the 3000 Trials, where individuals must face and complete each trial (World/Level). Those who pass 300 of these levels are considered to be at the level of a Demigod in the eyes of the Asura Clan.

The two were evenly matched, and their fight alone created an entrance to the time rift. After the 3000 trials Martis encountered a demigod Gatotkaca and fought, the two were evenly matched and their fight alone opened an entrance into the time rift.

en|Martis et Gatotkaca partagent égaleme: Martis and Gatotkaca also share the same Japanese language voice actor, Abe Daiki, with Helcurt, who shares Jungle and Roaming Lane endorsements with each of them, respectively.
en|Il y avait une terre dans l'extrême n: There was a land in the far north called Northern Vale, which was covered in winter snow all year round. It was also known as the land closest to the frozen sea. During their long history, the Sarmi tribe and the bears have shared their lands. Having a common ancestor, they never attacked each other and lived in harmony. Over time, they developed a spiritual bond. This peace lasted a long time.
en|Personne n'aurait pensé que l'environ: No one would have thought that the perilous natural environment of the North Valley would still invite invaders to these lands. A large number of pirates from the Frozen Sea arrived in the Northern Valley. They brought not only endless plunder, but also bitter wars. As formidable as they were, the pirates plundered and occupied these lands. As if that were not enough, the invaders began to hunt the bears. Every tribe in Northern Vale was threatened by these invaders - some of them were conquered, others were forced from their homes, having to fight homeless in the cold. As the leader of the Sarmi tribe, Masha protected her tribe from waves of attacks. As a tribal hunter, she had great combat skills, and this was the reason why she could defend the dignity of the Northern Valley.
en|Elle n'a jamais oublié le vœu de Sarm: She never forgot Sarmi’s wish: “Protect the bears! » She tried to find the bears. But when she found the bears' habitat, she found nothing but dead people and signs of violence everywhere. Suddenly, Marsha heard a loud roar. It was a familiar roar. As expected, a group of invaders were trying to hunt down the Bear King, who was constantly repeating "Beast Power". They launched attacks with their advanced weapons and unique hunting skills. The Bear King tried to protect the injured little bears by shielding them with his body, even though he had been seriously injured by those iron spears. Masha rushed to the battlefield to help the Bear King, but it was in vain. The Bear King, sensing Masha's intentions, decided to divert the attention of these hunters by moving away. Masha understood the goal of the Bear King, saved the little bears and ran into the mountains.
en|Elle a utilisé son propre tissu pour: She used her own cloth to dress the bears' wounds and placed them safely in a secret cave. She returned to help the Bear King who was seriously injured. These hunters beat him and tried to capture him. This angered Masha who descended on them and tore them apart trying to save the Bear King. The Bear King then gathered all his remaining strength and unleashed his last "Beast Power". Masha and the Bear King fought together and let the hunters pay for their invasion with their blood. It was the first time the Sarmi and the Bears had fought together, and victory belonged to all of Northern Vale. What Masha didn't expect was that the Bear King was in his final moments. Masha could feel the grateful confidence in the Bear King's eyes. It seemed that the king was showing his deepest respect for what she had done. Finally, the king closed his eyes and endowed Masha with powerful energy. Masha felt this energy coursing through her body and she realized it was "Beast Power". His body has become extremely powerful. It seemed like she could withstand any type of attack with this body and beat any opponent with her superb attack speed.
en|Masha a réussi à sauver les petits ou: Masha managed to save the little bears, hoping that the bears will be resurrected in the future. From that day forward, Marsha swore to guard the North Valley with her "Beast Power" and no invader would escape the wrath of her savage fists.
en|Le nom Masha est une variante en lang: The name Masha is a Russian-language variant of the female name Mariya, equivalent to the English name Mary. She also speaks with a Russian accent.
en|Le nom de Masha et sa relation avec l: Masha's name and her relationship with bears are likely inspired by the Russian folk tale Masha and the Bear.
en|De plus, elle a été libérée à l'occas: Additionally, it was released on the 10th anniversary of the series.
en|Sa tribu est la seule qui soit basée: His tribe is the only one based on a real tribe; according to tradition, she is a member of the Sami or Sarmi tribe, which could be the Land of Dawn equivalent of the Sami peoples of Northern Europe.
en|Elle est la seule héroïne à posséder: She is the only heroine to have three health bars.
en|Elle est le seul héros sans croissanc: She is the only hero without defense growth since version 1.8.30.
en|Elle a été présentée pour la première: She was first introduced as a hunter/tank hero in patch 1.4.14, but was later transformed into a pure fighter in patch 1.4.94. However, it was restored in patch 1.6.66.
en|Capacités bénies par le Roi Ours: Abilities blessed by the Bear King
en|Libère le coup de tonnerre de ses poi: Unleash the thunderclap from his fists and disarm enemies
en|Une fille courageuse qui se tient deb: A brave girl who stands up and is not afraid of power.
en|Dans le vaste désert occidental, sur: In the vast western desert, on a barren land, with its backs to the mountains, lived an ancient and simple tribe. For generations, they preserved the traditions of their ancestors, guarded their sacred mountains and led a hard but quiet life. Mathilda and her family were members of this tribe.
en|Le père de Mathilda, Thasgard, était: Mathilda's father, Thasgard, was the leader of the entire tribe. He was courageous, upright and responsible, and firmly carried the burden of the tribe's survival on his shoulders. Under his influence, little Mathilda had developed a personality similar to that of her father and was deeply proud of him.
en|Un jour, un groupe de chasseurs de sa: One day, a group of sand hunters from Los Pecados broke into this closed tribe and disrupted the peace they had maintained for hundreds of years. The group of sand hunters got lost in the desert in pursuit of giant beasts. They were discovered by Mathilda's tribesmen as they were about to die. The tribesmen took them back to the tribe.
en|Cependant, les attentes des membres i: However, the expectations of the innocent and kind members of the indigenous tribes were shattered when their good deeds were returned in the form of unforgivable atrocities. These were not ordinary sand hunters, but those from the "Iceberg Sand Hunting Group" led by Waldo Kane, the most powerful boss of Los Pecados. These guys not only sought life in the desert, but also did a lot of dirty work and sinful acts.
en|Bien qu'ils soient dans un état proch: Although they were in a near-death state, some veterans of the sandhunting group developed an idea in their minds as soon as they saw the mountains behind the tribe: beneath this seemingly ordinary mountain range, there were countless gold mines that could bring them a steady stream of wealth.
en|Sous la garde des membres de la tribu: Under the care of the aboriginal tribesmen, the sand hunters quickly recovered and left the tribe under their leadership. Before leaving, they promised to reimburse everyone.
en|Cependant, les membres de la tribu de: However, Mathilda's tribesmen did not receive the reward they deserved, but were instead subjected to a sinful invasion. The sand hunters who came out of the desert quickly reported the news to Waldo Kane. On Kane's instruction, Kane's nephew Blandy returned to Mathilda's tribe with a large number of thugs, preparing to take the entire mountain range by force.
en|Pour les membres de la tribu de Mathi: To the members of Mathilda's tribe, this was the tribe's sacred mountain range, and no one was allowed to walk there. The patriarch of the Thasgard tribe harshly rejected Blandy's coercion and temptation and demanded he and his thugs leave their homeland immediately.
en|Blandy, qui avait toujours traversé L: Blandy, who had always passed through Los Pecados without worry, became furious. He pulled out a gun and shot Thasgard, wounding him. He then gave him an ultimatum: either leave the tribe's lands within a month and abandon the gold mine located behind the mountain range, or be wiped out along with his tribe.
en|Leur patriarche désormais blessé, les: Their patriarch now injured, the members of the tribe, having lost their leader, fell into panic and confusion. More and more people began to advocate leaving the village to avoid further losses. Facing the retreating tribe, little Mathilda stood up, denounced their weakness and called on everyone to take up arms and use their own strength to defend their homeland.
en|D'un côté se trouvait la petite et fa: On one side was the small and weak Mathilda, and on the other, the powerful group of Sand Hunters and their band of thugs. The tribesmen chose to shut up one after another and began to quietly pack up their things and prepare to leave the tribe.
en|La petite Mathilda a quitté la tribu: Little Mathilda left the tribe disappointed. She firmly believed that justice should exist in this world. For this reason, she began traveling the vast west, looking for people who could actually help the tribe. While walking towards a small town not far from Los Pecados, Mathilda's sense of justice took over and she found herself in an argument. Mathilda stood up and stood up to the bullies in front of her. Mathilda was outnumbered, but then an old, bald-faced cowboy appeared and fought off the bandits. He then teams up with Mathilda and leaves with her.
en|Ce n'était autre que Clint, un vieux: It was none other than Clint, an old cowboy who had come looking for Blandy for revenge. After learning what happened to Mathilda and her people, Clint, also with a strong sense of justice, decided to help Mathilda and fought alongside her to defend their homeland.
en|Dans la bataille pour défendre sa pat: In the battle to defend her homeland, Mathilda formed a deep relationship with Clint, Claude and others. After a severe ordeal, the brutal Blandy was defeated and the bandits' greedy hopes of conquering the sacred mountain range were shattered.
en|La tribu rétablit la paix qu'elle ava: The tribe restored the peace they once had and Mathilda was summoned by the sacred mountain range. Upon entering the sacred mountain, she inherited a mysterious power that no one had inherited for hundreds of years.
en|Pour Mathilda, une grande aventure ne: For Mathilda, a great adventure was only just beginning. As the sun set, she said goodbye to her family and chose to go on the road with Clint, because she firmly believed that in this world, there were even more oppressed people waiting for justice, and she would do everything she could to help them get it.
en|Le nom Mathilda a des origines german: The name Mathilda has Germanic origins and is derived from the words "maht" (meaning "power" or "strength") and "hild" (meaning "battle" or "fight"). Thus, the name Mathilda can be interpreted to mean "powerful in battle" or "strength in battle".
en|Initialement, Mathilda a été conceptu: Initially, Mathilda was conceptualized as a support hero focused on healing and helping her team. She wasn't originally an assassin support hybrid. His abilities focused on his more traditional support role, providing crowd control and healing.
en|Lors de la libération de Mathilda, el: When Mathilda was released, it was distributed free for a limited time.
en|Mathilda est le premier héros désigné: Mathilda is the first hero designated as support and assassin.
en|L'apparence de Mathilda et de sa trib: The appearance of Mathilda and her tribe appear to be based on the indigenous people of North America, particularly the United States.
en|Swift Plume est un type d'oiseau que: Swift Plume is a type of bird found in lowland tropical rainforests. which could be the inspiration for its design. The bird is visible on the icon of its skill 1.
en|La caractéristique la plus unique est: The most unique feature is that if Mathilda is close to an ally, the bird will take that ally with it, allowing it to quickly reposition its allies on the map.

en|Une fille aux aiguilles maudites qui: A girl with cursed needles who runs a sewing workshop and solves customer problems.
en|Une fille avec une aiguille maudite q: A girl with a cursed needle who runs a sewing workshop and solves customers' problems. A girl with a cursed needle who runs a sewing workshop and solves customers' problems in her "unique" way. The illegitimate child of a nobleman, Melissa grew up in Lumina City, capital of the Moniyan Empire, where she runs a small tailoring shop. Endowed with dark magic, she uses cursed needles to fight, solving her clients' problems in unique ways. === The Needle: Broken Doll ===
en|Il y avait autrefois une petite bouti: There was once a small, inconspicuous tailor shop on the bustling streets of Lumina City, capital of the Moniyan Empire. Its owner was an elegant woman, always with a tired smile on her face, who had an intelligent and original daughter named Melissa.
en|Ils vivaient une vie difficile, mais: They lived a difficult life, but Melissa always wore a pretty dress and clean shoes, the worn parts of which were carefully patched into adorable patterns. She was mean, but she was also thoughtful and sensible. When she was at the store, she helped her mother with the needlework and put the shredded rags aside. When she was old enough and had enough experience of the world, she never asked where her father was again.
en|Melissa a toujours souhaité avoir une: Melissa always wanted to have a beautiful rag doll, but she never told her mother about it, because she knew that her mother, despite her illness, could not even afford to go to the doctor.
en|Chaque fois qu'elle passait devant le: Every time she passed the doll store, she raised her head to look inside, and the exasperated store owner tried to scare her several times with empty threats. Then the girl made a face instead of panicking, so the shopkeeper who was pretending to lose his temper gave up first.
en|Un jour, après la fermeture de leur m: One day, after their store closed, her mother magically created a rag doll sewn with shredded fabric from a fabric pile. Melissa was beyond happy, smiling and jumping up and down holding the doll and her mother.
en|Son enfance heureuse s'envola et la p: Her happy childhood vanished and little Melissa who ran in the streets became a pretty young woman and was able to help her mother. Watching the girl grow up, her mother always expected to see Melissa get married in a beautiful wedding dress she had made for her, but unfortunately, she left Melissa forever before she could make her wish come true.
en|La petite boutique de tailleur a ferm: The small tailor shop closed its doors and the father Melissa had never met before suddenly appeared and took her with him.
en|Ils retournèrent chez son père et c'e: They returned to her father's house and that's when she discovered that her mother was a Paxley. Renouncing her ties to the noble family, she fled for love with her father, who abandoned her and left her an illegitimate daughter.
en|Par la suite, même si son père a tent: Subsequently, although her father tried to compensate for her abandonment, he was unable to give her all the rights of a legitimate child. When Melissa was introduced to her half-sister, a cultured and graceful young woman, she became filled with hatred towards Melissa. She thought Melissa broke into her family, so she always bullied Melissa when their father wasn't home, and Melissa pretended not to care but remembered everything.
en|Chaque nuit, seule la poupée tapis ac: Every night, only the carpet doll accompanied Melissa in her sleep, which gave her the feeling that her mother was always there with her inside the doll, so when she felt the need to cry, she held back her tears and hugged the doll.
en|Mais sa sœur était également hostile: But her sister was also hostile towards the carpet doll. She once deliberately tore it up and falsely suggested that Melissa throw away the broken doll that didn't please her eyes and accept one of her old dolls.
en|Même si Melissa a prétendu qu'elle ét: Even though Melissa claimed she was okay with it, there was no way she was going to throw away her “mommy doll.” Afterwards, whenever she was bullied, she would often push the doll with her sister's favorite bow tie sewn on it, as if it were her sister herself.
en|Un jour, alors qu'elle exprimait sa c: One day, while venting her anger at the doll, she accidentally discovered that her actions seemed to have actually affected her sister! Her suspicions were confirmed after a few attempts, and an idea began to form in this little girl's mind...
en|C'était bientôt la cérémonie de passa: It was soon her sister's coming-of-age ceremony, and important guests were gathered in their house, but as an illegitimate daughter who could not be seen by others, Melissa stayed in her room while her sister showed off her piano skills to everyone in the room. When her sister gracefully sat on the stool while people applauded, Melissa was also ready with a big smile on her face: she was following the rhythm of the song on the piano with one hand and the other hand was ready to push the "sister doll".
en|Un son mélodieux de piano remplit la: A melodious piano sound filled the room and soon reached the climax of the song. It was when her sister confidently pressed the keys that Melissa pushed the doll – she had practiced it to perfection when her sister was practicing the piano.
en|À ce moment-là, la chanson a commencé: At that point, the song started to go wrong.
en|Sa sœur n'arrêtait pas de frapper les: Her sister kept hitting the wrong notes, once, twice, and the guests started whispering to each other as they listened to the wrong melody. His sister's pale face gradually turned crimson, until she finally broke and smashed the piano while insulting him, and the whole audience was completely silent...
en|Lorsque sa sœur et la servante qui a: When her sister and the maid who raised the alarm rushed into Melissa's room, she had already changed into her old outfit and sneaked out of the house with her little luggage and dolls.
en|Melissa s'est échappée de la maison d: Melissa escaped from her father's house and returned to wander the familiar streets.
en|Une nuit, elle rêva de Cuddles lui pa: One night she dreamed of Cuddles speaking to her in her mother's voice, telling her not to be afraid because she would always protect her. Overwhelmed and ecstatic, Melissa threw herself at her mother, only to wake up alone on a rainy night just as she raised her hands. Suddenly, an inexplicit magical energy burst forth from her heart – her dark magic ability inherited from her mother had awakened, and a girl with nature's curse magic was born.
en|Après cette nuit, Melissa a décidé de: After that night, Melissa decided to settle down and opened a small sewing shop in the town of Lumina, inside which she recreated the layout of her mother's old shop, with various dolls hanging here and there. Sitting behind the counter, Melissa still had her feet on the table and coldly looked at the bustling world outside with a sneer.
en|Malgré l'apparence d'un atelier de co: Despite the appearance of a normal tailoring shop, Melissa's Tailor guarantees that all customer problems will be resolved, provided that the picky store owner does not refuse to accept your requests.
en|À seulement 16 ans, Melissa parvient: At only 16 years old, Melissa really manages to solve all her clients' problems. She always has unexpected ideas for taking care of targets: it's either swapping a bad contract with a loan shark or telling a homeless child to hug a groom who abandoned his former love and call him dad at his wedding.
en|Lorsque ces cibles venaient se venger: When these targets came to get revenge on Melissa, she would smile and remind them what it feels like to miss your damn needles.
en|Peu de temps après qu'elle ait ouvert: Soon after she opens the shop, even the nobles start talking about it: "Have you heard of Melissa's Tailor?"
en|\"Oui. Le propriétaire est-il vraimen: "Yes. Is the owner really as good as they say?"
en|\"Ouais, j'ai un travail difficile qu: “Yeah, I have a tough job that needs help with…”
en|Si vous vous retrouvez également en d: If you also find yourself in trouble in Lumina City, simply go to Melissa's Tailor and find its owner, Melissa…
en|Son nom est un prénom féminin provena: Its name is a feminine first name coming from the Greek word μέλισσα (melissa) meaning "bee" which in turn comes from μέλι (meli), "honey" or "bee".
en|Les descriptions des compétences de M: Descriptions of Melissa's skills are written in Melissa's first person with her character present.
en|Son concept tourne autour des poupées: Its concept revolves around cursed dolls and dark magic, giving it a unique identity among MLBB heroes. The voodoo theme is reflected in her skills, where she controls "Muddles", a cursed doll that attacks enemies. Melissa is the first sniper in the game to use a needle and a voodoo doll as part of her attack kit.
en|Bien que cela n’ait pas été officiell: Although it has not been officially confirmed, Melissa is said to be one of the first heroes created due to an upcoming anime collaboration skin. Other heroes involved are members of Forsaken Light – Yin, Xavier and Julian – for the Jujutsu Kaisen collaboration, as well as Suyou, Lukas and Kalea for the Naruto Team 7 collaboration event.
en|Melissa de Mobile Legends : Bang Bang: Melissa from Mobile Legends: Bang Bang shares striking similarities with Nobara Kugisaki from Jujutsu Kaisen, both in design and personality. Although not officially confirmed, it is highly likely that Nobara was a major source of inspiration for Melissa. This shared voodoo-style magic suggests that Melissa's gameplay mechanics were inspired by Nobara's abilities.
en|Melissa est le premier héros du jeu à: Melissa is the first hero in the game to have three companions in-game at the same time! Her three companions are Muddles, Cuddles, and Giggles, although Muddles is the only companion who actively fights with her, functioning as a cursed bond mechanism.
en|Melissa est l'un des rares tireurs d': Melissa is one of the few marksmen with a strong self-peeling ability outside of sprinting, thanks to her ultimate (Go Away!), which allows her to counter melee heroes like assassins and fighters.
en|Yin, Xavier, Julian (co-membres de Fo: Yin, Xavier, Julian (co-members of Forsaken Light)
en|Le prince minoen était déterminé à re: The Minoan prince was determined to restore his homeland.
en|Autrefois, les Minoens fondèrent un É: Long ago, the Minoans founded a mysterious and prosperous state called Minoa in the barren lands of Agelta.
en|L'ancienne Route d'Émeraude reliait M: The ancient Emerald Road connected Minoa to other western cities, creating a network of trade routes, while Minoa stood out among all others for its advanced civilization and martial traditions.
en|Le prince Minotaure de Minoa était al: Prince Minotaur of Minoa was then the most esteemed warrior. Passionate about fighting and often fueled by his rage, the Minotaur displayed terrifying bursts of strength in combat. Few could hope to last more than a few rounds against him.
en|Les gens ont commencé à adorer le Min: People began to worship the Minotaur, but his father was deeply concerned about him. While achieving great success on the battlefield, the Minotaur's savagery and impulsive behavior were unworthy of the successor to the state.
en|Pour faire du Minotaure un héritier a: To make the Minotaur a suitable heir to the throne, the old king has arranged a special trial in which the prince must defeat a mysterious figure from foreign lands to qualify for the throne of Minoa.
en|Le Minotaure accepta sans hésitation: The Minotaur accepted this bare-handed duel without hesitation. He entered the arena with his head held high and attempted to crush his opponent with brute force, as he had always done. However, his opponent this time was much tougher, and the Minotaur quickly exhausted himself, losing his advantage.
en|En fin de compte, le personnage mysté: In the end, the mysterious figure defeated the "invincible" Minotaur with measured counterattacks.
en|La foule acclamait le vainqueur fort: The crowd cheered the victor loud and graceful, but the Minotaur was overcome with rage and shame.
en|Et lorsque la silhouette mystérieuse: And when the mysterious figure reached out to help the Minotaur back to his feet, the Minotaur grabbed the unsuspecting hand and pinned the unsuspecting hand and pinned the mysterious figure to the ground, before throwing a series of vicious punches at him.
en|Alors que ses poings étaient couverts: As his fists were covered in blood and the mysterious figure stopped struggling, the Minotaur tore off the latter's mask amid the jeers of the crowd, and that's when his entire body stiffened. The seriously injured figure on the ground was actually his father!
en|Le vieux roi saisit la main du Minota: The old king grabbed the Minotaur's hand with his last strength and spoke his final words of instruction to his son: "You must learn to take responsibility as king and continue the glory of Minoa..."
en|Consumé par la honte et le regret, le: Consumed by shame and regret, the Minotaur made his way to the Minoan Labyrinth, the burial place of the Minoan ancestors, and began his training and repentance.
en|Au fil du temps, Minotaure a progress: Over time, Minotaur gradually gained control of his rage and became capable of harnessing his unleashed powers at will.
en|Alors que le Minotaure se lançait dan: As the Minotaur embarked on this arduous training, an unexpected catastrophe occurred. The whole of Minoa. was flattened by the explosion of the Twilight Orb, and only the Minotaur remained unharmed under the protection of the Labyrinth. The Minotaur rushed to the State amidst the tremors, wanting to find out what had happened, when a broken piece of the Orb of Twilight fell into the Labyrinth and sealed it entirely. The Minotaur, who was half a step away from the Labyrinth, was completely sealed and put into a deep sleep.
en|La catastrophe a effacé toute trace d: The catastrophe erased all traces of Minoan civilization, leaving only the Minoan labyrinth half-hidden in the sand. After countless days and nights, the broken piece of the Twilight Orb transformed into Lunox and left.
en|Le sceau a ensuite été levé. Le temps: The seal was then lifted. Time in the Labyrinth began to pass again, while the Minotaur slowly opened his eyes....
en|Aldous, le gardien du Labyrinthe, a d: Aldous, the guardian of the Labyrinth, told the Minotaur that his state had long since turned to dust and that he and his memories were all that remained. The Minotaur, however, would believe none of this.
en|Avec la mission finale de son père en: With his father's final mission still fresh in his mind, the prince vowed to find his lost parents and rebuild the Minoan civilization.
en|Dans le sable sans limites, un ensemb: In the boundless sand, a set of hoof prints stretched to the horizon...
en|Son nom vient du Minotaure, créature: Its name comes from the Minotaur, a legendary creature from Greek mythology with the body of a man and the head of a bull.
en|Le vrai nom du Minotaure est Astérion: The Minotaur's real name is Asterion, inspired and taken from Astraeus. His name Minotaur was given to him when he became the most powerful minotaur in Minoan.
en|Le nom Astraeus vient du mot grec \"Ἀ: The name Astraeus comes from the Greek word "Ἀστερίων" meaning Starry which suggests association with the Taurus constellation Taurus, hence its skin name.
en|Le Minotaure est le seul tank capable: The Minotaur is the only tank capable of healing its allies.
en|Son skin Orbiter s'appelait à l'origi: His Orbiter skin was originally called Taurus, but was later changed because it would collide with his Zodiac Taurus skin.
en|Les premiers concepts artistiques mon: Early concept art showed a more primitive stone hammer, but later versions gave it a more refined and enchanted look, perhaps hinting at a magical origin.
en|Il est le premier héros doté d'une mé: He is the first hero with a "Rage Bar" mechanic in MLBB. Unlike most heroes who have a mana or energy system, the Minotaur's abilities become stronger when his rage bar is full, making him a unique tank. But this has been remade, so his skills are improved when he uses his previously upgraded Ultimate.
en|Roi de Minoa (père, tué par le Minota: King of Minoa (father, killed by the Minotaur)
en|Un jeune roi qui a mené le peuple de: A young king who led the people of Mahar Pura to victory against the invaders.
en|Je me tenais sous l'imposant mur du c: I stood under the imposing castle wall, it was just another day in my mundane life as an unimportant servant. A sudden baby cry shook the sun but the birth of a prince could not awaken my stranded life. I stood under the imposing castle wall, praises and blessings reached my ears: some wished him to be kind; some wished him courage; some wished him a great future... I have seen so many royals and nobles in my life, their authorities are like knives to the throat. Just like at this moment, I am waiting for my masters to punish me because my senility made me break the dishes. A small figure stands before me with a short wooden sword – the praised prince protects me just as he has sworn to protect his subjects. Now I so wish it could grow safely and bring warmth to people like the sun on Mahar Pura.
en|Agenouillé sur les terres agricoles c: Kneeling on the cracked farmlands, I prayed for rain to save our dying crops, our parched mouths, and our desperate hearts. But what came before the rain was our savior in golden armor, he brought us food and eased our suffering. When he looked at his subjects, I could see a whole world deep in his eyes, a world as beautiful as a landscape. When he looked up, he noticed the silhouette of a small rosewood flower, which made the world jump with joy in his eyes. Later, I was told that our savior, the crown prince of our kingdom, had fallen in love with a civilian girl. He got rid of his royal trifles and continued the free life with the girl. However, the free life is not limited to starry skies and love. It also means paddy, sackcloth and hard work in the fields. This time, the prince finally had the chance to see the truth about the world and the lives of his fellow citizens.
en|J'ai marché vers le champ de bataille: I marched toward the battlefield with my comrades as enemy warships once again breached our naval defenses. The black waves rushed towards us from the horizon and soon transformed into millions of blades. My comrades, my brothers, were pierced by the blades. They told me to bring their last smile back to our hometown. Black clouds rolled out from enemy ships, covering the sun. We fought desperately for our lives, but no hope could be seen. Suddenly, a golden light broke through the dark sky, driving away all the darkness from the battlefield. I recognized the Sacred Spear in the comer's hand. He was our crown prince! The sun of Mahar Pura! He blocked all enemy attacks with his sturdy body. He blew his horn to rally the desperate soldiers. Torches gathered all over the battlefield and formed a wildfire. Under his leadership, we dispelled all the darkness and pushed it back to where it came from. Later, we knelt before our new king and swore to be his feet and his spear. May Mahar Pura shine forever.
en|Je l'ai revu à un âge très avancé. Il: I saw him again at a very advanced age. He returned to the palace and once again enjoyed the splendor of the crown. I was told that he put aside his duties and lived the life of a farmer with his true love. However, he could not turn a blind eye to the bitterness of his people. He left his rosewood flower garden, reforged his sacred spear, and returned to the brutal battlefield. Now I live behind the castle walls, sheltered from the sound of battle horns. Thanks to warriors like him, I can still serve wine with care and respect. I offer him the cup of wine, he looks down, there is loneliness in his eyes. But the bright sun still shines as always on the unchanging land of Mahar Pura.
en|Minsitthar est basé sur le roi Kyansi: Minsitthar is based on King Kyansittha, a famous ruler of the pagan dynasty of Myanmar (Burma).
en|Minsitthar est le 4ème héros basé sur: Minsitthar is the 4th hero based on a real historical character, with Zilong, Yi Sun-shin, Lapu-Lapu and Zetian.
en|Il est le premier héros à avoir des l: He is the first hero to have Burmese bloodlines.
en|Son Ultime (King’s Calling) invoque d: His Ultimate (King’s Calling) summons royal guards that form a phalanx-style barrier. This makes him the only MLBB hero to use a military training mechanic, preventing enemies from using blink skills within.
en|L'histoire de Minsitthar présente une: Minsitthar's story bears some resemblance to the 'Baahubali' film series.
en|Il est également probable que son his: It's also likely that its story is based largely on the life of the person it's based on.
en|Il est l'un des deux héros capables d: He is one of two heroes capable of disabling enemies' sprint or blink skills, the other being Obsidia with his Bone Hunt.
en|Les premières fuites suggéraient que: Early leaks suggested that Minsitthar was meant to be a tank, but he was later developed into a fighter with strong crowd control abilities. It retains some tank-like features, such as damage reduction and sustain.
en|La prêtresse de la Lune et protectric: The priestess of the Moon and protector of the moonlit forest.
en|La prêtresse de la Lune gardant les f: The Moon Priestess Guarding the Forests of Azrya Born at the end of the Age of Strife, Miya witnessed the unspeakable tragedies that befell the elves during the Endless War. She saw how the Abyss desecrated the Marsh of Shadows and corrupted many of its inhabitants into Dark Elves. It was not until the Moon Goddess created the Lunar Aegis on Azrya that the Moon Elves were able to prosper again under her protection. Miya became the Priestess of the Moon, and for thousands of years she served faithfully in the Lunar Temple, diligently watching over her people. However, with the continued expansion of the Abyss and its dark legions, the Land of Dawn is once again shrouded in the fog of war. From the moonlit forest, a call to war that has not been heard for thousands of years rings out again. Miya took her silver bow and swore by the light of the moon to fight for her people. === Bio === “What is war, brother?” "When the races of the Land of Dawn have clashed instead of embracing unity and mutual prosperity, it is war. When they have invaded their neighbors and razed cities, it is war. When they choose destruction over peace, cruelty over benevolence, and corruption over purity... that is war." “Peace, kindness and purity... is this your wish for the world?” Estes did not answer. The outstretched branches of the Tree of Life wrapped around him and he fell back into a deep sleep. This time he wouldn't wake up for many years. Long enough for Miya to grow from a little girl, who couldn't even reach the branches of the Tree of Life, to a fearless warrior and protector of the moonlit forest.
en|Miya se tenait au sommet des arbres e: Miya stood atop the trees and watched for the enemy incursion. A warband of orcs and demons had just crossed the border, inflicting a wound on the Moon Aegis that caused the Tree of Life to tremble. Drawing his bow, three silver beams of moonlight danced gracefully through the branches before quickly killing the leader and sending the others fleeing in disarray. With the threat gone, the elves channeled the energy of the Tree of Life to repair the breach and restore the Aegis. Peace returned to the forest and all was well.
