Miya, nestled wearily in the trees, had taken on the responsibility of protecting the moonlit forest after her brother Estes had fallen asleep to preserve the energy of the lunar aegis. At first, Estes spoke to Miya through the Tree of Life, and it was through these conversations that she learned of the peace, kindness, and purity that her brother yearned for. And in Estes' absence, Miya watched over the forest according to the last words he spoke. As she relaxed and put down her bow, Miya noticed that she had injured her hand while dealing with the intruders. She began to remember the days when she practiced archery while her brother studied nearby. As a somewhat stubborn child, Miya would often shoot her bow, constantly trying to hit a leaf or branch, until her fingers bled. His brother would look up from his parchment and, with a wave of his hand, heal his wounds with the magic of the forest. Maybe Miya was too attached to the past. She often longed for a time when she could still hide under her brother's protection. Miya snapped back to attention and clenched her fist. Now was not the time to dwell on the past. She knew that the only direction for her was to move forward, for she had become the hope that her people turned to in their difficult times. But Miya knew deep down that she was only lying to herself. She turned a blind eye to the outside world as evil grew in power and only acted when the enemy encroached on her lands. Although this stopped the elves from waging war, how long would it last? Even a fool could see that she was delaying the inevitable. A war that has never been fought can never be won. But peace, goodwill and purity were his brother's wishes. How could she willingly plunge her people into the horrors of war? She couldn't; she wouldn't do it.
en|Mais la guerre va et vient à sa guise: But war comes and goes as it pleases, and it would come suddenly for the Moon Elves, at a bloody dawn. Orc shock troops have destroyed the Aegis. But unlike previous attacks, this time the orcs seemed much more savage, as if they had been driven into an insane bloodlust by dark magic. Black smoke seeped into the forest as the elves awoke to the screams and crackling of burning trees. Large pillars of smoke could be seen from the direction of the Tree of Life. The war was there. "Run! Get out of the forest! Our house is lost, save yourself!" Miya heard the desperate cries, and before she could act, most of her people were already fleeing in panic.
en|\"Frère... donne-moi une réponse !\": "Brother...give me an answer!" Miya made a final appeal to the Tree of Life as the smoke enveloped her, hoping for salvation, but the tree remained silent amid the scorched Earth. Miya looked around her home, the place where the first oracle emerged from the Tree of Life; the place where elves first took root; the place where their branches grew into a great empire; the place where the last pure Moon Elves resisted the corruption of the Abyss. It was their most sacred land, blessed by the Moon Goddess herself, and Estes' hope for their future.
en|\"Qu'est-ce que la guerre...\" Elle t: "What is war..." She finally found her answer. "When we have been pushed to the brink of destruction and finally taken up arms for our survival, it is war. When we must defend our final resting place, the Moonlight Forest, at all costs, it is war." The Moon Elves heard Miya's words and turned back towards their home. "My people! We have suffered for too long...have lived in fear for too long. There is nowhere left for us to escape. If the Moonlight Forest falls, then we truly will have lost everything. Who will support me one last time?" At first, a few dozen elven warriors came out of the trees. Then hundreds more followed, holding swords, spears and bows. As they rushed to Miya's side, their silver hair shimmered like moonlight cascading across the battlefield. The Tree of Life also responded to Miya's call. Using its precious energy, the tree spread its roots in all directions to quell the raging fires and reinvigorated the Moon Elves for a final counterattack. The Moon Elves rushed out of the trees and completely caught the Abyss Legion off guard. They quickly gained the upper hand and continued their attack until all invaders were driven from the moonlit forest. The surviving orcs came to their senses as their bloodlust subsided and gained a new respect for the elves.
en|\"Je comprends maintenant, frère.\" \: “I understand now, brother.” "Peace, goodwill and purity are what you wished for, but if we lose our home, our way of life, then all our efforts will be in vain. If war is already upon us, then we will face it head on. We are ready to sacrifice everything for our home. Give me the strength, courage and faith to protect our people and our homeland!" === Side story ===
en|En japonais, « Miya » (宮) signifie «: In Japanese, "Miya" (宮) means "shrine" or "palace", often referring to sacred places or nobility. This matches the elegant and mystical background of Miya's Moon Elf.
en|Elle s'inspire quelque peu de Lufia d: She is somewhat inspired by Lufia from Magic Rush, a game created by Moonton before MLBB. Miya's Jungle Ranger skin looks a bit similar to her.
en|Dans le jeu, Miya est le premier héro: In the game, Miya is the first hero and the first shooter released according to the sale time.
en|Elle est le premier héros à avoir une: She is the first hero to have a running animation when he has a high movement speed attribute.
en|Elle est l'un des trois héros qui app: She is one of the three heroes who appear on the icons of the Mobile Legends: Bang Bang application, the other two are Layla for the Chinese version of the game and Gusion for the Indian version of the game.
en|Le skin Honor de Miya est un skin cad: Miya's Honor skin is a gift skin to celebrate the summer holidays in the Philippines.
en|Sa peau, Suzuhime (鈴姫), est japonaise: Its skin, Suzuhime (鈴姫), is Japanese and can be broken down into two parts: 鈴 (Suzu) – Means "bell" or "chime", often associated with soft, pleasant sounds. 姫 (Hime) – Means “princess” or “young noble”.
en|L'une de ses lignes les plus célèbres: One of her most famous lines: “Where there is life, there is hope” reflects her role as a guardian of nature and life.
en|Miya était l’un des héros réorganisés: Miya was one of the revamped heroes in the first batch of Project NEXT in September 2020, along with Layla, Eudora (with whom Miya also shares the same Japanese language voice actor, Morisaki Miho), Zilong, and Saber. The goal was to balance the power gap between older and newer heroes, as the latter had better mechanics and animations.
en|Invoque les ombres du clair de lune e: Summons the shadows of moonlight and the lunar eclipse
en|Un guerrier du désert qui a embrassé: A desert warrior who embraced the darkness for revenge.
en|Je suppose que vous êtes une exceptio: I suppose you are an exception among this pitiful herd.
en|Voulez-vous savoir pourquoi vous êtes: Do you want to know why you are here?
en|Quand vous étiez encore parmi les viv: When you were still among the living, your name was Moskov, although that no longer matters today.
en|Oui, tu es mort. D'innombrables lance: Yes, you are dead. Countless spears pierced your insides while your enemies pinned you to the sand. Your blood flowed freely, seeping into the earth and coloring the sand a dark purple. But there was defiance in your bones. Even in death, you refused to collapse; reluctant to admit failure.
en|Oui, vous avez échoué. Cette bataille: Yes, you failed. This battle marked the end of your tribe. Your rival, Khaleed, has brought a force three times yours, if not more. Yet you did not flee, because the blood feud between your two tribes had reached the point of no return. You are a true tragic hero.
en|Dans vos derniers instants, vous avez: In your last moments, you must have thought that this death was worthy of a desert warrior. You fought for your tribe at the cost of your life. The golden sands will surely transport you to the halls of glory and etch your name in the annals of history...
en|Regardez autour de vous. Ce sont vos: Look around you. These are your so-called golden halls of glory. There is nothing here except a great vortex of darkness. It lurks beneath the surface of the desert, voraciously corrupting every grain of sand, rendering everything unholy. Beneath your feet lies a mountain of bones, the countless remains of your ancestors. Above you, their tortured spirits groan in agony, filled with pain, despair and resentment. However, they will never be able to escape this devouring vortex. They are doomed to be devoured by darkness; to be the food of the insatiable.
en|En fin de compte, ils deviennent une: Ultimately, they become a part of me.
en|Je suis une arme. Une arme de pure ob: I am a weapon. A weapon of pure darkness.
en|Ce n'est pas difficile à expliquer. D: It's not difficult to explain. In this world where there is birth, there is death; where there is light, there is darkness. I am in the heart of this vortex of darkness. War, death and anguish are what I feed on. Deep down, you've already known this for some time. Due to the constant feuding between the tribes of the desert, you were taught from a young age to be a fearless warrior. Everything you knew was about fighting, and you and Khaleed were destined to fight to the death – but have you ever wondered why?
en|Je peux voir la rage dans tes yeux. T: I can see the rage in your eyes. This all comes to mind now, right?
en|Oui, vous n'êtes que du fourrage pour: Yes, you are just fodder to me. Simple lambs, born to be slaughtered. And I grow stronger with each offering, extending my influence to more and more tribes and plunging them into war and chaos. All this to ensure that this cycle of violence is passed down from generation to generation.
en|Économisez vos forces. Votre sang aut: Save your strength. Your once warm blood has long since cooled. Your powerful body has stiffened and your rage is nothing more than the complaint of a powerless soul. I am here in front of you, and yet you can do nothing.
en|Mais ne vous y trompez pas. Je ne sui: But don't be fooled. I am not the mastermind of your destiny. While you mindlessly killed each other in your enclosures, the shepherd stood at a distance, drinking your blood and harvesting your flesh. He was once the king of the desert, a ruthless tyrant, but now he slumbers far away, beneath the ruins of Tivacan. Before he fell asleep, he buried me here to gather power for his return.
en|Le monde aurait dû être à moi de le c: The world should have been mine to conquer. I should be the one to plunge this world into darkness. Yet here I am, trapped in this desert, like a caged animal being fattened. I guess our destinies aren't so different. No matter how powerful I become, I remain just a pawn. Someone else's ship. And now he's about to wake up...
en|Eh bien, votre colère est admirable e: Well, your anger is admirable and your blood is boiling again. You are the first to want to escape your pen after learning the truth. I see your soul burning with fury. Your pride, your pain, your hatred... they try to wake up your body. With such remarkable determination, you will surely bring eternal silence to this noisy desert...
en|Viens! Viens devant moi. Sortez-moi d: Come! Come in front of me. Get me out of this damn vortex. Free me and let me see the light again.
en|Détester! Pour avoir été oublié par l: Hate! For being forgotten by history. For the humiliation of being someone's pawn. For your sullied honor. Let all the hatred of the desert flow into you.
en|Brûler! Une âme vengeresse brûle le p: Burn! A vengeful soul burns the most. Return to the battlefield once again. With the darkness, I will reshape your body. I will grant you unlimited power. I will give you your revenge!
en|Aller! Embrassez les ténèbres et fait: Go! Embrace the darkness and silence this desert for eternity.
en|Le nom de Moskov est dérivé de la riv: The name Moskov is derived from the Moskva River in Russia, from which its capital, Moscow, is also derived.
en|Son nom est également d'origine russe: Her name is also of Russian origin, just like Natalia and Masha's.
en|Moskov lance sa lance en utilisant sa: Moskov throws his spear using his left hand, making him the only left-handed sniper to wield one.
en|La peau de Moskov Javelin Champion po: The Moskov Javelin Champion skin has the number on its shirt "1718" which relates to the Laboratory 1718 tradition
en|Le skin Infernal Wyrmlord de Moskov e: Moskov's Infernal Wyrmlord skin is the first-ever skin to receive "mind-blowing special effects."
en|Prince du clan des Sables Sauvages: Prince of the Wild Sands Clan
en|Après la guerre sans fin, le Pays de: After the endless war, the Land of Dawn was covered in scars, but the lunar forest of Azrya was still bathed in the light of the Moon Goddess. Besides the elves, there were various other strange creatures living in this dense forest with a most frantic appearance. There have been very few disputes.
en|Les Léonins étaient la race la plus p: The Leonins were the most peculiar race of this forest. They were few in number, but they were born with cute appearance, agile demeanor, and some talent for using spiritual power. They used their spiritual power to bake apple pies, catch fish, and jump in the woods... As long as the Leonins were awake, the moonlit forest was particularly lively.
en|Nana était la Léonine [la plus coquin: Nana was the Leonine [the naughtiest] of them. She was born on a moonlit night and possesses great spiritual powers. Nana was naturally enthusiastic and energetic and loved using her own power to help her friends in the jungle. It's just a shame that she, through carelessness and recklessness, burned other people's apple pies to ashes or uprooted berry bushes. Little by little, everyone began to distance themselves from Nana.
en|Heureusement, il y avait un petit Tan: Luckily, there was a little Tanuki called Molina who was always by Nana's side. Molina was a little Tanuki living on the edge of the moonlit forest. She had no father, mother or friends. She has lived alone for as long as she can remember. Following an accident, Molina entered the Leonin gathering place, found herself stuck in a dangerous cave and it was Nana who saved her. Since then, Molina has always liked to harass Nana. But Nana didn't like staying with Molina all day. She felt that Molina, who only had the ability to change, was too weak and since Nana always likes to make trouble, Molina should not always be by her side.
en|Nana préférait jouer avec ses camarad: Nana preferred to play with her Leonin comrades.
en|Même si elle se sentait déçue par le: Although she felt disappointed by everyone's rejection, Nana, naturally optimistic, would soon try to help everyone. Once the indolent Leonins gathered in a rare meeting and discussed the construction of a playground that would belong to the Leonine race. For the Leonins, this was a rare and serious event, and Nana also participated enthusiastically.
en|Après des mois de travail acharné, gr: After months of hard work, thanks to the efforts of all the Leonins, they used moonlight stones gifted by the elves, long logs gifted by the forest, colorful stucco paint mixed evenly with berry juice, and other treasures gifted by the nature spirits to build the exquisite Meow Playground. There was a cat climbing frame, a pond to catch fish, a dessert room, a large trampoline… everything. On the day it was built, to celebrate, the Leonins brought out dusty old fruit wine, baked hundreds of apple pies and grilled sea bass, and drank in the garden of Meow Playground.
en|Nana aimait le plus ce genre d’événem: Nana loved this kind of event the most. She jumped happily, picking up the fruit wine and sipping it. She drank so happily. When the moonlight came, a drunken Nana jumped on stage. She wanted to use her spiritual power to bake even more apple pie for everyone to celebrate. But when she began to cast her spell, the power in her hands began to lose control and a hurricane was unleashed, throwing the Meow playground into such disarray that it completely lost its original appearance.
en|Voyant que les efforts de toute la co: Seeing that the entire race's efforts were ruined by her own mistake, Nana felt guilty and afraid. Before everyone woke up, she quietly left her fellow Leonins without taking anything with her, wanting to find a way to control her power so she could return and help everyone build a more fun paradise.
en|Nana a marché jusqu'à l'ouest, son ch: Nana walked all the way west, her path filled with strange creatures. She tried to talk to some small creatures, but everyone ignored her, which made Nana extremely depressed. Nana, who had never left the moonlight forest, felt an unprecedented sense of loss and loneliness, until she discovered that Molina had been secretly following her all along.
en|Molina comprenait la culpabilité de N: Molina understood Nana's guilt and how she must have felt. She told Nana: In the southern part of Azrya – the Swamp of Shadow near the Land of Despair, there is a kind of mystical fruit that grows in dangerous places and can help the user control their own energy.
en|Nana était un peu surprise que le pet: Nana was a little surprised that little Tanuki was still following her, and she was a little emotional. But Nana always refused Molina's request to accompany him to Shadow Swamp. She was worried that there would be dangers on the way that could hurt her girlfriend. Nana pretended to scare Molina harshly: "You are so weak and small. Don't follow me."
en|Mais peu de temps après son départ, M: But shortly after he left, Molina caught up with him and stubbornly refused to leave.
en|Nana a découvert pour la première foi: Nana discovered for the first time that the weak and small Tanuki was also persistent. She was happy inside, but on the surface[,] she accepted Molina's company reluctantly.
en|Les deux hommes traversèrent de nombr: The two passed through many obstacles and finally reached the Shadow Swamp. Deep in the cave, they found the magical fruit they were looking for. Nana happily went to get the fruit, but did not notice the danger that was gradually approaching. Near the Land of Despair lived many monsters eaten away by the Abyss, Nana's pure nature made this black and ugly creature lick its lips and open its ferocious mouth.
en|Molina à ses côtés remarqua le danger: Molina next to him noticed the danger. Seeing that her good friend Nana was about to pick the fruit, she screamed and used the transformation power that only worked occasionally – Molina became Nana's portrait and stood in front of Nana defenseless.
en|\"Aussi faible que je sois, je peux t: "No matter how weak I am, I can still protect my friend."
en|Nana, qui avait récupéré le fruit, ét: Nana, who had collected the fruit, was stunned by everything that was happening in front of her. With the help of the fruit, Nana sent a powerful force to repel the monster, but Molina was also dying. Nana cried and shared her spiritual power with Molina, but it was of no use. Eventually, Molina grabbed Nana's hand and shared her transformative power with Nana, hoping that she would be with her only friend forever.
en|Il s’est avéré que l’apprentissage du: It turned out that learning to control was just the beginning of his growth. Nana continued on her way with Molina's blessing and trust.
en|Ceux qui n’ont jamais oublié survivro: Those who never forgot will always survive in another way; those who have never forgotten their hometown will always return there.
en|Son nom (なな; na na) signifie sept en: Her name (なな; na na) means seven in Japanese and is a common feminine Japanese name.
en|Nana est le seul héros du jeu capable: Nana is the only hero in the game who can transform enemies.
en|Nana souffre d'illéisme, l'acte de se: Nana suffers from illeism, the act of referring to oneself in the third person instead of the first person.
en|Nana est actuellement le plus jeune p: Nana is currently the youngest character with a confirmed age.
en|Ses anciennes lignes vocales sont pri: Her older voice lines are primarily based on the character Ruby from Magic Rush (not to be confused with Ruby in MLBB), another feline hero.
en|L'ancien passif de Nana lui permettai: Nana's old passive allowed her to give gold to nearby allies every 10 seconds (see Nana/History)
en|Bénédiction accordée par Molina, tran: Blessing granted by Molina, transforming Nana into an invincible cat
An assassin exiled by the Empire.
en|Natalia est devenue orpheline de la g: Natalia was orphaned by the war and raised as a little girl by the Monastery of Light. Natalia was trained to become one of the Light's assassins. This young phenomenon had become the best assassin in the monastery, thanks to his exceptional talents. However, during an assassination mission, she failed in its execution, causing unprecedented disaster and death for her companions. Although she managed to escape danger, with Tigreal's help, it was undoubtedly a blow to Natalia's pride. To further prove herself, she exiled herself to the borders of the country, far from the Moniyan Empire and the Monastery of Light, to carry out more dangerous missions. You never know who her target is or where she might strike next. All people know is that Natalia intends to win back everything she once had.
en|Le nom de Natalia a des origines lati: Natalia's name has Latin origins and means "Christmas Day"; the name was usually given to girls born during the Christmas period. Coincidentally, she was released in the month of December 2016.
en|Natalia est probablement inspirée par: Natalia is likely inspired by the Assassins of the Assassin's Creed video game series, as evidenced by her design and quotes.
en|Natalia est l'un des héros qui possèd: Natalia is one of the heroes who has an ability that interacts with the environment (the bush).
en|Sa citation ultime, \"Rien n'est vrai: His ultimate quote, "Nothing is true!", is a phrase attributed to Hassan-i Sabbah, the founder of the Order of the Hashshashin from which the term "assassin" comes.
en|Cyber ​​Spectre est le skin du meille: Cyber ​​Specter is the best design skin in the first MLBB skin design competition hosted by MGL.
en|Le skin collector de Natalia « Warrio: Natalia's Collector's Skin "Warrioress Paragon" was offered for a limited time, making it the first free Collector's Skin ever.
en|Le skin collector gratuit de Natalia: Natalia's free collector's skin and Miya's collector's skin are both linked. Miya's arrows can open portals to the future. Natalia went through this portal.
en|Natalia partage son doubleur en japon: Natalia shares her Japanese voice actor, Iwasaki Chiaki, with Ruby.
en|Le sauveur qui voyage à travers le te: The savior who travels through time and space.
en|Le Pays de l'Aube est né du vide, et: The Land of Dawn was born from the void, and it is to the void that it will return.
en|Au cours des derniers siècles, le sce: Over the past few centuries, the seal that holds the Lord of the Abyss has lost power, while the fissures in the Abyss have steadily widened. The mountains of Lantis could no longer withstand the crippling corruption of the Abyss, and humanity was forced further and further north to survive.
en|Avec cela, le Seigneur des Abysses s’: With this, the Lord of the Abyss fully awakened and his demonic forces reached the walls of the cities of Moniyan. Humanity began to understand that their apocalypse was near. But then, a ray of pure light appeared and provided protection to Moniyan.
en|Les gens jetaient leurs regards vers: People cast their gazes toward the sky, searching for the source of this divine light. It was then that they realized that this was a sign that the Lord of Light had also awakened.
en|Les pouvoirs de la lumière et des tén: The powers of light and darkness have come into action and endless war has once again descended upon the lands.
en|La tragédie et la guerre abondaient,: Tragedy and war abounded, destroying all life, never to be reborn. At such a time, it seemed that no one could stop the spread of war. A thousand years have passed, then three hundred more, and yet the conflict continues with increasing intensity, showing no signs of stopping.
en|C’est à cette époque que Natan est né: It was at this time that Natan was born.
en|En grandissant à Eruditio, Natan s'es: Growing up in Eruditio, Natan proved to be naturally gifted. Whether in science or magic, he has achieved achievements unimaginable to any normal man.
en|Au fil des années, les troubles de la: Over the years, the troubles of war have left a terrible scar in people's hearts that can never be healed. This despair was a heavy burden carried by everyone, even young children.
en|Et rien de plus que les Érudits, qui,: And none more so than the Scholars, who, as humanity's last hope, now constituted the pinnacle of human wisdom, built over millennia. Natan therefore followed the same path as the other scholars, from a very young age taking responsibility for saving this world.
en|Quelques années plus tard, le jeune N: A few years later, young Natan had already become the driving force behind Eruditio, actively participating in various important research projects. At the age of 28, he had already been named the official head of Eruditio for his outstanding achievements. Along with his citizens, he strived to find a way to save the world.
en|À ce stade, les Abysses avaient accum: At this point, the Abyss had accumulated even more Twilight Orbs. If each of them fell into the hands of the Lord of the Abyss, it would mean the return of pure chaos to the world, as all light would disappear into darkness. Natan and the others were running out of time. They took command of everyone at Eruditio and Magic Academy, striving with all their might to find a way to turn the situation around and avoid a certain descent into chaos.
en|Une multitude d’armes, chacune puissa: A multitude of weapons, each powerful beyond belief, were researched and created before being sent to war. Nevertheless, humanity remained vulnerable under the threat of demons and their twilight orbs. The plan to stop the Abyss Lord's advance was already less of a plan of action and more of a wish, something that plunged humanity even further into despair.
en|C’est à ce moment sombre que Natan es: It was at this dark moment that Natan appeared once again and presented a new idea: the creation of a time machine.
en|C’était une idée folle et fantaisiste: It was a crazy, fanciful idea that seemed to raise more problems than it solved. How exactly do we travel in time? Even if it were possible, how would you know when to travel? And besides, would changing the past really also change the future?
en|Quoi qu’il en soit, l’humanité s’est: Either way, humanity found itself stuck in a dead end with no way back. Even the faintest glimmer of hope could not be extinguished.
en|L'érudition a mis de côté toutes les: Scholarship has put aside all other research and devoted all its manpower and resources to finding a way to make time travel a reality.
en|Natan ne s'est pas accordé une second: Natan did not allow himself a second of rest, devoting almost all his time and energy to his research.
en|Cet effort incessant a finalement pro: This relentless effort finally produced results. Natan and the other researchers worked together to produce a device that, if powerful enough, could warp time itself. They continued to advance their research around this discovery, a rudimentary time machine slowly developing before their eyes. One lingering problem remained, however: even with their current research, they had no way of providing the machine with such a gargantuan amount of power.
en|Un autre problème était le fait que l: Another problem was the fact that the four corners of the Land of Dawn had been ravaged by the Endless War for a long, long time now. Fissures spread across the land, floods surged, and tornadoes howled as countless life forms faced extinction in their unforgiving environments. The former glory of the Moniyan Empire has been replaced by a scene of true desolation. Scholarship continues thanks to its protective shield and welcomes a myriad of refugee families.
en|Eruditio n’était plus simplement la «: Eruditio was no longer simply the “City of Scholars”. It was now the last light still shining as humanity faced its apocalypse.
en|Alors que les Abysses prenaient le co: As the Abyss took control of the last shard of the Twilight Orb, it seemed as if fate had been decided. Dark blasts of fearful energy erupt, encircling the skies as the Land of Dawn lets out a cry of pain. I had a feeling it was going to be completely split before long.
en|Le dernier bastion de l’humanité, Eru: The last bastion of humanity, Eruditio, stood alone as he struggled to ignite his dying flames of hope.
en|Mais c’est précisément à ce moment-là: But it was precisely at that moment that a miracle happened. The explosive power that erupted from the Twilight Orbs resonated with the time machine, and so Natan hastily activated the device: it trembled with an awesome energy that surged through its hollows and glowed with a warm, powerful glow as if it were alive.
en|Au-delà du laboratoire, l'obscurité e: Beyond the laboratory, darkness encroached upon the land as it descended from the sky. The defensive network had been devastated by the energy blast, and now an unstoppable tide of demons was flooding the city en masse. Buildings collapsed and streets caught fire.
en|Tout le monde savait très bien que ce: Everyone knew very well that this would be humanity's last fight. Besides, they all knew very well how this was probably going to end. Even though failure weighed heavily on their heads, those incessant sparks of hope continued to burn in their hearts. This hope in the face of defeat is what humanity is all about, and they placed it entirely on Natan.
en|Natan aperçut la scène sombre devant: Natan saw the dark scene before him and started the machine with resolve in his eyes. We hadn't had time to test it, but their theories suggested it could support a single person and transport them through time and space. This was only a theory, however, which meant there would be no way to guarantee his safety.
en|La fin du monde se profilait devant l: The end of the world loomed before him and behind him shone the hope of everyone else. Natan fulfilled the expectations of humanity and entered the past.
en|L'avenir devait changer. Même si cela: The future had to change. Even if it meant spending his life exploring the vast expanses of time and space, Natan would never lose hope, because that hope did not belong to him alone. This was the hope of everyone in Moniyan. As long as he continued and never gave up, there was still a chance for the survival of the Land of Dawn.
en|Toutes les compétences de Natan sont: All of Natan's skills are based on real physics concepts.
en|Son passif, Théorie du tout, affirme: Its passive, Theory of Everything, states that a single theory could explain all aspects of physics. Finding a theory of everything is one of the major unsolved problems in physics.
en|Sa compétence 1, Superposition, et sa: His skill 1, Superposition, and his skill 2, Interference, describe the phenomenon linked to waves.
en|Son ultime, l'Entropie, est utilisé c: Its ultimate, Entropy, is used as a measure of the “randomness” of a system.
en|Selon la chronologie de Natan, cela i: According to Natan's timeline, this implies that the Abyss is about to win the Endless War over the Land of Dawn and is about to conquer the lone Eruditio.
en|La plupart des citations de Natan ne: Most of Natan's quotes are just puns on time, reflecting his horological knowledge.
en|Un érudit qui parcourt l'univers avec: A scholar who travels the universe with divided souls to save his daughter.
en|Nolan, un érudit posé et éminent d’Er: Nolan, a poised and eminent scholar of Eruditio, aspired to unlock the secrets of the multiverse. But after discovering a cosmic threat of unimaginable proportions, he was forced to abandon everything he held dear to stop it. Despite his initial efforts, Nolan fell into despair when he realized that the ever-expanding Calamity would soon find its solution. He discovered a glimmer of hope within himself: his soul. So, Nolan left everything behind and set out on his mission across the multiverse, scattering fragments of his soul as beacons to trap the Calamity. Despite all the pain he endured, he never lost sight of his goal...his Layla. ===Tombstone=== He stood in front of his own tombstone. This particular tombstone had nothing written, not even a name. He was a scholar of the Eruditio, someone who fought for the freedom of others. Science was both his blessing and his curse. "Dad! Wake up!" Who was calling him? Who could this weak voice be? And how many legends of his life remained to be revealed? Hit the link below and discover Nolan's story! As day broke, a man stood in front of a tombstone.
en|En y regardant de plus près, cette pi: Upon closer inspection, this particular tombstone had nothing written on it, not even a name. The man had not come to pay homage, but rather to tell a story; its history.
en|====Partie I==== Il y a vingt ans, le: ====Part I==== Twenty years ago, Nolan's professor, on his deathbed, extolled the virtues of science and warned him of its dangers.
en|Nolan savait que son professeur s'éta: Nolan knew his teacher had always worried about him. Nolan specialized in the study of the multiverse and theorized that their universe was just one of countless others, like a drop in the ocean. But how could humans hope to measure the immensity of the cosmos when their lifespan could not even be recorded on a cosmic scale? Perhaps through his research, Nolan will discover a bright new future for the Land of Dawn, but more likely, he will toil in obscurity for the rest of his days.
en|La science était à la fois sa bénédic: Science was both his blessing and his curse. But he was a scholar of the Eruditio, someone who fought for the freedom of others, and he was never afraid of the unknown.
en|Lorsque Nolan a appris l'existence de: When Nolan learned of the cosmic threat known as the Calamity, he suggested looking beyond their universe to find a way to prevent it. This is how he launched the Infinite Gateway Project, leading research into dimensional portals and multiversal coordinate tracking technology. If he could open the door to the multiverse, he could not only disperse the cosmic forces of Calamity into the void, but also create a better future for his world. If he could reach beyond the stars, his world could be saved.
He will devote his life to this mission.
en|====Partie II==== Lorsque Lillian a i: ====Part II==== When Lillian invited Nolan to the cemetery, he wondered if she was sane. Would it not be in bad taste to wander around the final resting place of so many exalted generations of scholars? But when he discovered the bribe hidden by his predecessors, he realized that this cemetery had long been a gathering place where scholars discussed life, death and everything in between.
en|Lillian était bien plus grégaire que: Lillian was much more gregarious than Nolan. For her, death was not the end, but rather the way back. When they broached the subject of their future, Lillian confessed that she was willing to give up everything to better understand the multiverse. She wanted her tombstone to be anonymous, because she cared little for fame and recognition; she just wanted to live her life without regrets. Hearing this, Nolan felt inexplicably worried. Mistaking his loss of words for disinterest, Lillian punched him in the shoulder that made him stagger. She was surprisingly strong for her small size.
en|Ils ont parlé toute la nuit. Alors qu: They talked all night. As the sun began to rise over the horizon, Lillian stood up and extended her arms in his direction. She cradled the new dawn and exclaimed that this light belonged to them, and all Nolan had to do was reach out and take it.
en|Nolan était déconcerté. La lumière es: Nolan was taken aback. Light is energy...how could he take it and take it?
en|Mais alors qu'il regardait Lillian, b: But as he looked at Lillian, bathed in the soft glow, he felt a sense of ease and comfort.
en|====Partie III==== À l'échelle cosmiq: ====Part III==== On a cosmic scale, the human body is more fragile than a piece of paper. Without any coordinates to serve as a focal point, any matter attempting to cross a dimensional rift would be atomized and lost to the Void. Nolan worked day and night but could not find a solution. The Infinite Gateway was already in the final stages of construction, but no tests had been performed to prove or disprove Nolan's theories because there were far too many unknowns.
en|Les réponses semblaient être à la por: The answers seemed to be within Nolan's grasp, but he just couldn't take the final step. Without coordinates to guide him in the right direction, he would be lost in the multiverse and never return. Nolan felt like he was trapped in a rapidly drying well. Sometimes the pressure was so great that he could barely breathe.
en|Un jour, le cri d'un enfant le sortit: One day, a child's cry broke him out of his trance. Lillian had brought their daughter to the lab. As Nolan held his little girl, this new life that had just blossomed, he suddenly realized something: all coordinates are relative. To create a working coordinate tracking system, he simply needed a starting point. With an anchor, he could venture into the unknown and still find his way.
en|Il plaça doucement une amulette à côt: He gently placed an amulet next to his daughter. She will be the anchor to guide him home.
en|====Partie IV==== L'activation de la: ====Part IV==== The activation of the Infinite Gateway was like a bell ringing throughout the multiverse.
en|Ce fut le point culminant de leur tra: This was the culmination of their work. Nolan and Lillian bravely walked towards the light and found themselves among the stars they used to gaze at every night. They themselves had become astral entities beyond their own understanding. The secrets of the cosmos were slowly revealed to them, like an ancient scroll unfolding, revealing the answers to the questions they had pondered all their lives.
en|Cependant, alors que les étoiles étai: However, with the stars now within their reach, their home had become a vanished dream. It was only once they arrived at their destination that they realized the hopelessness of their mission. The Calamity was a force far greater than they could ever have imagined. Not only had it not dispersed, but it was heading towards the Land of Dawn at an ever-increasing speed.
en|Nolan tomba dans un profond désespoir: Nolan fell into deep despair, but Lillian gently placed her hands on his shoulders and told him that he needed to do something more important.
en|Et juste comme ça, le corps de Lillia: And just like that, Lillian's body slowly faded into stardust as she flew towards the Calamity. She had sacrificed her life to stop the relentless advance of the Calamity. Suddenly, a blinding flash blinded Nolan. Then he lost his hearing and the rest of his senses. In their place, he felt Lillian's unwavering courage and determination. It was his way of saying goodbye.
In an instant, Nolan lost everything.
en|Alors qu’il se remettait de l’éclair: As he recovered from the flash of light, a path appeared in front of him. It suddenly occurred to him. “The anchor!”
en|Seize ans, c'était le temps que Lilli: Sixteen years was the time Lillian had bought in her life. Nolan is expected to complete his mission before then. With the determination of a father, he persevered, never to look back.
en|====Partie V==== Seize ans se sont éc: ====Part V==== Sixteen years have passed. The Calamity had been contained, but Nolan was now falling endlessly into the dark void of space.
en|Nolan n'avait pas vieilli d'un jour d: Nolan hadn't aged a day since entering the Infinite Gate. As he tirelessly carried out his mission, time ceased to affect him. He has learned to open dimensional rifts, now travel between universes, and use his soul as a weapon. He would shatter his soul into countless fragments and scatter them across the multiverse like beacons to attract Calamity. And when all was done, he would send the Calamity of each universe into the Void, all at once.
en|Mais au cours de ces seize années, sa: But during those sixteen years, his loneliness was unimaginable and the agony of his divided soul was beyond compare. Yet, as excruciating as they were, these experiences were nothing compared to the guilt of not being there for Layla. He couldn't watch his own daughter grow up. He couldn't go home, not even once. To carry out his plan, he had to isolate himself from Eruditio and Layla. Their destinies could never meet. Trying to defy him would only bring him pain and suffering, so he did the only thing he could and stayed away.
en|La profondeur de sa douleur était aus: The depth of his pain was as vast as the cosmos, and more tortuous than splitting his soul a thousand times.
en|Mais tout cela touchait enfin à sa fi: But it was all finally coming to an end.
en|Il a utilisé son âme pour absorber le: He used his soul to absorb the destructive power of the Calamity across the multiverse and led it into the Void, saving Eruditio from the brink of destruction.
en|Une fois sa promesse tenue, il pouvai: Once his promise was kept, he could finally let go. Soon he would be with Lillian.
en|Son monde était en sécurité et sa fil: His world was safe and his daughter would have the chance to grow up to become the brightest star in the cosmos.
en|Même s’il avait commis de nombreuses: Although he had made many mistakes in life, he only had one regret. If only he could see her... just once...
en|Après ce qui lui parut être une étern: After what seemed like an eternity of drifting in the Void, he saw a light in the darkness.
en|Et de là sortit une voix faible. La l: And from there came a weak voice. The light was calling to him.
en|Il sentit le soleil briller sur son v: He felt the sun shine on his face as his daughter's voice echoed in the distance.
en|C'est ici que se termine cette histoi: This is where this story ends.
en|On dit que si vous avez accompli tout: They say that if you have accomplished everything you set out to do in life, your name need not live on after death.
en|Toutes ses épreuves et tribulations s: All his trials and tribulations would be scattered to the stars.
en|Alors que le soleil se levait, Nolan: As the sun rose, Nolan felt a familiar warmth. That was the feeling that belonged to them.
en|Debout devant la tombe sans nom, il t: Standing before the nameless grave, he reached out to the dawn and kissed it. ===Who is Nolan?===
en|Son arme est calquée sur le sextant,: His weapon is modeled on the sextant, used in navigation to measure angular distances between objects.
en|Avec Nolan. le concept de multivers a: With Nolan. the concept of multiverse was introduced in the story of Mobile Legends.
en|« Nolan » est un mot d'origine irland: “Nolan” is a word of Irish origin meaning “champion” or “nobleman”.
en|Avec l'introduction et la création de: With Nolan's introduction and creation, each new hero introduced into the game will then have their own background music theme that will be played in the main interface.
en|Il était l'un des héros mentionnés da: He was one of the heroes mentioned in lore before later being introduced as a playable character.
en|Il a été mentionné pendant 7 ans comm: He was mentioned for 7 years as the unnamed father of Layla, who died and then went missing until he was released for the Project NEXT 2023 and MLBB 7th Anniversary events.
en|Nolan porte le même nom que son doubl: Nolan has the same name as his voice actor, Nolan North.
en|Le skin de Nolan, The Navigator, ains: Nolan's skin, The Navigator, as well as the rest of the Nexus Sea skins, are heavily inspired by real-life astronomy-related references. To Nolan, it appears to represent the North Star, aka the North Star, which was primarily used for maritime navigation in medieval times. Additionally, his signature entrance where he cuts a four-pointed star closely resembles common depictions of Polaris.
en|Bruno, Ixia, Lolita, Johnson, Diggie,: Bruno, Ixia, Lolita, Johnson, Diggie, Kimmy (aka)
en|La jeune fille qui cherche à reconstr: The young girl who seeks to rebuild the Star Atlas in order to unlock the secrets of the Stars.
en|=== The Nova === Appuyez sur le lien: === The Nova === Hit the link for more Novaria stories from her bio "The Nova". Together, let's witness her rebellious journey against the stars and how she brings back the destiny they stole!
en|Novaria s'est réveillée dans le silen: Novaria woke up in the silence of the night. She found herself once again in the vast, empty darkness, floating among the remains of the Star Atlas.
en|Mais contrairement aux innombrables f: But unlike countless previous times, an exceptionally bright star could be seen tonight. As Novaria looked at him, his hands reached out as if by instinct, until he was stopped by an invisible cage.
en|Bien sûr, ils ne le permettraient pas: Of course they wouldn't allow it. Novaria knew this only too well. Tonight, and every night, the stars held her prisoner. She could only stare at the little lights above her head and ruminate on the story of her life over and over again.
en|Novaria, le dernier artificier astral: Novaria, the last remaining astral artificer, belonged to us. She was born in the Valley of Stars and that's all she'll ever know. His people had been given a fragment of our power, but they foolishly sought to build the Star Atlas, under the illusion that it would allow them to unlock our secrets.
en|Des créatures si naïves ! Nous, les é: Such naive creatures! We, the stars, are infinite, while they, mere mortals, waste their lives trying to understand us. But this girl, Novaria, was unique. She somehow discovered in the Star Atlas the destiny we had designed for her: when the stars align, her power as Prime Watcher will awaken and she will become a semi-astral being. By our will, she will inadvertently destroy the Star Atlas and doom all of its people.
en|Nous sommes les stars. Elle respecter: We are the stars. She will respect our wishes. She must respect our wishes.
en|Après avoir vu son destin, Novaria a: After seeing her destiny, Novaria hid her power out of fear. But one fateful day, she predicted in the stars that a tragedy would befall her mother and had no choice but to alter the Star Atlas.
en|Lorsque sa mère rentra chez elle sain: When her mother returned home safely, Novaria finally understood the connection between the Star Atlas and the stars. That's when she decided to betray us. Little by little, she made tiny, seemingly insignificant changes to the Atlas. Star patterns began to appear on her body, which distressed her but did not stop her work.
en|Elle leva les yeux et trouva à nouvea: She looked up and found that star again, this time even brighter than before, as if it was burning up all her energy.
en|Cela n’était pas dans le dessein des: This was not the stars’ intention.
en|Novaria sentit quelque chose remuer d: Novaria felt something stirring in her heart, something she hadn't felt since that night.
en|Le soir de son seizième anniversaire,: On the evening of her sixteenth birthday, she aligned the last star according to her drawing. His people would finally be saved. The next morning, as Novaria enjoyed the cake her mother had made for her, she felt at peace. The naive girl believed she was blessed by the stars.
en|L'Atlas stellaire a soudainement comm: The Star Atlas suddenly began to shift drastically as a rift grew from its center, tearing the Atlas apart. Fragments of stars wrapped around Novaria and began to pull her toward the rift. Her mother and the other artificers exhausted the last of their powers desperately trying to force her back. She was the only one capable of completing the Star Atlas.
en|Les forces cosmiques au sein de la fa: Cosmic forces within the rift began to transform Novaria, transforming its skin. She struggled and cried, trying to hold on to what little hope she had left, but to no avail.
en|Novaria s'est évanouie. Lorsqu'elle r: Novaria has vanished. When she came to, she found herself chained by astral rings. She couldn't escape fate. She tried to resist; in the darkness she pursued and pursued the fleeting stars, but she could not detach herself from our purpose. We chose it. She will no longer be allowed to challenge us. No creature could...
en|Le dernier espoir s'est allumé dans l: The last hope was kindled in the heart of Novaria. A large explosion lit up the sky in a magnificent spectacle. It was this star! For her, breaking a star... it was unthinkable! She had defied destiny with her own will. The stars were no longer arrogant; they began to tremble at the sight of such power. The astral rings that chained Novaria were also trembling. It was his chance.
en|Novaria s'est libérée en utilisant so: Novaria freed herself using her newfound power. The rings shattered and shattered into countless small pieces.
en|Novaria leva la main et tenait un fra: Novaria raised her hand and held a burning star fragment on her fingertip. She thought for a long time, trying to understand everything. Finally, she realized...
en|Alors que le jour se levait enfin, No: As day finally dawned, Novaria felt a greater calling: to leave the Valley of Stars and seek the location of the shattered star. She raised her head and looked at the fading night.
en|\"Je sais que je n'aurai jamais un po: "I know I will never have power as infinite as yours," Novaria told us, "But I will complete the Star Atlas, and with it I will unlock the secrets of the stars. The destinies that are available to you will also be available to me. Then we will have a level playing field. You will not chain me, or anyone else for that matter. Our destiny will be in our hands."
en|Alors que la nuit tombait, les étoile: As night fell, the stars could only respond with silence.
en|Novaria secoua les fragments d'étoile: Novaria shook off the star fragments and headed towards dawn.
en|Le nom Novaria est d'origine latine e: The name Novaria is of Latin origin and means fresh and innovative. The name "Novaria" recalls "nova", a term used in astronomy to describe a star whose brightness suddenly increases. This fits with its celestial theme and its role as a luminous force on the battlefield.
en|Novaria s'inspire probablement des Pl: Novaria is probably inspired by the Pleiades, beautiful nymphs transformed by Zeus into constellations to save them from the giant Orion of Greek mythology.
en|Le lien de Novaria avec l'Atlas stell: Novaria's connection to the Star Atlas is likely a reference to the fact that the Pleiades were the daughters of the legendary king of Mauretania, the Atlas Titans, the creator of astronomy and geography in Greek mythology.
en|Les vêtements de Novaria lorsqu'elle: Novaria's clothing when she was still human seems to be inspired by typical Arab clothing, particularly that of Morocco.
en|Sa tenue présente des motifs chatoyan: Her outfit features shimmering, luminous patterns resembling stars and constellations, emphasizing her celestial nature.
en|L’ensemble du design de Novaria s’ins: The entire design of Novaria is inspired by the cosmos, stars and celestial elements. She is a manifestation of the Astral Artificer of the Valley of Stars, and her design reflects her deep connection to astral energy and cosmic forces. The dominant colors of his creation are blue, purple and white, all traditionally associated with the night sky and space.
en|Contrairement à la plupart des mages,: Unlike most mages, she can walk through walls, which helps her reposition herself for better attacks or escape dangerous situations.
en|Contrairement à la plupart des mages: Unlike most mages who deal damage in a fixed range, Novaria's long-range skill rewards players for positioning and perfecting their aim, making her one of the few mages to function as a ranged sniper in a sense.
en|When she tracks down a Spawn of Decay: When she tracks down a Spawn of Decay, the hunt is already over. Another demon corrupted by the power of darkness, another weakling who succumbed to the temptation of the God of Darkness – having lost his reason, his will and his self, his flesh and form completely distorted into empty puppets.
en|Obsidia avait déjà ressenti ce pouvoi: Obsidia had already felt this power... before her rebirth, before her death.
en|In ancient times, the Elves occupied: In ancient times, the Elves occupied the vast central plains while the Orcs roamed the lush grasslands to the west. The weak, strange, less intelligent, and scattered races were pushed back to the subterranean realm of the far south, struggling to survive even in this resource-scarce world. Obsidia was one of them. When his race was threatened with extinction, the power of the God of Darkness returned to him.
en|Immense dark power descended, washing: Immense dark power descended, washing over her form. She felt like she was floating in an endless void. Every inch of her flesh transformed as a new world opened before her. The God of Darkness's chisel carved a void in her mind, forcefully filling it with power, wisdom, and vitality—painful, yet intoxicating.
en|Those who had oppressed her tribe wer: Those who had oppressed her tribe were easily crushed, their once-contemptuous gazes turning to terror. Obsidia used this power to unify the world underground. To those who submitted, she granted power; for those who rebelled, their bones were piled up. She named her kingdom the Abyss, and she became its one true sovereign.
en|Lorsqu'Obsidia s'est réveillée de son: When Obsidia awoke from her dream, the Abyss had become a tool of the God of Darkness. Its subjects were thrown into the forefront of an endless conflict between light and darkness. Barely one in ten people survived, and those who did came to view her as a merciless goddess of death.
en|Ces démons dotés de pouvoir ont perdu: These demons with power lost their reason and will and, like puppets in a trance, marched toward death in eternal battle. Perhaps they were already dead from the moment their individuality was removed, Obsidia thought coldly. The God of Darkness had finally bared his fangs: this was no longer his kingdom, but a breeding pool to fuel the cosmic war game of the gods. His subjects were summoned at will and dismissed just as easily. Even Obsidia's mind was corrupted by the dark god's influence, like a thick sludge of chaotic noise seeping through despite its resistance.
en|Elle ne ressentait aucune peur, aucun: She felt no fear, no regret, no remorse – only endless killing intent. But it was her kingdom, and it was up to her to decide life and death. If the Dark God broke his promise, then let this place become his tomb!
en|Obsidia a porté un coup dévastateur a: Obsidia dealt a devastating blow to the God of Darkness during his war against the God of Light, but she was mortally wounded in the process. And soon, she heard the screams of demons outside her palace. Seizing his moment of weakness, the creatures of the Abyss revolted. Despite this betrayal, Obsidia's lips curled into an icy smile.
en|C’était ainsi que devraient être les: This was how the Abyss should be: an unforgiving land with no room for rules and order. Strength and endless conflict were the purest ideals of the Abyss.
en|Il n'y avait pas de dieux pour prier: There were no gods to pray to for blessings, everything had to be taken into one's hands – conquest was its true nature!
en|Elle a permis aux créatures des Abyss: She allowed the creatures of the Abyss to take her blood and power as she entered the long sleep of death. The blood of the first ruler fused with that of the demons, and from then on, she became the Abyss itself, the source of her power.
en|Obsidia ne s'attendait jamais à se ré: Obsidia never expected to wake up. But the power of the Dark God that lingered around the palace where her remains were sealed finally woke her from her long slumber.
en|Elle avait vu cette elfe noire, Selen: She had seen this dark elf, Selena, the next sacrificial pawn of the dark god. In her, Obsidia saw his past: proud, foolish, ignorant of the future and lost in momentary pleasure.
en|Ensuite, il y a eu les Spawns of Deca: Then there were the Spawns of Decay. The blood that had been stolen from him had become the perfect medium of the Dark God. The god's insidious power expanded from within, enhancing their strength, distorting their minds and forms, and destroying their self-will until they became worthless trash.
en|Alors que certains démons étaient cap: While some demons were able to harness this power without becoming mindless husks, these powerful descendants were confined within their narrow circumstances; fighting for power, aspiring to ascend the throne of the Abyss. One day, they too would undoubtedly submit to the God of Darkness.
en|Sa chasse temporairement terminée, Ob: Her hunt temporarily over, Obsidia entered the darkest depths of the chasm. She felt the familiar pulse of the Abyss and those who carried its blood, as visible as the stars in the night sky.
"I will announce the return of the Abyss. I will hunt down every last Spawn of Decay. I will set the trap to kill a god."
en|\"C'est ma terre, mon royaume, mon do: “This is my land, my kingdom, my domain.”
en|« Obsidia » évoque « l'obsidienne » (: “Obsidia” evokes “obsidian” (a dark volcanic glass), which corresponds to its identity as a being of darkness and bone. Her title, "Ruler of the End of Darkness", presents her as a ruler or judge of darkness.
en|Son design visuel utilise du noir, du: Its visual design uses black, gray, and deep purples, which mimic the brilliant, dark luster of real obsidian stone.
en|Visuellement, les éclats d'os flottan: Visually, the floating bone shards, ethereal trails, and dark/ghostly shadow effects draw inspiration from gothic, dark fantasy, and necromantic aesthetics.
en|Elle est le deuxième héros qui peut d: She is the second hero who can disable enemies' sprint or blink skills, the other being Minsitthar.
en|*Souverain de la Fin des Ténèbres *So: *Ruler of the End of Darkness *Ruler of the Abyss
en|Dieu des Ténèbres, Selena, Alice, Tha: God of Darkness, Selena, Alice, Thamuz, Dyrroth (enemies)
en|Princesse innocente qui a grandi dans: Innocent princess who grew up in Swan Castle and genius mage who excels with sword and scepter.
en|Le château de Swan situé près du lac: Swan Castle located near Azure Lake was the stronghold of Prince Alvin of the Moniyan Empire. The first lord of this country, Prince Alvin I, was a hopelessly romantic crown prince. To marry a woman of humble birth, he resigned and yielded the throne to his brother, Sirius IV, leaving Lumina City and settling in the countryside now known as Swan Castle.
en|La maison Alvin et son romantisme se: The Alvin house and its romanticism were then passed down from generation to generation. Prince Alvin II also assumed his royal title from a young age: his brother and eldest son Prince Alvin I focused on religious activities and later became archbishop of the Church of Light. Princess Odette was the [third generation] descendant of the family, and the love story of this elegant and adorable swan princess perfectly attested to the romantic nature of the descendants of House Alvin.
en|Ayant droit au trône, le prince Alvin: Having a right to the throne, Prince Alvin and his family understood the delicate situation they found themselves in and rarely became involved in domestic politics or had much contact with other nobles. Since her childhood, Odette led a peaceful and quiet life within the Château des Cygnes, without ever leaving their territory. But the seemingly calm girl was full of curiosity and longing for the outside world.
en|Au moment où elle a atteint l'adolesc: By the time she reached adolescence, she found the courage to hide under a coat and sneak out to visit the nearby market without her parents' permission. The naive princess once tried to pay for bread with a whole bag of gold coins and gave a beggar all the jewelry she had on her after hearing his routine heartbreaking story, but these little delinquencies just outside her home were enough to make Odette feel adventurous.
en|Mais finalement, ses aventures lui on: But ultimately, her adventures got her into trouble: this clueless young princess only learned what powerlessness felt like when she was harassed by a few thugs in a tavern... Fortunately, in a drunken stupor, Lancelot drew his sword and chased these men away. But Odette no longer knew what to do when she saw her rescuer injured and falling to the ground, her eyes filled with tears. So she made a decision that went against her family's rules: bring the unconscious Lancelot back to the Château des Cygnes.
en|Dans une pièce au sommet de la tour d: In a room at the top of their castle tower, Odette bandaged Lancelot's wound and cast her family's healing spell with a scepter to heal him with the help of a young servant. She spent the whole day and night watching over Lancelot who was about to die, and only breathed a sigh of relief and smiled wearily when the man finally opened his eyes...
en|Les jours suivants, Odette cachait La: In the following days, Odette hid Lancelot inside the Swan Castle so that he could recuperate, and she brought him food every day with the maid and listened to the interesting romantic knight of Castle Gorge play the harp and sing songs about the adventures he had across the land. These songs were amusing melodies that Odette had never heard as she only knew royal music, and the lyrics once again piqued her strong curiosity and desire for the outside world.
en|Les rencontres d'Odette avec Lancelot: Odette's meetings with Lancelot became the greatest pleasure of her day. As she opened up to this new friend, she also told him about her little adventures as rebellious delinquents and even learned from him some sword fighting techniques for self-defense.
en|Au fur et à mesure qu'ils bondissaien: As they bounced around over time, Lancelot slowly became reluctant and withdrawn. He no longer played these funny songs in praise of the hero Lancelot, but often sang the love story between a knight and a young girl, exalting a kind and beautiful princess.
en|L'innocente Odette ne comprit pas la: The innocent Odette did not understand the reason for her change, until the devious servant suddenly asked her in a whisper: "Who do you think Lancelot plays these songs to, Your Grace?"
en|Les paroles de la servante réveillère: The servant's words woke the blind princess. Odette finally understood that someone was subtly courting her!
en|C'est encore une fois la jeune servan: It was once again the mischievous young servant who persuaded Odette not to run away or ignore her court that the princess had the courage to confront Lancelot's feelings. But she still didn't know if she was also in love with him.
en|A mesure que la blessure de Lancelot: As Lancelot's wound healed each day, Odette knew that the day of his departure was approaching. Her morale sank and one day a letter delivered by her father troubled her even more: "Duke Baroque was proposing to me on behalf of his son? What a boring suitor!"
en|Mais Odette se rendit soudain compte: But Odette suddenly realized: wasn't the “romantic knight of Castle Gorge” from the stronghold of House Baroque? So the Duke's son must be...
en|Malgré son cœur qui battait à tout ro: Despite her heart beating wildly, Odette had to feign calm in front of her parents. But when she returned to her room, she couldn't help but laugh inside and even danced happily with the maid. But not knowing how to face Lancelot, Odette realized she couldn't bring herself to see him now.
en|Mais contre toute attente, Lancelot l: But against all expectations, Lancelot left a letter and left without goodbye a few days later. Depressed, Odette finally realized how much she adored him...
en|Jusqu'au soir, après avoir pris sa dé: Until the evening, after having made her decision, Odette wrote a letter to her parents before quietly leaving the Château des Cygnes.
en|Elle suivrait les traces laissées par: She would follow in the footsteps left by Lancelot and seek the love of her life...
en|Le nom complet d'Odette est Princesse: Odette's full name is Princess Odette Alvin.
en|L'épée qu'Odette porte est utilisée c: The sword that Odette carries is used as a focus point for her spells. She does not use the sword by conventional means.
en|Depuis la fondation de l'empire par G: Since Gaius founded the empire, the ruling Monian dynasty has never changed, as Silvanna is a direct descendant of Gaius. This means that Odette, Silvanna and Dyrroth have a common ancestor.
en|Le fait que la dynastie régnante n'ai: The fact that the ruling dynasty never changed shows us its connection to Vexana, who was also a princess of the Monian Empire.
en|L'une de ses citations laisse entendr: One of his quotes implies that the sword is a gift. The sword offered by Lancelot.
en|Lancelot est référencé dans deux de s: Lancelot is referenced in two of his quotes: "Don't ask me why a mage carries a sword!" » "This sword is a gift."
en|Odette s'inspire d'un personnage du m: Odette is inspired by a character of the same name in Swan Lake.
en|Son skin \"Black Swan\" fait égalemen: Her "Black Swan" skin also refers to another character from the same opera.
en|La musique de son Ultimate, Swan Song: The music for his Ultimate, Swan Song is taken from Swan Lake (Ballet Suitte), OP by Tchaikovsky. 20
en|Au début, elle pouvait être achetée a: At first, it could be purchased with Battle Points. Now it can only be obtained by new players through quests, purchased from the Shard Shop using 120 Hero Shards, or from the Lucky Shop using 20 Lucky Gems.
en|Odette est le seul héros qui ne peut: Odette is the only hero that cannot be purchased with Battle Points or Diamonds.
en|Le héros qui utilise ses deux poings: The hero who uses both fists to protect hope and love.
en|Les Abysses gagnèrent en puissance, p: The Abyss grew in power, plunging the Land of Dawn once again into the thick fogs of eternal war. It was a true calamity that spread suffering throughout the Land of Dawn. Especially the southern border of the Moniyan Empire. The rampant menace and corruption of the Abyss has left this place in ruins, and it now stands as a barren wasteland.
en|L'Empire avait depuis longtemps cessé: The Empire had long since stopped trying to reclaim these lands, and the numbers of those fleeing to the heart of the Moniyan for a new life grew by the day. Those who did not want to leave their homeland stayed behind and struggled to make ends meet, but they failed to unite and offer resistance to the advance of the Abyss. Instead, they have adopted brutal force and violence in their efforts to lay claim to the earth's dwindling resources. Conflict reigned over everything.
en|Comme le lointain Pays du Désespoir,: Like the distant Land of Despair, this frontier has fallen into deep decline, an abyss without a glimmer of hope. Until that day comes. A man with a distinctive scar on his back and fists of iron roamed these chaotic lands, purging the injustice and cruelty that dominated them. A long-lost warmth returned to people's hearts as one malevolent force after another fell before him.
en|Personne ne savait d’où venait cet ho: No one knew where this man came from. And so, those he saved would simply call him the “Heavenly Fist”. Yet his name was Paquito.
en|Paquito est né dans un petit village: Paquito was born in a small southwest village of Moniyan. To survive and thrive in a country like this, so far from the royal capital, you had to be strong. And so[,] he had only one dream since he was a little boy: to become the strongest fighter in the world. Paquito tempered his mind, body, and spirit by every means possible in his quest for this power.
en|Un homme réticent a traversé son vill: A reluctant man walked through his village, witnessing the incredible effort Paquito was putting into his training. That's why he decided to stay and trained Paquito, taking him as a student.
en|Dans les mois qui ont suivi, les capa: In the months that followed, Paquito's abilities improved at an exponential rate as he trained under his master. Yet his departure was approaching. Before leaving, he said this to Paquito: the summit, the true essence of combat, does not lie in destruction. It's not about attacking.
en|Paquito continue sans relâche à perfe: Paquito continued tirelessly to perfect his technique in the years following the departure of his master. However, he still had difficulty embodying this essence that his master spoke of.
en|Cela lui a laissé une incertitude au: This left him with uncertainty deep in his heart, so he too left his village, still determined to become the strongest in the world. And so[,] he sought powerful adversaries as he roamed the lands. As he traveled the mountains of Lantis, he found a land rife with injustice and evil. Therefore, he would enter the fray, fighting for justice and annihilating evil, becoming known as the "Heavenly Fist".
en|Alors que Paquito avançait sans relâc: As Paquito relentlessly advanced, a mysterious figure known as the "Dominator" gained great power in the Moniyan Empire. He commanded his subordinates and launched a grand plan to take control of the earth. To fuel his plans, the Dominator plundered these lands already on the verge of collapse, leaving behind cruelty and massacre.
en|Paquito a eu vent de cette série de t: Paquito heard about this series of tragedies, and it made his blood boil. He has sworn to stop this Dominator and eradicate all traces of his control. In his mission to unmask this dark figure and his true identity, Paquito discovered that he was none other than his former master. He had searched for the true essence of what it means to fight, but instead he had been eaten up and spat out by the harsh realities of this world. He had lost everything he once stood for, becoming cruel and ruthless.
en|La loyauté et l'amitié de Paquito env: Paquito's loyalty and friendship to his former master clashed with the justice and morality that had always been so dear to him. He made his decision. The student and the master began an unprecedented battle. Paquito held his ground and received the first of his master's crushing blows – a reward for the teaching he had received. Then they started exchanging blows; a collision of two colossal forces. The master's technique had only strengthened over the years, with dominant advances hitting Paquito until he was on the brink of death. Strength began to leave his body and Paquito thought of those he had worked to save from oppression; their grim looks, how they wanted nothing but peace. It was then that he had his epiphany: the true essence of combat was not to attack or destroy, but rather to defend hope wherever it might be found.
en|Paquito a forcé le Dominateur à la dé: Paquito forced the Dominator to defeat, and the master looked at his former student, filled with regret. His evil forces were subdued and peace flourished in the land.
en|C'est alors que Paquito a mis son sac: It was then that Paquito put his bag on his shoulders and prepared to hit the road again, telling his master: our world is bigger than we think, with powerful adversaries awaiting our arrival, not to mention the powers of evil...
en|Il comptait sur ses deux poings. Avec: He counted on his two fists. With them, he would fight for the hopes and dreams of all who needed him.
en|Paquito est basé sur Manny Pacquiao,: Paquito is based on Manny Pacquiao, a former professional boxer from the Philippines, who is also the current brand ambassador for Mobile Legends: Bang Bang. This is also evident in Paquito's left-handed stance, similar to his real-life counterpart.
en|Dans les prénoms teutoniques, le nom: In Teutonic first names, the name Paquito means “free”.
en|Lors des premières fuites, Paquito s’: When first leaked, Paquito was originally named Parry.
en|Le skin Manny Pacquiao pour Paquito é: The Manny Pacquiao skin for Paquito was initially exclusive to players in the Philippines when it was released as a special collaboration in 2021. It came with special effects, voice lines, and animations referencing Pacquiao's real-life boxing career.
en|Lorsque Paquito est affecté par la dé: When Paquito is affected by crowd control effects being disabled, he is shown in a common defensive stance.
en|nom = Verri Crow Princesse de la forê: name = Verri Crow Princess of Askati Forest As the princess of the Crow clan of Askati Forest, she was born with mutated blood. The mutation could gain its incredible abilities if awakened. When Alice invaded the Askati Forest, Pharsa, awakened, chased Alice away and lost her sight. After that, her lover transformed into a crow to replace her eyes. === Bio === The Raven people of Askati Forest are one of the oldest races still in existence in the Land of Dawn. This race was united by the Raven King, Osana, under whose leadership they perfected the art of Sky Magic. This unique school of magic allows its wielder to transform into a bird, soar through the skies and strike at enormous distances. However, only those whose blood is "awakened" can use it.
en|La noble princesse Pharsa est née ave: The noble Princess Pharsa was born with an unknown blood type that would have enormous potential if awakened, but despite their best efforts, her baffled tribesmen failed to unleash its true power. Soon, Pharsa's special blood became a burden, as ill-intentioned opportunists across the land sought to harvest it for their own benefit. On the day of Pharsa's wedding, the tyrannical witch Alice invaded the Askati Forest, mercilessly killing countless ravens and leaving a trail of smoldering ruins in her wake. Numbed to the core by the carnage around her, Pharsa let Osana's ancient crown fall to the ground. His appearance began to change, as an unprecedented power flowed through his veins: his blood had been awakened. Pharsa's eyes darkened, while one side of her hair turned pure white, and she flew into the sky to unleash a torrential assault of horrible magical power, fierce enough to drive Alice away.
en|Verri, l'amour de sa vie, ne pouvait: Verri, the love of his life, could not bear to see his fiancée suffer a life of blindness alone and chose to accompany Pharsa wherever she went, using his own magic to become permanently linked to Pharsa and allowing her to see through her eyes. Pharsa wishes her power had never awakened, she wishes even more that her home hadn't been destroyed, but this witch took everything from her, and now it was time for revenge...
en|Lorsque Pharsa fut libérée pour la pr: When Pharsa was first released, she was known as Fasha. Its name was later changed to Pharsa.
en|\"Pharsa\" pourrait être inspiré du m: "Pharsa" could be inspired by the Arabic word for "bird" or "eagle", which corresponds to Pharsa's avian and flight abilities. As a mage hero with a powerful bird companion and the ability to glide through the air, this interpretation fits his design and skills well.
en|Pharsa est un prénom féminin très rar: Pharsa is a very rare female first name often used by the Muslim community which means "Riding".
en|Dans certaines langues, son nom est F: In some languages, her name is Fasha, which may be an abbreviation of the Arabic word Farasha meaning "Butterfly", symbolizing beauty, transformation and freedom.
en|En tant que princesse du clan Crow de: As the princess of the Crow Clan of the Askati Forest, she was born with mutated blood.
en|Avant sa refonte, elle était temporai: Before her rework, she was temporarily banned from Brawl games because her ultimate skill gave her enemies a huge disadvantage due to its short cooldown, range, and damage.
en|Se désintègre en une brume et s'enrou: Disintegrates into a mist and wraps itself around Verri for fast travel
en|Un ancien soldat des frontières de l': A former soldier from the frontiers of the Empire who took on the chains of sin to defend his people.
en|Phoveus était autrefois un soldat Mon: Phoveus was once a Moniyan soldier from the borders of the Lantis Mountains. His unit, made up of fourteen hardened warriors, was well known among the locals for their reckless bravery, fighting the Abyss using dubious but effective methods.
en|Au cours d'une offensive désastreuse: During a disastrous Empire offensive, Phoveus was forced to summon the power of an evil god to turn the tide. Despite the lives he saved, Phoveus was labeled a sinner for conspiring with a demon. On the way to his execution, the Evil God attempted to take over Phoveus' body, but Phoveus took advantage of the situation to bond with the Evil God in a stone monolith. While the Empire continues to condemn Phovéus as a sinner, those on the border will forever consider him a hero.
en|Le monolithe sans nom, sous le crépus: The nameless monolith, beneath the crimson twilight of Moniyan's sky, the scent of blood wafting in the cold air hinted at a horrific battle not long ago.
en|Les roues d'un chariot de prison rebo: The wheels of a prison cart bounced shakily over rocks as it was pulled along the mountain road. "Farewell to yesterday, to forgotten glories, on this familiar night. Open my chest and engrave this oath in the hearts of those on the border..."
en|Dans le wagon, une silhouette obscure: In the carriage, a shadowy figure revealed itself through a gap in the cage. His armor broken, his face mutilated and his empty eyes glinting coldly in the moonlight.
en|Un soldat a hurlé en heurtant le char: A soldier screamed as he hit the cart, interrupting the mumbled song. Growing anger rose to his face as he cursed the prisoner:
en|\"Nous avons perdu treize mille bons: "We lost thirteen thousand good men in this battle! And what you did... it's like spitting on their graves!"
en|Le vent s'est levé comme un couteau a: The wind rose like a sharp knife. After a few moments of silence, Phoveus turned and retreated into the darkness. The voice rang out from the cart once again, but this time it was not the chants of the border guards. Instead, thirteen names were whispered over and over again. These seemingly ordinary names once brought joy and hope to the villages of the Lantis Mountains. These were the names of fathers, brothers and sons who had protected the border for generations. But now they were just names written disdainfully on a piece of Moniyan Border Regiment paper.
en|\"On se souviendra de vos hommes comm: “Your men will be remembered as sinners and traitors, just like you.”
en|À ce moment, un monolithe de pierre t: At this moment, a stone monolith carried in the same wagon began to move. Phoveus watched in disbelief as an eye slowly opened on the monolith; the same eye that led him to this destiny. She focused on Phoveus, reflecting the madness in his eyes.
en|Cette rencontre n'était pas une coïnc: This meeting was not a coincidence. Centuries ago, Phoveus' ancestor sealed an evil god atop a great pillar. The pillar eroded over the years until it finally became a monolith on the border of the Moniyan Empire and the Abyss. After this fateful battle, the monolith was placed in the wagon to be moved. Phoveus knew everything about the demon, and the demon knew everything about him.
