en|\"Reprenez mon pouvoir et revendiquez: “Take back my power and claim everything that is rightfully yours…”
en|Phoveus resta silencieux mais ne rema: Phoveus remained silent but did not notice his hand unconsciously moving towards the whispering monolith. The thirteen names echoed again in the darkness, this time accompanied by the sound of nails scraping against stone. He had invoked these names countless times. They were etched into his soul, as were the trusting eyes, the exhausted smiles, and the exhausted faces that responded.
en|Mais tout cela n’était plus. Il ne re: But all that was no more. All that remained were the anonymous tombstones erected at the border. The border they protected with blood and tears and from which they could not find peace even in death. Phovéus is then reminded that names are only useful to the living.
en|Lorsque les Abysses commencèrent à at: When the Abyss began to relentlessly attack Mount Lantis Pass, trying to break the Empire's defensive line, a desperate Phoveus found himself staring at a giant demonic eye. He felt as if the eye was peering into his soul, searching for something... "Ah, he desires power overwhelming enough to stop this senseless slaughter."
en|Sous l'influence de l'entité démoniaq: Under the influence of the demonic entity, Phoveus and his men managed to rout the Abyssal forces that day. The trumpet of momentary victory and the frustrated howls of the Abyss were carried to the center of the Empire, fueling the Empire's ambitions to reconquer lost territories.
en|Ainsi, le Chevalier Impérial Tigreal: Thus, the Imperial Knight Tigreal was sent to the pass with a force of thirteen thousand soldiers. They arrived in good spirits, with their golden armor shining in the afternoon sun. But when the fighting began, Phoveus realized that these men had lived in the light for too long and had forgotten how insidious the darkness could be.
en|La ruse des Abysses et l'inexpérience: The cunning of the Abyss and the inexperience of the Empire's field commanders caused their entire second regiment to be surrounded by the Abyssal forces. Phoveus looked desperately at his men still holding the line, their battered bodies refusing to fall, and closed his eyes. He told Tigreal that he would rather be cursed by the world than let another comrade become a nameless tombstone. Defying Tigreal's orders, Phoveus called to the eye. When he appeared before him, he used his blood to break the demon's seal.
en|Un instant plus tard, Phoveus a percu: An instant later, Phoveus slammed into the middle of the battlefield and began pushing the Abyss back, giving Tigreal and the remaining soldiers time to retreat. But in the eyes of the Empire, there was no greater sin than colluding with a demon. On the other hand, the lives of the soldiers he saved had no consequence on his crime. Phoveus was branded a traitor and imprisoned for execution.
en|De retour dans le chariot, le pouvoir: Back in the chariot, demonic power began to wrap around Phoveus' arms like hellish chains. Spikes protruded from it and pierced deep into Phoveus' flesh. Finally! The Evil God had patiently waited and plotted for this very moment, and now he was about to take the flesh and blood of his former enemies.
en|Le chariot tourna, révélant le visage: The cart turned, revealing Phoveus' calm face in the moonlight. There was a determination in his eyes that a desperate man should not have had. Phoveus suddenly grabbed the chains and, with the weight of his own soul, began to push the demon back into the monolith. The more the demon struggled, the tighter the chains became. In the process, Phoveus' body and soul began to merge with a monolith as its power flowed into him.
"We are alike in one way. We have the patience of wise men, hiding our true ambitions or that fateful day. Unfortunately, you will never have the chance to know the words engraved on the back of this monolith..."
en|Phovéus essuya la poussière du monoli: Phovéus wiped the dust from the monolith, revealing the ancient oath engraved on it:
en|La cage éclata en morceaux pour révél: The cage burst into pieces to reveal Phoveus, covered in chains and pulsing with power. With a heavy step, he backed heavily towards the border, dragging the monolith behind him.
en|Le monolithe emprisonnait désormais d: The monolith now imprisoned two souls, but Phoveus had never felt so liberated, for he had finally gained the power to save his people.
en|Phoveus est le 7ème et fait partie de: Phoveus is the 7th and is one of the heroes offered free to players when they are released. The other free heroes are Faramis, Belerick, Silvanna, Luo Yi, Benedetta, Mathilda, Floryn, Edith and Julian.
en|Phoveus est le troisième héros à être: Phoveus is the third hero to be given away for free during Event 515 (of 2021). The others are Faramis, Luo Yi and Julian.
en|Dans les anciennes lignes vocales, As: In the old voice lines, Astaros speaks in Latin on some quotes.
en|Il était autrefois un héros de dégâts: He was once a magic damage hero, but was retooled to physical damage while retaining some magic damage.
en|Phoveus n'a pas reçu de skin depuis s: Phoveus has not received a skin since its release on May 11, 2021, breaking the record for the longest time for a hero to receive a skin other than the base skin, which is Faramis (1255 days) in a few main days as of June 30, 2020.
en|Il faisait équipe avec l'escouade de: He teamed up with the ranger squad, but was reworked to become a lone warrior.
en|Son doubleur anglais, Jordan Reynolds: His English voice actor, Jordan Reynolds, is married to Valentina's voice actress, Mara Junot. Outside of MLBB, they are also known for voicing Adam Warlock and Storm from Marvel Rivals.
en|Boy et un Icefield Wolf, des partenai: Boy and an Icefield Wolf, partners who understand each other well.
en|Les Feldans sont une tribu nomade ord: The Feldans are an ordinary nomadic tribe found in the middle of Northern Vale. Like most local populations, they live near the forest and lead a peaceful and quiet life as experienced hunters.
en|Mais il y avait une exception. Popol,: But there was one exception. Popol, a naughty boy who was known as the expert prankster and little adventurer of the tribe, always seemed to be the center of attention. Unlike the other calm and composed Northern Valers, he was full of vigor and imagination. Thanks to Northern Vale's warrior tradition, Popol had mastered the art of spear throwing since childhood. He often joined the adults in their hunt and returned with a cart full of prey.
en|Écouter les adultes chanter des chans: Listening to adults sing songs about legendary heroes after drinking was his favorite pastime. He dreamed of becoming one of them and having his name sung by others like Popol, the Intrepid.
en|Cependant, les membres de sa tribu ne: However, his tribe members did not take his ambition seriously and laughed it off as if it were a childish dream. Popol apparently couldn't stand it. In order to impress others, he played all sorts of well-planned pranks on them, which resulted in the villagers, especially children, viewing him as a monster and staying away from him.
en|Plus il était aliéné, plus il avait e: The more alienated he was, the more he wanted to get their attention by playing even more pranks. However, it continued to produce the opposite effects. In the end, he had no friends left. Alone and desperate, he decides to do something extraordinary to reverse his image once and for all.
en|Par une nuit sombre, Popol quitta le: One dark night, Popol left the village and ventured into the mountains. He planned to kill a fierce ice wolf all by himself to impress others. He stumbled into the thick forest and examined his surroundings curiously. As expected, he lost his orientation in the darkness and fell into a trap.
en|Alors que Popol tombait dans la fosse: As Popol fell into the deep pit, he hit his head on a rock, staring into his line of vision. After regaining consciousness, he looked around, wondering where he was, and the first thing he saw at the bottom of the hole was a pair of glowing blue eyes, which scared him. But when the moonlight shone into the trap, he saw the owner of the eyes - a trapped ice wolf, to whom he later gave the name Kupa. One of its front legs was trapped and injured by a beast trap, and because of starvation it could barely move.
en|Popol aurait pu tuer Kupa sur-le-cham: Popol could have killed Kupa there and then, but when he raised his spear, he saw the same loneliness in Kupa's eyes. If he killed Kupa, he would find himself completely alone in the darkness of the trap. Hesitantly, he put down the spear and tried to help Kupa.
en|Au début, ils étaient sur la défensiv: At first, they were defensive and hostile towards each other. But over time. The two lonely souls finally let their guard down and considered themselves to be of the same gender. Although they were trapped in the pit, they felt a warm sensation in each other's presence. The beast trap became the bridge of their friendship. And perhaps because of their loneliness, Popol treated Kupa as a listener and playmate. He even playfully threw snowballs at Kupa's muzzle.
en|Mais à ce stade, Kupa mourait presque: But at this point, Kupa was almost starving. Popol hesitated for a moment, before sharing the food he was carrying with the dying Kupa.
en|Cependant, Popol a décidé de nourrir: However, Popol decided to feed Kupa and Kupa was eventually saved from starvation. In Kupa's mind, all humans were cold and ruthless like hunters. It was usually always a life or death situation between them and the ice wolves. But Popol was different. Having been hunted alone in the forest since birth, Kupa felt Popol's kindness and warmth for the first time. Over time, Popol and Kupa began to survive on rats and other small creatures, which Popol caught with his spear and then shared with Kupa.
en|Quelques jours passèrent et les deux: A few days passed and the two struck up a subtle friendship. Unfortunately, they didn't have much food or rats left to survive. And to make matters worse, their first visitors were not people who came to rescue them, but a group of vultures. They rushed to the trap and began to attack. Popol threw his spear at the vultures, but he could not repel them, while Kupa could only fight aimlessly with a free paw.
en|Sous le harcèlement continu des vauto: Under the continuous harassment of vultures, they became food for the birds. It was at this moment of danger that Popol made a remarkable decision: he threw down the spear and with all his might, tore open the beast trap, in order to help Kupa escape. With his back exposed, he was grabbed by a vulture and lifted from the trap in mid-flight. Just as Popol was losing all hope, a thunderous roar erupted. Kupa jumped out of the pit and threw himself at the vulture, freeing Popol from its grip.
en|Maintenant, alors qu'ils combattaient: Now, while fighting side by side, Popol and Kupa showed incredible synergy and fended off all the vultures for good. From now on, they become the best partners in the adventure. They traveled across the frozen lands and began a new chapter in their adventure story together.
en|Popol & Kupa s'inspirent fortement de: Popol & Kupa draw heavy inspiration from Nordic and Arctic tribal cultures, particularly their hunting traditions and close ties to animals like wolves and dogs. His fur-lined outfit and tribal markings resemble the Inuit, Sami and Viking hunters of the Viking Age who lived in icy regions.
en|Popol et Kupa sont les premiers héros: Popol and Kupa are the first heroes whose names and titles are shared. Although he is considered a hero alongside Popol, Kupa is a summoned unit, due to the fact that he summons her to be resurrected.
en|Popol est l'un des rares héros à bris: Popol is one of the few heroes who breaks the 4th wall through one of his quotes. Specifically, he refers to either his "Dark System" teammates or those of lower rank in certain matches involving him.
en|Popol et Kupa sont les seuls tireurs: Popol and Kupa are the only snipers in Mobile Legends: Bang Bang with a full set of four skills.
en|Kupa est basé sur Fenrir, qui est un: Kupa is based on Fenrir, who is a monstrous wolf in Norse mythology. In Old Norse texts, Fenrir plays a key role during the events of Ragnarök.
en|Nunu & Willump de League of Legends,: Nunu & Willump from League of Legends, Rexxar from Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos, and Beastmaster from Dota 2 are some of the Summoner/Beastmaster type heroes in other RTS/MOBA games, similar to Popol and Kupa.
en|Le style de jeu du duo est similaire: The duo's playstyle is similar to that of traditional beast tamers or shamans of various cultures.
en|Popol et Kupa, Kadita et Lunox partag: Popol and Kupa, Kadita and Lunox share the same English-speaking voice actress, Alicia Gerrard.
en|Un ange aimé et respecté par les gens: An angel loved and respected by the people of this world.
en|Avec la fin de l’ère d’or, une monstr: With the end of the Golden Age, a monstrous abyssal fissure has once again opened within the Land of Dawn, and from its depths dark energies rise once again.
en|L’obscurité de la nuit allait retombe: The darkness of the night was about to fall again. The Abyss loomed menacingly.
en|Pour protéger ce monde, le Seigneur d: To protect this world, the Lord of Light has selected a number of pure maidens who will become pregnant with angels. Legends said that only women could be angels – for example, those chosen by the Lord of Light could only give birth to daughters.
en|Argus et Rafaela sont des frères et s: Argus and Rafaela are twin siblings born in the Moniyan Empire. The Sacrists of the Monastery of Light forced their mother to imbibe holy water, in the name of the Lord of Light. Therefore, she would give birth to an angel in her temple. Their mother was certainly an ordinary woman, she and her lover faithfully devoted to each other. Yet, under the supervision and persuasion of the sacrists, she had no choice but to accept the "honor" bestowed upon her by the Lord of Light.
en|La grossesse de celle qui porte un an: The pregnancy of the one carrying an angel is an incredibly long and slow process. During these three years, his heart grew heavy, tortured by the solitude of such a long ordeal. She longed for her lover, longed to be with him again. After two years, she couldn't take it anymore and escaped the temple to find him; together they lived happily once again. But it will only be a short-lived happiness.
en|Les sacristes ne tardèrent pas à la r: The sacrists did not take long to find her. Her lover was killed before her eyes for threatening to desecrate the divine lineage of the Lord of Light, and she was sent back to the monastery.
en|Une autre année s'écoula, à la fin de: Another year passed, at the end of which she died in childbirth. To everyone's surprise, she gave birth to a pair of twins: one of whom was a baby boy.
en|Les yeux de l'enfant ressemblaient ét: The child's eyes strangely resembled those of his late mother's lover. The Cleric of Light soon realized this, realizing that the boy was born of humanity – and yet, incredibly, he possessed the power of angels. The sacrists attempted to kill him but their efforts were thwarted, for every time they tried, a dazzling light burst from Rafaela, protecting her brother from all harm.
en|Cela a été considéré comme un miracle: This was considered a miracle. So they gave up any idea of ​​killing the boy. Instead, in silent unanimity, it was decided that the circumstances of his birth should remain a secret from everyone.
en|Le Monastère de Lumière a dissimulé l: The Monastery of Light hid the truth so masterfully that even the twins themselves knew nothing about it.
en|Argus et Rafaela ont donc grandi ense: Argus and Rafaela therefore grew up together, following the same education and training. What set them apart, however, was the fact that she was seen as a magnificent ray of light: a holy and immaculate being. In people's eyes, Rafaela was their only true angel. Argus, on the other hand, was kept in the shadows and forever deprived of the glory that was rightfully his.
en|Pourtant, Rafaela aimait beaucoup son: However, Rafaela loved her brother very much, as she loved him. The two underwent entirely different treatments, and Argus was constantly warned that his only choice was to live in his shadow, but the two were nonetheless an inseparable couple who cared deeply for each other. Both were extremely good-hearted and, as soon as they came of age, swore to uphold their common mission: to use their power to protect peace and spread Light.
en|Les éloges et l’admiration sont arriv: The praise and admiration came in waves, but alas, it only fell on Rafaela. Even though Argus was just as exceptional as his sister and, like her, had gone to great lengths to maintain the path of Light, everyone's praise was instead directed only at the gentle Rafaela. While he fought for the Light, it was in darkness that Argus remained.
en|Rafaela en a été témoin et a voulu à: Rafaela witnessed this and repeatedly wanted to speak on behalf of her brother: to change people's attitudes towards him. However, she didn't succeed even once. She didn't understand: why was he treated like an outcast? No matter how hard he tried, no matter how much he sacrificed, they knew everything and yet they treated him the same...
en|Rafaela était une âme toujours attent: Rafaela was an always attentive soul, and so she quickly noticed that Argus' attitude towards humanity was beginning to change. In his eyes, human nature was malicious and selfish. That being the case, why should he even bother trying to curry favor with them? The twins had several arguments about this, as Rafaela conversely believed that the Abyss was the root of all darkness in life. She believed that humanity was good and kind, but that these qualities disappeared once tainted by the Abyss. Neither was willing to change their point of view, no matter how hard they tried to persuade the other.
en|Les deux divergents en termes de phil: The two diverge in terms of individual philosophies. Over time, however, their battlefield tactics also began to differ.
en|Au milieu de la bataille, Argus a per: Amidst the battle, Argus persevered tirelessly, eager for a quick victory, but ultimately fell into the demons' trap. Rafaela ordered the troops to retreat, but Argus ignored her as he headed towards the demons' nest.
en|Argus revient du camp ennemi avec une: Argus returns from the enemy camp with a demonic blade in his hand, a weapon emitting a malevolent aura. A dark, menacing mist swirled around him. Although Rafaela worked hard to purge him of this darkness, he broke away and killed the troops all around her before escaping.
en|À partir de ce moment-là, Rafaela rec: From that moment on, Rafaela tirelessly searched for every tidbit about her brother's whereabouts. His behavior did not surprise the Monastery of the Sacrists of Light; on the contrary, they claimed that they had long considered him a corrupt soul and that this day was inevitable. Their words shook Rafaela to her core, and for the first time, her faith was shaken as well. She punished them severely and left the Monastery of Light to find her lost brother.
en|Plusieurs mois se sont écoulés. Final: Several months have passed. Finally, it was in the Arid Lands that she found Argus. What she didn't realize, however, was that the Argus she knew was now long gone. The golden aura in which he once bathed, his radiant wings, were nowhere to be seen; and in their place was an oppressive aura of cruelty and pitch-black wings.
en|Il n'y avait plus de retour en arrièr: There was no going back now... Rafaela wanted to increase her staff and put an end to this, as was her duty. Yet memories of the past floated through her mind, one after the other, and she couldn't bring herself to do it. Argus looked at her from afar and silently turned to leave.
en|À partir de ce moment-là, il ne fera: From then on, he will only sink further into the darkness of the Abyss. Constantly wracked with pain and confusion, constantly sinking deeper and deeper. Over time, Rafaela became the woman she is today: an angel admired by all, savior of the apocalypse and incarnation of Light. Despite this, she could never bear to face the one who was closest to her.
en|Le temps passe, pour ne jamais reveni: Time passes, never to return. No matter human or angel, no one can go back.
en|Rafaela est la première guérisseuse e: Rafaela is the first healer and pure support in the game.
en|La peau de Rafaela, « Déesse de la fe: The skin of Rafaela, “Goddess of Fertility,” may be based on Isis, the goddess of healing and magic, and was crucial to ancient Egyptian religious beliefs.
en|Rafaela est l'un des rares héros du j: Rafaela is one of the few heroes in the game to receive an official tournament skin, "Biomedic MPL Special".
en|Elle fait partie des héros qui n'ont: She is one of the heroes who does not have a base skin.
en|Argus et Rafaela sont des jumeaux dys: Argus and Rafaela are dysgotic twins
en|Pouvoir de la Lumière sacrée en soign: Power of Holy Light by healing allies and dealing damage to enemies.
en|Un loup-garou errant dans la sombre f: A werewolf wandering the dark forest in search of revenge.
en|Ignorant les avertissements des villa: Ignoring the villagers' warnings, Roger decided to settle just on the edge of the Black Forest, just a few kilometers east of the Megalith Wastes. His countless years in the Imperial Army had made him a resolute man...and perhaps too stubborn for his own good. Regardless, now that his days as a soldier were over, he was determined to hunt in the dark forests and make a living from its riches.
en|La Forêt-Noire abritait toutes sortes: The Black Forest was home to all manner of unsavory vermin. But none were more terrifying than the hundreds of wolves lurking in the shadows. With their new Wolf King, White Fang, having awakened ancient magical abilities within him, they became even more ferocious. And while the forest lacked prey, wolves gradually expanded their hunting territory and began to appear outside the forests. Still hunting in packs, they began to attack unwary travelers who dared to pass by.
en|Bien déterminé à garder cette menace: Determined to keep this threat at bay. Roger followed Whitefang's pack. finally finding them huddled around a small village. He had barely arrived when a guttural howl broke the calm of the night. send out the wolf pack and ravage everyone in its path.
en|Le village fut plongé dans le chaos,: The village was thrown into chaos, with White Fang himself standing in the middle, about to feast on an injured little girl. Without wasting any time, Roger lunged directly at the beast and ripped the girl from its grasp. White Fang jerked back, digging his claws into the hunter's chest as he tried to pull the girl to safety.
en|Sans se laisser décourager par ses bl: Undeterred by his injuries, Roger managed to repel the vicious horde, warning White Fang never to return to the village with the same ferocity as that of the wolves. The Wolf King retreated with his pack, but when he looked back, Roger felt his blood run cold with the hatred in the wolf's eyes.
en|Hanté par la terreur qu'il ressentait: Haunted by the terror he felt that day, Roger couldn't help but fear that White Fang would return for revenge. He began training the surviving villagers to fight wolves, especially the little girl he saved whose name he later learned was Ruby.
en|Cependant, peu de temps après, Roger: However, soon after, Roger noticed bizarre changes in his body. He suspected that they were somehow connected to the injuries White Fang had inflicted on him. Concerned for the safety of others, the hunter fled the village in secret.
en|De retour chez lui, les soupçons de R: Returning home, Roger's suspicions were soon confirmed, as the ancient magic carried by White Fang had begun to infect his own body.
en|\"Même celui au cœur pur, celui qui n: “Even the pure-hearted, the one who never once misses his nightly prayers, is powerless to resist the curse of the lupine when the full moon looms in the night sky.”
en|Le moment est vite arrivé. Lorsque la: The moment quickly arrived. When the glow of the full moon illuminated the vast grasslands around the Black Forest, Roger could do nothing but watch in horror as his body slowly changed shape, transforming into a spitting image of White Fang himself. Fearing harm to those he was sworn to protect, he had no choice but to leave his home and embark on his own journey. <!--"old tradition"-Roger lived outside the Dark Forest, east of the Megalith Desert. He was an experienced hunter who hunted for a living. Many dangerous animals live in the Dark Forest, and the most fearsome among them are not the rare magical creatures but the old wolf king "White Fang", who leads a ruthless pack of more than a hundred strong wolves. They were a cooperative pack of predators under the control of their leader, White Fang, who also possessed the influence of an evil power that awakened magical abilities in him.
en|Pour répondre à leurs besoins de chas: To meet their hunting needs, the wolf pack gradually began to prowl outside the confines of the Dark Forest, often attacking travelers along the way. In the spirit of justice, Roger considered getting rid of this public menace and followed in the footsteps of the White Fang. Roger caught up with White Fang and caught him off guard just as the Wolf King was about to devour a little girl, Ruby. Roger shot the White Fang and ended his life by cutting open the wolf's belly. Roger had defeated White Fang, but the evil power lurking inside White Fang contaminated the hunter.
en|Les pouvoirs maléfiques étaient suffi: The evil powers were dark enough to prevent even a man with the purest heart, a man who never forgets to say his prayers at night, from turning into a werewolf under the full moon. Under the call of the moon, Roger was shocked to discover that the old legends were true. He had become a Lycanthrope, commonly known as a werewolf. To avoid losing his sanity by transforming and harming his family, Roger had no choice but to flee far from home.-->
en|Le nom Roger a des origines germaniqu: The name Roger has Germanic origins and means "famous spear" or "renowned warrior". It comes from the old High German name Hrodger, which is composed of two elements: "hrod" meaning "fame" or "glory" and "ger" meaning "spear".
en|Roger est actuellement le seul héros: Roger is currently the only Fighter/Marksman hybrid hero in MLBB, known for his ability to switch between human and werewolf forms.
en|Le personnage de Roger est la fusion: The character of Roger is the fusion of the hunter and the big bad wolf from Little Red Riding Hood, just like Ruby, whose main character she is based on.
en|Roger fume un cigare lors de sa libér: Roger smokes a cigar upon his initial release, but was returned to comply with MLBB age classifications. His match model always has his cigar when observed closely.
en|Roger est mentionné par Chang'e dans: Roger is mentioned by Chang'e in one of his quotes. This is a reference to his wolf form, as wolves are known to hunt many types of prey, including rabbits, Chang'e's favorite animal. This hostile relationship is one of the most popular relationships in fiction.
en|Il s'inspire également quelque peu de: He also takes some inspiration from Warwick from League of Legends and Ursa and Lycan from Dota 2.
en|Le skin \"Anubis\" de Roger est inspi: Roger's "Anubis" skin is inspired by the Egyptian god Anubis, featuring golden armor and a jackal-like werewolf form.
en|Son skin \"Phantom Pirate\" est quelq: His "Phantom Pirate" skin is somewhat inspired by cursed pirate myths like The Flying Dutchman and Davy Jones' crew from Pirates of the Caribbean.
en|Il partage le même doubleur japonais,: He shares the same Japanese voice actor, Tsuyuzaki Wataru, with Clint,
en|Une fille qui a grandi avec l'aide de: A girl who grew up with Roger's help.
en|Cela aurait pu être juste une autre n: It could have been just another peaceful night in a remote village near the outskirts of the Dark Forest, but they were interrupted by the vicious howls of wolves in the distance. In a small cabin, a little girl was kneeling by her bed and praying. Next to her were disproportionate giant scythes. Indeed, she prayed for the return of the legendary Hunter – Roger. Only he could save the village from wolf vandalism.
en|Des années plus tôt, Roger avait sauv: Years earlier, Roger had saved his family from a pack of wild wolves, which they had accidentally encountered while wandering the Land of Dawn. His bravery wreaked havoc among the wolves. At the request of the village elders, Roger ultimately stayed to train the villagers. One day he left the village without warning and no trace was found.
en|Ce qui se passe dans les contes de fé: What happens in fairy tales can rarely be the same in reality. On a silent, moonless night, Pale Tusk, the new Wolf King, took the village by surprise and slipped away with his people. In the end, Ruby's grandfather and grandmother both died, protecting Ruby, who in turn narrowly escaped by hiding under her grandparents' corpse.
en|Personne ne pouvait imaginer qu'à par: No one could imagine that from the moment she witnessed the death of her grandparents, her character would completely change. Indignant, she got up, picked up the scythes and, to everyone's shock, rushed into the pack of wolves and slaughtered almost all of them. Beneath his seemingly weak appearance now hid a disturbing and irritable soul. Pale Tusk was the only survivor among the wolves. Looking to the horizon, Ruby was determined to put an end to everyone who was responsible for the deaths of all those good, innocent people, including her grandparents.
en|Pale Tusk n’a jamais été vaincu aupar: Pale Tusk has never been defeated before, but this time it happened in the most severe way. But during a fight, Ruby hesitated to shoot the wolf, who seized the opportunity and knocked Ruby down, scratching her in the left eye. Surprisingly, Pale Tusk didn't want to kill, but turned and fled.
en|Ruby a progressivement repris conscie: Ruby gradually regained consciousness after Pale Tusk left, but unfortunately, she lost an eye during the battle. Now, every time she hears the wolves howling, her eye fills with rage and pain.
en|Le nom Ruby doit son nom à la pierre: The name Ruby is named after the gemstone ruby, which is red and symbolizes passion, strength and vitality. This fits with his red-themed design, scythe, and blood-related lifestealing abilities. The color red (ruby) also represents blood, aggression and power, matching its vampiric life-stealing gameplay.
en|Son apparence pourrait être inspirée: Her appearance could be inspired by RWBY's Ruby Rose, who herself is alluded to in the fairy tale character Little Red Riding Hood.
en|Son histoire et son titre « Le Petit: Its story and title “Little Red Riding Hood” also refer to Little Red Riding Hood. Additionally, in the game files, she is called Xiaohongmao, which translates to "Little Red Riding Hood" in Chinese.
en|Son histoire originale a été rétablie: Its original story was reinstated upon the release of the so-called "family update", as the story of Ruby ripping out the heart of Haas the wolf (later renamed Whitefang) still beating and drinking his blood, as well as Ruby falling into madness, was deemed too dark and disturbing for many of the game's younger audiences.
en|Old Ruby, image complète, son cache-œ: Old Ruby, full image, her eyepatch is over her left eye, but in the game model it's in her right eye.
en|Les yeux rubis sont de couleur bleue: Ruby eyes are blue in color but the model has green eyes.
en|Ruby a l'un des taux de vol de vie le: Ruby has one of the highest lifesteal rates in the game. Her passive (Let's Dance!) allows her to gain huge vamp spells from items and skills. With the right build, she can recover all of her HP in just a few attacks!
en|Elle s'inspire du Petit Rouge de Moon: She is inspired by Little Red from Moonton's Magic Rush, which is also a clear reference to Little Red Riding Hood.
en|Elle partage son doubleur en japonais: She shares her Japanese voice actor, Iwasaki Chiaki, with Natalia.
en|Un épéiste en quête d'invincibilité,: A swordsman seeking invincibility, used by Laboratory 1718.

A swordsman seeking invincibility, used by Lab 1718. Formerly called Duan Meng and obsessed with kendo, Saber came to Lab 1718 to transform in order to pursue perfection, but his memory was erased and he was transformed into a killing machine. The torture of his memories pushed him to permanently destroy the laboratory and set out in search of the past. ===Knowledge=== Deep in the northern mountains of the Riverlands of Cadia lies a quiet and peaceful village. This village is home to the legendary Tianyin Swordmaster sect and is also where Duan Meng spent his childhood perfecting his technique.
en|Dès qu’il fut assez vieux pour ramass: As soon as he was old enough to pick up a bamboo sword, Duan Meng was determined to become a great sword master. While everyone was still sleeping, he would already be training hard and would continue until the sun set and the moon was clear and bright.
en|Il savait que les exigences pour entr: He knew that the requirements for entering the Tianyin Swordmaster Sect were high, and so, after countless days and nights of training in wind, rain, and snow, the gates of the holy temple finally opened to Duan Meng. Soon, his extraordinary talent and obsession with swordsmanship attracted the attention of the leader, Master Longma, who was once a disciple of the Great Dragon and the spiritual leader of the Tianyin Swordmaster Sect. Under the guidance of Master Longma, Duan Meng soon excelled among his peers and became the leader of the new generation of students.
en|Au fil du temps, Duan Meng s’est lass: Over time, Duan Meng grew tired of the stoic life of personal cultivation in the mountains. His obsession with swordsmanship and his innate ambition made him eager to challenge stronger foes so that he could create his own legend and spread it across the world like the legendary swordsmen who inspired his personal journey. However, Master Longma refused his request to go down the mountain.
en|\"Ce n'est pas encore le moment. Vous: "It is not yet time. You have not yet become a truly invincible swordsman." The young and lively Duan Meng refused to agree with his master's point of view. He had enough confidence in his own abilities and hoped to improve his swordsmanship through constant combat alone.
en|Au cours des années suivantes, Duan M: Over the next few years, Duan Meng traveled throughout the Riverlands of Cadia, defeating one swordsman after another, including the adherents of the Dragon Altar. He continued to climb towards the title of “Best Swordsman” without a single defeat.
en|C'était jusqu'à ce que Duan Meng renc: That was until Duan Meng met a man who would become his ultimate rival, Zhixu. This man came from nowhere and had no teacher. His life was like that of a sword, perfectly formed and complete in itself.
en|Dans leur bataille, Duan Meng a été v: In their battle, Duan Meng was defeated, completely unable to fight back. In order to one day defeat Zhixu, Duan Meng isolated himself in the mountains and embarked on a painstaking training program for three long years.
en|À la fin de ces trois années, Duan Me: At the end of these three years, Duan Meng felt ready to fight Zhixu again and came out of the mountains. But as fate would have it, his opponent made even greater progress during these three years. He was defeated again and his sword was even cut in two by his opponent.
en|Les échecs répétés de Duan Meng lui o: Duan Meng's repeated failures reminded him of his master's words: "It is not yet time. You have not yet become a truly invincible swordsman." However, Duan Meng knew that he had already done everything he could and there was no way the sword in his hand could become any faster or stronger.
en|Afin de rechercher un style d’escrime: In order to seek a truly invincible style of swordsmanship, Duan Meng left the confines of the Riverlands of Cadia and traveled across the Land of Dawn. During his travels, he heard rumors about Lab 1718, that they could boost the human body's potential through artificial transformation, granting additional power. Duan Meng couldn't help but inquire further. If this rumor was true, he might still have a chance to reach the pinnacle of swordsmanship. As long as he could get stronger, he was ready for anything.
en|A cette époque, les méchants scientif: At that time, the evil scientists from Laboratory 1718 were also interested in this swordsman from the East. They were preparing a new augmentation project to create a human weapon. As soon as the two sides reached an agreement, an unprecedented transformation began.
en|Après de nombreuses expériences et op: After numerous experiments and operations, the project finally came to fruition and a being with mechanical strength, human sword skills, and sentience was born. But after waking up, Duan Meng had forgotten everything about himself, including his own name. His creator then gives him a new code name: Saber. A sword from the 1718 Laboratory, the Saber became a tool used to hunt down those who stood against them.
en|Bien entendu, tout cela faisait parti: Of course, this was all part of Lab 1718's plan. They intended to attract the right person to help them carry out their human weapons plan. Once the transformation was completed, Duan Meng, who once dreamed of reaching the pinnacle of swordsmanship, no longer existed. Instead, the merciless mechanical killer, Saber, was born.
en|Même si ses créateurs étaient convain: Even though her creators were convinced that they had achieved great success, over time, the familiar movements, the feeling of holding her sword in her hands, kill after kill, day after day, something began to stir within Saber. As a warrior, he could not accept being reduced to the status of a mere killing machine, and could feel the memories buried deep within his mind fighting to be remembered again. He begins to question his own past and the meaning of his existence.
en|Tard dans la nuit, tourmenté par des: Late that night, tormented by fragments of his memories, Saber severed the neural control implant in his head, destroyed the humanoid weapons project laboratory, and embarked on the long, lonely path to exile.
en|Dans les années qui ont suivi, le Lab: In the years that followed, Laboratoire 1718 never gave up its quest for what it considered to be a failed product. Through the constant fighting and wandering that followed, Saber was determined to rediscover his name and origin. The fragments of his memory constantly bubbled to the surface, guiding him towards the slow discovery of his past. There was one thing he was certain of: he knew that he had not yet become a truly invincible swordsman and that he still had a destined opponent waiting for his next challenge.
en|Dans la première version du jeu, il y: In the first version of the game, there was a quote that Saber's favorite sport was baseball.
en|Son skin \"Force Warrior\" est le pre: His "Force Warrior" skin is the first Starlight membership skin. Additionally, his “Iron Hound” skin is the first skin in the revamped Starlight membership.
en|Il est équipé de deux épées avec Fann: He is equipped with two swords with Fanny, Lapu-Lapu, Karina and Martis.
en|Dans la première version, il porte un: In the first version, he wears a helmet with the letter H which represents Professor Henry.
en|Son skin « Codename Storm » est le pr: His skin “Codename Storm” is the first Legend skin.
He is the first Assassin in the game.
en|Dans l'ancienne tradition, Saber et A: In old lore, Saber and Alpha were like brothers who escaped from the lab with Beta, who was killed.
en|Duan Meng ou Duanmeng Village sans no: Duan Meng or Duanmeng Unnamed Village, Cadia Riverlands
en|Fille elfe noire tombée dans les Abys: Dark elf girl fallen into the Abyss.
en|Au sud de l'Empire Moniyan se trouve: To the south of the Moniyan Empire lies a bottomless chasm, carved into this barren landscape as if an ancient demon used the sharpest blades to carve a disfiguring scar into the Land of Dawn. People call this the Shadow Abyss.
en|Enfermé au fond de cet abîme légendai: Locked at the bottom of this legendary abyss is the most terrible demon in the Land of Dawn: the Dominator of the Abyss. But as the seal slowly fades, the will of the abyss gradually strengthens.
en|Les démons au fond de l'abîme élabore: The demons at the bottom of the abyss continually hatch plots to strengthen the power of darkness, persuading misguided believers to offer them sacrifices for their evil cause. They use these sacrifices to feed the "Devil of the Abyss", a monster formed of the purest dark energy that waits in the darkness to devour its prey.
en|Selena, une jeune Elfe Noire, a été s: Selena, a young Dark Elf, was sacrificed to the Shadow Abyss by fanatics in exchange for dark energy, and as Elves are the Devil of the Abyss' favorite sacrifice, Selena was immediately offered by the demons. The Abyss Devil thrust maniacally into Selena, intense pain and despair spreading to every corner of the young Elf's body. Just as she was about to be consumed by the dark magic, a miracle happened: a warm blue light enveloped the girl, and the dark abyssal magic and this mystical power began to wage a savage battle inside her fragile young body.
en|Selena s'est réveillée et s'est retro: Selena awoke to find herself lying in the depths of the abyss, her skin now a mysterious blue tone and her lavender eyes filled with a scarlet glow, with the Devil of the Abyss lying quietly beside her.
en|Les Démons des Abysses étaient occupé: The Abyss Demons were busy wondering what had just happened. They didn't know that the will of the Abyss had arrived. This girl is deeply loved and that love has protected her from darkness. The Abyss and the Moon Goddess – these two opposing forces have achieved balance within his body. An ancient and heavy voice echoed in the demons' minds: "Leave these girls to me." She will become the most powerful warrior in the Shadow Abyss! The demons obeyed the orders of the abyss and left her there. When Selena reappeared before the demonic inhabitants of the Abyss, with the Devil of the Abyss at her side, she had completely forgotten her past.
en|Elle a découvert qu'elle pouvait habi: She discovered that she could skillfully manipulate the abyss to release dark magic, a demon capable of tearing her enemies to shreds. The will of Shadow Abyss designated her as its voice, making it her duty to rule over the demonic inhabitants. Even the proud Queen of Blood Magic began to feel disconcerted upon seeing this young Dark Elf, not only because the abyss had chosen her, but also because Alice could sense the terrible power that lay inside this seemingly cute and mischievous young girl.
en|À l'exception de son skin de base \"W: With the exception of her base skin "Wasp Queen", all of Selena's skins were initially released for a limited time.
en|Le nom Selena vient du nom grec « Sel: The name Selena comes from the Greek name "Selene" (Σελήνη) or Selina, meaning "moon" or "moon goddess". In Greek mythology, Selene was the Titan goddess of the moon, often depicted riding a chariot across the night sky.
en|Selena a été l'un des premiers héros: Selena was one of the first MLBB heroes to have two distinct skill sets in one hero. Her switching mechanics make her both an assassin and a mage, depending on the form.
en|Selon la tradition, Selena ignore et: According to lore, Selena ignores and breaks the rules of time, meaning that even if time is stopped, backwards or forwards, she can do the exact opposite of any of the three that happens.
en|Selena était censée sortir à la date: Selena was supposed to release on Chang'e's release date, but the developers decided to delay her release until a month later (after Kaja) because some of them saw her as overpowered and others saw her as underpowered.
en|Sa flèche abyssale (2e compétence sou: Her Abyssal Arrow (2nd skill in Elven form) can stun enemies for up to 2.5 seconds, making it one of the longest stuns in the game!
en|Au cours de son passage sur le serveu: During his time on the Advanced Server before release, his second Elven Form skill, name = Abyssal Arrow, lasted up to 4 seconds, which was later reduced to 3 seconds due to it being an overwhelming CC for a single skill.
en|Le skin Abyssal de Selena « Lady Veng: Selena's Abyssal skin "Lady Vengeance" pays a wicked homage to Kerrigan from Starcraft.
en|Le skin Zenith de Selena \"Curse of C: Selena's Zenith skin "Curse of Cinder" is a reference to Ashes. In Selena Zenith's story, her half-sisters call her Little Ash. The name "Cinder" is also a shortened form of "Cinderella", from the classic fairy tale. Additionally, her outfit, theme, and skin story are inspired by it, while Vexana's Zenith skin is inspired by Snow White.
en|Elle et sa sœur aînée, Karina, partag: She and her older sister, Karina, share their Japanese voice actor, Nokubi Naoko.
en|L'actrice de voix de son skin S. T. U: The voice actress of her S. T. U. N. skin in the 2021 515 Together music video, Kim Eun Jae, is known for providing vocals for Rumi from Netflix's KPop Demon Hunters. Coincidentally, both characters belong to the same species as half-demons.
en|Princesse de l'empire Moniyan et rein: Princess of the Moniyan Empire and Queen Regent.
en|Le prince avait disparu et personne n: The prince had disappeared and no one knew if he was dead or alive! For the sake of the country and the safety of its people, King Aurelius II had decreed to expand the Order of Imperial Knights and establish fortresses on the outskirts of Moniyan, to strengthen the defense of the empire. Meanwhile, the Imperial Knights continued their search for clues to the prince's whereabouts. The Imperial Knight is sought after day after night. They had almost crossed the entire Land of Dawn, but all they found was an interminable wait. The Aurelius royal family was drowning in sorrow. For young Silvanna, the tragic memory of this time was too heavy. As a princess, Silvanna has always had a heart of justice and compassion since she was little. After her brother's disappearance, she kept the queen company almost daily. For years, they had both been waiting for a miracle to happen in the Imperial Castle. However, in the meantime, day after day, and year after year later, the queen eventually became ill and bedridden due to physical and mental exhaustion.
en|Dix ans s'étaient écoulés après cet é: Ten years had passed after this tragic event. As the Queen and King grew older, Princess Silvanna, now a remarkable adult, always wanted to do something for her empire. She wanted to let go of the grief, but every time she thought of her brother, the sadness and frustration always came back to her. Every night in her dream, Silvanna felt like her brother was within her reach, but she just couldn't hold him. Shortly after, on the day of Silvanna's coming-of-age ceremony, she decided to ignore her princess status and join the Imperial Knights. Maybe this was the only way she could cope with the pain! In the Order of Knights, Silvanna would have to undergo intensive training. She would no longer be treated like a royal. Silvanna had strong faith and worked harder than others. Her faith had made her more and more powerful. All the scars on his body were the best proof of his training journey. In a short time, she had become the most powerful female knight among the Imperial Knights. But even then, Silvanna still couldn't get Tigreal's special approval. Tigreal knew the cruelty of the true battlefield and knew there was no room for error. Deep down, Tigreal saw that Silvanna had already acquired all the skills of a knight. He could also see Silvanna's determination. But after all, she was a royal of the empire. Tigreal did not want another successor to the empire to be at any risk again.
en|Mais un jour, tout d’un coup, l’armée: But one day, suddenly, the army of Demons arrived at the gates of the empire... Moniyan was faced with disaster and war. Tigreal ordered Silvanna to remain in the empire while he leads the entire Order of Knights into battle.
en|À mi-chemin, Tigreal reçut un rapport: Halfway there, Tigreal received a report from the Order of Knights that, to prove herself, Silvanna had crossed the forbidden zone, the Imperial Sanctuary, where countless unknown creatures lurk. Even Tigreal himself didn't have the confidence to escape unscathed. At this moment, a sharp cry came from afar, making Tigreal shudder. He immediately takes the elites of the Order of Knights back to the Imperial Sanctuary while the rest of the knights march towards the outskirts of the empire to fight the demons. On the way, he prayed that he would be able to arrive in time. He prayed that his fear would not come true.
en|Devant les dieux du Sanctuaire Impéri: In front of the gods of the Imperial Sanctuary, a giant figure slowly approached the injured knight. The Seed of Light was shining in the distance and its powerful opponent was approaching. In the Imperial Archives, Silvanna once read a legend about the Seed of Light in the Imperial Sanctuary. But the powerful creature that keeps the Seed of Light before her became an obstacle she could not overcome. But Silvanna knew that only when she was protected by the Lord of Light could she truly become the Holy Knight and lead the empire to victory in battle. And for this reason, she was ready to sacrifice her life...
en|Mais ce n'était pas nécessaire, la dé: But that was not necessary, Silvanna's determination impressed the God of Light and he passed on some of his magical powers to Silvanna. With this power in hand, she overtook the Guard and put an end to the chaotic army. Once the battle was won and peace returned, Silvanna's courage earned her great fame.
en|Avec du pouvoir, du courage et de la: With power, courage and royalty in her blood, she became the princess of the Moniyan Empire and perhaps… also its protector.
en|Le nom Silvanna est une variante du f: The name Silvanna is a variation of the feminine Silvana or Sylvana, meaning “she who lives in the forest” in Latin.
en|Alternativement, Silvana est égalemen: Alternatively, Silvana is also an Italian female given name as the female counterpart of Silvano, which is an Italian male given name.
en|Silvanna est le seul héros capable d': Silvanna is the only hero capable of inflicting Restrain status.
en|Silvanna est le premier héros à avoir: Silvanna is the first hero to have a skin based on a player's credit score.
en|Au début de son développement, Silvan: Early in her development, Silvanna was supposed to be a tank destroyer mix, but the developers decided to focus more on her magical fighter identity.
en|L'armure et la lance de Silvanna ress: Silvanna's armor and spear resemble medieval European knights, blending holy warrior aesthetics with magical power. Its design is inspired by the culture of medieval knights.
en|Ses citations dans le jeu « Guerriers: His in-game quotes "Moniyan warriors, show your teeth" is an idiomatic expression meaning show your strength or willingness to fight. (like an animal showing its teeth). The phrase is British English usually used in Europe, as the Moniyan Empire is based in Europe.
en|Le fait que la dynastie régnante n'ai: The fact that the ruling dynasty has never changed shows us its relationship with Odette and Vexana.
en|Silvanna partage son doubleur en japo: Silvanna shares her Japanese voice actor, Takada Sakie, with fellow heroes Moniyan, Carmilla and Lesley.
en|Alucard, Fanny, Granger, Harith, Tigr: Alucard, Fanny, Granger, Harith, Tigreal (co-members of Lightborn)
en|Un garçon pur et libre d'esprit avec: A pure, free-spirited boy with unwavering determination, drifting across the golden sands.

A pure, free-spirited boy with unwavering determination, drifting across the golden sands. Amid the windswept sands of Agelta's barren lands, a boy named Sora drifts as freely as flowing clouds. Pure and free-spirited, he brandishes his fists surrounded by ever-changing clouds, sometimes like thunderclouds crackling with fierce lightning, other times accumulating in thick cumulus clouds to protect him from the fury of the desert. Adventure calls to Sora like a seductive song, drawing him deep into the unexplored ruins of the desert where he seeks mysterious wonders. Yet the people know that when droughts threaten and despair sets in, he will ride the winds, bringing the precious rains their parched lands need. Sora now continues his journey along the ancient Emerald Road, carrying rain-bearing clouds to every corner of the desert and bringing hope to every desperate tribe.
en|=== A Cloudseeker's Song === Quatre-v: === A Cloudseeker's Song === Ninety-nine oases crossed, ninety-nine sandstorms weathered.
en|Au cœur des ruines antiques, là où le: Deep within the ancient ruins, where thunder calls, mystical clouds gather.
en|Nuages ​​mystiques, oh nuages ​​mysti: Mystical clouds, oh mystical clouds, grant me your life-giving rain, protect me from the swirling sands and wake the sleeping earth...
en|—Le voyageur Camel Bell, la chanson d: —The Traveler's Camel Bell, A Cloud Seeker's Song
en|Il y a des siècles, une lutte née de: Centuries ago, a struggle born of greed triggered a catastrophic explosion of a fragment of the Twilight Orb in the heart of Agelta, wiping out many ancient cities and reducing the once magnificent Emerald Road to ruins. Since this cataclysm, Agelta has become known as the Agelta Drylands, consumed by the relentless sands, its former glory fading into the endless burning expanse. Yet there are still young souls moved by this ancient song of the cloud seeker, who dare to chase the clouds across the dunes with unwavering determination. Just like Sora, who first heard the cloud seeker's song during a devastating drought.
en|\"Aîné ! Je vais certainement trouver: "Elder! I will definitely find the mystical clouds! And bring life back to this desert!"
en|Sora déclara son intention avec une c: Sora declared his intention with ardent conviction, but the tribal elder just shook his head with a weary, knowing smile – adults, after all, should never risk their lives on meaningless legends. But Sora did not let himself be influenced, his voice resonated in every corner of his tribe. When the moon reached the top of the dunes, other young hearts kindled by her determination gathered in the shadows. They carried their travel bags and set off together into the vast unknown, chasing the dreams of the mystical boxes.
en|Au début, l’aventure semblait pleine: At first, the adventure seemed full of wonder and possibility. But with only endless seas of sand stretching out before them, their true ordeal began. As their wineskins dried under the merciless sun, hope withered like flowers in the burning desert. "I can feel it in the air: the mystical clouds are resting not far from here. Just a little further!" Sora showed an expression of contentment. The others closed their eyes and sniffed the air. They also began to feel this crisp mist sensation in the air. This quickly lifted their weary souls, and they continued on their way, crossing the dunes to… an oasis! Was it just a coincidence, or had their collective hope sparked a miracle?
en|Mais leur quête était loin d’être ter: But their quest was far from over, and after this blessed respite came another round of howling sandstorms. When the strongest storm hit, they lost all direction, cowering against the rocks, clutching their precious packs in their arms. But amid the howling winds, Sora gathered their cloaks piece by precious piece and weaved them into an ingeniously designed tent, as if conjuring his own cloud against the fury of the sandstorm. Outside their tent, the wind and sand raged with ancient fury; inside, Sora imagined a future full of hope: they would find the mystical clouds, the elders would welcome them home with unspeakable pride, and their tribe would blossom with life again... As the light in Sora's eyes shone brighter than the desert sun, his once-shaken companions found comfort.
en|Après avoir traversé quatre-vingt-dix: After crossing ninety-nine oases and withstanding ninety-nine sandstorms, the mystical clouds still eluded them. Even as Sora's faith burned intact, his companions' resolve crumbled one by one until he could no longer hold them back. They finally reached the heart of the desert, where no mystical clouds awaited them, only ruins swallowed up by endless sand. Worse still, a colossal sandstorm that devoured the skin fell upon them, threatening to bury them along with every trace of their desperate journey.
en|\"C'est fini. Il n'y a pas de nuages: "It's over. There are no mystical clouds."
en|\"Tout ce voyage était une course fol: “This whole trip was a wild ride!”
en|\"Sora, combien de temps vas-tu conti: "Sora, how long are you going to keep lying to yourself!"
en|Alors que ses compagnons s'effondraie: As his companions collapsed in despair and anguish, Sora fixed his gaze on the approaching storm, and from his eye came a sound: the faint but unmistakable rumble of thunder. "Hey, remember the end of the song? 'In the heart of ancient ruins, where thunder calls, mystical clouds gather'. We're almost there!"
en|Sora se tourna vers ses compagnons br: Sora turned to his broken companions:
en|\"Je porterai tous nos espoirs jusqu': “I will carry all our hopes to the end!”
en|Sans hésitation, il sauta dans la gue: Without hesitation, he jumped into the maw of the storm.
en|La fureur de la tempête s'empara de S: The fury of the storm grabbed Sora and pulled him inward, but instead of being torn apart, he found himself floating in a strange place. Here he saw puffs of clouds and streaks of sand that took the shapes of the young adventurers who had traveled here in search of the mystical clouds.
en|Sora entendit soudain leurs voix réso: Sora suddenly heard their voices echo:
en|\"J'ai juré à mes amis de trouver les: “I swore to my friends that I would find the mystical clouds!”
en|\"Je ne laisserai plus Agelta être un: “I will no longer let Agelta be a wasteland of despair!”
en|\"Notre tribu refleurira avec la vie: “Our tribe will flourish again with life!”
en|Suite aux échos, Sora aperçut un étra: Following the echoes, Sora saw a strange radiance pulsing in the center of space – a fragment of the Twilight Orb whose explosion had once fractured the Agelta Wastelands, its lingering energy still coursing through that sacred space. This energy possessed the miraculous capacity to transmute the abstract into reality; the unfulfilled dreams of all those adventurers seeking power had been touched by its influence, crystallizing in the monuments that surrounded it. An immense surge of determination filled Sora's heart as he reached out for the power core: if this could truly give form to their hopes, then let it resonate with him...with everyone who had ever sought the clouds in this desert!
en|En un instant, les nuages ​​et les il: In an instant, the clouds and illusions dissipated, flowing toward Sora's outstretched hands – evaporating, expanding, soaring into the sky, condensing into living clouds. Thunder cracked like the awakening of the world as Sora emerged from the eye of the storm, transformed into a mystical cloud like in the legends. His took the form of swelling cumulus clouds to protect against the fury of the sandstorm, then storm clouds to shatter the ancient debris with lightning - until finally, the chaos became silent.
en|Lorsque la tempête s'est dissipée, le: When the storm cleared, the skies opened. The long-awaited rain fell in torrents, and his companions finally understood the true meaning of the Cloudseeker's Song: he who seeks the mystical cloud must, through unwavering determination, become the cloud itself.
en|Désormais, Sora porte dans ses paumes: Now, Sora carries clouds in his palms that will never fade, as eternal as the determination in his heart. He travels the vast golden sands of Agelta with Belerick and Floryn, breathing new life into a parched land. When new adventurers passed by singing this ancient song, the cloud that guided them stopped to join their chorus.
en|Le nom Sora est dérivé du mot japonai: The name Sora is derived from the Japanese word "空 (sora)", meaning "sky", "heavens" or "empty space". For this reason, the name is often associated with feelings of freedom, openness, hope and serenity.
en|Lorsque Sora a été divulgué pour la p: When Sora was first leaked, he was called Cirrus. In meteorology, cirrus clouds are delicate, wispy white clouds that form at high altitudes, usually above 20,000 feet. Due to their altitude, they are composed entirely of ice crystals. This feature also aligns well with Sora's cloud-based appearance.
en|Certaines publications sur les réseau: Some social media posts indicate that Sora and Floryn are lovers, although these images were considered edits and are confirmed to be fake.
en|Sora est le premier héros à avoir 2 U: Sora is the first hero to have 2 different Ultimates by swiping left to Thunder Form and right to Torrent Form.
en|L'immortel Roi Singe, résolu et infle: The immortal Monkey King, resolute and inflexible like the mountain that carried him.

The immortal Monkey King, resolute and inflexible like the mountain that carried him. Sun, the immortal mountain spirit born from a magical stone, wandered freely between heaven and earth until one day the cries of a group of pandas caught his attention. It was from them that he learned of the existence of death. Although confused by this sudden revelation, the pandas mistook him for the mountain deity. In particular, a little panda named Li Li fell in love with Sun and devoted his days to picking peaches for the Monkey King. But when a flash flood hit the panda village one day, Li Li was lost in the torrents while searching for peaches. Sun arrived too late, and despite the pleas of the other pandas, he was unable to bring his friend back from the dead. It was then that Sun suffered a loss for the first time. Unable to understand his grief, he fell into a deep sleep. Millennia have passed, and many more would have passed if Sun had not been awakened by a battle between dragons. After slaying the Black Dragon and unknowingly saving the Riverlands of Cadia, he questioned the Silver Dragon about immortality and finding his purpose. Instead of the answer he sought, the dragon gave him the name Sun and the task of being the guardian of the earth. But what does this imply? Sun was once again lost in thought... ===An immortal existence=== Before the cataclysmic upheaval awakened him, he had been asleep for millennia.
en|Au fond d'un long rêve, il contemplai: Deep in a long dream, he contemplated majestic waterfalls in all their splendor and hills adorned with flowery fauna. A little panda emerged from the green woods and called out to him. In the end, all these visions converged on a single butterfly, emerging from the confines of its sleeping reverie.
en|Il s'est réveillé à présent, un être: He has awakened now, a being born from the spiritual energy of the mountain, formed within the rocks and forged over millennia. His domain spanned the limitless expanse of creation, heaven and earth submitting to his whim, and his alone. But at the height of his celebrations, he finally discerned a deep and unknown emotion seeping into his existence. Perched on a solitary branch, he gazed for centuries at full moon nights, perplexed by the barely perceptible melancholy that threaded its way deep into his heart like a delicate thread.
en|\"Grand Roi Singe ! Regardez ce que j: "Great Monkey King! Look what I brought! I climbed to the highest peak and picked the plumpest peaches!" He looked at the bustling scene under the tree, and memories of that small figure, a little panda named Li Li, stirred within him. In the eternity of his existence, this moment marked a brief but significant interlude.
en|À cette époque, il errait librement p: At that time, he roamed freely among the sprawling mountains between heaven and earth. The mysteries of its origin and final destination eluded him, but an unprecedented feeling of freedom enveloped him. It was only when a mournful wail fell on his ears that he was drawn to the black and white creatures, who were crying because of what they called "death." What was this “death”? Intrigued by this mysterious entity, he cast a single fleeting glance, and thus unknowingly became entangled in their story. In the story presented to him, the very essence of the mountain spirit had frozen into a stone, forming an immortal being, none other than himself, the great Monkey King.
en|Dans un premier temps, il écarta les: At first, he brushed aside the disturbances and moved to another mountain peak, where he continued to rise early in the morning, drenched in dew, reveling in the isolation of the mountains. However, a small creature deep in the forest cried incessantly, invoking the Monkey King's name with persistent cries that echoed through the canopy, disturbing its peaceful solitude. Annoyed, but curious, he parted the thick veil of the forest and fell on the source of the tumult: his little limbs were damaged and worn out by incessant work. At that moment, their gazes intertwined and a radiant glow flickered in the creature's eyes.
en|Sauver la créature et ses proches du: Saving the creature and its kin from the raging torrent was enough of an afterthought. These creatures were marked by intractable stubbornness. Well aware of the merciless power of river floods during the rainy season, they nevertheless clung tenaciously to their meager homeland. The Monkey King had lived eons and developed miraculous abilities akin to godhood. Among his many skills was complete mastery of river diversion and the construction of shrines on rocking slopes. He passed on these skills not out of charity but solely out of a desire for peace and tranquility.
en|Pourtant, un panda avait une ténacité: Yet a panda had a tenacity that exasperated the Monkey King. Day after day, he clumsily crossed the hills and valleys just to present to the Monkey King what he considered to be the finest peaches. It was an unwavering devotion that the Monkey King could not avoid.
en|Malgré l'irritation initiale du Roi S: Despite the Monkey King's initial irritation, as the days turned into seasons, he grew accustomed to the daily ritual of eating a perfectly ordinary peach, as well as the presence of the panda who had introduced himself as Li Li. The Monkey King even began to slightly enjoy their mundane conversations. Mortals possessed a primordial penchant for naming everything, and Li Li was no exception. He chattered endlessly, insisting that the Monkey King had a name. The pandas even named their village Spirit Creek. Invariably, Li Li always asked him the same question.
en|\"Avez-vous trouvé un nom aujourd'hui: “Did you come up with a name today?”
en|\"Je sais que tu es le grand Roi Sing: "I know you're the great immortal Monkey King, but that's not your name, is it? Everything in this world still needs a name."
en|C’était vraiment très vexant. Le Roi: It was really very upsetting. The Monkey King moved to a higher mountain and, as expected, the mornings became peaceful again. However, a particular desire began to awaken within him. He found himself drawn back from the once disruptive hustle and bustle, eagerly awaiting the arrival of this little panda who would defy all odds to cross the mountain forests. As the days passed in silence, his desire only intensified. He was suddenly seized with the urge to seek out Li Li and ask her why everything in the world had to have a name. It had become a maddening distress that had taken root within him.
en|Cependant, en descendant de la montag: However, as he came down from the mountain, he heard those pitiful groans again. But this time, it was Li Li who had succumbed to what the pandas lamented as death. Three days earlier, rain had caused another flood. The fierce roar of the currents could not reach the most distant peaks, and when the river carried Li Li away, he still clung to a peach. In his final moments, he reassured his friends, unwavering in his belief, that the Monkey King would surely come to his aid, for there was nothing the Monkey King could not do.
en|\"Vous devez être capable de sauver L: "You must be able to save Li Li, right? He believed in you! Please use your divine powers! We implore you, great Monkey King, please save him!" The Monkey King was frightened by his helplessness. What was life? What was death? How could he save Li Li when he couldn't even understand these concepts? Question after question swirled through his mind like a storm.
en|\"Je ne peux pas le sauver. Je ne peu: "I can't save him. I can't save anyone! I'm not a god, I'm... I'm..."
en|Qui était-il ? Il n'avait même pas de: Who was he? He didn't even have a name.
en|Il courut en avant, l'esprit consumé: He ran forward, his mind consumed by the idea of ​​the permanence of death.
en|Il s'enfuit vers le nord. Mais où all: He fled to the north. But where was he going? Where do we go after death?
en|Puis, une révélation le frappa comme: Then a revelation struck him like a bolt of lightning: the path north pointed to the very mountain of his birth. Did death mean he would never see Li Li venturing across the hills and rivers again?
en|Le lieu de naissance, la maison de ch: One's birthplace, one's home held the power to console even the most broken souls... At least that's what he heard the pandas say one day.
en|Il arriva enfin au lieu de sa naissan: He finally arrived at the place of his birth, where the broken stones from which he was born still stood atop the peak. He gathered them in a tight embrace, and in that moment, those cold, lifeless stones seemed to vibrate with palpable heat. He allowed himself to fall asleep and slept there for millennia, until the world convulsed and roared, waking him once more.
en|Sa conscience replongea dans le boule: His consciousness plunged back into the upheaval that had awakened him. It turned out to be a black dragon, covered in blood and relentlessly crashing into a barrier that had inexplicably formed around it.
en|\"D'où vient cette mouche gênante ?\": “Where did this annoying fly come from?”
en|Il a vaincu le dragon seulement pour: He defeated the dragon only to see the arrival of another, identical in appearance but silver instead of black. However, this one wasn't there to fight. The silver dragon began to explain what had happened while the Monkey King slept and how the land had changed greatly over the ages. Crowds of refugees had fled the ravages of war and sought refuge here. The silver dragon seemed to be a guardian responsible for their safety. However, a schism had torn him and his brothers apart. For the sake of these mortals, the silver dragon had no choice but to suppress his own kin, a painful duty that had inadvertently caused a cataclysmic vortex in the northern sea. In light of this calamity, the silver dragon had decided to calm the storm with its own body.
en|Le Roi Singe, qui était maintenant co: The Monkey King, who was now fully awake, listened half-heartedly while gathering his own thoughts. What was the meaning of existence for an immortal like him? He still hadn't found the answer in all his sleep. But before him stood the silver dragon, apparently sharing the same fate.
en|Peut-être que cette créature pourrait: Perhaps this creature could reveal the answers to the questions that had eluded it. "Since I helped you, answer this question for me. You're an immortal, aren't you? Do you ever get bored of just... existing?"
en|Le dragon rit. Cela faisait une étern: The dragon laughs. It had been ages since anyone had asked such a question, and never so bluntly. The last one to inquire... well, that's a story for another day. The story now focused on the stone monkey.
en|\"Le destin tisse sa tapisserie pour: "Fate weaves its tapestry for all living beings, guided by the hand of fate. Yet you and I, unbound by life or death, are exempt from their mortal suffering. Thus, it is our sacred duty to protect the world, the cycle of life, and the fleeting moments between them. Stay vigilant here, and when the time is right, I will reveal to you the truth you seek."
en|\"Attends, qui es-tu ? Comment sais-t: "Wait, who are you? How do you know all this?"
en|Le dragon avait déjà disparu dans les: The dragon had already disappeared into the waves, leaving behind ripples that spiraled into the vortex. "Allow me to grant you a name," an echoing voice sounded, "One that embraces the cosmos of existence. As guardian of this realm, your name will embrace all. You will be known as 'Sun'." As the sea began to calm down after the dragon descended, Sun's heart also regained a sense of serenity. But then he realized...
en|\"Quel genre de réponse était-ce ? C': "What kind of answer was that? That's complete nonsense! I was just tricked into standing guard here. Well, I have a name now, but how is it written? All that about the cosmos and such... it's gibberish to me."
en|Après avoir marmonné pendant un momen: After muttering for a while, Sun settled back down on the same rock. This time he looked up at the sky, as if hearing a familiar voice. How he longed to see Li Li again so he could finally tell her his name.
en|L'inspiration classique du personnage: The classic inspiration for the character is Sun Wukong from the 16th century Chinese novel: Journey to the West. His staff and ability to summon clones are direct references to the mythological figure.
en|Son nom vient d'un mot chinois qui si: Its name comes from a Chinese word meaning “grandchild or descendant.”
en|L'ancienne version de Sun était capab: The old version of Sun was able to summon three clones, one of his name = Simian God and two of his name = Clone Techniques, but the reworked version can only summon two clones, one of his name = Endless Variety and one of his name = Clone Techniques.
en|Lorsque les clones de Sun sont vaincu: When Sun's clones are defeated, they swing their staff and disappear.
en|Son skin « Rock Star » est un clin d’: His “Rock Star” skin is a visible nod to Elvis Presley.
en|Le doubleur anglais de Wicked Flames,: Wicked Flames' English voice actor Jimmie Yamaguchi also provides Zilong's current voice.
en|Un exorciste de Zhu'an qui a hérité d: An exorcist from Zhu'an who inherited the power of Immortal Nuo.
en|Tambours et gongs tonitruants, lumièr: Thundering drums and gongs, blazing lights. Suyou was lying quietly on the edge of a tall building with his hands behind his head. His lips stretched into a smile as he observed Zhu'an's bustle at night. A prosperous city reflected in his eyes. Under the eaves, laughter could be heard as children wearing traditional Nuo masks ran past. “Immortal Nuo, bless the land, Immortal Nuo, our most auspicious guardian! Little did the carefree children know that right above them, Suyou, the last successor of the Exorcists of Nuo, was listening, with the sacred mask and blade of Nuo, looking down with a smile. Suyou jumped to her feet like a spring and enjoyed a long stretch. He had just woken up from a dream about the past. Over ten years ago, the sky darkened and the wind howled while moans could be heard from all directions. The lingering obsessions and evil thoughts of the dead had gathered in this place, creating a phenomenon known as the Echo of Wickedness and threatening to consume the entire village. A young Suyou could only cower in fear among the rubble and wait helplessly for death to claim him. Suddenly, a massive figure broke through the clouds with a trident in hand. His fierce stature stood between the village and the echoes of wickedness like an angry mountain. The next moment, an agile figure wielding a holy blade rushed in front of Suyou, towards the evil scourge. He was an exorcist from Nuo. With a single blow, he split the sky. With another, he swept away the scourge like freshly fallen dust. There was no need for a third. That day, the fearsome power of Immortal Nuo was deeply engraved in a boy's heart. Inspired by the miracle he had witnessed, Suyou decided to travel the country, helping people in any way he could, as its savior.
en|Dix ans passèrent et Suyou se retrouv: Ten years passed and Suyou found himself following trails to a small town near Zhu'an in the Cadia Riverlands. The city was shrouded in echoes so thick you wondered how anything could survive in such a place. But the townspeople lived happily, unaware of the danger in which they found themselves. Strange phenomena were forming due to the concentration of echoes, only for the townspeople to look away without a care in the world. Suyou quickly found the reason. An old exorcist lived in the town and maintained a kind of fragile balance. The same one who had saved him all those years ago. Even as the echoes were about to devour the town, the old exorcist continued to lie and reassure the townspeople that everything was fine. Young Suyou didn't understand how his hero could have fallen into such a state. Suyou firmly believed that deceiving these people could only lead to disaster. Why was the old exorcist playing with their lives? The slightest misstep would surely doom them all. Suyou was forced to conclude that the exorcist was a fraud, so he set out to warn the town of the danger they were in. However, this caused complete panic and only accelerated the growth of echoes. It was only then that Suyou realized that the world was not filled with valiant heroes, but with ordinary people with their countless worries and fears. And the oversaturation of negative emotions is what creates the echoes of unkindness. After learning of the impending disaster, their fear would only fuel the echoes until they devoured everything. For the townspeople, their faith and hope were the silver lining that protected them in this dire situation. Nuo's power comes not from the heavens, but from the strength of human faith. The old exorcist has always struggled with fear and uncertainty in people's hearts. But the human heart easily wanders and gets lost without direction. Those guiding them were the Exorcists of Nuo, using faith to manifest Immortal Nuo. To repair his mistake, Suyou helped the old exorcist prepare the Nuo ritual. The exorcist had spent most of his life fighting the Echoes, and the countless injuries he had suffered in these battles left him unable to perform the ritual any longer. As luck would have it, he passed the sacred Nuo mask and blade to young Suyou to continue in his place. Suyou put on the mask and held the blade tightly. For the first time, Suyou took the stage as Nuo's exorcist: he performed the ritual dance and sang the ancient songs to summon the Immortal Nuo.
en|Le ciel s'assombrit soudainement, com: The sky suddenly darkened, as if Suyou had returned to the past. Unaware of the impending catastrophe, the masses looked at Suyou with fear and expectation. Only then could Suyou understand...What is Nuo? Nuo is faith. People's hearts are like candle flames, swaying in the direction the wind blows. And at that time, as Nuo's exorcist, Suyou was that wind. When people see your resolution, they will believe. When people see your smile, they will rejoice.
