When people see your fear, they will cower. And when people see your hesitation, they will doubt. Their faith comes from you, and the faith you evoke from them is the power of Nuo! As night fell, the faith of the townspeople under the stage became like flames and illuminated Suyou's performance. Immortal Nuo once said: “Do not fear evil. People chanted “Immortal Nuo will protect us from harm! » over and over again in their hearts. Thus, Immortal Nuo gained the power to dispel evil. Immortal Nuo said: “Do not fear disaster. People chanted “Immortal Nuo will save us from disaster!” again and again in their hearts. Thus, Immortal Nuo gained the power to avert disaster. Little by little, something emerged from the people. He gathered around the Nuo mask, the holy blade, and the statue of Immortal Nuo. The hopes of the people, the power of the human heart, and the sparks of their faith came together and manifested in the three-headed, six-armed Immortal Nuo. Nuo is faith, and Immortal Nuo is the resulting miracle. The sparks of their faith, gathered to give shape to the body. The thoughts of the people, sharp as an edge to cut through despair.
en|Suyou brandissait la lame sacrée et g: Suyou wielded the sacred blade and guided the people. He summoned Immortal Nuo and cut off the echoes of malice. He split the sky, just like his predecessor. He saw the faith of the people and heard their prayers. At this very moment, he had understood the true meaning of being a Nuo exorcist. Suyou carried the power of immortal deity in his body to guide people to enlightenment. It was his duty. After passing on the sacred relics and knowledge of the ritual to Suyou, the old exorcist left without a trace. The world still assumes that those who shoulder great responsibilities must bear heavy burdens and undergo trials. But Suyou was free, wandering from place to place, enjoying the sights and sounds. Sometimes he would perform the Nuo ritual to reaffirm people's faith, and other times he would draw his sacred blade to reduce evil manifestations. He has seen what the power of faith and the human heart are capable of, and he returns it in kind. His love for the world and his faith in others allow him to protect every glimmer of hope. Just like his name, Suyou, in the Cajun language... Exorcist of evil and wanderer in this world.
en|Suyou (肃游) est un nom chinois qui sig: Suyou (肃游) is a Chinese name meaning "solemn" (肃) and "traveler" (游).
en|Son concept « Nuo » est basé sur la r: His concept “Nuo” is based on the Chinese folk religion of exorcism. Nuo means oath or chasing away evil spirits.
en|Ses effets sonores de jeu sont basés: Its gaming sound effects are based on real samples.
en|Ses 3 armes, la hallebarde, les doubl: His 3 weapons, the halberd, the double blades and the war bow, are hidden in the form of pieces of jade on his waist. He wears a different mask for a different weapon.
en|Ses 3 masques différents peuvent être: His 3 different masks can be seen in this intro and in the game when he uses his different grappling skills.
en|Suyou est le deuxième héros à posséde: Suyou is the second hero to have a level 5 Ultimate skill, the first being Julian.
en|Bien que cela n’ait pas été officiell: Although it has not been officially confirmed, Suyou is believed to be one of the heroes created through an upcoming anime collaboration skin. Other heroes involved are members of Forsaken Light – Yin, Melissa, Xavier and Julian – for the Jujutsu Kaisen collaboration, as well as Lukas and Kalea for the Naruto Team 7 collaboration event.
en|Suyou est le premier héros à disposer: Suyou is the first hero to have the throw and hold mechanic.
en|Dans les vidéos promotionnelles offic: In official promotional videos, Suyou is depicted as having a fondness for hot springs.
en|Autrefois maître forgeron excentrique: Once an eccentric master blacksmith, but now vengeful on the side of the Abyss.

Once an eccentric master blacksmith, but now vengeful on the side of the Abyss. The once revered master craftsman was now known as the famous Executioner of the Abyss, but Terizla didn't care. Since the moment he had been labeled a heretic by the Church, he had only wielded his hammer in revenge, waiting for the day when he could finally soothe the troubled souls of those close to him. ===The Fallen Blacksmith=== As one of the most powerful institutions in the Land of Dawn, the inquisition of the Monastery of Light has garnered both extreme respect and absolute terror from its inhabitants. The mere thought of having to traverse its hallowed halls and enigmatic depths would make even the most fervent followers of the Light shudder involuntarily. For deep within this solemn place lay the Renaissance Gate, the dungeon housing the Church's deepest secret: a past so dark that it could leave even the bravest soul petrified with fear.
en|Il y a dix ans, au plus profond des c: Ten years ago, deep within the dungeons of the Inquisition, a guard slowly opened an iron door to check on the imprisoned victim, only to find her completely abandoned. The dark, desolate cell was empty except for a bloody message that stained its unforgiving walls. Heavy with hatred, the vile words read:
en|Renversez la foi… La lumière périra…: Overthrow the faith... The light will perish...
en|Consterné, le garde se tenait dans le: Appalled, the guard stood in the deserted dungeons, in silence and pure horror. Very quickly, news of the escape spread, taking the entire Monastery of Light by storm: the heretic Terizla has escaped!
en|« Les forgerons doivent respecter la: “Blacksmiths must respect freedom, maintain their know-how in their work and never be subject to the rules of the Church! This is what Terizla openly shouted during a large gathering of blacksmiths.
en|En tant que chef de la Guilde des For: As leader of the Freesmiths' Guild and spiritual leader of the anti-Church alliance in Lumina City, Terizla has repeatedly ignored the Church's commandments while openly defending fellow smiths sanctioned by the Church. His blatant disregard for the monastery's teachings has earned him both the disfavor of the Church and the label of a "known heretic" in Lumina City.
en|Outre son côté rebelle, Terizla, qui: In addition to his rebellious side, the principled Terizla was also known for his exceptional craftsmanship. He was a man of great competence, respected by his peers for his unrivaled rigor and precision. His meticulous eye did not allow the slightest error in the forge. Any apprentice who tried to cheat him with faulty work was severely punished. The frustrated apprentices often complained among themselves, but not a single one dared to voice their grievances against Terizla out loud.
en|Le savoir-faire et les normes de Teri: Terizla's know-how and standards, as severe and demanding as they may be, have always given the best. creations from the forge. Due to their high quality, the works of the Free Blacksmiths Guild were valued throughout the Moniyan Empire and quickly gained popularity as soon as they hit the market. So, seething with jealousy over the guild's success, the competitors bribed Terizla's apprentices to send a secret message to the Church: the "heretic" Terizla had always designed his creations using dark magic!
en|Avant le sixième anniversaire de son: Before her son's sixth birthday, Terizla spent days in her workshop just outside of town, preparing a special gift for her son: a finely detailed statue of their family. Terizla skillfully worked on the statue with so much care and attention that it took her until the very day of her son's birthday to finally complete it. Eager to surprise her young son with his gift, Terizla ran home excited. What awaited him, however, was the ambush of Raven assassins sent by the Church.
en|Réalisant que quelque chose n'allait: Realizing something was wrong, Terizla struggled to escape the siege, but was immediately pinned to the ground.
en|Au milieu des cris déchirants de Teri: Amid Terizla's heartbreaking cries, the Knights of the Church and the Ravens stormed the fortress of the Freesmiths' Guild. Within minutes, the air was filled with echoes of screams and cries of anguish.
en|Le chef des Corbeaux a saisi Terizla: The Raven leader grabbed Terizla by the hair and forced him to watch the fortress burn to the ground. "See them burn. Hear them scream. This is what heretics deserve!"
en|Les Corbeaux ramenèrent ensuite Teriz: The Ravens then brought Terizla back to the Monastery of Light. They threw him deep into the dungeons and chained his bloodied and beaten body with enchanted chains. Alone in his cell, Terizla carefully raised his tired head and looked at his iron handcuffs, only to discover the symbol of the Freesmiths' Guild carved deep within the links.
en|Le fer forgé par ses propres mains em: The iron wrought by his own hands now imprisoned their masterful creator. Struck by the irony of his situation, Terizla felt a burning hatred rise in his veins. In a fit of rage, Terizla lashed out, violently pulling on the chains, screaming in both anger and agony. He vowed to fight the Church to the death and make it pay for everything it had done. But despite all his efforts, he could not free himself from the force of his own creation.
en|Alors qu’il était sur le point d’aban: Just as he was about to give up, Alice, the Demon Queen, entered the cell. "How pathetic to see your entire family wiped out by the Church. The Blood Demon lifted Terizla's chin with his long, sharp nail. Do you want revenge? I can help you..."
en|Terizla leva la tête alors qu'Alice s: Terizla looked up as Alice leaned closer and whispered. "The only thing I ask in return? Join the Abyss. Unleash the horror of your legendary skill on all those who have wronged you."
en|Dès qu'il entendit sa maudite promess: As soon as he heard his cursed promise of vengeance, the flickering glow of the dungeon's solitary lamp roared in Terizla's impassive eyes and the master blacksmith was no more. Alice has successfully transformed the Abyss into a new artisan with an insatiable appetite for revenge.
en|Alors qu'il s'éloignait pour toujours: As he walked away from Lumina City forever, the only thing Terizla took with him was the statue he had made before this horrible event.
en|Dans sa forge abyssale condamnée. Ter: In his condemned abysmal forge. Terizla crafted enchanted weapons for the demonic army in the Desolation, accompanied only by the faint illusion of his wife standing at his side. Over and over he tried to talk to her, telling her how much he wanted to touch her face again. And each time, Terizla encountered nothing but the rhythmic echo of his hammer hitting the anvil.
en|Au fil du temps, sa haine envers l’Ég: Over time, his hatred towards the Church and its faithful grew even stronger. Driven by unfathomable anguish and hatred, Terizla threw all followers of the Light captured by the Abyss into her furnace, using them as raw materials for her terrible enchanted creations.
en|Terrifiant, talentueux et tourmenté,: Terrifying, talented and tormented, the once revered master blacksmith had transformed into the famous executioner of the Abyss.
en|Quiconque aurait le malheur de se ret: Anyone unfortunate enough to find themselves in the cursed forge of Terizla would find the walls stained with the blood of its victims, representing a macabre fresco: a man with outstretched arms, protecting his family.
en|\"Un jour, je détruirai l'Église et M: "One day, I will destroy the Church and Moniyan with my own hands..."
en|Dans cette dernière note de patch, il: In this latest patch note, he shared the role (Fighter/Tank) of Hilda, as both are equipped with an ax as their own weapon.
en|Cependant, la compétence 2 est différ: However, Skill 2 is different from Hilda due to the delay she needs to spam her skill.
en|Terizla ne gagne aucune vitesse d'att: Terizla does not gain any attack speed from items. He is one of three heroes to do so along with Kimmy and Marcel.
en|La Frappe d'exécution (deuxième compé: Execution Strike (second skill) can damage more than some mages' skills if all hits land.
en|Penalty Zone (Ultimate) a été testé a: Penalty Zone (Ultimate) was tested with different CC effects before the pull mechanics were finalized.
en|Terizla était l'un des rares héros de: Terizla was one of the few physical combat heroes to use mana before it was eventually removed in a later update.

Their relationship could be attributed to that of father and pet.
en|Thamuz semble faire preuve d'une véri: Thamuz appears to show genuine empathy towards his species, portraying him as a strict but well-meaning leader, prioritizing the survival of his tribe above all else, as shown in multiple artworks posted to official accounts.
en|Une silhouette qui ressemble beaucoup: A figure that closely resembles Thamuz appears in the name=Nolan|image=Nolan cutscene, in which he talks about the origins of Light and Darkness and the Age of Strife. Considering that the events took place at an unknown time in the past, one could hypothesize that Thamuz has been fighting for the Abyss for longer than expected.
en|Avec le récent changement dans la tra: With the recent change in Thamuz lore mentioning an ancient Lava Lord, it could also be that this character is one of the ancient Lava Lords.
en|Dans Mobile Legends Adventure, Thamuz: In Mobile Legends Adventure, Thamuz encountered name=Uranus|image=Uranus several times over an unspecified period of time. Every time name=Uranus|image=Uranus sees him, her hatred for him grows each time. === Fire Demon Biology ===
en|Dans la vidéo conceptuelle de name=Ob: In the name=Obsidia|image=Obsidia concept video, Thamuz's race, the Fire Demons, do not appear to naturally grow their heads as they do in typical depictions of their species. This could suggest that Thamuz may have carved it himself to assert his dominance as the rightful Lord of Lava.
en|Ceci est encore renforcé par l'entrée: This is further reinforced by the entry in Chapter 1 of his Mastery Code, where Thamuz is described as having "forged his body from lava".
en|Les noyaux en fusion trouvés à l’inté: The molten cores found inside a Fire Demon's chest constitute its life force. As long as it exists, the Fire Demon cannot die.
en|Les faux de Thamuz sont des extension: Thamuz's scythes are extensions of his body, made entirely of crystallized shards from his own molten core. Thamuz scythes are made specifically from obsidian. === Belerick sacrificed himself! Who is responsible? ===
en|Lors de l'invasion de la forêt au cla: During the Abyss' invasion of the Moonlight Forest (in "Belerick Sacrificed Himself! Who's Responsible?"), Thamuz indirectly killed Belerick, as he sacrificed his life to defend the Tree of Life.
en|Lorsque name=Belerick|image=Belerick: When name=Belerick|image=Belerick was revived, his skills were retooled to better counter opponents who continuously deal damage. One of these enemies is Thamuz.
en|On ne sait pas si name=Belerick|image: It is unknown if name=Belerick|image=Belerick grew specifically to defend against him.
en|Cependant, il existe de nombreux cas: However, there are many real cases of plants evolving and adapting to specific threats. === The demons are approaching ===
en|Dans la bande dessinée officielle \"D: In the official comic "Demons Approaching", Thamuz reveals that he is in possession of one of the "Nine Demon Lords of the Abyss", an orange crystal that Astaros recognizes as "Gamunti". However, due to the new tradition of name=Phoveus|image=Phoveus, it is unclear whether this remains canon or not. === The Abyss: Will of the Sovereign / Post-Rework ===
en|Dans la cinématique Volonté du Souver: In the Sovereign's Will cutscene, Thamuz interrupts name=Alice|image=Alice and name=Dyrroth|image=Dyrroth from harvesting name=Obsidia|image=Obsidia's blood. Convinced that his corruption still lives in his blood, he expresses his frustration at name=Obsidia|image=Obsidia's past crimes against his people, corrupting them into the Spawns of Decay.
en|Peu de temps après, Thamuz rencontre: Shortly after, Thamuz encounters a hesitant corrupted Fire Demon before being forced to kill it, further fueling his rage.
en|En raison de la petite taille du Démo: Due to the Fire Demon's small size, it is possible that Thamuz was forced to kill a young member of his species, making this the second depiction of the death of a young, the first being Mila, in name=Arlott|image=Arlott's lore.
en|Dans l'histoire saisonnière de la sai: In the Season 38 seasonal storyline, name=Obsidia|image=Obsidia encounters a Fire Demon corrupted by the God of Darkness and on the verge of transforming into the Spawn of Decay, collapsing as he fears not only for himself, but also for his tribe members.
en|Le démon du feu, dans ses derniers in: The fire demon, in his final moments, isolates himself from the rest of his people to protect them from diseases, in the name of Lord Thamuz. === Sea Nexus ===
en|L'Annihilator est fortement basé sur: The Annihilator is heavily based on H.P. Lovecraft and his works of cosmic horror, primarily from the Cthulhu Mythos, in which beings commonly known as "Outer Gods" (a term popularized by the heavily Lovecraft-inspired role-playing game "Call of Cthulhu") exist beyond human comprehension.
en|Ils sont décrits pour servir à des fi: They are described to serve purposes far beyond mortal comprehension, and are known by many names (in Thamuz's case he is also known as "The Great Scourge"), very similar to the lore that accompanies the skin.
en|De plus, une boucle en forme de calma: Additionally, a squid-shaped buckle adorned with wings can be seen on his model, strongly reminiscent of the more common depiction of Cthulhu (the titular Outer God).
en|Certaines lignes vocales de The Annih: Some vocal lines in The Annihilator directly reference Thamuz's original vocal lines.
en|\"Je suis la volonté de l'abîme.\" /: “I am the will of the abyss.” / “I am the will of destruction, the end of all realities.”
en|\"L'anéantissement attend.\" / \"L'an: “Annihilation awaits.” / “Annihilation awaits all who oppose me.”
en|\"Un nouvel abîme, forgé dans le feu: “A new abyss, forged in the fires of hell.” / "Once I devour the lighthouses, I will create a new beacon."

en|À sa libération, il a plutôt marché s: Upon release, he instead walked on his hind legs, leaning slightly inward, with his arms extended outward.

However, this change would soon be reverted to the previous version with an unknown number of subsequent updates.
en|Lors de sa refonte du 17 septembre 20: During his September 17, 2025 overhaul, he received a new scythe-free animation, similar to the one removed in patch 1.6.84.
en|Thamuz a été le premier héros introdu: Thamuz was the first hero introduced by the Abyss faction, preceding heroes like name=Alice|image=Alice, name=Dyrroth|image=Dyrroth, and name=Selena|image=Selena in the story.
en|Son passif Grand Lord Lava a été l'un: His passive Grand Lord Lava was one of the first abilities in the game to consistently deal true damage based on enemies' HP.
en|Certains joueurs comparent son look à: Some players compare his look to Balrog from Lord of the Rings or Ifrit from Final Fantasy.
en|Ses armes, les Molten Scythes, lui re: His weapons, the Molten Scythians, return to him of their own accord, similar to boomerangs.
en|Après sa refonte, Thamuz a désormais: After his rework, Thamuz now has different glow effects on his model during his ultimate, depending on his skin.
en|Lorsque Thamuz bouge, une traînée de: When Thamuz moves, a trail of lava forms behind him, showing his burning presence. He is one of the rare heroes whose footsteps leave elemental effects on the battlefield.
en|Malheureusement, cela a été supprimé: Unfortunately, this has since been removed after its redesign.
en|Le 18 décembre 2025, Thamuz a reçu un: On December 18, 2025, Thamuz received a skin survey with a design very reminiscent of the Chaos Space Marine known in the Warhammer franchise.
en|Thamuz partage le même doubleur en ja: Thamuz shares the same Japanese voice actor, Nakamura Taishi, with Franco and Grock.

en|Le skin Starlight de Thamuz, Sanctifi: Thamuz's Starlight skin, Sanctified Flame, had an unexpected change in patch 1.8.08. Originally, his Starlight Skin's card design showed a tongue in his mouth, but has since been transformed into a hollow blue energy. The reason for this change is currently unknown.
en|Thamuz est l'un des rares personnages: Thamuz is one of the few characters with a chance-based passive. The other two are name=Belerick|image=Belerick, with his Deadly Thorns, and name=Faramis|image=Faramis, with Vicious Retrieval.

en|Chef de l'Ordre de la Lumière, gardie: Leader of the Order of Light, guardian of the Moniyan Empire.
en|Tigreal est né dans la noble famille: Tigreal was born into the noble Wertz family. Since the establishment of the Moniyan Empire, House Wertz has continually provided military talent to the empire and guarded Moniyan's imperial power and national security for generations. The Tigreal generation is no exception. His father Gareth is the Empire's Minister of Defense and the Emperor's right-hand man, while his uncle Eckert is in charge of the border guards stationed in the most dangerous area between the southern part of the Empire and the Land of Despair.
en|Bien que des milliers d'années se soi: Although thousands of years have passed since the shocking changes that divided the empire, rumors and threats about the Abyss, heretics, and terrible creatures have never been far away. Since he was a child, Tigreal has received systematic military training in Lumina City, constantly learning various combat skills such as fighting, swordsmanship, and horse riding. The whole family had high hopes for him, hoping that one day he could take up the banner of his father's generation and become the most loyal and faithful guardian of Moniyan.
en|À l'âge de seize ans, Tigreal rejoign: At the age of sixteen, Tigreal joined the Imperial Army with full dedication and was drafted into the ranks of the Garrison Army. During his four years in the Garrison Army, Tigreal led his troops to almost every part of Moniyan, further exercising Tigreal's command and leadership ability, earning him the favor of the Order of Light.
en|Par la suite, Tigreal a rejoint les C: Subsequently, Tigreal joined the Knights of Light thanks to his exceptional military talent and leadership ability. In the Moniyan Empire, only the most loyal and courageous fighters who had undergone extensive training were eligible to be elected Knights of Light, and Tigreal became the youngest member of the Knights in history. He was the glory of his family and a genius in the eyes of the Moniyan people. Everyone believed that he would become a hero in the history of Moniyan, just like the martyrs of previous generations of Walk of Heroes.
en|Cependant, peu de gens ont une vie au: However, few people have such a smooth life. Just when people thought a star was about to rise, a heavy blow soon fell on Tigreal. In the Drylands, in a battle launched to completely drive the demons of the Abyss, who had long held the area underground, Tigreal served as commander of the Second Regiment in an army composed of the Order of Light and the Imperial Border Guard. He was deployed on the left flank of the battlefield and launched an attack against the demonic army. However, due to an error from the command center, the second regiment went in alone and was besieged by the demon army.
en|Par la suite, le centre de commandeme: Subsequently, the command center ordered the Second Regiment to leave some of the soldiers behind to close the rear and disperse to break through the encirclement. At this time, Tigreal was determined to live or die with his troops, but the elderly and experienced deputy Roland stopped Tigreal and caused him to retreat with the main force he commanded, while he and a small number of fighters held off the enemy. Aiming to retain a few effective soldiers, Tigreal reluctantly led the troops to withdraw.
en|Après la bataille, l'armée démoniaque: After the battle, the demonic army, which had long been entrenched where the southern part of the empire met the Barren Lands, was completely wiped out, but only the Second Regiment suffered heavy losses, the unit remaining to hold back the enemy having been completely wiped out. Looking at the dead bodies and blood all over the ground, Tigreal felt full of guilt for the decision he had made.
en|Après cette bataille, afin de dissimu: After this battle, in order to cover up their mistakes, the senior officers of the Knights refused to give the soldiers of the Second Regiment the honor they deserved, and called these soldiers "disobedient" because they were greedy for merit and this led to unnecessary sacrifices. Subsequently, they tried to use the medals and promotions to encourage Tigrayal to remain silent. Feeling the stress of the unsuccessful struggle and pressure from family, Tigreal left Moniyan and came to the cold Northern Valley. In the icy and snowy north, Tigreal formed a deep friendship with the rugged tribes of the Northern Valley and, more importantly, fighting side by side again and again, Tigreal realized that as a knight, the life of a companion is more important than the outcome of a battle: because we choose to fight to protect everyone around us. If fighting only means sacrifice, then victory has no meaning.
en|Après cela, Tigreal est retourné à Mo: After that, Tigreal returned to Moniyan, returned to the Knights of Light, and became the leader of the Knights over the years, guarding everything in Moniyan with determination and bravery day after day. In folklore, as long as there is a place where darkness invades, there will be the fearless Warrior of Dawn to guide everyone in chasing away the darkness.
en|Le passif de Tigreal a été retravaill: Tigreal's passive has been reworked twice to date.
en|Son premier passif lui accordait un b: His first passive granted him a bonus to armor and magic resistance when he made a basic attack, stacking up to 5 times.
en|Son deuxième passif lui a accordé 15: His second passive granted him 15% more armor and magic defense against items.
en|Il existe de nombreuses incohérences: There are many inconsistencies and ironies in Tigreal's quotes:
en|\"Un vrai homme ne se cache jamais da: “A real man never hides in a bush,” while most Tigrayan players hide in the bushes.
en|\"Un vrai chevalier ne dit jamais mou: “A true knight never says die,” but he has said it before.
en|Il est basé sur Bedivere de Magic Rus: He is based on Bedivere from Magic Rush.
en|Son doubleur anglais actuel, Zach Laz: His current English voice actor, Zach Lazar Hoffman, also provides the voice of Yu Zhong, as does his current Japanese voice actor, Yano Masaaki, for Alucard and Barats.
en|Alucard, Granger, Harith, Silvanna (c: Alucard, Granger, Harith, Silvanna (co-members of Lightborn)
en|Gardien fait de foudre et d'air, gard: Guardian made of lightning and air, guards the Heavenly Palace.
en|Le Palais Céleste - La légende racont: The Heavenly Palace - Legend has it that the city floating above the skies of the Land of Dawn was once home to the Gods. This mysterious place is also said to hold the key to ruling the world. Ages ago, the ruler of the Heavenly Palace used the technological secret of the ancients to create Uranus, then ordered him to guard the city and wait for a new ruler to emerge.
en|Lorsque les érudits du Pays de l'Aube: When the scholars of the Land of Dawn found and opened the gates of the Heavenly Palace, the battle between the Zenith of Dawn and the Dark Abyss quickly spread throughout the kingdom, disrupting the solitude of the ancient city. Both forces sought to occupy the Heavenly Palace as a symbol of victory, their heroes unleashing the full extent of their power and ultimately finding themselves at a stalemate. The massive influx of energy generated during the incessant battles finally awakened the city's defense system, converting the released energy into pure lightning, injected into Uranus and awakened from its dormancy in the depths of the Heavenly Palace. “Leave now, intruder!” » he roared as he awoke, charging onto the battlefield fueled by lightning, ether and ready to fulfill his destiny. Their objective: to purge these wild intruders who had disturbed the tranquility of the Heavenly Palace.
en|leur nom, « Uranus », vient du dieu g: their name, "Uranus", comes from the primordial Greek god of the sky, who was the father of the Titans. Uranus is also the name of the seventh planet in the solar system, which corresponds to the hero's cosmic theme.
en|Leur nom était presque « Ouranos », l: Their name was almost "Ouranos", the original Greek spelling of the god Uranus. The developers chose "Uranus" to match the name of the planet and make it easier to recognize on a global scale.
en|Uranus est l'un des êtres les plus an: Uranus is one of the oldest beings in gaming history.
en|Ils sont les gardiens du Palais Céles: They are the guardians of the Heavenly Palace which is one of the playable maps in the game before it is replaced by Sanctum Island.
en|Contrairement à la plupart des chars: Unlike most tanks that rely on shields or lifesteal, Uranus quickly regenerates HP over time, making him one of the hardest heroes to take down. His passive (Radiance) allows him to accumulate HP regeneration whenever he takes damage, allowing him to excel in prolonged fights.
en|Belerick (allié) Edith (alliée) Kaja: Belerick (ally) Edith (ally) Kaja (ally) Lunox (ally/master) Rafaela (ally) Argus (enemy)
en|L'héritier de Wind Fort, un mage du v: The heir of Wind Fort, a wind mage.
en|[\"]Valir, mon frère bien-aimé. Tu as: ["]Valir, my beloved brother. You lost everything the day we made the pact. I will ensure that the Fire Kingdom restores everything to the way it once was. Although you still wish to avenge your cruel father, I do not blame you as long as you can chase away the storm in your heart. Nothing is as important as your happiness, not even my life.["] Vale fell into deep contemplation as he wrote his letter to Valir. These opening lines took Vale back to the days of his youth, when he and Valir were the closest of friends.
en|Alors que Vale tombait encore plus da: As Vale fell further into nostalgia, he remembered the day they met at a royal party. Since then, they both felt a strong affinity with each other's magic. For a long time, Vale and Valir were inseparable. Together, they left many memories in the Valley of the Winds, the Kingdom of Fire and many other exotic lands. When unrest engulfed the Fire Kingdom, Valir quickly took his leave. Only Vale knows exactly how much Valir sacrificed that day.
en|Au fil du temps, le jour du Pacte app: As time passed, the day of the Pact approached. Vale's magical abilities to control the winds had become more sophisticated over the years. In fact, he was the only member of his family who could change the winds through magic. However, Vale had never shown his magic to anyone before. Vale waited and waited for the day of the pact to come. That day, he would stage a spectacular display of wind magic for Valir. Vale thinks Valir will see his magic, remember the precious times they spent together, and look back at how things were in their youth.
en|Bien qu'il ait été développé avant pl: Despite being developed before several other heroes (name=Selena, name=Aldous, name=Claude, name=Belerick, name=Lunox, name=Thamuz, name=Leomord, name=Kimmy, name=Harith, name=Minsitthar, name=Hanzo, name=Kadita, and name=Badang), Vale was not released on the original servers until after all of them. Having been locked on the test servers for almost an entire year, he took longer to be released than any other hero. If you sort the heroes in the "Heroes" page by "Sale Time", Vale will appear between Claude and Leomord, instead of after Badang. The order of heroes is due to its earlier introduction in advanced servers.
en|Héritier du Fort du Vent: Heir to the Fort of Wind
en|Roi de la Vallée des Vents (Père): King of the Valley of the Winds (Father)
en|Ancienne chef de la maison Paxley qui: Former head of House Paxley who would stop at nothing to resurrect her lover.
en|La maison Paxley régnait sur les régi: House Paxley ruled the regions near the Lantis Mountains, south of the Moniyan Empire. Generations of the house had guarded these areas for the Empire, defending against invasion from the Abyss with magic and swords.
en|En tant que fille aînée du patriarche: As the eldest daughter of the patriarch of the house, Valentina had high hopes since birth. She underwent rigorous training and grew to become a proud perfectionist, the most qualified heir to lead this noble house.
en|En grandissant, elle se rendit à la f: As she grew up, she traveled to the border and helped the house fend off wave after wave of invading demons.
en|La nouvelle des victoires dans les mo: News of the victories in the Lantis Mountains became the only thing that could reassure civilians. As a result, House Paxley quickly rose among the nobles, while Valentina became the youngest and only female member of the house council.
en|À la recherche d'alliés, Valentina se: Seeking allies, Valentina journeyed alone into the Moonlight Forest despite the Empire's prolonged hostility towards the Elves. The Elf King, Estes, refused Valentina's request, saying that the Elves had no interest in the human war. An elf hero named Irlan, however, was moved by Valentina's heartfelt words. Unlike Estes, he believed that with the fall of the human empire, the demise of Moonlit Forest would also be imminent.
en|Quelques mots passionnés furent échan: A few heated words were exchanged, after which Irlan followed Valentina out of the moonlit forest with his friends.
en|Depuis lors, les elfes et les humains: Since then, elves and humans have fought side by side on the battlefields of the Lantis Mountains.
en|Après les jours et les nuits passés a: After the days and nights spent with Valentina, risking their lives, Irlan realized that he had fallen desperately in love with her. But Valentina was distraught when Irlan revealed his feelings for her: she had always been taught that a noble lady should not indulge in ridiculous romances and that she should marry someone of equal status for the sake of the house. Nevertheless, Irlan's passionate courtship awakened the feelings buried deep in Valentina's heart. She experienced the wonderful joy of being loved for the first time.
en|Juste au moment où Valentina faisait: Just when Valentina was pretending to be calm but didn't really know how to react, Irlan took the opportunity at the House Paxley election meeting and proposed that he was willing to fight under Valentina's command with the other Elves permanently, but on one condition: Valentina had to say yes to his marriage proposal.
en|La suggestion d'Irlan a parfaitement: Irlan's suggestion perfectly solved the problem that was troubling Valentina. Now she could follow her heart and accept her feelings for the sake of the house. And so[,] they shared their sacred vows under the moonlight, and Valentina became the head of their house as the house clapped with joy. But among the enthusiastic crowd, his uncle remained silent: the position should belong to him according to the rules of the house.
en|Avec l'aide des Elfes, la Maison Paxl: With the help of the Elves, House Paxley gained power every day and Valentina was given the title "Duchess" of the Moniyan Empire. And she also counted on Irlan who showered her with love. Accustomed to facing death, Valentina finally tastes the sweetness of life.
en|Mais c'est alors qu'un désastre survi: But then disaster suddenly struck: after biding their time and gathering their forces, the Abyss once again attacked the stronghold of House Paxley with powerful troops. Before the Emperor's reinforcements arrived, House Paxley was left to its own devices.
en|Consciente que la force de la maison: Realizing that the strength of the house was no match for the army of the Abyss, Valentina decided to resort to the last expedient: gathering all the mages of the house and casting the "Coffin of Souls", a forbidden spell that, when completed, could create a deadly zone and devour all the souls of the living. Even demons would not be spared.
en|Pour couvrir les mages préparant le s: To cover the mages preparing the spell at their backs, Valentina and Irlan led the bravest warriors to the forefront, confronting the Abyss army head-on.
en|La bataille commença et des milliers: The battle began and thousands of demons invaded the Elves and humans like the waves of the ocean. But the alliance remained firm as the strongest rock, letting the waves of troops from the Abyss break into a thousand pieces.
en|Mais ces courageux soldats tombèrent: But these brave soldiers still fell one after the other. Seeing this, Valentina became more anxious as she waited for the signal for the end of the spell. Their plan was to withdraw from the battlefield with all their troops as soon as the signal came, so that the magic zone covering the front line would destroy the demon army in one fell swoop.
en|Cependant, Valentina remarqua soudain: However, Valentina suddenly noticed the Soul Casket symbol appearing above the engaged armies, but the rear had not fired any withdrawal signals! Confused, she turned around to find her own uncle and the mages mocking her.
en|Sachant qu'elle avait été trahie sans: Knowing that she had been shamelessly betrayed, Valentina shouted for everyone to stand down immediately. At the last moment before the coffin fell, Irlan used his last strength to push Valentina out of the area, before falling on the battlefield losing his soul.
en|La bataille de Lantis prit ainsi fin: The Battle of Lantis thus ended and the invincible legend of Valentina continued. But only Valentina herself knew what price she had paid for this victory...
en|La duchesse a exécuté tous ceux qui l: The Duchess executed all those who betrayed her and escorted the body of her beloved to Aberleen Castle.
en|Elle a construit une salle sacrée en: She built a sacred hall in commemoration of Irlan and the other martyrs and has since dedicated her life to seeking a way to bring back Irlan's soul. During this process, Valentina became more and more desperate and eventually turned to dark magic and awakened a trace of consciousness from the evil god of trickery, Kalon.
en|Kalon a parlé à Valentina des pouvoir: Kalon told Valentina of the miraculous powers of the Heart of Anima, a broken piece of the Twilight Orb, and tricked her into signing a blood pact with him. According to the blood pact, Valentina would gain immortality and the power of shadow, but at the cost that since then all the souls of House Paxley had to be contaminated by Kalon. And when his power truly awakened, he would be resurrected thanks to a descendant of Paxley.
en|Pour empêcher le retour de Kalon, Val: To prevent Kalon's return, Valentina left a prophecy informing her descendants that if the Cursed One appeared, they must get rid of the person at all costs.
en|Depuis, Valentina se cachait dans l'o: Since then, Valentina had been hiding in the shadows, silently awaiting the appearance of the Heart of Anima, the day when her beloved's soul could be recovered...
en|Elle est le premier héros capable de: She is the first hero capable of copying an enemy's skills.
en|Elle est le premier héros à posséder: She is the first hero to have an ability linked to experience level.
en|Si les équipes alliées et adverses ch: If allied and opposing teams choose the same hero, she can participate in duplicate hero forms at the same time, such as double Angela, Faramis, Johnson, etc. This stacks ultimate skill effects that are not possible in normal matches.
en|En raison d'un bug antérieur au patch: Due to a bug before patch 1.6.42, she could copy hero icons in combat.
en|Elle est reportée pour les deux plate: It is postponed for both platforms, as patch update 1.6.34 is delayed from its originally scheduled release from November 23, 2021 to November 24, 2021 for Android and update 1.6.34 for iOS [including Valentina itself for both platforms] is postponed to November 25, 2021 due to the App Store's delay in process response time review of the app, resulting in the postponement of upcoming events, including Valentina-related events, the 2021 Starlight Fest, Black Friday Leaderboard, and Black Friday Lucky Star.
en|Sa doubleuse anglaise, Mara Junot, fo: Her English voice actress, Mara Junot, also provides the current voice of Sindel from the Mortal Kombat franchise, as both have identical voices and lost their lovers, Jerrod and Irlan. Other than that, his ability to replicate the powers of others is similar to that of Shang Tsung from the same franchise.
en|Siphonner la puissance de l'ennemi: Siphon the power of the enemy
Heir to Fire Throat, fire mage.
en|Au sud-ouest du Pays de l'Aube se tro: To the southwest of the Land of Dawn lies an active volcano that endangered the lives of anyone who dared to approach it. “Hell of Fire” was what people called this place. It was also known as the testing ground for mages seeking to master flame spells. After leaving the magic academy, Valir resided there for five years while carrying a ten-year promise to Vale. He hoped that this day would come sooner, but at the same time, he also hoped that this day would never come. One day, Valir cast his arcane flame magic towards the volcano but the result did not live up to his expectations.
en|Dans le désert occidental, il y avait: In the Western Desert there was a man who was looking for Valir. The betrayal of the years was something he could never forgive. With much anger and hatred, and to maintain the reputation of the magic academy, he decided to hunt down the traitor. The moment he felt unusual arcane power being released from the volcano, he smiled.
en|L'habitation à long terme dans cet \": Long-term habitation in this "Hell of Fire" has brought changes to Valir's body. His skin was burned by the volcano's flames, but to become the Son of Flames, he had to combine the power of his arcane flame magic with the volcano's hellfire. His body and his will must withstand the tests of these burning lavas. Suddenly, a strong wind blew, bringing a familiar feeling to Valir. Vale had come! They had never met since childhood. This meeting gave rise to the first fight between them, between fire and wind. The Windtalker and Son of Flame use all their magic to attack each other. No words were exchanged, but they shared a common thought: they didn't want to kill each other. However, their fight generated great power, which made the volcano worse. If the volcano erupted, they would surely die in hell.
en|Il reste cinq ans – tu ne peux pas at: There are five years left – can’t you wait for Vale!?
en|Avant que Vale ne dise quoi que ce so: Before Vale said anything, Valir heard another familiar voice, it was Gord. Gord's presence interrupted this fight between these brothers. He wanted to abolish Valir's arcane magic, because in his mind, her pure arcane wisdom should never be tarnished. However, the arcane spell he cast on Valir was stopped by Vale. Vale turned to sympathy as he looked at Valir's tortured body. He didn't want anyone to hurt his brother. However, Valir did not need such sympathy.
en|L'un d'eux était son maître qui voula: One of them was his master who wanted to destroy his apprentice for his apparent betrayal. Another of them was his closest brother. However, he was also the son of the one who killed Valir's father. The sacred flame would never go out. Valir managed to combine the power of his arcane flame magic with hellfire and release powerful energy. With this power, the lava became unstable. During this time, Valir gained a powerful body while his eyes became scarlet flames. At that time, Vale could understand his father's concerns. This kind of power amazed Gord, and as a teacher, he would rather kill his student than let him be possessed by this crazy power.
en|La flamme de Valir, le vent de Vale e: Valir's flame, Vale's wind, and Gord's arcane power aggravated the volcano, leading to a great collapse. After that, Vale and Gord tried to find Valir, but they couldn't find him. Vale knew that in his heart Valir was still alive and that their promise of ten years was not yet broken. The five years made Valir great, what would happen after five more years? Vale knew that the next time they met, it wouldn't be as friends and brothers. Rather, it would be the greatest fight for their lives.
en|Le nom « Valir » signifie « Vallée »: The name “Valir” means “Valley” in Bengali language.
en|Les compétences originales de Valir é: Valir's original skills were very different from his current version, focusing more on fire blasts than CC and sustain. Its burn damage can kill enemies even after it stops attacking (if they are still on fire).
en|Valir est le seul mage possédant une: Valir is the only mage with a skill capable of repelling multiple enemies at once.
en|Demonlord et Infernal Blaze ont parta: Demonlord and Infernal Blaze shared the ultimate quote.
en|Le skin collector de Valir, Demonlord: Valir's collector's skin, Demonlord, is in the same timeline as the name = Vale's collector's skin "Supernal Tempest"
en|Le skin Shikigami Summoner de Valir r: Valir's Shikigami Summoner skin resembles Seimei, the founder of Scarlet Shadow.
en|Roi du Royaume du Feu (Père, décédé): King of the Fire Kingdom (Father, deceased)
The young Duchess guarding Necrokeep. Vexana was the majestic ruler of Necrokeep, the gentle mother of the undead, but also the only glimmer of light that penetrated the Mist, bringing hope to this cursed land shunned by both life and death. === Undying Hope === Princess Vexana Gaius had never set foot outside of Lumina City, and she had no desire to do so. The capital Moniyan was warm, opulent and full of life. A horrible fortress in the southern hinterlands was the last place she intended to spend the rest of her life.
en|D’un autre côté, elle savait qu’elle: On the other hand, she knew that she was bound to her father's will. Duke Atticus of Ridgeburg had proposed to House Gaius a union through marriage, and Lord Gaius considered Vexana the most suitable partner. And now she found herself alone in her carriage on a long journey south.
en|Elle jeta un coup d'œil à la lettre q: She glanced at the letter that the duke had sent her to present his future home:
en|Ce sont les terres du sud bénies par: These are the southern lands blessed by the ancient gods, where torrential rains come and go and silver grass bathes in the glow of the moon.
en|Vexana admirait la prévenance du duc,: Vexana admired the duke's thoughtfulness, but these poetic words failed to ease her unease.
en|Pour aggraver les choses, Vexana n'a: To make matters worse, Vexana didn't even meet her host when she arrived in Ridgeburg. He was told that Duke Atticus had left the castle the day before, urgently seeking to clean up a demonic infestation along the border.
en|DES DÉMONS ? Les nausées de Vexana se: DEMONS? Vexana's nausea turned into a slow, creeping terror. She had difficulty understanding her misfortune. Looking around at the damp, grimy walls of the castle, she thought of her sunny, pastel room in Lumina City. She had hot baths, sumptuous banquets, and maidens attending to her every need. Now all she had was a sinister-looking knight named Leomord, who she believed was better suited to patrolling the brigs than her corridor.
en|Pourtant, elle gardait espoir. Peut-ê: However, she remained hopeful. Maybe if she wrote to her father about the conditions of her new house, he would change his mind. Indeed, it would be unwise to entrust a poor girl like her in charge of such a terrible fortress. As she wrote her letter, her peace was disturbed by external turmoil.
en|Apparemment, un tas d'épines avait ét: Apparently, a pile of thorns had been left at the castle gate. The locals must be trying to intimidate me! Vexana shuddered at the thought. She immediately asked Ser Leomord to find the culprits. But to their surprise, the disbelievers were just... a group of barefoot children.
en|Selon les enfants, ces épines s’appel: According to the children, these thorns were called Moonlight Grass. Despite their gruesome appearance, herbs could help calm the mind when brewed properly. The people of Ridgeburg sympathized with Vexana's plight and simply intended to offer her comfort, although it obviously didn't go as well as they had expected.
en|Peut-être ai-je jugé ces gens trop du: Maybe I judged these people too harshly. Vexana breathed a sigh of relief and her lips parted slightly to reveal a shy smile. She patted the children on the heads and thanked them for their kindness. Just another week, she thought. Maybe I could last another week in this soggy pile of rocks.
en|Alors une semaine s'est écoulée, deux: So a week passed, two weeks, then three...
en|Les lettres d'Atticus étaient la seul: Atticus's letters were the only company she had during her lonely nights in this strange land. With each stroke of the pen, she couldn't help but feel his pain...and his desire to return home. After all, this was precisely what she was going through herself. She wanted nothing more than to ease his grief, and maybe for him to do the same for her as well. More than she wanted to admit, she had developed a strange affection for the man she had never met.
en|Et puis les lettres s'arrêtèrent brus: And then the letters stopped abruptly, dashing any hope that Vexana had secretly harbored in her heart. However, she did not relapse into her earlier panic and anxiety; she now had the company of Ridgeburg and its people – her people.
en|Deux années se sont écoulées en un éc: Two years passed in a flash. The meek and immature Princess of the North has become a capable and decisive Duchess of the South. Walking through the muddy streets, solving one problem after another, big or small, Vexana didn't want to leave. With Atticus gone, she was the town's greatest and only hope.
en|Jusqu'à ce jour, comme si le destin a: Until that day, as if fate had heard his thoughts, the herald came knocking at his door...
en|Le cœur de Vexana manqua un battement: Vexana's heart skipped a beat, then thumped so hard against her chest that the cheers that had erupted in the streets were drowned out. For two long years she had waited for this day, except when she saw Atticus' face for the first time, she only felt a cold shiver run down her spine.
en|Dans ses lettres, le duc avait l’air: In her letters, the Duke seemed lively and spirited, but the man standing before her was quite the opposite. His gaze was hollow and empty, his face a picture of resignation...
en|Le mariage fut bientôt organisé à nou: The wedding was soon held again, and the nobles and commoners of Pentaga all gathered in Ridgeburg to watch this long-awaited union join in holy matrimony. With a bouquet in hand, the stunning bride had her eyes on no one but her groom as he opened the box containing their wedding ring.
en|Cependant, au lieu d'un anneau, une p: However, instead of a ring, a pair of magical wings came out of the box, followed by an evil voice echoing through the sacred walls:
en|Tout le monde dans la salle haletait: Everyone in the room gasped in horror as Duke Atticus and his men twisted and writhed, their bodies slowly resembling those of the demons of the Abyss. The city's sworn protectors were its ruin, as they began to ravage everything in sight.
en|Vexana se figea tandis qu'Atticus enr: Vexana froze as an enraged Atticus lunged at her, his sword raised high...
en|La bête lourde s'arrêta net, comme si: The heavy beast stopped abruptly, as if Vexana's voice rekindled a long-extinguished flame within it. The bride reached out to his heart and all that was left of him inside. “Atticus, please…it’s not you.”
en|Et d'un simple contact, Atticus a app: And with a simple touch, Atticus apparently managed to regain a trace of consciousness and froze. Fighting the demon he had become, for the sake of his people and his own, Atticus ordered Ser Leomord to pierce his heart.
en|Dans son dernier souffle, Atticus con: With his last breath, Atticus entrusted Ridgeburg to Vexana and revealed the dark secret hidden from all but Ridgeburg's royal family...
en|Il y a des lustres, pendant la Guerre: Eons ago, during the Endless War, the agony and resentment of hundreds of thousands of dying warriors condensed into a terrible curse. He could devastate anything with the stench of Abyss magic, but those without it would also suffer a fate worse than death.
en|\"La Brume... s'il n'y a pas d'autre: "The Mist...if there is no other choice—"
en|\"Atticus regarda profondément dans l: "Atticus looked deeply into the eyes of his bride; his demonic hands reached out to her sweet face. A mixture of emotions shone in his eyes. Regret, gratitude and serenity. Until the inevitable claws of death tore her from his arms.
en|À l’intérieur de la ville, les cheval: Inside the city, demon knights attacked everyone in sight; outside, other demonic forces were on their way.
en|En désespoir de cause, Vexana leva le: In desperation, Vexana raised Atticus' scepter; the magical power that flowed deep in her blood exploded: she chose to keep this city forever!
en|Un brouillard sombre s'est élevé dans: A dark fog rose into the sky and engulfed all of Ridgeburg. Any townspeople who came into contact with the fog groaned in pain, their skin losing its color in an instant. The demon knights collapsed into ashes, while those outside the gates turned around and rushed towards the Abyss.
en|Vexana pouvait presque sentir son esp: Vexana could almost feel her mind slipping out of her body. Amidst the chaos unfolding before her, she fell to her knees, her heart heavy with guilt. The inhabitants, however, came to surround their young duchess, not with reproaches or hatred but to thank her for having saved them from the grip of the Abyss...
en|Depuis, le brouillard noir enveloppai: Since then, the black fog had enveloped Ridgeburg for a hundred years. As the formidable fortress fell into ruin, its name was forgotten and people came to know it as Necrokeep, the land of the undead and home of restless souls.
en|Au petit matin, les enfants poussaien: In the early morning, the children pushed open the ruined door of the school; and when night fell, the whole family sat around a half-collapsed dining table, the food on the plate long turned to dust. It was all useless, but only in this way could they feel some semblance of life.
en|Pas une seule fois Vexana n’avait pen: Not once had Vexana thought about leaving again.
en|Depuis, elle avait pleinement assumé: Since then, she had fully assumed her role as leader of the city, but to the people of Necrokeep, she was also the gentle mother who loved and cared for them all.
en|Vexana croyait fermement qu'un jour,: Vexana firmly believed that one day, she would find a way to undo the curse... and that her people would regain a taste for life.
en|=== Chanson des temps anciens === Je: === Song of ancient times === I want to live To wake up with you When the world sleeps deeply Tender is the morning dew On the released rays of the sun
en|Je veux vivre Marcher parmi les fleur: I want to live Walk among the spring flowers And walk on the dead leaves Too cold the snow in the moonlight Melt in the humid summer breeze
en|Je veux vivre Pour siroter l'infusion: I want to live To sip the morning brew While the fragrance rises to the eaves To share the joy and the sorrow Taste all the bittersweet
en|Ta chaleur, tes souffles Et tes souri: Your warmth, your breaths And your blooming smiles How I want to live To wait for your return Until all the greens and all the colors are no more
en|O comme je veux vivre Pour le rire de: O how I want to live For the laughter of the old For the innocence of the newborn For the birds on the wings For the lingering melodies
en|Dois-je supporter tous les péchés Pou: Do I have to bear all the sins So that you come back to me Tell me all the suffering Is only a ghostly dream
Her full name is Vexana Gaius.
en|Le nom « Vexana » vient peut-être du: The name "Vexana" possibly comes from the Latin word "vexare", which means to torment, distress or harass. This could symbolize her ability to curse, harm, and control enemies through her necromantic powers, fitting her role as a necromancer who manipulates the spirits of the dead and inflicts torment on her enemies.
en|Son sceptre appartient au duc Atticus: Her scepter belongs to Duke Atticus, her fiancé, whom Alice had corrupted on the day of their supposed wedding.
en|Comme confirmé dans son Mastery Code: As confirmed in his Mastery Code Chapter 4, the soul of Duke Atticus, the former ruler of Ridgeburg/Necrokeep and fiancé of Vexana, is present in the Eternal Guard.
en|Dans Project NEXT, une mise à jour ma: In Project NEXT, a major update aimed at reworking and balancing older heroes in Mobile Legends: Bang Bang, Vexana was one of the revamped heroes alongside several others.
en|Vexana est le premier héros à recevoi: Vexana is the first hero to receive a Zenith-quality skin in Mobile Legends: Bang Bang. Its “Twisted Fairytale” skin, introduced between March 25 and April 30, 2024, marked the beginning of this very rare skin category. Currently, Vexana and name=Selena are the only heroes with the Zenith skin.
en|Les skins Zenith pourraient avoir un: Zenith skins might have a fairytale theme, as their effects, trailer, and names indicate their theme. Vexana's Zenith skin, "Twisted Fairytale", is heavily inspired by Snow White while Selena's Zenith skin, "Curse of Cinder" is inspired by Cinderella.
en|Vexana est l'un des héros qui a subi: Vexana is one of the heroes who underwent drastic changes during her rework. The other hero is Bane and his name = Aurora.
en|Vexana et Silvanna sont liées par le: Vexana and Silvanna are related by blood.
en|Lord Gaius et l'empereur Gaius sont d: Lord Gaius and Emperor Gaius are different personalities. In the first case, this is the title and surname of Vexana's father, and in the second, the title and surname of the first ruler of the Moniyan Empire, from which the surname "Gaius" comes.
en|Sa doubleuse anglaise actuelle dans s: Its current English voice actor in its 2022 revamp, Erica Mendez, is known for her several roles in English dubs of Japanese anime, such as [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gon Freecss Gon Freecss] (which is also in the form of a skin for Dyrroth) from the 2011 version of Hunter × Hunter, Diane from The Seven Deadly Sins, and Megumin from KonoSuba. In video games, she has voiced many characters such as Kamisato Ayaka from Genshin Impact, White Lily Cookie and Black Pearl Cookie from Cookie Run: Kingdom and Maki Harukawa from Danganronpa V3: Killing Harmony.
