Stolen Physical and Magical Defense can stack up to 5 times and last 5 seconds. However, Carmilla can only steal defense from the same enemy hero once every 5 seconds.
en|Carmilla invoque deux fleurs pourpres: Carmilla summons two purple flowers that spin around her for 5 seconds, dealing each time they hit an enemy and slowing them by 10% for 0.8 seconds (the slow effect stacks up to 50%). The rotation speed of the Purple Flowers also increases with each hit. [speed unknown] Carmilla recovers whenever a Purple Flower deals damage (only recovers 30% of this amount when hitting minions).
en|Carmilla accumule de l'énergie du bai: Carmilla accumulates energy from the bloodbath, gaining 70% movement speed which decays over 4.5 seconds. Use Again: Carmilla releases accumulated Bloodbath energy on the target enemy Hero or Creep, damaging and stunning them for 0.6 seconds. The duration of damage and stun scales with the accumulation time (up to 100%).
en|Carmilla lance Malédiction du sang su: Carmilla casts Blood Curse on the target location, slowing enemies hit by 50%. After 0.8 seconds, enemies still in the area will take, be immobilized for 1 second, slowed by 30% and bound for 5 seconds. When a linked enemy takes damage or becomes controlled, all other linked targets take 50% damage and become controlled for 100% of the duration. Enemies can move away from each other to break the bond. [scope unknown]
en|Cecilion augmente son Max Mana de 10: Cecilion increases his Max Mana by 10 and restores the same amount of Mana as his skill hits an enemy target. Cooldown: 1 second. Cecilion has higher Max Mana and Mana Regen, and his skill damage increases with his Max Mana.
en|Cecilion ordonne à une chauve-souris: Cecilion commands a giant bat to dive in a designated direction, dealing damage to enemies in the way. The giant bat will stay at its destination and launch another attack, dealing damage to enemies and triggering an additional overrun 1 time. Over 6 seconds, each time Cecilion casts this skill, the mana cost will be increased by 1.8 times (capped at 4 times). By casting this skill, he also gains 30% movement speed for 1 second.
en|Cecilion invoque une paire de griffes: Cecilion summons a pair of claws to a designated location. After a short delay, the claws will move towards each other and pull enemies towards the center, damaging and immobilizing them for 1 second.
en|Cecilion libère le pouvoir du Démon d: Cecilion unleashes the power of the Blood Demon [for 6 seconds], increasing his movement speed by 60% (rapidly decreasing over 1.5 seconds) and gaining immunity to slow effects|slow immunity. During this time, he fires 40 blood energy bolts at nearby enemies, each dealing and slowing them by 3% (up to 30%) for 1 second. Hitting an enemy heals them for 10 and 1% of their lost HP|Health.
en|Lorsque Carmilla est à proximité, Cec: When Carmilla is nearby, Cecilion can summon her to become a Vermilion Shadow around him, granting her a shield of 520 to 800 (scales with Carmilla's level). Carmilla can choose to leave Cecilion and charge at the target location, gaining an equal shield while dealing 520-800 magic damage (scaled by level) to nearby enemies and slowing them by 30% for 1 second.
en|Chaque fois que Chang'e inflige des d: Every time Chang'e deals damage to an enemy, she leaves a mark on them. Each mark reduces the target's movement speed by 1%, stacking up to 20%.
en|Chang'e envoie une sphère d'énergie d: Chang'e sends a sphere of energy in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies in its path and slowing them by 10% for 1.5 seconds. Crescent Moon: The Crescent Moon will send out 4 additional energy spheres along with Chang'e's, each dealing 20% ​​damage. The slowing effect can stack (up to 20%).
en|Chang'e invoque le Croissant de Lune,: Chang'e summons Crescent Moon, gaining a permanent and 10% movement speed (which lasts until the shield is destroyed). Each time Chang'e casts a skill, she also gains 50% movement speed which decreases over 2.5 seconds. Crescent Moon also causes Chang'e's basic attacks to deal bonus magic damage 2 times. Every time Chang'e deals magic damage with his basic attack and skills, the cooldown of this skill is reduced by 0.2 seconds.
en|Chang'e tire 30 météores dans la dire: Chang'e fires 30 meteors in the target direction for 4 seconds, each dealing to the first enemy hit. This skill deals 100% more damage to minions and Creeps. Chang'e also gains 10% movement speed for the duration of the effect. Crescent Moon: The Crescent Moon also shoots meteors with Chang'e, each dealing 33% damage.
en|Chip commence à manger des chips une: Chip begins eating chips once every 2 seconds outside of combat, regenerating HP equal to 300 plus 45% of HP lost after finishing an entire bag (requires 4 bites). After eating a bag of chips, Chip will be full and will not be able to eat for 5 seconds. (Bite count will be saved if entering combat before completing an entire bag)
en|Chip enfonce son aéroglisseur dans le: Chip drives his hovercraft into the ground, dealing magic damage equal to plus 4% of the target's maximum HP and applying Chip's Mark to enemy units hit. Chip gains one when hitting an enemy hero, which increases by 40% for each additional enemy hero hit. Chip's next basic attack will become ranged and will also hit all nearby enemies with Chip's Mark|e, detonating the mark to inflict and stun each target for 0.6 seconds.
en|Chip se précipite pendant 2 secondes,: Chip dashes for 2 seconds, gaining up to 65% additional movement speed, after which he maintains maximum speed for 2 seconds. Chip's next basic attack will have him charging at the enemy, damaging them and knocking them back slightly.
en|Chip laisse tomber le portail princip: Chip drops the main portal on an enemy hero, briefly slowing them by 25%. the main portal deals 2x damage and immobilizes them for 1 second after a delay. During this time, he creates connection portals near allied heroes within 10 units and behind the allied base. The main portal and login portals last up to 15 seconds. Connection Portal: Heroes (from both teams) can teleport from Connection Portals to the main portal, and allied Heroes gain explosive movement speed for 1.5 seconds and a shield. Main Portal: The main portal inherits 70% of Chip's attributes. Heroes can stay in the main portal for 2 seconds to return to the connection portal they came from. Casting skills or launching basic attacks will reset the hold time.
en|Chip a 4 balises fixes sur la carte l: Chip has 4 fixed beacons on the map when the battle begins. Use this skill to teleport to any other beacon. (This skill cannot be used in combat.)
en|Après avoir parcouru 5 unités, Chou i: After traveling 5 units, Chou deals 180% damage with his next basic attack (can't crit), briefly slows the target by 80%, and reduces his physical defense by 10 (+1*hero level) for 3 seconds (up to 2 charges).
en|Chou frappe dans la direction ciblée,: Chou strikes in the targeted direction, dealing damage to enemies hit. This skill can be cast 3 times before entering the cool down phase. On the 3rd throw, Chou also throws enemies hit into the air. Hitting an enemy hero with the 3rd throw resets Shunpo's cooldown.
en|Chou charge dans la direction cible,: Chou charges in the target direction, gaining control immunity and a shield.
en|Chou frappe le héros ennemi ciblé ave: Chou hits the targeted enemy hero with a roundhouse kick on the targeted enemy hero, dealing damage and knocking them back. Cast this skill again to pursue the target, dealing a total of.
en|Cici génère une pile de Délice après: Cici generates a stack of Delight after dealing damage, increasing her movement speed by 0.75% and her Vamp spell by 0.75% per stack up to 10 times, doubling the effects on full stacks.
en|Cici utilise Yoyo pour attaquer conti: Cici uses Yoyo to continuously attack the closest enemy within range (prioritizing Heroes) for 3.5 seconds, hitting them up to 10 times and dealing a percentage equal to the target's maximum HP per hit. Cici can move and use other skills during this attack. If there are no enemy heroes in range, Yoyo will attack the turrets or base instead. The skill deals 20% more damage to minions.
Cici jumps to a target location. If she lands on any unit (not including turrets and base), she can jump in the direction of the joystick again. If it lands on an enemy from the first jump, it inflicts a spell on them.
en|Cici lance Yoyo sur le héros ennemi c: Cici casts Yoyo at the targeted enemy hero and links them to another nearby enemy hero, slowing them by 30% and bringing them closer. Meanwhile, Cici can use Yo-Yo Blitz to attack both linked targets at the same time. If only one is within range of Yo-Yo Blitz, Cici will attack the target twice, but the damage of the second attack will be reduced to 25% ~ 45%.
en|Dexter lance une attaque supplémentai: Dexter launches an additional attack every time Claude's basic attack lands, dealing to the same target. Dexter's basic attack can also trigger Claude's attack effects with 30% effectiveness.
en|Claude attaque les ennemis dans une z: Claude attacks enemies in a fan-shaped area in front of them, dealing and reducing their movement speed by 20% and attack speed by 10%. For each target hit, Claude gains 3% additional movement and attack speed (doubled if the target is an enemy hero, up to 5 charges) for 6 seconds.
en|Claude laisse une image miroir de Dex: Claude leaves a mirror image of Dexter at a designated location. Dexter's mirror image automatically attacks enemies. Lasts 5.5 seconds. Claude can reactivate this skill to change places with the mirror image. Dexter's basic attack deals and can trigger Claude's attack effects.
en|Claude et Dexter tirent rapidement su: Claude and Dexter rapidly fire at nearby enemies for 3 seconds, dealing up to two targets each time they fire. This skill benefits from Claude's basic attack effects and gives him a shield capable of absorbing damage.
en|Après chaque compétence lancée, la pr: After each skill cast, Clint's next basic attack within 4 seconds penetrates a line of enemies and deals damage. This damage can trigger attack effects and the party affected by the physical attack can make a critical hit.
en|Clint tire 5 balles en succession rap: Clint fires 5 bullets in rapid succession in the target direction, each dealing damage to the enemy hit. Bullets will spread evenly over enemies in a fan-shaped area. Enemies hit by multiple bullets will take [11% to 16%] damage after the first bullet.
en|Clint tire un piège dans la direction: Clint fires a trap in the target direction, jumping back slightly while dealing the first enemy hit and immobilizing them for 1.2 seconds. Successfully hitting an enemy reduces the cooldown of this skill by 40%.
en|Clint lance une grenade dans la direc: Clint throws a grenade in the target direction which explodes on the enemy's first hit, damaging them and slowing them by 50% for 0.5 seconds. Clint gets a grenade recharge every 10 to 5 seconds (up to 3).
en|Chaque fois que Cyclope frappe un enn: Each time Cyclops hits an enemy with his skills, all his skill cooldowns are reduced by 0.5 seconds.
en|Cyclope lance deux disques Stardust,: Cyclops throws two Stardust Discs, each dealing damage to enemies in its path.
en|Cyclope évoque des sphères étoilées a: Cyclops conjures up starry spheres around him while gaining 30% movement speed for 2 seconds. Spheres will automatically seek out and attack nearby enemies (prioritizing enemy heroes), exploding on collision and dealing damage to the enemy. Enemies hit by multiple spheres will take reduced damage after the first hit.
en|Cyclope crée une sphère planétaire et: Cyclops creates a planetary sphere and sends it after the targeted enemy Hero or Creep, damaging and immobilizing them for 1-2 seconds (increases with movement distance).
en|À sa mort, Diggie inverse le temps et: When he dies, Diggie reverses time and transforms into an egg, in which he can continue to move and learn a new set of skills. It cannot be targeted in egg form and will resurrect after a while.
en|Diggie lance une alarme de hibou à l': Diggie sounds an owl alarm at the target location. The alarm will then remain stationary for 25 seconds or until it reacts to the first enemy within range, chasing them and detonating on collision. The explosion deals damage to nearby enemies and slows them by 30%. Diggie gains 2 stacks of Dangerous Sparks|stack every time an enemy hero is hit by the blast (up to 60 stacks), with each stack increasing the skill's damage by 1%. Diggie loses half the stacks upon death, but can gain 1 stack of Dangerous Sparks each time his skill hits an enemy hero in egg form. Up to 5 owl alarms can exist at the same time.
en|Diggie marque un héros ennemi ciblé p: Diggie marks a targeted enemy Hero for 4 seconds and returns them to their previous location once the duration ends, damaging and slowing them by 80%. If the enemy exits the circle, the shot will be triggered earlier.
en|Diggie supprime tous les affaiblissem: Diggie removes all debuffs from nearby allied heroes (including himself) and grants them control immunity for 3 seconds. He also gains 50% movement speed for 0.5 seconds.
en|Les dégâts de compétence de Dori infl: Dori's skill damage inflicts a mark on targets for 4.5 seconds. Hitting a marked enemy with a skill causes the mark to explode again and deals damage. Each time Dori casts a skill, she gains 30% movement speed for 1 second.
en|Dori gagne un bouclier pendant 3 seco: Dori gains a shield for 3 seconds, knocking back and damaging nearby enemies.
en|Après un court délai, Dori s'attaque: After a short delay, Dori attacks enemies in the surrounding area of ​​the ring, slowing them by 30% for 1.5 seconds. She also gains 15% movement speed for 3 seconds.
After a short delay, Dori attacks enemies in a large ring area, stunning them for 1 second.
en|Lorsque la Rage de Dyrroth atteint 50: When Dyrroth's Rage reaches 50%, he will upgrade Burst Strike – Abyss Enhanced and Specter Step – Abyss Enhanced. After every 2 basic attacks, Dyrroth will cast the skill Circle Strike|, dealing enemies in the circle and regenerating [50 + 40% of damage dealt|pd HP] (Circle Strike has no ATK effect). Every time it hits an enemy hero, the CD of Burst Strike and Specter Step will be decreased by 1 second.
en|Dyrroth lance une frappe éclatée dans: Dyrroth launches a burst strike in a designated direction. Each burst deals damage to enemies and Slows them by 25% for 1.5 seconds. (Damage decreases against the same target and decreases to only 75%|hp on minions.) Abyss Enhanced|skill: Burst Strike has a longer range, deals 140% of the original damage|hp, and its slow effect is doubled.
en|Dyrroth se précipite dans la directio: Dyrroth rushes in the direction indicated. It will stop when it hits a [non-minion] target, dealing damage to enemies. When he uses this skill again, he will lock on to a target and deliver a fatal strike, dealing [a total of]. Enemy Heroes or Creeps hit by Fatal Strike will have their Physical Defense reduced by 40% for 4 seconds. Abyss Enhanced|skill: Fatal Strike will deal 150% of original damage|pd, slow the target by an additional 90% [for 1 second], and reduce the target's physical defense by 60% [instead] for 4 seconds.
en|Après un court délai, Dyrroth lance u: After a short delay, Dyrroth launches a destructive strike in the targeted direction (cannot be interrupted), dealing damage to enemies along the way and slowing them by 55% for 0.8 seconds.
en|Après chaque lancement de compétence,: After each skill cast, Edith and Phylax become overcharged for 3 seconds, during which all basic attacks will unleash chains of lightning, dealing additional magic damage equal to up to 4 enemies. Chain Lightning damage against minions is increased to 150%.
en|Après un délai de 0,75 seconde, Edith: After a 0.75 second delay, Edith controls Phylax to deliver a devastating blow in a designated direction, dealing 120% damage to minions to enemies hit and knocking them into the air for 1 second. This skill will not be interrupted by regular control effects (excluding Suppression).
en|Edith contrôle Phylax pour charger da: Edith controls Phylax to charge in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies along the way. If Phylax hits an enemy hero during this process, he will immediately stop and throw them over his shoulder and deal damage.
en|Passif : Lorsqu'elle est à l'intérieu: Passive: While inside Phylax, Edith can accumulate Wrath based on the damage she receives (calculated before damage reduction). Active: Edith ejects from Phylax, knocking back nearby enemies. After that, she takes flight and can perform ranged basic attacks, each dealing damage. Edith also learns new skills in this state. While flying, Edith gains 350 to 650 to 350 to 650 points of additional shield, 50 to 150% additional attack speed, and 5 to 20% hybrid lifesteal depending on how much anger she has accumulated, and converts each point of additional physical defense and additional magic defense into 3.5 magic power. The flight state lasts up to 8-12 seconds.
en|Après chaque lancement de compétence,: After each skill cast, Edith and Phylax become overcharged for 3 seconds, during which all basic attacks will trigger chains of lightning, dealing bonus magic damage equal to (+20% total magic power) plus 3 (+0.2*hero level)% of the target's maximum HP to up to 4 enemies. Chain Lightning damage against minions is increased to 150%.
en|Edith impose un châtiment divin sur u: Edith imposes a divine smite on a target area, dealing 170 (+40% total magic power) magic damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. It then continues to deal 68 (+16% total magic power) magic damage to enemies in the area every 0.5 sec for the next 1.5 sec.
en|Edith tire un éclair dans une directi: Edith fires a bolt of lightning in a designated direction, dealing 150 (+50% total Magic Power) magic damage to the first enemy Hero hit and Rooting them for 0.8 seconds.
en|Passif : à l'intérieur de Phylax, Edi: Passive: Inside Phylax, Edith accumulates Wrath based on damage taken (calculated before damage reduction). Active: Edith ejects from Phylax, knocking back nearby enemies and taking flight for up to 8 seconds. During this time, she gains new skills and can perform ranged basic attacks, each dealing 35 (+75% of total physical attack) (+25% of total magic power) magic damage. She also gains 350 (+5% total HP) - 350 (+20% total HP) additional shield, 50% - 150% additional attack speed, and 5% - 20% hybrid lifesteal based on accumulated anger, and converts each point of additional physical defense and additional magic defense into 3.5 magic power.
en|Esmeralda manipule Stardust et Frostm: Esmeralda manipulates Stardust and Frostmoon: Stardust deals physical damage while Frostmoon deals magic damage and gives the target a shield equal to 135% of the damage dealt by Frostmoon. Each basic attack deals and. Esmeralda's damage ignores all shield effects and gradually converts her shield into HP. [unknown amount/conversion rate]
en|Esmeralda gagne 40 % de vitesse de dé: Esmeralda gains 40% Movement Speed ​​which rapidly decreases for 4 seconds. During this time, she gradually transforms the shields of nearby enemies into her own shield, [amount unknown] capped at 50% of her Max HP.
en|Esmeralda agite Stardust et Frostmoon: Esmeralda waves Stardust and Frostmoon, dealing damage to nearby enemies. Each time she damages a hero, Frostmoon Shield's cooldown is reduced by 1.5 seconds (damaging non-hero units grant a reduction of 0.5 seconds) and the enemy's movement speed is reduced by 10% for 1.5 seconds.
en|Esmeralda regroupe la puissance de l': Esmeralda brings together the power of Astrospace in her two weapons: Stardust and Frostmoon. The longer this skill is channeled, the longer the casting range. Use Again|e: Esmeralda casts Stardust at the target location, dealing it, then flashes to the target location and casts Frostmoon, dealing and immobilizing enemies in the area for 1 second.
en|Les Écritures de Moon Elf chargent le: The Moon Elf Scriptures slowly charge Estes with energy. When the energy reaches 100 charges, the Estes' Nest's basic attack will be enhanced, dealing damage to the target and nearby enemies and slowing them by 60% for 1.5 seconds.
en|Estes restaure immédiatement le héros: Estes immediately restores the target hero and bonds with them for 3 seconds, slowly healing back towards the target. Bonding with an allied hero will also increase Estes' hybrid defense by 20-45 and movement speed by 15%, as well as increase the energy charge speed of the Moon Elf's Scriptures. Being too far from the target will break the link. (Improved:|e Estes immediately restores the target hero and bonds with them for 3 seconds, slowly healing back to the target 15 times...)
en|Estes projette un flot de clair de lu: Estes projects a flood of moonlight onto the target area, dealing damage to enemy units there. Then it turns to a Moon Goddess domain and reveals the enemies inside [for 1.5 seconds]. Enemies will be slowed by 90% for 1.5 seconds when touching the edge of the domain area. (The slow effect will diminish over time.)[time needed]
en|Estes lance une Immersion au clair de: Estes casts an enhanced (enhanced) Moonlight Immersion on all friendly heroes nearby. In the next 8 seconds, "Moonlight Immersion" will be enhanced and Estes will continuously recover.
en|Les compétences d'Eudora infligent Su: Eudora's skills inflict Superconductor on affected non-minion units for 5 seconds and can trigger additional effects against enemies affected by Superconductor.
en|Eudora lance Forked Lightning dans un: Eudora casts Forked Lightning in a fan-shaped area, dealing (increased to 200% against minions) to enemies inside. When you hit targets affected by Superconductor. Eudora forms a chain of lightning with the target. gaining 40% movement speed while chaining for up to 1 second. The lightning chain expands over time and extra when it ends. If this hit succeeds, it reduces the skill's cooldown by 50%.
en|Eudora lance un orbe de foudre sur l': Eudora launches an orb of lightning at the targeted enemy, reducing their magic defense from 10 to 25 for 1.8 seconds, damaging and stunning them for 1 second. If the target is affected by Superconductor, the lightning orb reduces the magic defense of nearby enemies, deals AOE damage focused on the target, and stuns all nearby enemies.
en|Eudora déclenche un éclair sur la zon: Eudora fires a bolt of lightning at the target area, dealing damage to targets in the center. Then he hits targets off center and inflicts them. Whenever Thunder's Wrath hits a target affected by the Superconductor, it triggers an explosion centered on the Superconductor's target after a short delay, dealing damage.
en|Pendant le combat, Fanny inflige 10 à: During combat, Fanny deals 10-20% more damage to enemies hit (scales with flight speed [unknown speed]) and applies a stack of Prey Mark|mark (up to 2 stacks) to them with each attack. His subsequent skills on marked enemy heroes restore 8 energy per stack. Energy restoration is reduced [amount unknown] if it hits multiple enemy heroes in a short period of time. [duration unknown]
en|Fanny fait tournoyer ses lames, infli: Fanny spins her blades, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
en|Fanny tire un câble dans la direction: Fanny pulls a cable in the target direction which pulls her to the first obstacle encountered. She can cast this skill again within 2 seconds until her energy is depleted. Each successive cast reduces the energy cost of the skill by 2. Fanny automatically casts Tornado Strike when she hits an enemy in mid-air, as long as her energy is sufficient.
en|Fanny saute sur le héros ennemi ciblé: Fanny jumps on the targeted enemy hero or Creep with her blades, dealing damage. Each stack of the target's Prey Mark increases this damage by 30%.
en|Toutes les 4 secondes, la prochaine c: Every 4 seconds, Faramis' next skill against enemy heroes and summoned items generates a Soul Fragment on the spot. Faramis can absorb the soul fragment to restore it and gain 2 additional magical powers (up to 40 stacks). Upon death, he consumes the absorbed Soul Fragments to reduce the respawn time, each reducing the time by 3% (up to 90%). Enemies that die around Faramis also have a chance [how much?] to drop Soul Fragments.
en|Faramis entre dans l'état d'Ombre pen: Faramis enters the Shadow state for 3 seconds, gaining 70% additional movement speed, 25 additional physical and magical defense, 20% reduction in the cooldown of this skill, and the ability to move around the field. Enemy heroes who come into contact with Faramis in this state receive a Nether Mark. Leaving the Shadow state, Faramis drags all marked enemy heroes towards him and distributes them. Use it again to exit the Shadow state early and drag marked enemies towards him. The absorption range of Soul Fragments is increased when this skill is active.
en|Faramis rassemble l'énergie du Nether: Faramis gathers Nether energy into a fan-shaped area, attacking enemies within. The energy will then split and bounce back to nearby enemies, dealing (will split up to 2 times on enemy hero hits and 1 time on non-enemy hero hits).
en|Faramis transforme son environnement: Faramis transforms his environment into the Nether Realm for 6 seconds, causing the affected allied hero (including himself) to enter the Ghost state and granting him +% increased HP and 50% increased movement speed for 1 second. When the Ghost state breaks, the hero will clear all debuffs and enter a brief resurrection state for 1 second. An allied hero's Ghost state ends when they leave the Void Realm.
en|La Lanterne de rosée augmentera de ma: The Dew Lantern will permanently increase Floryn's attributes by a small amount. After leaving combat for 5 seconds, Floryn can share the Flower of Hope with an allied hero (30 second cooldown), which will grant him each time he is healed by Floryn. Floryn will never sell the Lantern.
en|Floryn lance une graine d'énergie sur: Floryn throws an energy seed at a targeted enemy, dealing damage. Healing Fruits will then appear and bounce to nearby allied heroes, restoring them.
en|Floryn projette une goutte d'énergie: Floryn projects a blob of energy in front of him that explodes when it hits an enemy, dealing damage to nearby enemies and stunning them for 0.5 seconds (and briefly revealing their positions). [time required]
en|Floryn résonne avec le pouvoir de Dew: Floryn resonates with Dew's power, healing all allied heroes 2x, no matter where they are. This effect also increases their Shield and HP Regeneration effects by 12% for 2 seconds.
en|Si aucun dégât n'est subi dans les 5: If no damage is taken within 5 seconds, Franco gains 10% movement speed, recovers 1% maximum HP per second, and begins accumulating Wasteland Force|e (up to 10 stacks). Franco will consume all stacks of Wasteland Force during his next skill to increase the skill's damage by up to 150%.
en|Franco lance un crochet de fer dans l: Franco throws an iron hook in the target direction. The hook will snag the first enemy unit hit, dragging it towards Franco.
en|Franco se déchaîne, infligeant des dé: Franco goes on a rampage, dealing physical damage equal to 300-450 plus 4% of his maximum HP to nearby enemies and Slowing them by 70% for 1.5 seconds.
en|Franco supprime le héros ennemi ciblé: Franco suppresses the targeted enemy hero for 1.8 seconds and hits them 6 times for the duration, dealing damage each time.
en|Fredrinn gagne 1 point de combo qui d: Fredrinn gains 1 combo point that lasts for 5 seconds each time his skill hits a non-minion enemy, up to 4 combo points. His Ultimate costs different numbers of combo points depending on different skill levels. Fredrinn stores 100% of the damage he receives as crystal energy | E, which decays after 5 seconds at a rate of 10% maximum HP per second. Fredrinn can convert stored Crystal Energy|E into HP for 20% of his damage dealt (10% for damage dealt to minions). Gaining a combo point resets the timer.
en|Fredrinn pousse son épée dans la dire: Fredrinn thrusts his sword in the targeted direction, dealing damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30% for 2 seconds. His next basic attack gains additional attack range and deals. [Skill duration required] This skill deals 200% damage to non-hero enemies.
en|Fredrinn se précipite dans la directi: Fredrinn dashes in the target direction, dealing to the first non-minion enemy hit. Its next basic attack knocks the target into the air for 0.3 seconds. [duration of skill required]
en|Fredrinn inflige 210 (+100 % d'attaqu: Fredrinn deals 210 (+100% bonus physical attack) physical damage to nearby enemies and taunts them for 1 second. Striking a non-minion enemy grants Fredrinn 25 Physical and Spell Defense for 3 seconds and reduces the cooldowns of Piercing Strike and Courageous Assault by 75%. This skill costs 1 combo point.
en|Fredrinn claque son épée dans la dire: Fredrinn slams his sword in the target direction (this skill can only be interrupted by Suppression), dealing 600 plus 21% of his crystal energy as physical damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area after a short delay. Enemies in the center of the area take 175% damage. This skill doubles the conversion rate based on damage dealt to enemy heroes, crystal energy stored in HP. This skill costs 3 combo points.
en|Freya gagne 1 orbe sacré à chaque att: Freya gains 1 holy orb with each basic attack (up to 6 holy orbs). Consuming 1 Holy Orb grants Freya 100% attack speed for her next basic attack (max 6 stacks). Holy orbs gradually recover outside of combat.
en|Freya saute vers la zone cible et fra: Freya jumps towards the target area and slams the ground with her shield, gaining and dealing damage to enemies inside while knocking them into the air for 0.4 seconds.
en|Freya charge en avant et frappe, infl: Freya charges forward and strikes, dealing and slowing enemies by 30% for 0.5 seconds. This skill has no base cooldown but consumes 2 Holy Orbs per cast. This skill deals 50% damage to creeps.
en|Freya sélectionne une zone cible et p: Freya selects a target area and dives like a Valkyrie (gaining control immunity and 50% damage reduction), dealing and slowing enemies in her path and at the landing point by 40% for 2 seconds. Upon landing, Freya enters the Valkyrie state for 12 seconds, during which her basic attacks deal an additional 30-60 damage (additional damage cannot be critical) and she recovers per basic attack, and her basic attacks deal area damage.
en|Gatotkaca gagne [1] Défense Physique: Gatotkaca gains [1] Physical Defense equal to 2% of his HP lost (up to 100). For every 300 damage suffered (calculated before damage reduction), he gains 5 Rage (up to 100). When he reaches above 25 Rage, Gatotkaca's next basic attack becomes enhanced, consuming all of his Rage to deal additional magic damage and recover. Additional damage depends on his rage, level and magic power.
en|Gatotkaca claque le sol, créant une z: Gatotkaca slams the ground, creating a broken area in the target direction while dealing damage to enemies inside. Enemies in the Broken Zone will take a second and be slowed by 30%.
en|Gatotkaca commence la canalisation, p: Gatotkaca begins channeling, then sprints in the target direction with a battle cry, forcing enemies in the path to attack and deal damage to him for 1.5 seconds. The sprint distance changes with channel time. Canceling the skill reduces the remaining cooldown by 50%.
en|Gatotkaca saute vers l'emplacement ci: Gatotkaca jumps towards the target location, dealing damage to nearby enemies and knocking them into the air for 1 second. Enemies near the center of the area will be knocked into the air for a longer duration, while enemies on the fringes will be pulled towards the center. The camera will move with the skill indicator but will not grant additional sight.
en|Les ennemis gagnent une charge de Sti: Enemies gain a stack of Sticky whenever they are hit by Gloo's skills, reducing their movement speed by 4% for 6 seconds. Stacks up to 5. Each stack of Sticky on an enemy reduces damage dealt to Gloo by 4%.
en|Gloo tend la main et claque le sol, i: Gloo reaches out and slams the ground, dealing damage to the enemy. At the end, there is still a Goo which explodes after 3 seconds to deal with nearby enemies and immobilize them for 1 second. If Gloo touches the Goo, it will immediately explode, reset the skill cooldown, and heal Gloo for 2.5-5% of maximum HP if the explosion hits an enemy (double if it hits an enemy hero).
en|Gloo se divise en Goos, infligeant de: Gloo splits into Goos, dealing damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area and rooting them for 0.5 seconds. When split, Gloo gains 10% movement speed and deals damage every 0.25 seconds to enemies it hits, for 4 seconds. If this skill hits a Goo, Gloo will charge to merge with it, dragging enemies in its path in the same direction for a certain distance.
en|Débloqué lorsqu'un héros ennemi possè: Unlocked when an enemy hero has full Sticky stacks. Gloo attaches to the targeted enemy hero for up to 9 seconds, recovering 25-30% of their maximum HP. For the duration, its basic attacks are converted to dealing damage, and it transfers 80% of the damage it receives (excluding turret damage) to its host. If the target dies while attached, the cooldown of this skill is reduced to 5 seconds.
en|Après que Gord ait touché un ennemi 4: After Gord hits an enemy 4 times with basic attacks or skills in a short period of time, the next attack on the target will deal an additional attack and slow them by 20% for 1 second (the slow effect stacks up to 2 times).
en|Gord invoque un orbe mystique qui reb: Gord summons a mystical orb that bounces in the target direction and explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing damage to enemies in the area, while stunning them and revealing their location for 1 second.
en|Gord crée un champ d'énergie dans la: Gord creates an energy field in the target area, dealing damage every 0.3 seconds to enemies inside (up to 13 times).
en|Gord libère un faisceau d'énergie dan: Gord releases a beam of energy in the target direction, damaging enemies hit every 0.2 seconds (up to 16 times). The beam direction can be adjusted using the joystick.
en|Le pistolet et le canon de chasse aux: Granger's unique demon hunting pistol and cannon are powered by demonic energy. Both of his weapons have a fixed energy limit of 800. His weapon restores 8% energy per second while his cannon restores 2% energy per second. Each Minion/Creep kill will permanently increase the energy cap of Granger's Pistol and Cannon by 6/6, and instantly restore their energy by 5%/5%, respectively. Each kill or assist of an enemy hero will permanently increase their energy cap by 12 and instantly restore 10% energy. Each gain of 1% Granger CD reduction is converted into 2 physical attacks. Demonic energy cost is not affected by energy cost reductions.
en|Granger tire rapidement 6 coups avec: Granger quickly fires 6 shots from her weapon, each shot dealing and consuming 70 weapon energy. The last ball is guaranteed at the Crit. Each bullet deals 70 additional damage to Creeps and Minions. While shooting, Granger's movement speed is increased by 15%. Granger stops shooting when he runs out of energy or when the skill is cast again. Rhapsody has a brief cooldown and can be cast once its Gun Energy exceeds 420.
en|Granger utilise son agilité de Chasse: Granger uses her Demon Hunter agility to dash in the target direction, instantly restoring 15-25% energy to her weapon. Rondo can be cast while channeling Rhapsody. Each time Rhapsody hits an enemy, Rondo's cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds.
en|Granger tire avec son canon dans la d: Granger fires her cannon in the targeted direction, dealing damage to the first enemy Hero hit as well as other targets within the blast radius. Targets hit will be slowed and revealed for a brief duration. Granger can roll in the direction of the joystick after each shot. Death Sonata can be cast while drawing Rhapsody. Death Sonata has a brief cooldown and consumes 250 units of Granger Cannon energy per shot.
en|Grock gagne un bouclier égal à 10 % d: Grock gains a shield equal to 10% of his maximum HP and allows the next basic attack to deal an amount equal to % of the target's maximum HP (capped against non-hero units). This effect has a cooldown of 18 to 12 seconds (decreases with level), which decreases by 200% near terrain. Grock's skills cannot be interrupted and gain % additional physical defense while the shield is active.
en|Grock attaque avec une force massive: Grock attacks with massive force and deals. Enemies with obstacles behind them are knocked against the obstacle, launched into the air, and take an additional % of their maximum HP (capped against non-hero units). If there are no obstacles behind, enemies are only slightly pushed back.
en|Après un bref délai, Grock invoque un: After a brief delay, Grock summons a stone wall in the target area, dealing and knocking enemies towards him. Reuse: Cancel the wall early.
en|Grock charge en avant, infligeant des: Grock charges forward, dealing damage to enemies in his path. When it hits the ground, it immediately stops and unleashes a massive explosion that knocks nearby enemies into the air for 1 second and deals damage to them. If this skill does not hit the field, 50% of its cooldown is refunded.
en|Guenièvre inflige 25 % de dégâts supp: Guinevere deals 25% more damage to aerial enemies. Guinevere manages her basic attacks and accumulates super magic every time she deals damage. When fully charged, her next basic attack becomes guided, dealing hits and regenerating. Enemies hit by Guinevere's Improved Basic Attack, Energy Wave, or Space Migration are marked for 5 seconds. Those with 3 marks will be knocked into the air when hit by her Violet Requiem.
en|Guenièvre libère un orbe d'énergie da: Guinevere releases an orb of energy in the targeted direction, dealing damage to the first enemy hit and slowing them by 25% for 1.2 seconds. Successfully hitting an enemy reduces all skill cooldowns by 1 second.
en|Guenièvre saute vers l'emplacement ci: Guinevere jumps towards the target location, inflicting [stunning enemies there for 1 second]. Enemy Heroes and Creeps hit will be knocked into the air for 1 second and take additional magic damage. After casting, Guinevere can reactivate the skill in 5 seconds to blink towards the target direction [while invisible for 0.5 seconds] and leave an illusion behind. If the illusion takes damage, it restores Guinevere's Super Magic and will explode over 1.5 seconds, dealing damage to nearby enemies.
en|Guenièvre crée un champ de force auto: Guinevere creates a force field around herself [for 2 seconds], attacking nearby enemies 11 times over 2 seconds, dealing total damage. If the hit enemy is already in the air, they will be knocked into the air again, up to 8 additional times. Guinevere is immune to crowd control when casting this skill.
en|Chaque compétence lancée ajoute une r: Each skill cast adds a rune to Gusion's dagger (cumulative up to 4 times). Each stack enhances Gusion's next basic attack to deal additional damage equal to 3% of the target's maximum HP and restore itself.
en|Gusion lance un poignard dans la dire: Gusion throws a dagger in the target direction, dealing the first enemy hit and marking them. Use again|e}: Gusion moves behind the marked enemy and deals damage to them. This skill cannot be interrupted while Gusion is moving behind the marked enemy.
en|Gusion lance une volée de [cinq] dagu: Gusion launches a volley of [five] daggers in the targeted direction, each dealing damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 6% for 2 seconds (when hit by multiple daggers, the slow effect can stack up to 30%). Reuse:|e Gusion recalls daggers, each dealing damage to enemies in its path.
en|Gusion se précipite vers l'emplacemen: Gusion dashes to the target location, resetting the cooldown of Sword Spike and Shadowblade Slaughter. If Shadowblade Slaugther was cast once before the reset, Gusion can cast five more daggers during his next Shadowblade Slaughter, and recall a total of ten daggers afterward. Reuse:|e Gusion dashes a short distance to the target location.
en|Les attaques et compétences de base d: Hanabi's basic attacks and skills will launch Petal Blades after hitting a target, bouncing up to 4 times to nearby enemies (the first bounce deals 40% damage, and subsequent bounces deal 85% of the previous damage). Rebounds from his basic attacks inherit part of the attack effects.
en|Passif :|e Le Ninjutsu secret de l'Om: Passive:|e The Scarlet Shadow's Secret Ninjutsu makes Hanabi immune to control effects while she has a shield from any source. Active:|e Hanabi gains one for 5 seconds. When the shield is active, Hanabi gains 20% movement speed, 25% attack speed, and 20% of damage dealt will also be added to this shield (only 10% of damage dealt to non-hero units). The shield cannot exceed 50% of Hanabi's max HP.
en|Hanabi tire l'énergie Kunai dans la d: Hanabi fires Kunai energy in the targeted direction, dealing damage to enemies along the way and reducing their movement speed by 60% for 1 second. Enemy units hit will also be marked, allowing the next bounce damage from Hanabi's basic attacks to deal them without damage decay.
en|Hanabi lance Higanbana dans la direct: Hanabi casts Higanbana in the targeted direction, dealing the first enemy Hero hit and immobilizing them for 0.8 seconds. After 1 second, Higanbana will bloom at the location of the first hit, dealing damage to nearby enemies. Subsequent hits on the same target reduce damage by 20%.
en|Les dégâts infligés par les attaques: Damage dealt by Hanzo's basic attacks and skills inflicts a charge of Dark Ninjutsu on the target, up to 5 charges. Ninjutsu Demon Feast can only be cast on targets with full stacks of Dark Ninjutsu.
en|Cette compétence ne peut être utilisé: This skill can only be used on targets with maximum Dark Ninjutsu stacks. When targeting a creep, Hanzo will immediately devour it and digest it over a period of time to recover 20% HP. When targeting the Turtle, Lord, or enemy Heroes, it deals damage, recovers 10-20% HP, and reduces the cooldown of this skill by 60%.
en|Hanzo se précipite dans la direction: Hanzo dashes in the target direction, leaving a dark mist in front of him that deals to enemies in the area every 0.5 seconds, up to 5 times (this damage counts as base attack damage but cannot critically hit). The dark mist slows enemies in the area by 40% and grants Hanzo 20% movement speed.
en|Hanzo charge au combat en tant que Ha: Hanzo charges into battle as Hanekage, consuming 170 energy per second. He gains 20 Energy when a non-hero unit dies nearby and 200 Energy when it is a hero. He gains 15 Energy when he attacks a hero, and 45 Energy when he attacks the Turtle or the Lord. When the energy is exhausted, Hanzo's body will slowly be pulled towards Hanekage's position. In Hanekage form, Hanzo's body is invincible and Hanekage ignores obstacles and gains 50% movement speed and 30% attack speed. Use Again or Upon Death: Hanekage returns to Hanzo's body, recovering 16% and becoming untargetable upon return. If Hanekage is killed, Hanzo will be slowed by 50% and revealed for 6 seconds.
en|Les dégâts infligés par les attaques: Damage dealt by Hanzo's basic attacks and skills inflicts a charge of Dark Ninjutsu on the target, up to 5 charges. Ninjutsu: Demon Feast can only be cast on targets with full charges of Dark Ninjutsu.
en|Hanekage se précipite sur un héros en: Hanekage dashes at an enemy hero, dealing 300 (+60% bonus physical attack) physical damage to the target after a brief delay. Each stack of Dark Ninjutsu on the target increases this damage by 20%. When the target has maximum Dark Ninjutsu stacks, it deals additional damage equal to 15 (+2% additional Physical Attack)% of the target's maximum HP (ignoring 30% of the target's Physical Defense) and recovers 20% of Hanzo's maximum HP. This skill can be cast on the Turtle or the Lord (deals up to 1000 damage).
en|Hanekage se précipite dans la directi: Hanekage dashes in the target direction, knocking enemies in his path into the air for 0.4 sec and dealing 405 (+45% bonus Physical Attack) physical damage (recovers 200 energy if he hits an enemy hero), leaving a dark mist in the area he passes through. The mist deals 135 (+45% bonus physical attack) physical damage to enemies in the area every 0.5 sec (up to 4 times). It also slows enemies in the area by 40%. This damage is considered basic attack damage, but cannot be critical.
en|Hanekage retourne dans le corps de Ha: Hanekage returns to Hanzo's body and leaves the Hanekage form.
en|Harith tire un aperçu de sa clé. Il g: Harith takes a glimpse of his key. He gains 7% hybrid lifesteal for each nearby enemy hero, stacking up to 35%.
en|Harith crée un fantôme de lui-même da: Harith creates a ghost of himself in a distant location. Harith and his ghost will then cast Synchro Fission at each other, dealing to all enemy units in the path. When the 2 energy waves collide, an explosion occurs, affecting all enemies in the explosion area.
en|Harith se précipite vers la direction: Harith rushes towards the target direction. When he arrives, he steals magic power from enemy heroes, generates a shield that at least absorbs damage, and enhances his next basic attack. Harith's improved basic attack deals and slows enemies by 40%. Hitting an enemy with Harith's Improved Basic Attack reduces the cooldown of Chrono Dash by 3 seconds.
en|Harith utilise sa clé pour invoquer l: Harith uses his key to summon the Zaman Force. When the Multidimensional Rift appears, Chrono Dash's cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds. The Rift initially slows enemy Heroes in the area by 70% and will then continually slow enemy Heroes by 35%. If Harith comes into contact with the rift using Chrono Dash, he will absorb the energy inside and reduce the cooldown of Synchro Fission by 1 second and Chrono Dash by 3 seconds. Harith gains 15% resilience while on the Rift.
en|La maîtrise de la magie de Harley per: Harley's magic mastery allows her basic attack to deal 60 (+50% of total physical attack)(+60% of total magic power) magic damage. His attacks reduce the enemy's Magic Defense by 2 for 3 seconds when hit (up to 10 stacks).
en|Harley lance 3 à 5 vagues de cartes d: Harley throws 3-5 waves of cards in the target direction, each dealing 130-210 (+25% total Magic Power) magic damage to the first enemy hit and granting them 10% more Attack Speed ​​for 3 seconds afterward (up to 5-10 stacks). Enemies hit more than 3 times will take less damage from subsequent hits.
en|Harley cligne des yeux dans la direct: Harley blinks in the direction shown, leaving a magic hat in its place, increasing her movement speed by 30% for 2 seconds. Reuse: Use again within 4 seconds to return to where the hat is and lose the speed boost.
en|Harley lance un anneau de feu magique: Harley throws a ring of magic fire at the targeted enemy hero (can be blocked by other heroes), dealing 200-400 (+60% total magic power) magic damage and Slowing them by 40% for 1.5 seconds. The magic ring stays around the enemy for 4 seconds, during which Harley can hit the magic ring to damage the enemy with her skills. The magic ring will explode at the end of the duration, dealing 100-200 (+30% total magic power) plus 50% of the damage taken by the enemy during the duration as magic damage.
en|Les attaques d'Hayabusa appliquent un: Hayabusa's attacks apply a charge of Shadow Mark|mark to the hit (up to 4 charges). Each stack lasts 6 seconds and increases Hayabusa's damage to the enemy by 5%.
en|Hayabusa lance trois shurikens dans l: Hayabusa throws three shurikens in the target direction, each dealing damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 35% for 2 seconds. Enemies hit by multiple shurikens only take 30% damage after the first hit. Hayabusa restores 10 energy for each non-minion enemy hit. Passive:|e Hayabusa permanently gains 3% to 18% Spell Vamp.
en|Hayabusa se précipite dans la directi: Hayabusa rushes in the target direction and releases four ghosts that move in different directions. The ghosts will either stay at the end of their path or attach to the first enemy hero hit, damaging them and slowing them by 40% for 2 seconds. Hayabusa will immediately stop if he hits an enemy hero while sprinting. Reuse:|e Hayabusa teleports to a ghost's location and reduces the cooldown of Ninjutsu Phantom Shuriken by 1 second. If the ghost is attached to an enemy hero, it also deals with the enemy.
en|Hayabusa se fond dans l'ombre et lanc: Hayabusa blends into the shadows and launches 6 single-target attacks at enemies in the area, each dealing damage. Attacks prioritize enemies with Shadow Mark|mark and each will consume a mark to deal additional physical damage. Do not apply the shadow mark.
en|Helcurt reste dans l'état Prowler|e j: Helcurt remains in the Prowler|e state until spotted by the enemy team, gaining 15% additional movement speed and continually regenerating his HP if he has dealt no damage. He gains 50% more Attack Speed ​​and 50% more Movement Speed ​​(decreasing over time) for 4 seconds after being spotted and exits the Prowler|e state 0.75 seconds later. Any hero killed after being hit by Helcurt leaves a dark fog that explodes and spreads with a 10 second cooldown. Helcurt hides in the dark fog.
en|Passif|e : Lorsque Helcurt est dans l: Passive: When Helcurt is in the Prowler state, the skill terrifies enemy heroes hit and its cooldown decreases 3 times faster. Active: Helcurt flashes to the target location and deals damage to enemies in the area, reducing their movement speed by 60% for 0.75 sec.
en|Passif :|e Helcurt gagne un Dard mort: Passive:|e Helcurt gains a Deadly Stinger every 1.5 sec spent in the Prowler|e state or with each basic attack. Up to 5 stingers can be stored. Active:|e Helcurt pulls all Deadly Stinger forward, dealing each to enemies (minons and Creeps only take 70% damage). Deadly Stinger counts as a basic attack, but it cannot crit.
en|Helcurt invoque la Nuit Noire|e, rédu: Helcurt invokes Black Night, reducing the sight range of all enemies and causing them to lose sight of their allies for 3 seconds. During Dark Night|E, Helcurt gains 40% movement speed. Black Night makes it easier for Helcurt to leave enemies' sight range.
en|Hilda récupère 2% de HP par seconde l: Hilda recovers 2% HP per second while in the bush. Entering a bush enhances his next basic attack, which deals damage to the target, reduces the target's movement speed by 40%, and deals damage to enemies behind the target. After using the Improved Basic Attack, this effect goes into a 6 second cooldown. Hilda's basic attack and skills apply a mark of desert on a hit, which lasts up to 4 seconds and stacks up to 6. Each stack reduces the enemy hero's physical defense and magic defense by 3%.
en|Hilda gagne 60 % de vitesse de déplac: Hilda gains 60% movement speed for 3 seconds and receives a shield that absorbs damage equal to 10% of maximum HP for 3 seconds.
en|Hilda se verrouille sur une cible enn: Hilda locks onto an enemy target and deals damage to them each time. The skill can be released a maximum of 3 times. The 2nd attack will deal damage to the surroundings of the target, and the 3rd attack will temporarily knock back the target and surrounding enemies.
en|Hilda [saute en avant et] lance une p: Hilda [jumps forward and] launches a powerful attack at the target enemy, damaging and stunning them for 0.2 seconds. Nearby enemies also take 60% damage. Each stack of Wilderness Mark allows Power of Wildness to deal 2.5% of the target's maximum HP as additional damage. At maximum stacks, Power of Wildness deals 20% of the target's maximum HP as additional damage.
en|Hirara n'a que deux compétences, repr: Hirara only has two skills, representing her two weapons: Meisen-e and Kaerazu. Drag one skill onto another to initiate a combo skill. Hirara has 2 Purple Energy / Death. Casting a combo skill consumes 1 purple/death energy. Energy recovery time is the same as Meisen-e's cooldown. Energy consumption interrupts the recovery process. Hirara only deals 30 (+4*hero level)% damage to minions.
en|Hirara surfe sur les vagues en utilis: Hirara rides the waves using Meisen-e, performing two joystick dashes (the first dash goes in the direction facing her). She takes care of affected enemies.
en|Hirara utilise Kaerazu pour libérer l: Hirara uses Kaerazu to release the Crimson Maple, dealing damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area. After a short delay, it deals damage again to the target location, dealing 2 times Crimson Maple's initial damage.
en|Hirara améliore Kaerazu avec le pouvo: Hirara enhances Kaerazu with the power of Meisen-e to launch a combo skill. She becomes untargetable and immobilized for 1 second maximum. After 0.6 sec, she deals 3x the damage of Crimson Maple, and can then throw Meisen-e's second joystick to end these states early.
en|Hirara améliore Meisen-e avec le pouv: Hirara enhances Meisen-e with Kaerazu's power to launch a combo skill. After throwing Meisen-e's first joystick, she spins, dealing 2.5 times the damage of Crimson Maple and rooting enemies for 0.8 seconds.
en|Hylos gagne 1,5 HP Max supplémentaire: Hylos gains 1.5 additional Max HP for each additional 1 Max Mana he possesses. When he runs out of mana, Hylos can use his HP to cast skills.
en|Hylos gagne 50 % de vitesse de déplac: Hylos gains 50% movement speed and allows his next basic attack within 3 seconds to damage, knock back, and stun the target for 1 second. The bonus movement speed decreases quickly over time and ends after the next basic attack.
en|Hylos libère l'Anneau du châtiment|E,: Hylos unleashes the Ring of Punishment|E, dealing damage to nearby enemies per second while slowing them by 4-6% and reducing their attack speed by 7.5-15% for 2.5 seconds (up to 8 stacks). Each stack also increases the damage dealt to the enemy by the Ring of Punishment by 5-20%. The Ring of Punishment consumes 30 to 150 Mana per second while active. Reuse|e; Hylos cancels the Ring of Punishment.
en|Hylos crée un énorme chemin dans la d: Hylos creates a huge path in the targeted direction, reducing enemies' movement by 75% for 1 second. The course lasts 6 seconds. While on the path, Hylos gains slow immunity and recovers 3% of his max HP} per second. Allied heroes moving along the path gain 60% additional movement speed, while enemy heroes on the path will be slowed by 25%.
en|Le travail d'équipe impeccable d'Irit: Irithel and Leo's impeccable teamwork allows him to shoot on the move. Each basic attack will fire 2 crossbow bolts (but takes longer to reload) which deal per bolt (inherits part [55%] of attack effects). The move will build Jungle Heart, up to a maximum of 10 units, and cause the next basic attack to trigger 1 additional bolt(s).
en|Irithel lance une volée de flèches su: Irithel launches a volley of arrows at the target area, damaging enemies within and reducing their physical defense by 15 to 40 for 3 seconds.
en|Leo laisse échapper un rugissement pe: Leo lets out a piercing roar, dealing damage to nearby enemies and Slowing them by 40% for 2 seconds.
en|Irithel ordonne à Leo de sauter dans: Irithel orders Leo to jump in the target direction and boosts his crossbow for 10 seconds. During this duration, she gains 30 additional movement speed and her basic attacks fire enhanced crossbow bolts, damaging the target and nearby units. Jungle Heart also stacks faster over the duration. [amount unknown]
en|Les attaques et compétences de base d: Ixia's basic attacks and skills apply a stack of Starlium Charge|e to enemies when hit. When Ixia performs a basic attack on an enemy with two stacks of Starlium Charge, the attack will consume the charges and be replaced with Siphon Starlium|e, dealing a bonus to the target. Ixia recovers HP equal to the damage dealt by Siphon Starlium (only % against non-hero units). Siphon Starlium can trigger on any enemies in front of Ixia that are within range of its basic attack, but it cannot deal a critical hit. Ixia's basic attacks cannot trigger lifesteal.
en|Ixia tire 2 faisceaux d'énergie charg: Ixia fires 2 Starlium-charged energy beams along the ground in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies in a rectangular area and slowing enemy Heroes by 40%. When hitting an enemy hero, Ixia also gains 40% movement speed for 3 seconds. Enemies hit by both beams will take double damage.
en|Ixia lance une cartouche d'énergie St: Ixia launches a Starlium energy canister in the target direction, knocking back nearby enemies and pulling enemies within range towards the midline after a short delay (approximately 0.5 seconds) and damaging them.
en|Ixia démonte son arme en 6 armes plus: Ixia disassembles her weapon into 6 smaller weapons and enters the Barrage state for 4 seconds. In this state, Ixia's basic attacks and skills can hit enemies in a large fan-shaped area, but not outside. Ixia's basic attacks can hit up to 6 enemy units (prioritizing heroes), and Siphon Starlium will fire simultaneously with her normal basic attacks.
en|Les attaques de Jawhead appliquent un: Jawhead's attacks apply a charge of Mecha Suppression on impact (up to 10 charges). Each stack lasts 3 seconds and increases the damage of Jawhead's basic attacks on the enemy by 8%.
en|Jawhead lance jusqu'à 12 missiles sur: Jawhead launches up to 12 missiles at random nearby enemies for 5 seconds, with each missile dealing damage to the enemy hit.
en|Jawhead gagne 30% de vitesse de dépla: Jawhead gains 30% movement speed and one for S seconds. Reuse:|e Jawhead knocks the nearest unit (prioritizing Heroes) towards the target location, dealing damage to enemies in the area and stunning them for 0.5 seconds. Can be used on allied heroes and they will not take damage.
en|Jawhead charge le héros ennemi ciblé,: Jawhead charges at the targeted enemy hero, inflicting and briefly stunning them. [duration unknown] Enemies around the target are knocked back and deal the same amount of damage. Jawhead is immune to control effects while charging.
en|Lorsque les PV de Johnson descendent: When Johnson's HP drops below 30%, he gains one for 10 seconds. Cooldown: 100.0 seconds.
en|Johnson lance sa clé vers l'emplaceme: Johnson throws his wrench towards the target location, dealing damage to enemies in his path. Enemies around the landing point are stunned for 0.8 seconds.
en|Johnson lève son bouclier, infligeant: Johnson raises his shield, continuously dealing damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area in the target direction and slowing them by 20%. Each instance of damage also increases the enemy's subsequent damage caused by the skill by 15% (up to 45%). This damage is increased by 60% against creeps. Johnson can perform basic attacks and skills for the duration of the spell.
en|Johnson se transforme en voiture et c: Johnson transforms into a car and begins to speed up over time. An allied hero can use Hop In|e near Johnson to board the car (only one allied hero can ride with Johnson). The car will explode when hitting a hero or enemy obstacle, dealing damage to nearby enemies. stunning them for 0.5 to 1 second (scales with the speed of the car before impact), [unknown speed] and creating an electrified zone at the location. The area continually deals and slows enemies in it. While in a car, press Brake to stop immediately or hold Nitrous to continuously gain speed for up to 5 seconds. Johnson's location will be revealed to the enemy for 3 seconds when casting this skill. Passive:|e Johnson's physical defense is increased by 10% to 30%.
en|Joy devient en colère !|E à chaque fo: Joy becomes Angry!|E whenever her skill hits a non-minion enemy, dealing 100 magic damage and increasing her movement speed by 60% which decreases over 4 seconds (hitting the Leonin Crystal|E will also grant the movement speed effect). This effect has a cooldown of 4 seconds for each target. Joy's basic attack will deal.
en|Joy invoque un Leonin Crystal|E à l'e: Joy summons a Leonin Crystal|E to the target location, dealing damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 30% for 1 second. The Leonine Crystal lasts 2 seconds and can be used as a springboard for its second skill, Meow, Rhythm of Joy!.
en|Joy se précipite dans la direction ci: Joy dashes in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies in her path. Hitting an enemy or the Leonin Crystal|E allows Joy to cast this skill again in 0.8 seconds and gain 1 Beat Energy. Casting this skill on beat increases the skill's damage by 100% and grants a shield that lasts for 3 seconds. This skill can be cast up to 4 times in a row.
en|Joy augmente sa défense physique et m: Joy increases her physical and magical defense and gains 30% movement speed. Over the next 4 seconds, it pulses 8 times, each time damaging nearby enemies. Each Meow, Rhythm of Joy!|E cast on the rhythm increases the damage of this skill by 40%. If a perfect rhythm is achieved by hitting each beat with Meow, Rhythm of Joy!|E, Joy also gains 40% Spell Vamp while this skill is active. This skill is unlocked when Joy acquires Beat Energy|E. Casting this skill with 3 Beat Energy|E will remove all debuffs from Joy and make her immune to slow effects while this skill is active.
en|Après avoir lancé deux compétences di: After casting two different skills, Julian upgrades his third skill. Casting the upgraded skill makes all his skills work with a cooldown of 9 to 6 seconds (decreases with his level. After casting a skill, his basic attacks in the next 5 seconds to deal and pull the target towards him. Casting another skill extends the duration. Julian gains 15% additional hybrid lifesteal for 5 seconds every time he hits an enemy hero with his skills (up to 3 charges).
en|Julian lance une faux volante dans la: Julian throws a flying scythe in the targeted direction, dealing damage to enemies along the way and slowing them by 30% for 1 second. The scythe disappears when hitting a non-minion enemy.
en|Julian invoque une épée volante et se: Julian summons a flying sword and rushes in the target direction, dealing damage to enemies along the way.
en|Julian lance des chaînes à l'emplacem: Julian throws chains at the target location, dealing 300 (+100% total Magic Power) magic damage to enemies hit after a short delay and Rooting them for 1.2 seconds.
en|Après avoir lancé deux compétences di: After casting two different skills, Julian upgrades his third skill. it|Lorsqu'Alpha utilise une compétence,: Quando Alpha usa un'abilità, Beta verrà convocato per attaccare. I [Nemici non-mionari] che vengono colpiti dalla Beta 2 volte verranno bloccati per |mark. Bloccato | marchio: una volta che Alpha ha inflitto danni al bersaglio, Beta gli sparerà un laser, infliggendo brevemente e applicando un potente [lento del 90% per 0,2 secondi].
it|Alpha libère une vague d'énergie dans: Alpha rilascia un'ondata di energia nella direzione presa di mira, infliggendo danni ai nemici sul suo percorso e rallentandoli del 40% per 1 secondo. Beta quindi colpisce i nemici sullo stesso percorso e li infligge.
it|Après un court délai, Alpha balance s: Dopo un breve ritardo, Alpha fa oscillare la sua lama nella direzione del bersaglio, infliggendo danni ai nemici in un'area a forma di ventaglio e recuperando ogni nemico colpito. Beta quindi colpisce i nemici nella stessa area e li infligge.
it|La bêta plonge dans l'emplacement cib: Beta si tuffa nella posizione bersaglio, infliggendo e stordendo i nemici colpiti per 1 secondo. Alpha quindi salta nella stessa posizione, lanciando in aria i nemici sul suo cammino e trasportandoli nel punto di atterraggio. Alpha poi colpisce, danneggiando e rallentando i nemici del 40% per 1,5 secondi. Beta quindi colpisce i nemici nella stessa area 5 volte, danneggiandoli.
it|Après chaque compétence lancée, la pr: Dopo ogni abilità lanciata, il successivo attacco base di Alucard gli consente di correre verso la posizione del bersaglio e distribuirlo.
it|Alucard roule jusqu'à l'emplacement c: Alucard rotola verso la posizione bersaglio e colpisce il terreno con la sua lama, infliggendo danni ai nemici colpiti e rallentandoli del 40% per 2 secondi.
it|Alucard lance une attaque tourbillonn: Alucard lancia un attacco rotante che infligge danni ai nemici vicini.
it|Passif :|e Alucard gagne en permanenc: Passivo:|e Alucard guadagna permanentemente il 10-30% di Rubavita ibrido aggiuntivo. Attivo: Alucard assorbe energia dai nemici nell'area bersaglio, riducendo la loro velocità di movimento del 30% e la loro Difesa Ibrida di 10-20. Alucard ottiene 10-20 Difesa Ibrida per ogni eroe nemico colpito e riduce il tempo di recupero delle sue altre abilità al 50% per 6 secondi. Usa di nuovo: Alucard rilascia un'onda d'urto nella direzione del bersaglio, danneggiando i nemici colpiti.
it|Angela gagne 7,5 % de vitesse de dépl: Angela ottiene il 7,5% di velocità di movimento aggiuntiva per 4 secondi ogni volta che lancia un'abilità (fino al 30%). Quando è attaccato a un eroe alleato, l'aumento della velocità di movimento viene trasferito all'eroe alleato.
it|Angela envoie des Love Waves|e dans l: Angela invia Love Waves|e nella direzione bersaglio, infliggendo i nemici colpiti, rivelando brevemente la loro posizione, [tempo necessario] e applicando loro una pila di Lover's Mark|mark (fino a 5 pile). Ogni pila di Marchio dell'amante aumenta i danni del 20% e rallenta i nemici colpiti dell'8% per 3 secondi. Love Waves|e ripristina anche gli eroi alleati colpiti. Angela può immagazzinare fino a 5 cariche di questa abilità e il tempo di recupero è influenzato dalla riduzione del tempo di recupero.
it|Angela lance un Puppet String|e sur l: Angela lancia un Puppet String|e sul nemico bersaglio, infliggendo danni e rallentandolo gradualmente fino all'80%. Se il nemico è ancora collegato alla corda dopo 3 secondi, verrà immobilizzato per 1,5 secondi e riceverà cure. Ogni pila di Marchio dell'Amante|marchio aumenta il danno finale del 20%.
it|Angela commence la canalisation [pend: Angela inizia a incanalare [per 2 secondi], applicando un effetto che dura 6 secondi all'eroe alleato bersaglio, indipendentemente dalla distanza. Una volta completata la canalizzazione, si lega all'eroe alleato per 12 secondi, durante i quali può lanciare abilità senza alcun costo di mana. Angela può lanciare nuovamente questa abilità per annullare l'incanalamento o staccarsi dall'eroe alleato. Lo stato di attaccamento terminerà prematuramente se l'eroe alleato viene ucciso.
it|Arlott possède un œil démoniaque qui: Arlott ha un occhio demoniaco che segnerà le unità nemiche vicino ad Arlott che saranno influenzate dagli effetti di controllo per 7 secondi. L'occhio segnerà automaticamente anche un eroe nemico vicino ogni 7 secondi.
it|Arlott balance sa lance vers l'avant,: Arlott fa oscillare la sua lancia in avanti, danneggiando e stordendo brevemente i bersagli nell'area. I bersagli colpiti dalla parte più lontana dell'AOE rimarranno storditi per 1 secondo.
it|Arlott charge un ennemi et le traite: Arlott carica un nemico e lo affronta (questa abilità non può essere interrotta durante il movimento). Se il bersaglio di Arlott viene marchiato, questa abilità infliggerà il doppio del danno, aggiornerà il suo tempo di recupero e ripristinerà Arlott (ripristina solo il 50% di questo importo se usata su un'unità non eroe).
it|Arlott se fend devant lui, s'attaquan: Arlott si lancia davanti a lui, affrontando i bersagli nell'area e spingendoli al limite dell'AOE e rivelando brevemente la loro posizione.
it|Atlas génère un souffle glacial autou: Atlas genera un soffio ghiacciato intorno a sé per 5 secondi ogni volta che lancia un'abilità. La velocità di movimento dei nemici che rimangono nell'area per più di 1,5 secondi verrà gradualmente ridotta fino a quando non verranno congelati per 0,5 secondi. Atlas ottiene 16-30 difese fisiche e magiche aggiuntive quando è presente Respiro Frigido.
it|Atlas fracasse le sol et provoque 3 e: Atlas spacca il terreno e provoca 3 esplosioni. Ogni esplosione infligge danni ai nemici. Stato di espulsione: se Atlas viene espulso dal suo Mecha Sentry, lui e il suo Mecha lanceranno Annientamento.
it|Atlas entre dans l'état éjecté|e, gag: Atlas entra nello stato espulso, ottenendo il 30% di velocità di movimento e l'immunità agli effetti di rallentamento. In questo stato, il Mecha Sentry seguirà il pilota ad una velocità crescente (può essere controllato solo da Suppression|cc). Una volta che si incontrano, Atlas tornerà al Mech, infliggendo danni ai nemici vicini e stordendoli per 1 secondo. Stato espulso: Atlas e il suo Mech condividono la stessa barra HP|HP e riducono i danni subiti del 50%|riduzione del danno in questo stato.
it|Atlas lance des chaînes et commence à: Atlas lancia catene e inizia a incanalare (può essere interrotto solo rimuovendo |cc), infliggendo danni agli eroi nemici colpiti e rallentandoli del 40% per 3 secondi. Usa di nuovo questa abilità durante la canalizzazione: Atlas attirerà i bersagli verso di sé e li abbatterà | cc nella posizione designata, infliggendo loro danni. Usa questa abilità nello stato Ejected|e: il Mecha Sentry tornerà immediatamente su Atlas, ma l'effetto di stordimento sarà sostituito da un effetto di rallentamento del 40%.
it|Après avoir infligé des dégâts, Aulus: Dopo aver inflitto danni, Aulus aggiunge una carica di Spirito Guerriero alla sua ascia al secondo per 4 secondi (fino a 6 cariche). Ogni stack garantisce% di velocità d'attacco. Al massimo degli stack di Spirito Guerriero, l'attacco base di Aulus è migliorato e ottiene la portata dell'attacco. Attacco base migliorato: Aulus colpisce il terreno con la sua ascia, infliggendo + (% degli HP massimi del bersaglio) ai nemici in linea.
it|Aulus commence à accumuler de l'Espri: Aulus inizia ad accumulare Spirito Guerriero, rimuove tutti gli effetti di rallentamento e ottiene il 30% di velocità di movimento aggiuntiva per 5 secondi. Se Aulus non subisce effetti di controllo di alto livello entro 2 secondi, entrerà nello stato Infuriato e otterrà l'immunità al controllo.
it|Aulus balance sa hache, infligeant de: Aulo fa oscillare la sua ascia, infliggendo danni ai nemici in un'area a forma di ventaglio e rallentandoli del 30% per 2 secondi. Dopo aver colpito un nemico, Aulus può lanciare nuovamente questa abilità per scattare e frantumare il terreno, infliggendo danni ai nemici vicini.
it|Aulus balance sa hache à plusieurs re: Aulo fa oscillare ripetutamente la sua ascia contro i nemici vicini, colpendo ogni volta. Dopo 4 colpi, Aulo carica brevemente prima di scatenare un attacco più ampio, colpendo i nemici in un'ampia area. Durante questa abilità, Aulus ottiene una riduzione del danno del 20-40% e una breve esplosione di velocità di movimento ad ogni colpo.
it|Après avoir subi des dégâts mortels,: Dopo aver subito danni fatali, Aurora si blocca per 1,5 secondi, diventando invincibile durante questo periodo e recuperando gradualmente il 30% dei suoi HP massimi. Questo effetto ha un tempo di recupero di 150 secondi. Gli effetti di congelamento di Aurora possono influenzare anche le torrette.
it|Aurora invoque une météorite glacée p: Aurora evoca un meteorite ghiacciato che colpisce la posizione bersaglio, infliggendo e rallentando i bersagli colpiti del 40% per 1 secondo. Poi cadono 5 chicchi di grandine, ciascuno dei quali infligge danni.
it|Aurora souffle Frosty Breeze dans une: Aurora lancia Brezza Gelida in un'area a forma di ventaglio nella direzione del bersaglio, infliggendo danni ai nemici colpiti, congelandoli per 1 secondo e creando un'area ghiacciata alla fine dell'attacco che infligge un totale di ai nemici nell'area.
it|Aurora crée un chemin de givre dans l: Aurora crea un percorso di gelo nella direzione presa di mira, infliggendo danni ai nemici sul percorso e riducendo la loro velocità di movimento dell'80% per 1,2 secondi. Il percorso gelido si trasforma gradualmente in ghiacciai che si espandono fino a raggiungere la dimensione massima e si frantumano, infliggendo danni a tutti i nemici nell'area e congelando i bersagli per 1 secondo. Ogni 100 poteri magici posseduti da Aurora aumenterà la durata del congelamento di 0,2 secondi.
it|Après chaque 4 noms = attaque de base: Dopo ogni 4 nomi = attacco base, il successivo attacco base di Badang colpisce i nemici e li respinge. I nemici scagliati contro gli ostacoli verranno storditi per 0,6 secondi (i servitori e i mostri vengono storditi direttamente). Anche il Pugno di Vento generato dalle abilità di Badang può attivare questo effetto.
it|Badang libère une rafale de vent de p: Badang rilascia un'esplosione di pugno d'aria nella direzione mirata, infliggendo danni ai nemici colpiti, rallentandoli del 30% per 1,5 secondi e respingendoli indietro. Il Pugno di Vento esploderà quando colpisce un ostacolo, infliggendo danni ai nemici vicini. Pugno Vento può attivare effetti di attacco e conferisce a Badang 1 accumulo di Pugno Cavalleresco al momento del lancio. Badang immagazzina fino a 2 cariche di Pugno di Vento e ripristina 1 carica ogni 10,4 secondi.
it|Badang se précipite dans la direction: Badang scatta nella direzione presa di mira, infliggendo danni ai nemici sul suo cammino e ottenendone uno che dura 5 secondi. Si ferma immediatamente dopo aver colpito un eroe nemico, spingendolo leggermente indietro e creando un ostacolo che dura 4 secondi dietro di lui. I nemici colpiti dall'ostacolo vengono eliminati. Usa di nuovo: Badang rimuove l'ostacolo che ha creato.
it|Badang lance une rafale de coups de p: Badang lancia una raffica di pugni nella direzione del bersaglio, colpendo i nemici 9 volte in 2,5 secondi (può attivare effetti di attacco). Il vento generato dai pugni esploderà quando si colpisce un ostacolo, infliggendo danni ai nemici vicini. Badang è immune agli effetti di controllo per tutta la durata dell'incantesimo.
it|Balmond récupère 5 % de ses PV maximu: Balmond recupera il 5% dei suoi HP massimi dopo aver ucciso un servitore o un Creep e il 20% dei suoi HP massimi dopo aver ucciso un eroe.
it|Balmond charge dans la direction cibl: Balmond carica nella direzione del bersaglio per una distanza prestabilita o finché non colpisce un eroe nemico, infliggendo danni ai nemici lungo il percorso. L'eroe nemico colpito verrà leggermente respinto e vedrà la sua velocità di movimento ridotta del 40% e la sua difesa fisica ridotta del 40% per 3 secondi.
it|Balmond gagne 15 % de vitesse de dépl: Balmond ottiene il 15% di velocità di movimento che diminuisce nel tempo e fa oscillare la sua ascia per 3 secondi, infliggendo fino a 14 volte per colpo ai nemici vicini. Ogni colpo successivo sullo stesso nemico infliggerà l'8,5% di danni in più (fino al 68%). La parte bonus dell'attacco fisico del danno può essere fondamentale.
it|Balmond déclenche une énorme frappe d: Balmond sferra un potente colpo nella direzione presa di mira (questa abilità può essere interrotta solo da Soppressione), infliggendo danni. Questa abilità infligge solo 1.000-2.000 danni alle unità non eroi.
it|Bane imprègne son arme d'une pile d'é: Bane infonde nella sua arma un accumulo di energia mareale ogni volta che usa un'abilità (fino a 2 accumuli). Ciascuno dei suoi successivi attacchi base consuma una carica per infliggere danni fisici pari agli HP massimi del bersaglio ai nemici vicini. (Percentuale di danno inflitto in base al limite massimo di danno HP contro i Creep:. (vedi Note sulla patch 1.7.82 Regolazione del bilanciamento))
it|Bane tire avec son canon à pinces de: Bane spara con il suo cannone ad artiglio di granchio nella direzione presa di mira, infliggendo il 150-200% di danni al primo nemico colpito e poi a un nemico casuale dietro di lui (dando priorità agli eroi nemici). I nemici colpiti vengono rallentati del % per 1 secondo. Ogni 100 attacchi fisici di Bane riduce il tempo di recupero di questa abilità di un ulteriore 8%.
it|Bane boit sa bière, récupérant plus%: Bane beve la sua birra, recuperando più della% dei suoi HP persi e guadagnando il 50% di velocità di movimento aggiuntiva che decade in 2,5 secondi. Riutilizzo: Bane sputa veleno nella direzione del bersaglio, colpendo (fino al 200% con il tempo di carica) i nemici in un'area a forma di ventaglio. Ogni 100 punti di potere magico posseduti da Bane riducono inoltre il tempo di recupero di questa abilità del 7%. |rapporto-vamp-incantesimo-50%
it|Bane invoque un banc de requins pour: Bane evoca un branco di squali che caricano nella direzione bersaglio, danneggiandoli, lanciandoli in aria per 0,6 secondi e rallentandoli del 75% (si disintegra in 3 secondi). Questa abilità infligge il 40% di danni alle torrette. |rapporto-vamp-incantesimo-50%
it|Detona gagne une pile de Big Guy|stac: Detona ottiene uno stack di Big Guy|stack per 12 secondi ogni volta che lui o Barats danneggiano un nemico con le sue abilità (fino a 10 stack). Ogni pila di Big Guy aumenta le dimensioni di Detona e garantisce 4-10 difese ibride aggiuntive (si adatta al livello di benvenuto di Detona) e il 5% di resilienza aggiuntiva. Al massimo degli stack, gli attacchi base di Detona verranno sostituiti con l'attacco base Travolgere|, che infligge danni ai nemici in un'area circolare, li rallenta del 40% per 0,2 secondi e aggiorna la durata di Big Guy ad ogni colpo.
it|Detona crache de l'huile contaminée d: Detona sputa olio contaminato nella direzione del bersaglio, infliggendo danni ai nemici in un'area a forma di ventaglio. Barats quindi accende l'olio con un petardo, infliggendo danni ai nemici nell'area. L'area di effetto del cosiddetto lavoro di squadra aumenta con il numero di stack Big Guy. [Quanto ?]
it|Barats tire deux missiles sur l'empla: Barats lancia due missili sulla posizione bersaglio, infliggendo e rallentando i nemici del 40% per 1 secondo. I missili espellono il fumo dai loro scarichi all'atterraggio, infliggendo danni ai nemici in un'area rettangolare e spingendoli verso Barats.
it|Après un court délai, Detona charge d: Dopo un breve ritardo, Detona carica nella direzione del bersaglio, infliggendo il primo nemico colpito, divorandolo e sopprimendolo per 1,2 secondi prima di sputarlo. Se il bersaglio colpisce un eroe o un muro nemico dopo essere stato sputato addosso, il bersaglio causerà un'esplosione, lui e i nemici vicini ne subiranno un'ulteriore e rimarranno storditi per 1 secondo. Durante questo periodo, Barats diventa immune agli effetti di controllo. Se il canale viene cancellato, verrà rimborsato il 60% del tempo di recupero delle abilità. Passiva: Detona ottiene 4-10 stack di Big Guy al momento della rigenerazione.
it|Baxia active la Marque Baxia de maniè: Baxia attiva Baxia Mark in modo permanente, riducendo i danni finali subiti di 15 (+1 livello eroe). Allo stesso tempo, Baxia ridurrà lo scudo e la rigenerazione degli HP dell'eroe nemico del 50% per 4 secondi quando viene colpito dalle sue abilità.
it|Baxia se rétracte dans son bouclier e: Baxia si ritrae nel suo scudo e accelera in avanti [per 9 secondi]. Quando colpisce un'unità nemica, infligge danni a lei e ai nemici vicini, stordendo il bersaglio per 0,8 secondi e respingendo leggermente gli altri nemici vicini. Durante il processo di accelerazione, usa nuovamente questa abilità per lanciare Baxia verso l'alto in modo che possa superare ostacoli e servitori nemici. Mentre salti, se c'è un eroe nemico sotto Baxia, abbatterà quell'eroe, infliggendo danni a quell'eroe e ai nemici vicini, stordendo il bersaglio colpito per 1,5 secondi e respingendo leggermente altri bersagli nemici vicini.
