es|Zilong jette l'ennemi ciblé par-dessu: Zilong lanza al enemigo objetivo sobre su cabeza y le inflige daño.
es|Zilong se jette sur l'ennemi ciblé, i: Zilong se lanza contra el enemigo objetivo, infligiendo y reduciendo su defensa física entre 15 y 30 durante 2 segundos. El tiempo de reutilización de Spear Strike se reinicia cada vez que Zilong mata a un enemigo.
es|Zilong supprime tous les effets de ra: Zilong elimina todos los efectos de ralentización sobre sí mismo y gana un 40% de velocidad de movimiento, un 35-55% de velocidad de ataque e inmunidad a la ralentización durante 7,5 segundos. Mientras dure, puede activar Dragon Furry cada 2 ataques básicos (en lugar de los 3 anteriores).
en|Le mode classique est le premier et l: Classic Mode is the first and oldest game mode in Mobile Legends. All other game modes use the Classic rules as a basis. This mode offers the 5v5 and Mobile Legends experience without fear of losing your rank, but your win rate will be affected, both on the hero side and overall.​​​​ Classic mode is suitable for beginners who need to familiarize themselves with Mobile Legends games. You can freely choose any hero you own, as well as free weekly heroes and any trial cards you own. However, you cannot have more than one hero in your team. You can also choose the hero you like, since there is no hero ban unlike Ranked mode.
en|Comme tous les jeux MOBA, l'objectif: Like all MOBA games, the main objective is to destroy the enemy base. This requires you to defend your turrets and base and destroy theirs. Each turret in a specific lane must be destroyed in sequence for your minions to reach the base. There are ways to destroy turrets by using minions/creeps to take damage from turret bullets. After destroying the turrets, you will be able to damage/destroy the enemy base. Destroying the last turret in a lane will grant super minions that deal high damage to heroes and clear lanes faster. Sometimes players are forced to rack up kills against enemy heroes instead of focusing on enemy minions and turrets. More kills might get them MVP and farming, but destroying the turrets, accessing the enemy base and destroying it is the main objective.
en|Celestial Palace/Western Expanse — Un: Celestial Palace/Western Expanse — A field inspired by the Defense of the Ancients: Allstars (DOTA for short) version of the map, with several features and mechanics changed. The game consists of five heroes from each team, who are then placed in an arena with the goal of destroying everyone's base inhibitor, resulting in a victory. The typical time it takes to complete most games is around 10-15 minutes, but some games can last over 30 minutes.
en|Le champ de bataille est divisé en tr: The battlefield is divided into three lanes to fight your way to the enemy base.
en|Une jungle peuplée de monstres de la: A jungle populated with jungle monsters grants healing buffs, role buffs, and gold buffs when defeated. There are also Boss Monsters that provide gold for your entire team or the Lord fighting alongside you.
en|La Voie d'Or peut également être empr: The Golden Path can also be taken by Tanks moving for the team to quickly obtain items to support the team.
en|Classé est un mode de jeu de file d'a: Ranked is a competitive queue game mode. Players earn or lose stars if they win or lose in this mode. Warrior, Elite, Master, Grandmaster, Epic, Legend and Mythic (Mythical Honor, Mythical Glory and Mythical Immortal) are the seven ranks of Mobile Legends: Bang Bang.
en|Les joueurs peuvent choisir trois hér: Players can choose three heroes to feature in their lobby and draft phase. These heroes must be played at least once in a row.
en|Les joueurs peuvent jouer en solo ou: Players can play solo or form a team of two, three, or five players to queue up. Players can invite other players of a higher or lower rank than them to the lobby. A team of four people is not permitted.
en|Lorsqu'une équipe avec des joueurs de: When a team with players of different ranks queues, it is called Flex Rank, and they will only queue the matches of the highest ranked person.
en|Un joueur Mythique fait équipe avec u: A Mythic player teams up with an Epic player, both will follow the Mythic player's draft rule.
en|Un joueur Mythic Glory fait équipe av: A Mythic Glory player teams up with a Grandmaster player and a Legend player, all of whom will follow the Mythic player draft rule, although Draft Pick is not normally available to players below Epic rank.
en|Cependant, un joueur en file d'attent: However, a player in solo queue may find themselves matchmaking with higher or lower ranked allies, this can be triggered by the following:
en|Les alliés jouent en équipe tandis qu: Allies play as a team while you are solo. Among the allies of said team is at least one player of similar rank to yours.
en|Exemple : un joueur Epic fait équipe: Example: An Epic player teams up with a Legend player and you, an Epic player, can meet them.
en|Tous les joueurs jouent en solo, mais: All players are playing solo, but the enemy team has someone with a similar rank to you.
en|Exemple : Votre rang est Légende, mai: Example: Your rank is Legend, but 4 of your teammates are Mythic. So at least one of the enemies is Legend.
en|Lorsque ce phénomène se produit, il e: When this phenomenon occurs, it is possible that only one team member is in a different rank.
en|Exemple : Votre équipe compte 4 joueu: Example: Your team has 4 players at Legend rank and 1 player at Mythic rank, this means the enemy team can have 1-4 players at Mythic rank, but there must be someone at Epic rank.
en|Grâce à cette mécanique de Flex Rank,: Thanks to this Flex Rank mechanic, even a solo player from Legend I can queue with an ally from Epic V, as they are just a different rank, but the gap is very different, leading to the widely perceived dark system.
en|Une option de matchmaking rapide sera: A quick matchmaking option will be offered if the queue is taking too long, this option will match you even with players you blocked previously.
en|Si le joueur que vous avez bloqué fai: If the player you blocked teams up with someone you don't block, you can still queue with them during the match.
en|Lorsqu'un joueur atteint Epic V ou su: When a player reaches Epic V or higher (Grandmaster V or higher in Advanced Server), Draft Pick becomes available for future matches. Unlike Blind Pick, Draft Pick allows both teams to see their heroes during their selection, and allows up to 10 banned heroes (3/4/5 bans in Epic/Legend/Mythic) for each team for balancing purposes. Heroes already selected or banned cannot be chosen for the duration of the match.
en|Il y a sept rangs dans Mobile Legends: There are seven ranks in Mobile Legends: Bang Bang. They are: Warrior, Elite, Master, Grandmaster, Epic, Legendary and Mythical.
en|Chaque rang comporte des divisions éc: Each rank has divisions written in Roman numerals and a certain number of stars necessary to be promoted to the next division or rank. If a player exceeds the maximum number of stars in their current division or falls below zero stars, they can move to the next division or return to the previous division. Completing all divisions from their current rank or being demoted from all divisions will result in promotion to the next rank or demotion to the previous rank.
en|Dans Mythic, les étoiles ont été remp: In Mythic, stars have been replaced with points to advance to the next division.
en|Points de levée d'étoiles et de prote: Star Raising and Star Protection Points
en|Il existe de nombreuses méthodes pour: There are many methods to increase or prevent star loss, leading to star elevation and protection points.
en|La levée d'étoiles permet aux joueurs: Star Raising allows players to earn an additional star when a player reaches 100% Star Raising Points on their next victory. 100/200/300/500/700/1000 points required at Warrior / Elite / Master / Grandmaster / Epic / Legend. Star increase bonus points cannot be accumulated in Mythic ranks.
en|La protection des étoiles permet aux: Star Protection allows players to avoid losing a star in a match by reaching 100% Star Protection points or using Star Protection cards. 100/200/300/500/700/1000/1500 points required at Warrior / Elite / Master / Grandmaster / Epic / Legend / Mythic.
en|Les cartes de protection des étoiles: Star Protection Cards are usually obtained through in-game events or through Starlight Rewards. They generally only last 7 days once obtained or claimed on the event pages.
en|La carte de protection de rang est la: The rank protection card is the card that prevents you from demoting once you reach the previous rank. It is often acquired after reaching a higher rank: from Epic to Legend, from Legend to Mythic.
en|Seuls les points de protection des ét: Only Star Protection Points are available in Mythic, as Star Obtaining Points are disabled.
en|Les cartes de protection de rang ne p: Rank protection cards can only be obtained from rank promotion rewards. Unlike star protection points/cards, they only activate on defeats that will result in a player being demoted (for example, a defeat resulting in a loss of stars from Legend V 0 stars to Epic I 4 stars, demoting from Legend rank to Epic rank).
en|Une fois la saison terminée, tous les: Once the season ends, all players will start their new season with their new rank based on their ranking from the previous season. They also receive the reward for reaching a certain rank.
en|La réinitialisation du classement n'e: The ranking reset is only applied when the player logs in for the first time in the new season, but their old ranking is not saved in the leaderboard.
en|Brawl est un mode de jeu dans lequel: Brawl is a game mode in which you cannot freely choose your heroes. Instead, each player will have two random heroes to choose from. Battles in this mode take place only on a single lane with two turrets defending the base in both teams respectively. Brawl matches generally end in a much shorter time than Classic Mode and Ranked Mode. This type of match is preferred for increasing lost credit scores or completing tasks.
en|Chaque joueur a le choix entre 2 héro: Each player has the choice between 2 random heroes.
en|Les joueurs ne peuvent acheter des ob: Players can only purchase items once they die or before leaving the altar area each time they respawn.
en|L'autel ne guérit plus ni ne régénère: The altar no longer heals or regenerates mana. All healing effects are halved. The base is no longer restocking.
en|Chaque héros peut avoir un buff ou un: Each hero can have an additional buff or handicap.
en|Les joueurs peuvent discuter pendant: Players can chat during the selection phase.
en|Tous les joueurs commencent au niveau: All players start at level 4 and receive 2,500 starting gold to purchase items. Once they leave the base, they must die to be able to purchase items again.
en|Les héros qui meurent rarement au com: Heroes who rarely die in combat will drop a healing glyph. (Heals both Max HP and Mana.)
en|Les tourelles dans Brawl se comporten: Turrets in Brawl behave the same as in classic games. However the turrets are weaker and do not have a golden shield.
en|La deuxième tourelle de chaque côté l: The second turret on each side releases a wave that kills all minions when destroyed.
en|L'or et l'expérience gagnés grâce aux: Gold and experience gained from minions are higher than in classic mode.
en|Au bout de 12 minutes, les Super Mini: After 12 minutes, the Super Minions are deployed to avoid long games.
en|Il y a deux crabes sur les côtés oppo: There are two crabs on opposite sides of the path that spawn at 0:30 and respawn 30 seconds after dying. Killing a Frozen Crab regenerates small amounts of health, gives gold and a small shield. Nearby allies who help with the crab also receive gold. This crab can be used as a springboard for heroes like Lancelot, Joy or Natalia, interact with certain heroes like Vexana, Benedetta or Yi Sun-shin, or check if the enemy is in the nearest bush or kill yourself to buy items when their health is too low.
en|Il y a deux runes de guérison sur les: There are two healing runes on opposite sides of the path that appear at 0:30 and reappear 35 seconds after being collected. The timer and sound effect are visible and audible to everyone. The rune continuously heals the picker for the 5 second delay, then regenerates some health and up to 40% mana to all allied heroes within range. If the recoverer dies during the delay, the healing is canceled.
en|Il y a un baril de chaque côté qui ap: There is a barrel on each side that appears at 0:20 and every 30 seconds after being picked up. Pick this barrel and shoot at the enemies to surprise them!
en|Le baril rend l'utilisateur impossibl: The barrel makes the user untargetable shortly, deals true damage, and has a 15 second cooldown, making it impossible to pull off two barrels at once. When someone picks up a barrel, a sound is made, audible to everyone on the map.
en|Le Barrel est également désactivé par: The Barrel is also disabled by rooted effect.
en|Un Diggie mort ou un héros impossible: A dead Diggie or an untargetable hero can collect the barrel.
en|Contrairement aux modes Classique ou: Unlike Classic or Ranked modes, there are no rank restrictions in Brawl. This means you can queue up matches where one side is a 5-man solo queue while the other is a team of 5, or one side is a 5-man Mythic Immortal while the other is someone who just downloaded the game.
en|Être AFK, éviter les combats d'équipe: Being AFK, avoiding team fights or verbal abuse is entirely punishable through reporting.
en|Il existe de nombreux héros parmi les: There are many heroes to choose from with different playstyles. Knowing the heroes' skills, strengths, and weaknesses as well as their optimal positioning is essential. Prioritize Assassins, Mages, or Fighters as they deal a lot of damage and provide crowd control. Avoid Marksman as they are item dependent and fragile at first, unless they have good minion clearing and area of ​​effect abilities like Beatrix or Granger. Avoid teams with too many Mages, too many Snipers, or too many Tanks.
en|Flameshot a un temps de recharge très: Flameshot has a very low cooldown and can be used to check the bush, secure kills, or negate abilities.
en|Au moins un joueur doit apporter les: At least one player must bring the following:
en|Revitalisez-vous pour que leur équipe: Revitalize so their team can sustain after the fight as the altar no longer heals, especially when your team is in a bad position and can't secure healing runes; And
en|Purifiez, si votre héros a de bons dé: Purify, if your hero has good damage but is vulnerable to crowd control (CC).
en|Cependant, Sprint n’est pas très reco: However, Sprint is not highly recommended.
en|La carte unique de Brawl peut amélior: Brawl's unique card can massively buff heroes such as Luo Yi, Odette, Lancelot, Xavier, Fanny while heroes who rely too much on basic attacks like Freya or Thamuz become useless.
en|De même, il faudra éviter de rester p: Likewise, you will need to avoid staying close to each other when the enemies are Atlas or Tigreal.
en|Au lieu d’acheter un article décent,: Instead of purchasing a decent item, purchasing smaller components might give a better advantage. You can also wait a few seconds and send a message to your allies that you are almost enough gold to purchase items.j
en|au lieu de précipiter une équipe de 5: Instead of rushing a 5-man team with full Sky Piercer, a healing-reducing item can greatly counter the enemy team.
en|Profitez des buissons pour tendre une: Take advantage of the bushes to ambush enemies, especially suitable for heroes like Helcurt, Hilda, Natalia, Luo Yi. Be careful if enemies have such heroes.
en|Au début, les joueurs auront le choix: At the start, players will have the choice between 2 heroes. If no hero really suits you, you roll a die to obtain a new hero and send your discarded hero to the reserve for the others. Sometimes just one discarded hero is enough for everyone to swap. You can chat and ask other players or use quick chats and emotes. Keep in mind that if the hero is discarded twice and disappears from everyone's selection, he might reappear if you use another die, which would waste your dice. Up to 10 heroes can appear on the abandoned location.
en|Certains héros sont difficiles à joue: Some heroes are difficult for you to play, but that doesn't mean it's difficult for your allies, swap them and avoid accumulating two good heroes while your allies have none.
en|Puisqu'il n'y a qu'une seule voie, il: Since there is only one lane, it's easier to guess your opponents' moves and place your hero in the best position to defend or attack.
en|Lorsque l'équipe ennemie a Xavier, No: When the enemy team has Xavier, Novaria, expect you to be damaged or revealed by purchasing items from the altar or reaching the battlefield.
en|Vous pouvez vérifier les objets des e: You can check enemies' items to see if they have left their altar or not.
en|Vous pouvez économiser un baril pour: You can save a barrel to escape after a dive, turret dive, or use it to shorten the distance with Flicker. Barrels first appear at 20 seconds, while the first healing runes last for 30 seconds. It's best to secure the bush to the right and the glyph nearby, so your team can at least turn off a healing option after the enemies fight. Use the barrel to stop enemies when they try to secure the healing rune.
en|Tous les héros reçoivent Flicker par: All heroes receive Flicker by default alongside another chosen combat spell.
en|Tous les sorts de combat commencent a: All combat spells start on 50% of their normal cooldown.
en|Comme certains héros seront trop puis: As some heroes will be too powerful or too disadvantaged in Brawl, certain buffs or handicaps are added to certain heroes as follows:
en|Il y a quatre portes pour Chip, chaqu: There are four doors for Chip, each side has one near the base, while the other two are on either side of the opposite bushes.
en|Le mode « Vs A.I » dans Mobile Legend: The "Vs A.I" mode in Mobile Legends: Bang Bang was introduced towards the end of 2017, shortly after the game's global release. Originally featuring only easy and normal difficulties, the mode underwent significant upgrades, including a hard mode added during Project Next in 2020 and a modernized and challenging AI. training methods published around November 2023.
en|Il existe trois modes de jeu que vous: There are three game modes you can choose in this mode: Classic, Brawl, and Draft Pick.
en|Il existe également trois niveaux de: There are also three difficulty levels: AI: Simple, AI: Normal, and AI: Hard.
en|AI:Easy a une IA très simple, idéale: AI:Easy has a very simple AI, ideal for practicing a hero you have just unlocked or don't know yet.
en|AI: Normal a des adversaires IA légèr: AI: Normal has slightly more advanced AI opponents who can sometimes pose a threat when farming, use their skills carefully. This difficulty is a bit more complex than AI: simple and a much better option for training a hero in near-real combat.
en|AI:Hard a des adversaires IA moyennem: AI:Hard has moderately advanced AI opponents who know when to use their combat spells and time their skills correctly to kill their opponent. They also attack turrets correctly, unlike normal and simple where they die on purpose, they also know how to macro and track their team, and actually know how to escape, it is recommended to use the main hero.
en|Les jeux personnalisés sont très simi: Custom games are very similar to Vs. AI. The difference is that players are pitted against other people or AI. Players can invite friends to join the game or add AI with existing buttons. Players can also add an AI to the opposing team or your team, you can also play alone with an AI.
en|Le mode personnalisé n'affectera pas: Custom mode will not affect your rank, hero mastery, or placement. You will also not gain any BP or EXP.
en|Si vous avez des cartes d'essai avec: If you have trial cards with heroes that you don't yet have Draft Pick, there is still a bug that allows you to use that trial card with the hero you still don't have, the trial card will not be consumed/used.
en|La plupart des joueurs utilisent géné: Most players usually use customization to compete in 1v1 or organize custom matches between 2 teams (tournaments).
en|Les modes Arcade sont un mode de jeu: Arcade modes are an additional game mode in Mobile Legends: Bang Bang that can be played from time to time during special events, holidays, or occasions. The mode features various strategy-based subgames, listed below.
en|Dans le passé, ce jeu n’avait pas vra: In the past, this game didn't really have an official name. This game mode was first released and it was simply the Summer Carnival that arrived and contained consumables to improve the heroes' skills, with a modified map corresponding to Summer. During Halloween, this mode returned with the same features as Summer Carnival, modified skills, bonus candies, and Halloween-themed map. Then Christmas came and the mode had the same features; However, even though the map was changed to fit Christmas, the candies were kept as consumables. And then Easter came. Finally, Mayhem mode was introduced: this time the game mode had no consumables, but it had modified skills and map changes.
en|Il n'y a que 50 héros disponibles dan: There are only 50 heroes available in this mode.
en|Duels du même héros mais utilisant de: Duels of the same hero but using different tactics!
en|Le mode Miroir utilise la même carte: Mirror mode uses the same map as Bruno Cup Mayhem mode (in fact, the map layout, Lord and minions have the same theme), however, during the selection phase, in each team, players will vote for one from six randomly chosen heroes. Whoever gets the most votes will be the hero chosen for their entire team. Similar to Mayhem mode, players will start at hero level 4 and receive 900 gold. As in all game modes, the objective is to destroy the enemy base.
en|Serez-vous celui qui tiendra jusqu'au: Will you be the one who lasts until the last?
en|Survival est similaire à n'importe qu: Survival is similar to any other Battle Royale game, but with a few tweaks to fit Mobile Legends. Survival only works with teams of 3 players in a 99 player battle (33 teams) and the map will not be the Heavenly Palace or the Western Expanse, as in other game modes, instead it will be set on a single map, Minos' Labyrinth, which is a very large map to accommodate 99 players. Survival only offers 15 selectable heroes, dividing them into three groups of 5: Physical, Magic and Defense. Looting in this game mode is different from Battle Royales: you have to kill Creeps/Jungle Monsters to make them drop items, and there are 4 new Creeps in this game mode, each with different chances of dropping items for the three categories. To learn more about this game mode, click on the highlighted text above.
en|Entrez dans Eruditio et efforcez-vous: Enter Eruditio and strive to be the last one standing.
en|Ces derniers temps, un concours des p: In recent times, a most fascinating competition, whose popularity is growing day by day, has taken Eruditio by storm. Known as “Survival: Nexus,” it attracts participants from across Eruditio. Convenient terminals allow participants to control Beatrix's virtual avatars using only their brain waves, immersing themselves in a virtual realm. Here they can participate in a tactical competition in which the last player standing receives a huge reward. Seize your chance while you can, adventurers, and join Survival: Nexus!
en|Jouez différents héros dans un seul m: Play different heroes in one match!
en|Il s'agit d'un autre type de jeu sur: This is another type of game in Mobile Legends, selection is very similar to survival in which the player has to choose a hero from the randomly selected heroes whether he owns it or not. In gameplay, when the hero dies, the player must choose another hero. If two players have chosen the same hero, they must choose another. There are two ways to achieve victory: either destroy the enemy base or achieve 30 victories before the enemy. In 2019, it is released in coordination with the Spring Festival. The battlefield therefore rises to the occasion.
en|Dans ce mode, divers produits aliment: In this mode, various food items can be found in the mode. By collecting different food items, players can obtain different buffs that improve their hero abilities. Some achievements are exclusive to Frenzy mode and can only be obtained by playing this mode.
en|Les produits alimentaires peuvent êtr: Food items can be found where some of the creeps are killed, where some of the special minions are killed, where the enemy heroes are killed, and at supply points inside the house and enemy base.
en|Dans ce mode de jeu, 15 joueurs sont: In this game mode, 15 players are dropped onto a map where they must level up and evolve by collecting gems dropped by monsters or randomly appearing on the map, with the goal of being the last player standing. Killing an enemy player will not eliminate them, rather they will suffer a respawn time penalty and lose experience; however, once the first player reaches level 15 and becomes the "Devil", all deaths are permanent.
en|Les monstres lâcheront également des: Monsters will also drop colored gems that permanently increase stats: red gems increase physical attack, blue gems increase magic attack, and green gems increase HP. Different monsters drop different gems. Some higher level monsters will also drop combat spells to equip; Only one can be equipped at a time, as one is already given upon reaching level 6.
en|Il n'y a pas d'écran de sélection de: There is no champion select screen, all players start as level 1 “Cells” and can progress by reaching certain experience levels.
en|Ils ne peuvent pas attaquer et ont un: They can't attack and have low health, but since everyone started in this state, this isn't a problem. They are also the fastest monsters.
en|Les monstres n'apparaîtront pas à ce: Monsters will not appear at this point in the game.
en|Une fois atteint le niveau 3, les jou: Once reaching level 3, players can choose to evolve into Basic Minion, Ranged Minion, or Ballista Minion.
en|En plus d'avoir une attaque et une vi: In addition to having a different attack and speed, this choice also affects all subsequent available evolutions.
en|Après 1 minute, des monstres commence: After 1 minute, monsters start appearing. At this point, only blue and red gelatins will appear, but they will not attack players.
en|Les joueurs évolueront dans différent: Players will evolve into different monsters depending on the minion they choose. Minor monsters will each have a skill.
en|Parcours physique : Si le joueur a ch: Physical course: If the player chose Basic Minion, he will evolve into Giant Mouth or Crammer.
en|: 1. La compétence de Giant Mouth inf: :1. Giant Mouth's skill will deal damage to an enemy equal to a percentage of the target's max HP.
en|: 2. La compétence de Crammer augment: :2. Crammer's skill will significantly increase his lifesteal for a while.
en|Parcours magique : Si le joueur a cho: Magical journey: If the player chose Ranged Minion, he will evolve into a Goblin or Crimson Lizard.
en|: 1. La compétence du gobelin lancera: :1. The Goblin's skill will throw a very damaging ball of energy in one direction.
en|: 2. La compétence de Crimson Lizard: :2. Crimson Lizard's skill will create a zone of energy that continuously deals damage to enemies inside.
en|Route Tank : Si le joueur a choisi Ba: Route Tank: If the player chose Ballista Minion, it will evolve into Spinner or Death.
en|: 1. La compétence de Spinner régénér: :1. Spinner's skill will instantly regenerate a certain amount of HP.
en|: 2. La compétence de la mort inflige: :2. Death skill will continuously deal damage to surrounding enemies.
en|Lorsqu'ils atteignent le niveau 6, le: When reaching level 6, players can also choose one of two random combat spells to equip for the remainder of the match. Possible combat spells are Flicker, Sprint, Execute, Inspire, and Aegis.
en|Niveau 9 : Monstres majeurs Les monst: Level 9: Major Monsters Major monsters will have two skills, many of which are inspired by skills of existing heroes or attacks that these monsters perform in other game modes.
en|Si le joueur a choisi la voie Physiqu: If the player chose the Physical path, he will evolve into a Gargoyle or Cleaver.
en|: 1. La compétence 1 de Gargouille au: : 1. Gargoyle skill 1 will increase his movement speed for a while, skill 2 will increase his attack.
en|: 2. La compétence 1 de Cleaver est u: :2. Cleaver's skill 1 is a flicker similar to Flicker, his skill 2 is his signature delayed wave attack from other game modes.
en|Si le joueur a choisi la voie Magique: If the player has chosen the Magic path, he will evolve into a Pioneer or a Statued Chaser.
en|: 1. La compétence 1 de Pioneer lance: :1. Pioneer's skill 1 launches an orb that will block enemies similar to Cyclops Ultimate, skill 2 is his poison trap characteristic of other game modes, but in a straight line.
en|: 2. La compétence 1 de Statued Chase: :2. Statued Chaser skill 1 is similar to Gusion's first skill (they will throw a dagger in one direction, and if it hits an enemy, the skill can be used again to chase them); skill 2 will attack enemies in front of it, dealing high damage.
en|Si le joueur a choisi l'évolution Tan: If the player chose the Tank evolution, he will evolve into Statued Shocker or Core Guard.
en|: 1. La compétence 1 du Statued Shock: : 1. The Statued Shocker's skill 1 will enhance his next basic attack, which will stun enemies; skill 2 will provide them with a shield that will explode after a certain amount of time or when destroyed, similar to Uranus' second skill.
en|: 2. La compétence 1 de Core Guard na: :2. Core Guard skill 1 will taunt nearby enemies, forcing them to attack, skill 2 will reflect damage received for a certain time. (Both skills resemble Gatotkaca's second skill.)
en|En atteignant le niveau 9, les joueur: Upon reaching level 9, players can also choose one of two passive buffs that last the rest of the match, depending on their path:
en|Buffs physiques : 30 % de dégâts d'at: Physical Buffs: 30% Attack Damage or 40% Attack Speed
en|Buffs magiques : 40 % de réduction de: Magic Buffs: 40% CD reduction or 40% Spell Vamp
en|Buffs de tank : 2 % de la santé est c: Tank Buffs: 2% of health converted to damage or recovers 300 HP every 5 seconds
en|Dès qu'au moins un joueur a atteint l: Once at least one player has reached level 9, minor monsters will also start appearing as monsters; they will attack players if provoked and drop more gems.
en|Une « tortue noire » peut également a: A “black turtle” may also appear. It can drop large quantities of large gems. Its location will be visible on each player's map.
en|Niveau 12 : Héros (Besoin de plus d'i: Tier 12: Hero (Need more info: Available heroes may specifically change based on Tier 6 and Tier 9 routes. More heroes may be available than listed.)
en|Si le joueur a choisi la voie physiqu: If the player chose the physical path, Marksman or Assassin heroes will be available.
en|Si le joueur a choisi la voie magique: If the player chose the magic path, Mage or Support heroes will be available.
en|: Mage : Odette, Gord, Alice, Esmeral: : Mage: Odette, Gord, Alice, Esmeralda, Harley.
en|Si le joueur a choisi l'évolution Tan: If the player chose the Tank evolution, Fighter or Tank heroes will be available.
en|Lorsque le premier joueur atteint le: When the first player reaches level 13, major monsters will start appearing. They can drop larger gems that are worth more than normal gems, and even equipable combat spells. Large experience gems will also start to appear.
en|Le premier joueur à atteindre le nive: The first player to reach level 15 will become the Devil. They will get bigger and their stats will increase, but they will move slower and their position will be revealed on all other players' maps. They will also have the ability to transform into a Lord for a time, gaining powerful new skills that resemble the Lord's attack from other game modes.
en|: Compétence 1 et Compétence 2, « Lor: : Skill 1 and Skill 2, "Lord Strikes": Pounds the ground heavily, dealing real damage to surrounding enemies and leaving a crack beneath their current position; after a while, the crack will explode, dealing damage and knocking down enemies.
en|: Compétence 3, « Frappes tournantes: : Skill 3, "Spinning Strikes": After charging for a short time, the Lord will spin his hammer, dealing true damage to surrounding enemies in a wide area.
en|Tout autre joueur atteignant le nivea: Any other player reaching level 15 will not become the Devil: the only way to claim the title and buffs is to kill the current Devil.
en|Dans cette étape finale, la zone de s: In this final stage, the safe zone will begin to slowly shrink, forming a circle centered on the current "Devil" and forcing other players to move closer to them. the area will move with the Devil, trying to keep them in its center. Now killing a player will eliminate them from the match.
en|La mystérieuse faille dans l’univers: The mysterious rift in the parallel universe is gradually widening. A Zlatan airship is about to crash into the Land of Dawn, which would be a disaster and a challenge! Warriors, Ravage is now open. Show your courage and strength to save Zlatan and defend the Land of Dawn.
en|Ravage est un mode dans lequel chaque: Ravage is a mode in which each team consists of 5 different roles and fights for the Aquamarines. Each player can choose 5 heroes with different roles before participating in a Ravage match. After the confrontation, each player randomly uses one of the 5 heroes they chose previously.
en|Dans ce mode, S.A.B.E.R. et V.E.N.O.M: In this mode, S.A.B.E.R. and V.E.N.O.M. are fighting. As they fight, aquamarines begin to fall around them. The first team to collect a certain amount of Aquamarine will win the match. Being eliminated causes the player to lose all aquamarines, which scatter on the ground. If a player has more than 10 aquamarines, their location will be exposed on the mini-map.
en|Au centre de la carte du mode Ravage: In the center of the Ravage mode map is the only HP regeneration point. Once eliminated, players quickly respawn in the Control Center and can rejoin the battle very quickly. Eliminating enemies and collecting their aquamarines is the goal of this mode.
en|La première équipe à accumuler 15 Aig: The first team to accumulate 15 Aquamarines will win this match. No laning, no destructive turrets, killing and ravaging is the goal of this mode! Come have fun, you will be the winner!
en|Du 7 au 13 août 2020, le mode Ravage: From August 7 to 13, 2020, Ravage mode returned with a new 3V3 mode. Only 3 out of 5 roles will be used and all players will start with 30,000 and a hero level of 15 (max).
en|Match de bagarre passionnant entre le: Exciting brawling match between mirrored heroes!
en|Sélection de héros : dans ce mode, le: Hero Selection: In this mode, players vote for the hero they want to use from a random set of heroes. The hero with the most votes will become the hero used by the entire team.
en|Ajustement des héros : dans ce mode,: Hero Adjustment: In this mode, different heroes receive different attribute upgrades to create more balance between heroes of different roles, improving the overall gaming experience.
en|Harper, qui s'aventurait dans le sud: Harper, who was venturing into the southern Abyss, inadvertently enters the Abyss. He discovers that demons led by the name =Dyrroth are gathering in the Abyss. Soon, they will cross Lantis Mountain and destroy the Moniyan Empire. However, any creatures that get in the way will suffer from the catastrophe.
en|CHESS-TD est un mode Arcade plein de: CHESS-TD is an Arcade mode full of fun and strategy! In this mode, 6 will be spread across 6 maps and will face each other as well as creeps. Players can purchase heroes from the store, purchase their own roster, loot gold, and upgrade their troops to achieve victory.
en|La carte est aléatoire pour chaque ma: The map is random for each match. Players can purchase Heroes from the store and deploy them on stones higher than the ground (slots). Deployed heroes will automatically attack nearby enemies and cast their skill once they gain enough mana.
en|Définition du round : Un round contie: Definition of the round: A round contains 4 phases: the preparation phase, the preparation phase, the combat phase and the resolution phase. The preparation phase involves players buying, deploying, recalling or selling heroes and improving their ability. During the combat phase, one of the other players' heroes will invade your map. If these invaders reach their destination before being eliminated, you will suffer relative damage.
en|Définition de l'or et de la capacité: Gold and Ability Definition: At the end of each round, players will receive a certain amount of gold and interest (for every 10 gold coins owned, get 1 extra gold coin). Additionally, getting winning streaks or losing streaks will also grant additional gold bonus. Capacity decides how many heroes you can deploy. The maximum is 9. At the end of each round, you will get 1 Ability Exp. Additionally, you can choose to purchase 4 Exp Abilities. with 4 gold medals. The chance of obtaining elite heroes increases with the ability level, at the same time, the chance of obtaining common heroes decreases with it.
en|Niveau de héros et étoile : Il existe: Hero Level and Star: There are 4 levels for heroes, which indicate their rarity and cost. Generally speaking, high level heroes should be more powerful. If there are 3 same heroes on the battlefield, they will become a higher level hero. Three 1-star heroes will become one 2-star hero. Three 2-star heroes will become one 3-star hero.
en|Synergie : Chaque héros a 2 attributs: Synergy: Each hero has 2 attributes: faction and role. The synergy effect will be activated if there are enough heroes with the same attributes on the battlefield (the attributes of the same heroes will only be counted once). It is important to take synergy into account.
en|Compétition d'échecs automatique rapi: Fast automatic chess competition between 8 players.
en|Magic Chess est un mode de jeu de str: Magic Chess is a complex 8-player strategy game mode, in which players will compete against each other and against random monsters on the magic chessboard. The goal of this game is to purchase and upgrade your heroes and the Little Commander, customizing your alignment to trigger and counter more and stronger synergies. Victory belongs to the one who holds out to the last!
en|La bagarre sur le pont de la destruct: The fight on the bridge of destruction.
en|Dans Shadow Brawl, les joueurs votent: In Shadow Brawl, players vote to select a hero from several randomly appearing heroes. All players on the team will use the same hero to play. Players are equipped with name=Blade of Silence which marks the current position and connects a chain to it. The chain will automatically return your hero to the marked position after 4 seconds. The CD is 20 seconds long.
en|Un nouveau type de jeu a pris d’assau: A new type of game has taken Moniyan by storm. The Little Commanders and their magical items can now be found in every house in the land. Crystal balls detect all kinds of life in the Land of Dawn and channel their energy; which turns into collectible cards. There are Monster cards and Hero cards. Monsters are easy to earn and control, while heroes require a higher price and more advanced energy. Decks are built and battles are fought with others; people strive to defeat the little enemy commander and achieve victory.
en|En mode \"Arène\", vous affronterez u: In "Arena" mode, you will face another player in a 1v1 battle. Your objective is simple: eliminate your opponent's Little Commander before he takes down yours. To do this, you will need to use cards to summon Heroes and Monsters and cast spells to fight against your opponent's troops. The battle will continue until the Little Commander on one side is eliminated. “Shard”, the resource for summoning monsters and using spells, is generated every 3 seconds. And by spending 5 “Shards”, the resource used to summon Heroes, “Essence”, will be generated.
en|Après être entré dans « l’Arène », vo: After entering the "Arena", you will receive a series of tutorials to help you get started. After going through the full tutorial, you will be rewarded with 9 basic cards. As you play, you can obtain cards from Battle Chests and Summon Orbs. The duplicate cards obtained will be used to improve the corresponding cards to give it more strength. Additionally, more cards will be unlocked as you progress in your ranking. All cards will be unlocked when legend is reached. There are two rarity levels for Hero cards: Uncommon and Epic. There are two maps, Uncommon and Epic. There are also two rarity levels for Monster/Spell cards: Common and Uncommon.
en|Vous pouvez gagner des Cup Points, de: You can earn Cup Points, Battle Points and Battle Chests after each match. More cards can be unlocked with more cup points. You can get battle points or already unlocked cards from battle chests.
en|Un concours fascinant appelé Boommand: A fascinating competition called Boommander is now trending in Laladona, and many Little Commanders have become its fans. The rules are simple: collect Fluffy that grows in the oasis near the Origin Tree and throw these explosive balls at the others. Can you dodge attacks and blast your opponent? Join Boommander and try it now! In Boommander mode, you play as little commanders and launch Fluffy to compete on maps reconstituted with different scene tiles.
it|Le mode classique est le premier et l: La modalità classica è la prima e la più antica modalità di gioco di Mobile Legends. Tutte le altre modalità di gioco utilizzano come base le regole classiche. Questa modalità offre l'esperienza 5v5 e Mobile Legends senza timore di perdere il tuo grado, ma la tua percentuale di vittorie ne risentirà, sia dal lato dell'eroe che in generale.​​​​ La modalità classica è adatta ai principianti che hanno bisogno di familiarizzare con i giochi Mobile Legends. Puoi scegliere liberamente qualsiasi eroe che possiedi, nonché eroi settimanali gratuiti e tutte le carte di prova che possiedi. Tuttavia, non puoi avere più di un eroe nella tua squadra. Puoi anche scegliere l'eroe che preferisci, poiché non è previsto il divieto degli eroi a differenza della modalità classificata.
it|Comme tous les jeux MOBA, l'objectif: Come tutti i giochi MOBA, l'obiettivo principale è distruggere la base nemica. Ciò richiede che tu difenda le tue torrette e la tua base e distrugga le loro. Ogni torretta in una corsia specifica deve essere distrutta in sequenza affinché i tuoi servitori raggiungano la base. Esistono modi per distruggere le torrette utilizzando minion/creep per subire danni dai proiettili delle torrette. Dopo aver distrutto le torrette, potrai danneggiare/distruggere la base nemica. Distruggere l'ultima torretta in una corsia garantirà super servitori che infliggono danni elevati agli eroi e liberano le corsie più velocemente. A volte i giocatori sono costretti a accumulare uccisioni contro gli eroi nemici invece di concentrarsi sui servitori e sulle torrette nemiche. Più uccisioni potrebbero far ottenere loro MVP e coltivare, ma distruggere le torrette, accedere alla base nemica e distruggerla è l'obiettivo principale.
it|Celestial Palace/Western Expanse — Un: Palazzo Celestiale/Distesa Occidentale: un campo ispirato alla versione Defense of the Ancients: Allstars (in breve DOTA) della mappa, con diverse funzionalità e meccaniche modificate. Il gioco è composto da cinque eroi di ciascuna squadra, che vengono poi posizionati in un'arena con l'obiettivo di distruggere l'inibitore di base di tutti, ottenendo la vittoria. Il tempo normalmente necessario per completare la maggior parte dei giochi è di circa 10-15 minuti, ma alcuni giochi possono durare più di 30 minuti.
it|Le champ de bataille est divisé en tr: Il campo di battaglia è diviso in tre corsie per raggiungere la base nemica.
it|Une jungle peuplée de monstres de la: Una giungla popolata da mostri della giungla garantisce potenziamenti curativi, potenziamenti di ruolo e potenziamenti d'oro quando viene sconfitta. Ci sono anche Mostri Boss che forniscono oro per tutta la tua squadra o per il Signore che combatte al tuo fianco.
it|La Voie d'Or peut également être empr: Il Sentiero d'Oro può essere intrapreso anche dai carri armati che si muovono per la squadra per ottenere rapidamente oggetti per supportare la squadra.
it|Classé est un mode de jeu de file d'a: La classifica è una modalità di gioco competitiva in coda. I giocatori guadagnano o perdono stelle se vincono o perdono in questa modalità. Guerriero, Elite, Maestro, Gran Maestro, Epico, Leggenda e Mitico (Onore mitico, Gloria mitica e Immortale mitico) sono i sette gradi di Mobile Legends: Bang Bang.
it|Les joueurs peuvent choisir trois hér: I giocatori possono scegliere tre eroi da includere nella lobby e nella fase di draft. Questi eroi devono essere giocati almeno una volta di seguito.
it|Les joueurs peuvent jouer en solo ou: I giocatori possono giocare da soli o formare una squadra di due, tre o cinque giocatori per mettersi in coda. I giocatori possono invitare altri giocatori di rango superiore o inferiore al loro nella lobby. Non è consentita una squadra di quattro persone.
it|Lorsqu'une équipe avec des joueurs de: Quando una squadra con giocatori di ranghi diversi fa la coda, si chiama Flex Rank e metterà in coda solo le partite della persona con il punteggio più alto.
it|Un joueur Mythique fait équipe avec u: Un giocatore Mitico fa squadra con un giocatore Epico, entrambi seguiranno le regole del draft del giocatore Mitico.
it|Un joueur Mythic Glory fait équipe av: Un giocatore di Mythic Glory fa squadra con un giocatore Grandmaster e un giocatore Legend, i quali seguiranno tutti la regola del draft del giocatore Mythic, sebbene la scelta al Draft non sia normalmente disponibile per i giocatori al di sotto del grado Epico.
it|Cependant, un joueur en file d'attent: Tuttavia, un giocatore in coda in solitario potrebbe ritrovarsi a fare matchmaking con alleati di grado superiore o inferiore, ciò può essere attivato da quanto segue:
it|Les alliés jouent en équipe tandis qu: Gli alleati giocano in squadra mentre tu sei da solo. Tra gli alleati di detta squadra c'è almeno un giocatore di grado simile al tuo.
it|Exemple : un joueur Epic fait équipe: Esempio: un giocatore Epic fa squadra con un giocatore Legend e tu, un giocatore Epic, puoi incontrarli.
it|Tous les joueurs jouent en solo, mais: Tutti i giocatori giocano da soli, ma la squadra nemica ha qualcuno con un grado simile al tuo.
it|Exemple : Votre rang est Légende, mai: Esempio: il tuo grado è Leggenda, ma 4 dei tuoi compagni di squadra sono Mitici. Quindi almeno uno dei nemici è Legend.
it|Lorsque ce phénomène se produit, il e: Quando si verifica questo fenomeno, è possibile che solo un membro della squadra sia in un grado diverso.
it|Exemple : Votre équipe compte 4 joueu: Esempio: la tua squadra ha 4 giocatori al grado Leggenda e 1 giocatore al grado Mitico, ciò significa che la squadra nemica può avere 1-4 giocatori al grado Mitico, ma deve esserci qualcuno al grado Epico.
it|Grâce à cette mécanique de Flex Rank,: Grazie a questa meccanica Flex Rank, anche un giocatore solista di Legend I può mettersi in coda con un alleato di Epic V, poiché sono solo di un grado diverso, ma il divario è molto diverso, portando al sistema oscuro ampiamente percepito.
it|Une option de matchmaking rapide sera: Se la coda impiega troppo tempo verrà offerta un'opzione di matchmaking rapido, questa opzione ti abbinerà anche ai giocatori che hai bloccato in precedenza.
it|Si le joueur que vous avez bloqué fai: Se il giocatore che hai bloccato fa squadra con qualcuno che non blocchi, puoi comunque metterti in coda con lui durante la partita.
it|Lorsqu'un joueur atteint Epic V ou su: Quando un giocatore raggiunge Epic V o superiore (Grandmaster V o superiore nel server avanzato), la scelta al draft diventa disponibile per le partite future. A differenza della scelta alla cieca, la scelta al draft consente a entrambe le squadre di vedere i propri eroi durante la selezione e consente fino a 10 eroi banditi (3/4/5 ban in Epico/Leggenda/Mitico) per ciascuna squadra a fini di bilanciamento. Gli eroi già selezionati o banditi non possono essere scelti per tutta la durata della partita.
it|Il y a sept rangs dans Mobile Legends: Ci sono sette gradi in Mobile Legends: Bang Bang. Sono: Guerriero, Elite, Maestro, Gran Maestro, Epico, Leggendario e Mitico.
it|Chaque rang comporte des divisions éc: Ogni grado ha divisioni scritte in numeri romani e un certo numero di stelle necessarie per essere promossi alla divisione o al grado successivo. Se un giocatore supera il numero massimo di stelle nella divisione attuale o scende al di sotto di zero stelle, può passare alla divisione successiva o tornare alla divisione precedente. Completare tutte le divisioni dal rango attuale o essere retrocesso da tutte le divisioni comporterà la promozione al rango successivo o la retrocessione al rango precedente.
it|Dans Mythic, les étoiles ont été remp: In Mythic, le stelle sono state sostituite con punti per avanzare alla divisione successiva.
it|Points de levée d'étoiles et de prote: Punti di aumento delle stelle e di protezione delle stelle
it|Il existe de nombreuses méthodes pour: Esistono molti metodi per aumentare o prevenire la perdita di stelle, portando all'elevazione delle stelle e ai punti di protezione.
it|La levée d'étoiles permet aux joueurs: Star Raising consente ai giocatori di guadagnare una stella aggiuntiva quando un giocatore raggiunge il 100% di Star Raising Points alla vittoria successiva. 100/200/300/500/700/1000 punti richiesti in Guerriero/Elite/Maestro/Grande Maestro/Epico/Leggenda. I punti bonus per l'aumento delle stelle non possono essere accumulati nei gradi Mitici.
it|La protection des étoiles permet aux: Protezione Stella consente ai giocatori di evitare di perdere una stella in una partita raggiungendo il 100% di punti Protezione Stella o utilizzando le carte Protezione Stella. 100/200/300/500/700/1000/1500 punti richiesti in Guerriero / Elite / Maestro / Gran Maestro / Epico / Leggenda / Mitico.
it|Les cartes de protection des étoiles: Le carte Protezione Stellare si ottengono solitamente tramite eventi di gioco o tramite Starlight Rewards. Generalmente durano solo 7 giorni una volta ottenuti o rivendicati nelle pagine degli eventi.
it|La carte de protection de rang est la: La carta protezione del rango è la carta che ti impedisce di retrocedere una volta raggiunto il rango precedente. Spesso viene acquisito dopo aver raggiunto un rango più alto: da Epico a Leggendario, da Leggenda a Mitico.
it|Seuls les points de protection des ét: In Mythic sono disponibili solo i punti protezione stella, poiché i punti ottenimento stelle sono disabilitati.
it|Les cartes de protection de rang ne p: Le carte di protezione del grado possono essere ottenute solo dai premi di promozione del grado. A differenza dei punti/carte protezione stella, si attivano solo in caso di sconfitte che comportano la retrocessione di un giocatore (ad esempio, una sconfitta che comporta la perdita di stelle da Leggenda V 0 stelle a Epico I 4 stelle, retrocedendo dal grado Leggenda al grado Epico).
it|Une fois la saison terminée, tous les: Una volta terminata la stagione, tutti i giocatori inizieranno la nuova stagione con il nuovo grado in base alla classifica della stagione precedente. Ricevono anche la ricompensa per aver raggiunto un certo grado.
it|La réinitialisation du classement n'e: Il ripristino della classifica viene applicato solo quando il giocatore accede per la prima volta nella nuova stagione, ma la sua vecchia classifica non viene salvata nella classifica.
it|Brawl est un mode de jeu dans lequel: Brawl è una modalità di gioco in cui non puoi scegliere liberamente i tuoi eroi. Invece, ogni giocatore avrà due eroi casuali tra cui scegliere. Le battaglie in questa modalità si svolgono solo su un'unica corsia con due torrette che difendono rispettivamente la base in entrambe le squadre. Le partite di rissa generalmente terminano in un tempo molto più breve rispetto alla modalità classica e alla modalità classificata. Questo tipo di corrispondenza è preferibile per aumentare i punteggi di credito persi o completare attività.
it|Chaque joueur a le choix entre 2 héro: Ogni giocatore può scegliere tra 2 eroi casuali.
it|Les joueurs ne peuvent acheter des ob: I giocatori possono acquistare oggetti solo dopo la morte o prima di lasciare l'area dell'altare ogni volta che si rigenerano.
it|L'autel ne guérit plus ni ne régénère: L'altare non cura più né rigenera il mana. Tutti gli effetti curativi sono dimezzati. La base non viene più rifornita.
it|Chaque héros peut avoir un buff ou un: Ogni eroe può avere un buff o un handicap aggiuntivo.
it|Les joueurs peuvent discuter pendant: I giocatori possono chattare durante la fase di selezione.
it|Tous les joueurs commencent au niveau: Tutti i giocatori iniziano al livello 4 e ricevono 2.500 oro iniziale per acquistare oggetti. Una volta che lasciano la base, devono morire per poter acquistare nuovamente gli oggetti.
it|Les héros qui meurent rarement au com: Gli eroi che muoiono raramente in combattimento lasceranno cadere un glifo curativo. (Cura sia HP massimi che Mana.)
it|Les tourelles dans Brawl se comporten: Le torrette in Brawl si comportano come nei giochi classici. Tuttavia le torrette sono più deboli e non hanno uno scudo dorato.
it|La deuxième tourelle de chaque côté l: La seconda torretta su ciascun lato rilascia un'onda che uccide tutti i servitori quando viene distrutta.
it|L'or et l'expérience gagnés grâce aux: L'oro e l'esperienza guadagnati dai servitori sono più alti che nella modalità classica.
it|Au bout de 12 minutes, les Super Mini: Dopo 12 minuti vengono schierati i Super Minion per evitare partite lunghe.
it|Il y a deux crabes sur les côtés oppo: Ci sono due granchi sui lati opposti del percorso che si generano a 0:30 e si rigenerano 30 secondi dopo la morte. Uccidere un granchio ghiacciato rigenera piccole quantità di salute, fornisce oro e un piccolo scudo. Anche gli alleati vicini che aiutano con il granchio ricevono oro. Questo granchio può essere utilizzato come trampolino di lancio per eroi come Lancillotto, Joy o Natalia, interagisci con alcuni eroi come Vexana, Benedetta o Yi Sun-shin, oppure controlla se il nemico è nel cespuglio più vicino o ucciditi per acquistare oggetti quando la loro salute è troppo bassa.
it|Il y a deux runes de guérison sur les: Ci sono due rune curative sui lati opposti del percorso che appaiono a 0:30 e riappaiono 35 secondi dopo essere state raccolte. Il timer e l'effetto sonoro sono visibili e udibili da tutti. La runa cura continuamente il raccoglitore per un ritardo di 5 secondi, quindi rigenera un po' di salute e fino al 40% di mana a tutti gli eroi alleati nel raggio d'azione. Se il recuperatore muore durante il ritardo, la guarigione viene annullata.
it|Il y a un baril de chaque côté qui ap: C'è un barile su ciascun lato che appare alle 0:20 e ogni 30 secondi dopo essere stato raccolto. Scegli questo barile e spara ai nemici per sorprenderli!
it|Le baril rend l'utilisateur impossibl: Il barile rende l'utente non bersagliabile in breve tempo, infligge danni reali e ha un tempo di recupero di 15 secondi, rendendo impossibile estrarre due barili contemporaneamente. Quando qualcuno prende in mano un barile, viene emesso un suono, udibile da tutti sulla mappa.
it|Le Barrel est également désactivé par: Anche il Barile è disabilitato dall'effetto radicato.
it|Un Diggie mort ou un héros impossible: Un Diggie morto o un eroe non bersagliabile possono raccogliere il barile.
it|Contrairement aux modes Classique ou: A differenza delle modalità Classica o Classificata, in Brawl non ci sono restrizioni di rango. Ciò significa che puoi mettere in coda partite in cui una parte è una coda in solitario da 5 uomini mentre l'altra è una squadra da 5, o una parte è un Mythic Immortal da 5 uomini mentre l'altra è qualcuno che ha appena scaricato il gioco.
it|Être AFK, éviter les combats d'équipe: Essere AFK, evitare scontri di squadra o abusi verbali è interamente punibile attraverso la segnalazione.
it|Il existe de nombreux héros parmi les: Ci sono molti eroi tra cui scegliere con stili di gioco diversi. Conoscere le abilità, i punti di forza e di debolezza degli eroi, nonché il loro posizionamento ottimale, è essenziale. Dai la priorità ad Assassini, Maghi o Guerrieri poiché infliggono molti danni e forniscono controllo sulla folla. Evita i tiratori scelti poiché all'inizio dipendono dagli oggetti e sono fragili, a meno che non abbiano una buona eliminazione dei minion e abilità ad area di effetto come Beatrix o Granger. Evita le squadre con troppi maghi, troppi cecchini o troppi carri armati.
it|Flameshot a un temps de recharge très: Flameshot ha un tempo di recupero molto basso e può essere utilizzato per controllare il cespuglio, uccidere in sicurezza o negare abilità.
it|Au moins un joueur doit apporter les: Almeno un giocatore deve portare con sé quanto segue:
it|Revitalisez-vous pour que leur équipe: Rivitalizza in modo che la tua squadra possa sostenere dopo il combattimento poiché l'altare non guarisce più, specialmente quando la tua squadra è in una brutta posizione e non può assicurarsi le rune curative; E
it|Purifiez, si votre héros a de bons dé: Purifica, se il tuo eroe ha un buon danno ma è vulnerabile al controllo della folla (CC).
it|Cependant, Sprint n’est pas très reco: Tuttavia, Sprint non è altamente raccomandato.
it|La carte unique de Brawl peut amélior: La carta unica di Brawl può potenziare in modo massiccio eroi come Luo Yi, Odette, Lancillotto, Xavier e Fanny, mentre gli eroi che fanno troppo affidamento sugli attacchi base come Freya o Thamuz diventano inutili.
it|De même, il faudra éviter de rester p: Allo stesso modo, dovrai evitare di restare vicini quando i nemici sono Atlas o Tigreal.
it|Au lieu d’acheter un article décent,: Invece di acquistare un articolo decente, acquistare componenti più piccoli potrebbe offrire un vantaggio migliore. Puoi anche attendere qualche secondo e inviare un messaggio ai tuoi alleati che hai quasi abbastanza oro per acquistare oggetti.j
it|au lieu de précipiter une équipe de 5: Invece di assalire una squadra di 5 uomini con Sky Piercer completo, un oggetto che riduce la guarigione può contrastare notevolmente la squadra nemica.
it|Profitez des buissons pour tendre une: Approfitta dei cespugli per tendere un'imboscata ai nemici, particolarmente adatto per eroi come Helcurt, Hilda, Natalia, Luo Yi. Fai attenzione se i nemici hanno tali eroi.
it|Au début, les joueurs auront le choix: All'inizio, i giocatori potranno scegliere tra 2 eroi. Se nessun eroe è davvero adatto a te, lancia un dado per ottenere un nuovo eroe e mandare il tuo eroe scartato nella riserva per gli altri. A volte basta un solo eroe scartato perché tutti possano scambiarlo. Puoi chattare e chiedere ad altri giocatori o utilizzare chat veloci ed emote. Tieni presente che se l'eroe viene scartato due volte e scompare dalla selezione di tutti, potrebbe riapparire se usi un altro dado, il che sprecherebbe i tuoi dadi. Fino a 10 eroi possono apparire nel luogo abbandonato.
it|Certains héros sont difficiles à joue: Alcuni eroi sono difficili da giocare per te, ma ciò non significa che sia difficile per i tuoi alleati, scambiali ed evita di accumulare due buoni eroi mentre i tuoi alleati non ne hanno.
it|Puisqu'il n'y a qu'une seule voie, il: Poiché c'è solo una corsia, è più facile indovinare le mosse dei tuoi avversari e posizionare il tuo eroe nella posizione migliore per difendere o attaccare.
it|Lorsque l'équipe ennemie a Xavier, No: Quando la squadra nemica ha Xavier, Novaria, aspettati di essere danneggiato o rivelato acquistando oggetti dall'altare o raggiungendo il campo di battaglia.
it|Vous pouvez vérifier les objets des e: Puoi controllare gli oggetti dei nemici per vedere se hanno lasciato il loro altare o meno.
it|Vous pouvez économiser un baril pour: Puoi salvare un barile per scappare dopo un'immersione, un'immersione in torretta o usarlo per accorciare la distanza con Flicker. I barili compaiono per la prima volta dopo 20 secondi, mentre le prime rune curative durano 30 secondi. È meglio proteggere il cespuglio a destra e il glifo nelle vicinanze, in modo che la tua squadra possa almeno disattivare un'opzione di guarigione dopo che i nemici hanno combattuto. Usa il barile per fermare i nemici quando cercano di impossessarsi della runa curativa.
it|Tous les héros reçoivent Flicker par: Tutti gli eroi ricevono Flicker per impostazione predefinita insieme a un altro incantesimo di combattimento scelto.
it|Tous les sorts de combat commencent a: Tutti gli incantesimi di combattimento iniziano al 50% del loro normale tempo di recupero.
it|Comme certains héros seront trop puis: Poiché alcuni eroi saranno troppo potenti o troppo svantaggiati in Brawl, alcuni buff o handicap verranno aggiunti ad alcuni eroi come segue:
